renderings.arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

english.text: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Au nom d’Allah, le Tout Miséricordieux, le Très Miséricordieux[1].
french.footnotes: [1] Nombreux sont les exégètes qui expliquent la différence entre le nom divin « Ar-Rahmân » (traduit ici par « le Tout Miséricordieux ») et le nom « Ar-Rahîm » (traduit par « le Très Miséricordieux »), tous deux tirés de l’attribut divin « Ar-Rahmah » (la miséricorde), de cette manière : Allah est Tout Miséricordieux dans Son Essence, Très Miséricordieux envers Ses créatures.

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: All praise be to Allah[1], the Lord[2] of the worlds[3],
english.footnotes:
[1] Allah is God’s most unique name.
 [2] The Arabic term "rabb" (translated as "Lord") includes all of the following meanings: "owner, master, ruler, controller, sustainer, provider, guardian and caretaker."
 [3] "the worlds" means mankind, jinn, and all that exists.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Louange à Allah, Seigneur de la Création[2],
french.footnotes: [2] Littéralement : des mondes, c’est-à-dire, expliquent les exégètes, le Seigneur de tout ce qui existe en dehors du Créateur, d’où notre traduction.

renderings.arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

english.text: the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful[4],
english.footnotes: [4] Ar-Rahmān and Ar-Raheem are two names of Allah: Rahmān is used only to describe Allah, while raheem might be used to describe a human as well. Rahmān carries a wider meaning - merciful to all creation. Justice is a part of this mercy. Raheem includes the concept of specialty - especially merciful to the believers. Forgiveness is a part of this mercy. In addition, Rahmān is adjectival, referring to an attribute of Allah and is part of His essence. Raheem is verbal, indicating what He does: i.e., bestowing and implementing mercy.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le Tout Miséricordieux, le Très Miséricordieux,

renderings.arabic: مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

english.text: Master[5] of the Day of Judgment.
english.footnotes: [5] Other meanings for "Mālik": Sovereign, Owner, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Maître souverain du Jour de la rétribution.

renderings.arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ

english.text: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Toi seul que nous adorons et de Toi seul que nous implorons aide.

renderings.arabic: ٱهۡدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ

english.text: Guide us to the straight path,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Guide-nous dans le droit chemin,

renderings.arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

english.text: the path of those whom You have blessed[6]; not of those who incurred Your Wrath[7], or of those who went astray[8].
english.footnotes:
[6] The way of the Prophets and those who follow them.
 [7] Those who know the Truth and do not follow it, like the Jews.
 [8] Those who are ignorant of the Truth and follow misguidance, like the Christians.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: chemin de ceux que Tu as comblés de Tes grâces, non celui des réprouvés[3], ni celui des égarés[4].
french.footnotes:
[3] Littéralement : ceux qui ont attiré sur eux la colère d’Allah. Et ce, pour avoir sciemment tourné le dos à la vérité.
[4] Ceux qui, par ignorance, se sont détournés du droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: الٓمٓ

english.text: Alif Lām Mīm[1].
english.footnotes: [1] Allah knows the meaning of these disjointed Arabic letters. This bears testimony to the inimitable nature of the Qur’an and its divine source.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Alif-Lâm-Mîm.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voici le commentaire d’Ibn Kathîr, le plus fameux exégète musulman, au sujet de ces lettres isolées appartenant à l’alphabet arabe et apparaissant au début de vingt-neuf des cent quatorze sourates du Coran : « Certains expliquent que ces lettres sont mentionnées au début de certains chapitres pour démontrer le caractère miraculeux du texte coranique que les hommes sont incapables d’imiter alors qu’il est composé de ces lettres dont ils font pourtant un usage quotidien. »

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛ فِيهِۛ هُدٗى لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for the righteous[2],
english.footnotes: [2] Literally, "those who have taqwā," i.e., who have piety, righteousness, fear and love of Allah, and who take great care of avoiding His displeasure.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici le Livre qui n’admet aucun doute[2] et qui est un guide pour ceux qui craignent le Seigneur[3],
french.footnotes:
[2] Quant à son origine divine, précisent certains commentateurs.
[3] La notion de « Taqwâ » sera, selon le contexte, rendue comme ici par l’expression « craindre le Seigneur », et plus rarement par la formule « se préserver du châtiment » comme au verset 21 de cette même sourate, ou l’expression : « se préserver du péché », comme au verset 183. Seule en effet la crainte d’Allah et de Son châtiment pousse le croyant à se préserver du péché.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ

english.text: those who believe in the unseen, establish prayer[3], and spend out of what We[4] have provided for them,
english.footnotes: [3] At its proper times and fulfill its all conditions. [4] "We" in reference to Allah in the Qur’anic verses is necessarily understood to denote grandeur and power.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui croient aux mystères[4], accomplissent la prière[5] et offrent par charité[6] une partie de ce que Nous leur avons accordé,
french.footnotes:
[4] Qui croient notamment en Allah, en Ses anges, au Jour dernier, au Paradis et à l’Enfer, pourtant inaccessibles au regard. Les « mystères » de l’islam ne sont donc pas ceux du christianisme (Trinité, Incarnation ou Rédemption) qui, pour leur part, sont inaccessibles à la raison.
[5] La « Salât », prière rituelle formée notamment de la lecture du Coran en position debout, d’inclinaisons et de prosternations, que les musulmans sont tenus d’effectuer cinq fois par jour.
[6] Ou : par obéissance à Allah.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ وَبِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ

english.text: and those who believe in what has been sent down to you [O Prophet] and in what was sent down before you[5], and in the Hereafter they believe with certainty.
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., the Taurāt (Torah) and the Injīl (Gospel), etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui croient au Livre[7] qui t’a été révélé[8] et aux Ecritures[9] révélées avant toi, et qui ont une foi inébranlable en l’au-delà.
french.footnotes:
[7] Employé seul et avec une majuscule, le terme « Livre » désignera généralement dans cette traduction le livre par excellence, le Coran.
[8] Littéralement : qui a été descendu sur toi. Nous traduirons, en général, cette idée de « descente de la Révélation » par le verbe « révéler » et ses dérivés, plutôt que par le verbe « descendre » et ses dérivés. Il est évident, d’ailleurs, que toute révélation est une « descente » puisqu’elle émane d’Allah qui est au Ciel.
[9] C’est le terme qui sera employé dans cette traduction pour désigner les Livres révélés aux juifs et aux chrétiens, l’Ancien et le Nouveau Testament, que ce terme désigne l’ensemble de ces livres ou une partie seulement.

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

english.text: It is they who are upon guidance from their Lord, and it is they who are successful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà ceux qui sont guidés par leur Seigneur, voilà les bienheureux.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Those who persist in disbelief, it is the same whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui ont rejeté la foi, que tu les avertisses ou non, ils ne croiront pas.

renderings.arabic: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَعَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِمۡۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ غِشَٰوَةٞۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: Allah has sealed their hearts and their hearing, and their sight is covered[6]; and for them there will be a great punishment.
english.footnotes: [6] A covering preventing from discerning guidance, as a result of their arrogance and persistence in sin.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah, en effet, a apposé un sceau sur leurs cœurs[10] et leur ouïe[11], tandis qu’un voile leur recouvre la vue. Ils sont donc voués à d’affreux tourments.
french.footnotes:
[10] Qui sont donc fermés à la foi.
[11] Ils sont donc sourds à la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: There are some people[7] who say, “We believe in Allah and the Last Day,” whereas they are not believers.
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., the hypocrites.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est des hommes qui prétendent croire en Allah et au Jour dernier alors qu’ils ne sont nullement croyants[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Après celle des croyants, puis des impies, est décrite ici l’attitude des hypocrites.

renderings.arabic: يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَمَا يَخۡدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

english.text: They seek to deceive Allah and those who believe, while they deceive none but themselves, but they do not realize.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils pensent pouvoir tromper Allah et les croyants, mais ne trompent en réalité qu’eux-mêmes, sans en être conscients.

renderings.arabic: فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡذِبُونَ

english.text: In their hearts is a sickness[8], and Allah increased their sickness, and they will have a painful punishment for their persistent lying.
english.footnotes: [8] The "sickness" mentioned here includes doubt, hypocrisy, arrogance and disbelief.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leurs cœurs sont atteints d’un mal qu’Allah ne fait qu’aggraver. Ils sont donc, pour prix de leurs mensonges, voués à un douloureux châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُونَ

english.text: When it is said to them, “Do not spread corruption in the land,” they say, “We are only reformers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’il leur est demandé de cesser de répandre le mal sur terre, ils répondent qu’ils recherchent le bien uniquement.

renderings.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ

english.text: Indeed, it is they who spread corruption, but they do not realize.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce sont, au contraire, les êtres les plus malfaisants, sans en être conscients.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ ءَامِنُواْ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: When it is said to them, “Believe as the people have believed,” they say, “Shall we believe as the fools[9] have believed?” Indeed, it is they who are the fools, but they do not know.
english.footnotes: [9] The hypocrites were considering the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) to be fools, whereas they themselves were fools.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exhortés à adhérer pleinement à la foi, à l’image des vrais croyants, ils disent : « Allons-nous croire comme ces ignorants ? » Ce sont pourtant eux, sans le savoir, qui sont ignorants.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ شَيَٰطِينِهِمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

english.text: When they meet those who believe, they say, “We believe.” But when they are alone with their evil ones[10], they say, “We are certainly with you; we were only mocking.”
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., their leaders in evil and disbelief.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’ils rencontrent les croyants, ils prétendent avoir la foi, mais dès qu’ils se retrouvent seuls avec leurs démons, les chefs de l’impiété, ils leur disent : « Nous sommes à vos côtés. Nous nous moquons simplement de ces gens. »

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَهۡزِئُ بِهِمۡ وَيَمُدُّهُمۡ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

english.text: Allah will mock them[11] and prolong them to wander blindly in their transgression.
english.footnotes: [11] Allah mocks them in response to their mocking Muslims.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah répondra à leurs moqueries et les laissera s’enfoncer dans l’impiété aveuglément.

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ

english.text: They are those who purchased misguidance for guidance, but their trade was profitless, and they were not guided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà ceux qui ont préféré, au droit chemin, la voie de l’égarement et qui courent à leur perte pour ce choix inconséquent.

renderings.arabic: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارٗا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ لَّا يُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: Their likeness is that of someone who kindles a fire. When it illuminates all around him, Allah takes away their light, leaving them in utter darkness, unable to see[12].
english.footnotes: [12] This is the situation of the hypocrites in the darkness of doubt and disbelief, not seeing the truth and guidance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils sont à l’image d’un groupe d’hommes qui ont allumé un feu mais qui, à peine ont-ils profité de sa clarté, se voient privés par Allah de sa lumière et plongés dans l’obscurité, incapables de distinguer les lieux environnants[13].
french.footnotes: [13] Parabole de l’hypocrite qui, bien qu’au contact de la lumière de la foi, se retrouve dans les ténèbres de l’impiété, incapable de trouver le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: صُمُّۢ بُكۡمٌ عُمۡيٞ فَهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: Deaf, dumb, and blind; they will not return [to the straight path].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sourds, muets, aveugles à la vérité, ils ne peuvent revenir de leur égarement.

renderings.arabic: أَوۡ كَصَيِّبٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٞ وَرَعۡدٞ وَبَرۡقٞ يَجۡعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: Or like a downpour from the sky accompanied by darkness, thunder, and lightning. They put their fingers into their ears out of thunderclaps, for fear of death. But Allah encompasses the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou à l’image d’hommes qui, sous une pluie battante accompagnée de ténèbres, de tonnerre et d’éclairs, se bouchent les oreilles, terrorisés par le fracas de la foudre et à l’idée de mourir foudroyés. Allah cerne de toutes parts les mécréants.

renderings.arabic: يَكَادُ ٱلۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوۡاْ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُواْۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

english.text: The lightning almost snatches away their eyesight. Every time lightning[13] strikes, they walk in its light, but when it becomes dark, they stand still. If Allah had willed, He would have taken away their hearing and their sight; for Allah is Most Capable of all things.
english.footnotes: [13] The parable of lightning is that of the light of the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Peu s’en faut que l’éclair ne leur ravisse la vue. Chaque fois que celui-ci illumine le ciel, ils progressent à sa lumière, mais s’immobilisent dès qu’ils sont plongés dans l’obscurité. Allah, s’Il le voulait, pourrait les priver de l’ouïe et de la vue. Allah, en vérité, est Omnipotent.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ

english.text: O people, worship your Lord, Who created you and those before you, so that you may become righteous;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ô hommes ! Adorez votre Seigneur - qui vous a créés vous et vos devanciers - afin de vous préserver de Son châtiment.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِرَٰشٗا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءٗ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: He Who made the earth a resting place for you, and the sky a canopy; and sends down rain from the sky, and brings forth fruits thereby as a provision for you. So do not set up rivals to Allah while you know[14].
english.footnotes: [14] Do not set up rivals to Allah (in worship), Who has provided you with all these things, and you know that He alone is worthy of worship.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui, pour vous, a fait de la terre une couche et du ciel un toit, et qui fait descendre du ciel une eau par laquelle Il fait pousser toutes les variétés de fruits dont vous vous nourrissez. Gardez-vous donc d’associer de fausses divinités au culte d’Allah alors que vous savez[14].
french.footnotes: [14] Que Lui seul mérite d’être adoré, étant Celui qui vous a créés et vous a dispensé tous ces bienfaits.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِنَا فَأۡتُواْ بِسُورَةٖ مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ وَٱدۡعُواْ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: If you are in doubt concerning that which We have sent down upon Our slave[15], then produce a chapter like it and call upon your helpers other than Allah, if you are truthful.
english.footnotes: [15] “Our servant” is referring to Muhammad (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous avez des doutes au sujet de ce que Nous avons révélé à notre serviteur, alors produisez une sourate identique, en vous aidant des divinités que vous adorez en dehors d’Allah[15], si vous dites la vérité[16].
french.footnotes:
[15] Autre sens : en vous aidant de qui vous voudrez en dehors d’Allah.
[16] Lorsque vous prétendez que le Coran est une invention. Nul, jusqu’à ce jour, n’a pu relever ce défi lancé à l’humanité il y a plus de quatorze siècles dans le désert d’Arabie par le prophète illettré.

renderings.arabic: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَلَن تَفۡعَلُواْ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُۖ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: But if you did not do it, and you can never do it; then beware of the Fire whose fuel will be people and stones, which is prepared for the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous n’y parvenez pas - et vous n’y parviendrez pas - alors préservez-vous du feu de l’Enfer, préparé pour les impies et alimenté par les hommes et les pierres.

renderings.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُواْ مِنۡهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٖ رِّزۡقٗا قَالُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي رُزِقۡنَا مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَأُتُواْ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَآ أَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞۖ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: And give glad tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens under which rivers flow. Every time they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, “This is what we were provided with before,” for they will be given fruit that resemble one another. They will have purified spouses, and they will abide therein forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Annonce à ceux qui croient et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres que leur sont réservés au Paradis des jardins traversés de rivières[17] où, en compagnie des épouses les plus pures, ils demeureront pour l’éternité. Chaque fois qu’un fruit du Paradis leur sera servi, ils diront : « Ce fruit est semblable à celui que nous avons reçu auparavant[18]. » Mais il ne lui sera semblable qu’en apparence.
french.footnotes:
[17] Littéralement : sous lesquels coulent des rivières. Certains exégètes interprètent donc ce verset de cette manière : des rivières coulent au pied des arbres et des palais de ces jardins.
[18] Sur terre ou au Paradis.

renderings.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيِۦٓ أَن يَضۡرِبَ مَثَلٗا مَّا بَعُوضَةٗ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗا وَيَهۡدِي بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗاۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ

english.text: Allah is not ashamed to give a similitude of a mosquito or even something less [significant][16]. As for those who believe, they know that this is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say, “What does Allah mean by this similitude?” He causes many to go astray thereby and guides many thereby, but He causes none to go astray except the evildoers –
english.footnotes: [16] Lit., "above it" i.e., greater in smallness.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah ne se gêne pas de proposer en parabole un moustique ou quelque chose de plus insignifiant. Les croyants savent d’ailleurs que cette parabole émane bien de leur Seigneur. Quant aux mécréants, ils disent : « Que peut bien vouloir signifier Allah par une telle parabole ? » Par elle, nombreux sont ceux qu’Il égare et par elle, nombreux ceux qu’Il guide. Mais Il n’égare, par de telles paraboles, que ceux qui Lui refusent obéissance,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

english.text: those who break the covenant of Allah after it has been ratified, sever bonds that Allah has commanded to be maintained[17], and spread corruption in the land. It is they who are the losers.
english.footnotes: [17] By keeping good relations with kith and kin.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui violent les engagements qu’ils ont, envers Lui, solennellement contractés, rompent les liens[19] qu’Il a ordonné de respecter et répandent sur terre le mal et le péché. Voilà ceux qui sont perdus.
french.footnotes: [19] De parenté, notamment.

renderings.arabic: كَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمۡ أَمۡوَٰتٗا فَأَحۡيَٰكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: How can you disbelieve in Allah, when you were lifeless then He gave you life, then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you back to life again, then to Him you will be returned?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment pouvez-vous renier Allah alors qu’Il vous a donné la vie en vous tirant du néant, qu’Il vous fera revivre après la mort, et que c’est à Lui enfin que vous serez ramenés ?

renderings.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

english.text: It is He Who created for you all that is in the earth, then He turned towards the heaven and made them seven heavens, and He is All-Knowing of everything.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui, dans Sa science infinie, a créé pour vous tout ce qui se trouve sur terre avant de procéder à la création du Ciel dont Il a fait sept cieux parfaitement constitués.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي جَاعِلٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ خَلِيفَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَجۡعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفۡسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَۖ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to appoint a vicegerent on earth.” They said, “Will You appoint on it someone who will spread corruption therein and shed blood, while we glorify You with Your praises and proclaim Your holiness?” He said, “I know that which you do not know.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne[20] ces paroles adressées par ton Seigneur aux anges : « Je vais installer un vicaire[21] sur terre où ses descendants se succéderont de génération en génération. » Les anges s’étonnèrent : « Vas-tu y installer des êtres qui y répandront le mal et y feront couler le sang alors que, par nos louanges, nous célébrons Ta gloire et sanctifions Ton nom ? » Il dit : « Je sais des choses que vous ignorez. »
french.footnotes:
[20] Allah s’adresse ici au prophète Mouhammad, appelé à rapporter aux hommes les paroles qui suivent.
[21] Adam, selon nombre d’exégètes. Le vicaire est, d’après eux, celui qui, au nom d’Allah, est chargé de l’application de la loi divine. Si Adam fut le premier vicaire d’Allah sur terre, il fut suivi par d’autres, les prophètes, puis les gouverneurs musulmans, chargés de faire appliquer les lois divines. On est donc loin de la notion de « vicaire » chez les chrétiens selon lesquels le « vicaire de Dieu » est le pape, représentant de Dieu sur terre.

renderings.arabic: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِي بِأَسۡمَآءِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: And He taught Adam the names of everything; then He presented them to the angels, and said, “Tell Me the names of these, if what you say is true?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah enseigna à Adam les noms de toutes choses avant de les présenter aux anges auxquels Il dit : « Indiquez-Moi leurs noms, si vous dites la vérité lorsque vous prétendez être supérieurs aux hommes. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

english.text: They said, “Glory be to You! We have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You Who are the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils répondirent : « Gloire à Toi ! Nous ne savons que ce que Tu nous as enseigné. C’est Toi, en vérité, l’Omniscient, l’infiniment Sage. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئۡهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مَا تُبۡدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ

english.text: He said, “O Adam, inform them of their names.” When he informed them of their names, Allah said, “Did I not tell you that I know the unseen of the heavens and earth, and I know what you reveal and what you conceal?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah dit : « Adam ! Indique-leur les noms de ces choses. » Lorsque Adam eut indiqué ces noms aux anges, Allah dit : « Ne vous ai-Je pas dit que Je connais les mystères des cieux et de la terre et que Je connais aussi bien ce que vous dissimulez que ce que vous exprimez ? »

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: And when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam[18],” and they prostrated except Iblīs[19]; he refused and was arrogant, and was one of the disbelievers.
english.footnotes:
[18] This prostration was done in obedience to Allah, out of respect, not worship.
 [19] The proper name of Satan, who was not an angel, but from the jinn.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Nous avons ordonné aux anges de se prosterner devant Adam, tous se sont exécutés, excepté Satan qui refusa par orgueil de se prosterner, se comportant en impie.

renderings.arabic: وَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسۡكُنۡ أَنتَ وَزَوۡجُكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنۡهَا رَغَدًا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمَا وَلَا تَقۡرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: We said, “O Adam, dwell in Paradise, you and your wife; and eat pleasantly from wherever you wish, but do not approach this tree, or else you will both become the wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons dit : « Adam ! Demeure en compagnie de ton épouse au Paradis dont vous pourrez manger paisiblement et librement tous les fruits. Mais n’approchez pas de l’arbre que voici, sans quoi vous transgresseriez l’interdit. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ عَنۡهَا فَأَخۡرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِۖ وَقُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: Then Satan tempted them and drove them out of the state they were in, and We said, “Go down [to the earth], as enemies to one another. You will have abode on earth and provision for an appointed time[20].”
english.footnotes: [20] Until the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais Satan provoqua leur chute en les incitant à manger des fruits de l’arbre interdit, les faisant chasser du Paradis où ils jouissaient de tous les délices. Nous avons dit : « Descendez d’ici ! Vous serez ennemis les uns des autres sur terre où vous pourrez séjourner et jouir quelque temps de la vie. »

renderings.arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english.text: Then Adam received some words[21] from his Lord, and He accepted his repentance. He is the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful.
english.footnotes: [21] These words, or supplications are: “They [both] said: “Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.” See 7:23.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Adam prononça alors certaines paroles inspirées par son Seigneur qui accepta son repentir. C’est Lui, en effet, le Très Miséricordieux, Celui qui accepte toujours le repentir de Ses serviteurs.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِنۡهَا جَمِيعٗاۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

english.text: We said, “Go down all of you from here[22]! Then when My guidance comes to you; whoever follows My guidance, will have no fear, nor will they grieve.
english.footnotes: [22] The addressees were Adam, Eve and Satan.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons dit : « Descendez tous d’ici ! Une révélation destinée à vous montrer la voie du salut vous sera transmise de Ma part. Celui qui s’y conformera sera préservé de toute crainte et de toute affliction. »

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: But those who disbelieve and reject Our signs, they are the people of the Fire; they will abide therein forever.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant aux impies qui renient Nos signes[22], ils sont voués au feu de l’Enfer où ils demeureront pour l’éternité.
french.footnotes: [22] Le terme « signe » désignera généralement dans cette traduction toutes les preuves, scripturaires (les Livres révélés), cosmologiques (visibles dans la Création) et rationnelles, de l’existence et de l’unicité du Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِيٓ أُوفِ بِعَهۡدِكُمۡ وَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ

english.text: O Children of Israel[23], remember My favor that I bestowed upon you, and fulfill My covenant; I will fulfill your covenant[24], and fear none but Me.
english.footnotes:
[23] Israel is Prophet Jacob (عليه السلام). The use of the epithet ‘Children of Israel’ for the Israelites is to remind them to follow their ancestor from whom they are descended.
 [24] This mutual pledge is as follows: If the Children of Israel keep up the prayer, give zakah, believe in and support the prophets, and spend in the cause of Allah, Allah will, in return, expiate their sins and admit them to the Gardens under which rivers flow, i.e., Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fils d’Israël ! Souvenez-vous des bienfaits dont Je vous ai comblés et soyez fidèles à vos engagements contractés envers Moi, j’honorerai Mon engagement pris envers vous[23]. C’est Moi seul que vous devez redouter.
french.footnotes: [23] Probable allusion à l’Alliance entre Yahvé et le peuple hébreu, fondement de l’Ancien Testament.

renderings.arabic: وَءَامِنُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتُ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓاْ أَوَّلَ كَافِرِۭ بِهِۦۖ وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِي ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗا وَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱتَّقُونِ

english.text: And believe in what I have sent down[25] which confirms that [Scripture] which is with you, and do not be the first to disbelieve in it, nor trade my verses for a small price, and fear Me alone.
english.footnotes: [25] i.e., the prophethood of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), which is mentioned in the Torah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Croyez au Livre que J’ai révélé et qui vient confirmer les Ecritures que vous détenez, ne soyez pas les premiers à le rejeter. Ne vendez pas Mes paroles à vil prix. C’est Moi seul que vous devez craindre.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: And do not mix the truth with falsehood, nor conceal the truth knowingly[26].
english.footnotes: [26] The prophethood of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gardez-vous de mêler le faux au vrai et de dissimuler la vérité que vous connaissez parfaitement.

renderings.arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرۡكَعُواْ مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ

english.text: And establish prayer, give zakah, and bow [to Allah] with those who bow[27].
english.footnotes: [27] This command is to the Children of Israel to bow down in obedience to Allah with Muhammad, as the Muslims do, i.e., embrace Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Accomplissez la prière, acquittez-vous de l’aumône[24] et inclinez-vous humblement avec les musulmans.
french.footnotes: [24] La « Zakât » prélevée sur les richesses (fortune personnelle, produits de la terre, cheptel et marchandises), régie par des règles très précises et redevable une fois dans l’année.

renderings.arabic: ۞ أَتَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَتَنسَوۡنَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: Do you enjoin righteousness upon people while you forget yourselves, even though you recite the Scripture[28]? Do you not understand?
english.footnotes: [28] i.e., the Torah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exhortez-vous les hommes à la vertu en oubliant vous-mêmes de la pratiquer ? Vous lisez pourtant les Ecritures. Etes-vous donc dépourvus de toute raison ?

renderings.arabic: وَٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ

english.text: Seek help through patience and prayer. It is strenuous except for the humble,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Armez-vous de patience et aidez-vous de la prière. Celle-ci représente cependant une lourde obligation, sauf pour les êtres humbles

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ

english.text: those who are sure that they are going to meet their Lord, and that they will return to Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui ont l’intime conviction qu’ils retourneront un jour à leur Seigneur et qu’ils Le rencontreront.

renderings.arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: O Children of Israel, remember My blessing which I bestowed upon you and that I favored you over all other people[29].
english.footnotes: [29] In their time, Allah favored them with certain privileges over other people such as sending them prophets and divine Books, and giving them kingship.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fils d’Israël ! Souvenez-vous des bienfaits dont Je vous ai pourvus et rappelez-vous que J’ai fait de vous Mon peuple élu[25].
french.footnotes: [25] Le peuple hébreu fut élu par l’Eternel qui lui envoya des prophètes et lui révéla les Ecritures jusqu’au jour où il rompit son alliance avec le Seigneur. Matthieu attribue dans son évangile ces paroles à Jésus qui s’adresse à ses contemporains juifs : « C’est pourquoi, je vous le dis, le royaume de Dieu vous sera enlevé et donné à une nation qui en rendra les fruits. » (Matthieu 21, 43)

renderings.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا تَجۡزِي نَفۡسٌ عَن نَّفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا شَفَٰعَةٞ وَلَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

english.text: And fear a Day when no soul will avail another anything, nor intercession will be accepted, nor compensation taken, nor will they be helped.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Craignez le Jour[26] où nul ne pourra rien pour son prochain, où nulle intercession ne sera acceptée sans l’autorisation d’Allah, où nul ne pourra racheter son âme et nul ne pourra être sauvé s’il meurt dans l’impiété.
french.footnotes: [26] Nous mettrons, dans cette traduction, une majuscule au mot « Jour » lorsqu’il sera question du Jour de la résurrection.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: And [remember] when We saved you from Pharaoh’s people, who were inflicting dreadful torment upon you: slaughtering your sons and sparing your women. That was a great trial from your Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Souvenez-vous lorsque Nous avons délivré vos ancêtres de Pharaon et de ses sujets qui leur infligeaient les pires tourments en égorgeant leurs fils, n’épargnant que leurs filles. Ce fut là une terrible épreuve[27] de la part de votre Seigneur.
french.footnotes: [27] Ou : une grâce immense, si le pronom « ce » renvoie à la délivrance des Hébreux et leur sortie d’Egypte.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ فَرَقۡنَا بِكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰكُمۡ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَآ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when We parted the sea for you and saved you, while We drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons alors fendu la mer pour vous ouvrir un passage, vous sauvant de vos ennemis et engloutissant sous vos yeux Pharaon et ses armées.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ وَٰعَدۡنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعِينَ لَيۡلَةٗ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when We appointed for Moses forty nights. Then you took the calf [for worship] in his absence, while you were wrongdoers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons ensuite fixé à Moïse une rencontre de quarante jours et quarante nuits. Vous avez alors, en son absence, adoré le Veau d’or, faisant preuve de la plus grande iniquité.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ عَفَوۡنَا عَنكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: Yet We pardoned you after that, so that you may be grateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons ensuite pardonné votre comportement afin que vous vous montriez reconnaissants.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when We gave Moses the Scripture and the criterion[30], so that you may be guided.
english.footnotes: [30] Differentiating between truth and falsehood. "The Scripture and the criterion" refers to the Torah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Souvenez-vous aussi lorsque Nous avons confié à Moïse l’Ecriture permettant de discerner le vrai du faux afin que vous suiviez le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّكُمۡ ظَلَمۡتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ فَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english.text: And [remember] when Moses said to his people, “O my people, you have wronged yourselves by taking the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]; that is best for you with your Creator.” Then He accepted your repentance, for He is the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et lorsque Moïse dit à son peuple : « Mon peuple ! Vous avez été injustes envers vous-mêmes en vouant un culte au Veau. Revenez donc à votre Créateur en tuant vous-mêmes les coupables. Voilà qui est préférable pour vous et plus à même de satisfaire votre Créateur. » Le Seigneur agréa alors votre repentir. C’est Lui le Très Miséricordieux, Celui qui accepte toujours le repentir de Ses serviteurs.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهۡرَةٗ فَأَخَذَتۡكُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when you said, “O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah openly,” so a thunderbolt struck you while you were looking on.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et lorsque vous avez dit : « Moïse ! Nous ne te croirons que lorsque nous verrons Allah de nos propres yeux. » Vous avez alors été foudroyés pendant que vous regardiez.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَٰكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: Then We raised you back to life after your death, so that you may be grateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons ensuite ressuscités afin que vous vous montriez reconnaissants.

renderings.arabic: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰۖ كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

english.text: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails[31], [saying], “Eat of the good things We have provided for you.” They did not wrong Us, but they wronged themselves.
english.footnotes: [31] They both have linguistic roots in Arabic; "al-mann" means that which is God-given without effort, while "al-salwā" means that in which one finds consolation and comfort.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rappelez-vous lorsque, par Notre grâce, vous avez progressé à l’ombre des nuages[28]. Nous avons alors fait descendre sur vous la manne et les cailles, vous disant : « Mangez de ces nourritures pures et saines que Nous vous avons dispensées. » Ce n’est pas envers Nous, mais bien envers eux-mêmes qu’ils ont été injustes.
french.footnotes: [28] Durant l’interminable exode qui suivit votre sortie d’Egypte.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا ٱدۡخُلُواْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةَ فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ رَغَدٗا وَٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡبَابَ سُجَّدٗا وَقُولُواْ حِطَّةٞ نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

english.text: And [remember] when We said, “Enter this town [of Jerusalem] and eat freely from wherever you wish, and enter the gate bowing down humbly and say, ‘Absolve us[32].’ We will forgive you your sins and increase [the reward of] those who do good.”
english.footnotes: [32] In gratitude to Allah and admission of sin.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous leur avons dit : « Entrez dans cette cité où vous pourrez manger librement et paisiblement toutes les nourritures que vous désirerez. Mais franchissez la porte en toute humilité et en implorant la rémission de vos péchés. Nous vous pardonnerons vos fautes et multiplierons la récompense des hommes de bien. »

renderings.arabic: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ قَوۡلًا غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمۡ فَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ

english.text: But the wrongdoers changed the words to other than what they were told[33]; so We sent down upon the wrongdoers a torment from the heaven for their rebelliousness.
english.footnotes: [33] They were asked to seek forgiveness. The word is hittah, which means: to put down a burden, but they twisted their tongues to mean ‘barley’, hintah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais ceux d’entre eux qui étaient injustes ont préféré d’autres paroles à celles qui leur avaient été indiquées. Pour prix de leur désobéissance, Nous avons fait fondre sur eux un terrible châtiment venant du ciel.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَإِذِ ٱسۡتَسۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡحَجَرَۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتۡ مِنۡهُ ٱثۡنَتَا عَشۡرَةَ عَيۡنٗاۖ قَدۡ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٖ مَّشۡرَبَهُمۡۖ كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ

english.text: And [remember] when Moses asked for water for his people, and We said, “Strike the rock with your staff,” Then twelve springs gushed forth from it; each tribe knew its drinking place[34]. “Eat and drink from Allah’s provision, and do not spread corruption in the land.”
english.footnotes: [34] The twelve tribes of the Children of Israel, who are called "Asbāt".
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rappelez-vous aussi lorsque Nous avons ordonné à Moïse, qui réclamait de l’eau pour son peuple[29], de frapper de son bâton un rocher dont jaillirent aussitôt douze sources. Chacune des tribus d’Israël sut donc à quelle source s’abreuver. « Mangez et buvez de ce qu’Allah vous a dispensé, et gardez-vous de répandre sur terre le mal et le péché. »
french.footnotes: [29] Toujours au cours de l’Exode.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصۡبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٖ وَٰحِدٖ فَٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخۡرِجۡ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۢ بَقۡلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَاۖ قَالَ أَتَسۡتَبۡدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَدۡنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِي هُوَ خَيۡرٌۚ ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِصۡرٗا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلۡتُمۡۗ وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلۡمَسۡكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَواْ وَّكَانُواْ يَعۡتَدُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when you said, “O Moses, we cannot bear the same meal. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from what the earth produces – its herbs, cucumbers, garlic, lentils, and onions.” Moses said, “Would you exchange what is better for what is inferior? Go down to any town and you will have what you have asked for.” They were struck with humiliation and destitution, and incurred the wrath of Allah. That was because they used to reject the signs of Allah and kill the prophets unjustly. That was because they disobeyed and were transgressors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais vous avez dit : « Moïse ! Nous ne pouvons supporter plus longtemps de consommer tous les jours les mêmes aliments[30]. Demande donc à ton Seigneur de faire pousser pour nous des légumes, des concombres, de l’ail, des lentilles ou des oignons. » Il répondit : « Voulez-vous vraiment substituer ces nourritures grossières à des aliments de meilleure qualité ? Descendez donc dans n’importe quelle cité, vous y trouverez ce que vous réclamez ! » Ils furent donc couverts d’opprobre, plongés dans la misère et poursuivis par la colère d’Allah pour avoir, poussés par leur goût de la désobéissance et de la transgression, renié les signes d’Allah et tué injustement les prophètes.
french.footnotes: [30] La manne et les cailles.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

english.text: The believers and those who were Jews, Christians, and the Sabians [before Prophet Muhammad] – whoever believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteous deed, they will have their reward with their Lord, and they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les croyants[31], les juifs, les chrétiens, les sabéens[32], tous ceux qui auront cru en Allah et au Jour dernier, et accompli de bonnes actions, obtiendront leur récompense auprès de leur Seigneur et seront préservés de toute crainte et de toute affliction[33].
french.footnotes:
[31] Les musulmans, seuls véritables croyants après l’avènement de l’islam.
[32] Nombre d’exégètes présentent ces sabéens comme des hommes restés attachés à leurs croyances naturelles, sans suivre de religion particulière. D’autres les décrivent comme une secte chrétienne (le Grand Robert parle de christianisme mêlé d’astrolâtrie) ou juive. Il pourrait également s’agir des mandéens.
[33] Allah dit : « La seule religion acceptée par Allah est l’islam. » (3, 19) Par conséquent, après l’avènement de l’islam, les adeptes des autres religions ne peuvent être sauvés que s’ils croient en la mission du dernier des Messagers, Mouhammad, et en celle de tous les prophètes qui l’ont précédé.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when We took your covenant [O Children of Israel] and raised above you the mountain [saying], “Hold firmly to what We have given you and observe its teachings, so that you may become righteous.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rappelez-vous aussi lorsque Nous avons contracté une alliance avec vous[34]. Dressant le mont Sinaï au-dessus de vous[35], Nous avons dit : « Conformez-vous scrupuleusement à l’Ecriture que Nous vous avons confiée, en appliquant chacun de ses préceptes, afin de vous préserver de Notre châtiment. »
french.footnotes:
[34] Allah s’adresse toujours ici aux juifs contemporains du Prophète auxquels Il rappelle certains événements marquants de l’histoire du peuple hébreu et certaines de Ses faveurs qui devraient les inciter à embrasser la foi.
[35] Afin de les contraindre à accepter cette alliance, selon certains exégètes, pour les punir de l’avoir violée, selon d’autres.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَۖ فَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ

english.text: But then you turned away after that. If it had not been for the grace and mercy of Allah upon you, you would have surely been among the losers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais vous vous êtes ensuite détournés, comportement qui, sans la grâce et la miséricorde d’Allah, aurait provoqué votre perte.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعۡتَدَوۡاْ مِنكُمۡ فِي ٱلسَّبۡتِ فَقُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُونُواْ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ

english.text: And you know about those among you who broke the Sabbath, whereupon We said to them, “Be apes, despised.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous connaissez pourtant le sort subi par ceux des vôtres qui ont transgressé le shabbat[36] auxquels Nous avons dit : « Soyez transformés en singes abjects ! »
french.footnotes: [36] Voir sourate 7, verset 163 et suivants.

renderings.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا نَكَٰلٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهَا وَمَا خَلۡفَهَا وَمَوۡعِظَةٗ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: So We made it a deterrent punishment for those alive and for those who succeeded them, and an admonition for the righteous.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous en avons donc fait une leçon pour leurs contemporains et les générations futures, et une exhortation pour ceux qui craignent leur Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تَذۡبَحُواْ بَقَرَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوٗاۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ

english.text: And [remember] when Moses said to his people, “Allah commands you to slaughter a cow.” They said, “Are you mocking us?” Moses said, “I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rappelez-vous lorsque Moïse dit à son peuple : « Allah vous ordonne de sacrifier une vache. » Ils répondirent : « Te moques-tu de nous ? » Il dit : « Qu’Allah me préserve d’agir en ignorant. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا فَارِضٞ وَلَا بِكۡرٌ عَوَانُۢ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۖ فَٱفۡعَلُواْ مَا تُؤۡمَرُونَ

english.text: They said, “Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what [type of cow] it is.” He said, “Allah says, ‘It is a cow that is neither too old nor too young, but somewhere in between. So do as you are commanded!’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils demandèrent : « Prie pour nous ton Seigneur de nous indiquer à quoi elle doit ressembler. » Il répondit : « Allah dit qu’elle ne doit être ni trop vieille, ni trop jeune, mais d’un âge intermédiaire. Exécutez donc l’ordre qui vous est donné. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوۡنُهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ صَفۡرَآءُ فَاقِعٞ لَّوۡنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّٰظِرِينَ

english.text: They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us its color.” He said, “Allah says, ‘It is a yellow cow, bright in color – pleasing to the beholders.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais ils ajoutèrent : « Prie pour nous ton Seigneur de nous préciser sa couleur. » Il répondit : « Allah dit qu’elle doit être d’un jaune vif et agréable à regarder. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ إِنَّ ٱلۡبَقَرَ تَشَٰبَهَ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: They again said, “Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. All cows look alike to us. If Allah wills, we will surely be guided.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils insistèrent : « Prie pour nous ton Seigneur de nous la décrire précisément, car les vaches se ressemblent à s’y méprendre. Nous pourrons alors, si Allah le veut, la trouver. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا ذَلُولٞ تُثِيرُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَا تَسۡقِي ٱلۡحَرۡثَ مُسَلَّمَةٞ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَاۚ قَالُواْ ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ جِئۡتَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ

english.text: He said, “Allah says, ‘It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor water the field; sound, without blemish.’” They said, “Now you have come with the truth.” Then they slaughtered it, although they were almost not doing it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Allah dit qu’elle ne doit être utilisée ni pour le labour, ni pour l’arrosage des champs. Ce doit être une vache exempte de tout défaut et sans la moindre tache. » Ils dirent : « Tu nous l’as enfin décrite clairement. » Ils finirent donc, après bien des hésitations, par l’égorger.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَتَلۡتُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَٱدَّٰرَٰءۡتُمۡ فِيهَاۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخۡرِجٞ مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ

english.text: And [remember] when you [Israelites] slew a man and disputed as to who the killer was, but Allah exposed what you were concealing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rappelez-vous lorsque les uns ont rejeté sur les autres la responsabilité d’un crime commis par l’un d’entre vous. Mais Allah a dévoilé l’identité du meurtrier que vous cherchiez à dissimuler.

renderings.arabic: فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِبُوهُ بِبَعۡضِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحۡيِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: We said, “Strike the slain with a piece of it.” This is how Allah brings the dead to life and shows you His signs, so that you may understand.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons en effet ordonné de frapper le cadavre à l’aide d’une partie de la vache égorgée[37]. C’est ainsi qu’Allah redonne vie aux morts et vous montre Ses signes afin que vous les méditiez.
french.footnotes: [37] La victime, relatent les commentateurs, se leva alors et désigna elle-même son meurtrier. Les fils d’Israël avaient auparavant consulté Moïse qui leur avait indiqué la manière, révélée par Allah, de procéder pour démasquer le meurtrier : égorger une vache, puis frapper le cadavre à l’aide d’une partie de l’animal.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِيَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةٗۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمَآءُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَهۡبِطُ مِنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: Then your hearts became hardened after that, like rocks or even harder. There are rocks from which rivers gush forth, and there are others that split open from which water comes out, while others fall down out of humility to Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais vos cœurs se sont par la suite endurcis, devenant durs comme le roc, voire plus insensibles encore. Car certains rocs peuvent laisser jaillir des ruisseaux, d’autres se fendre pour laisser sourdre de l’eau et d’autres encore débouler du haut des montagnes par crainte d’Allah. Allah n’est certainement pas inattentif à vos agissements.

renderings.arabic: ۞ أَفَتَطۡمَعُونَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ لَكُمۡ وَقَدۡ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Do you [O believers] hope that they would respond to your call to believe, while a party of them used to hear the word of Allah[35] then distort it knowingly after understanding it?
english.footnotes: [35] i.e., the Torah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
