french.text: Quiconque tournerait alors le dos à l’ennemi - à moins de se replier pour mieux revenir à la charge ou de rallier un autre groupe - serait poursuivi par la colère d’Allah et voué à la Géhenne. Et quelle horrible demeure !

renderings.arabic: فَلَمۡ تَقۡتُلُوهُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمۡۚ وَمَا رَمَيۡتَ إِذۡ رَمَيۡتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ وَلِيُبۡلِيَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مِنۡهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

english.text: It was not you who killed them, but it was Allah Who killed them; and it was not you [O Prophet] who threw when you threw [a handful of sand][8] but it was Allah Who threw, so that He might test the believers with a great test. Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
english.footnotes: [8] It filled their eyes and noses, preventing their advance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce n’est pas vous en réalité qui les avez tués, mais bien Allah[6]. Et lorsque tu lançais[7], ce n’est pas toi qui lançais réellement, mais bien Allah[8] qui voulait ainsi combler les croyants de Ses faveurs. Allah entend tout et sait tout.
french.footnotes:
[6] Qui vous a permis de les mettre en déroute par le soutien qu’Il vous a apporté.
[7] Une poignée de sable aux visages des mécréants, avant la bataille de Badr, expliquent les exégètes.
[8] Qui fit parvenir ce sable aux visages des polythéistes.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيۡدِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: As such, Allah undermines the plans of the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en fut donc ainsi par la volonté d’Allah qui ne cessera de ruiner les desseins des mécréants.

renderings.arabic: إِن تَسۡتَفۡتِحُواْ فَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلۡفَتۡحُۖ وَإِن تَنتَهُواْ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡۖ وَإِن تَعُودُواْ نَعُدۡ وَلَن تُغۡنِيَ عَنكُمۡ فِئَتُكُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَوۡ كَثُرَتۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: If you [disbelievers] were seeking the decision, it has come to you[9]. If you desist, it will be better for you, but if you return [to war], We too will return. And your forces – no matter how great in number they are – will not avail you anything, for Allah is with the believers.
english.footnotes: [9] The disbelievers implored Allah against Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) and Muslims (alleging that they were wrongdoers), so His decision came.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous avez réclamé le jugement d’Allah[9], Son jugement a maintenant été rendu. Et si vous mettez un terme à vos agissements, voilà qui est préférable pour vous. Si, en revanche, vous récidivez, Nous vous ferons subir un sort identique. Vos troupes, aussi nombreuses soient-elles, ne vous seront alors d’aucune utilité, car Allah est avec les croyants.
french.footnotes: [9] Allusion possible à ces paroles prononcées par Abou Jahl - le chef des mécréants de la Mecque - au moment où les deux armées se firent face : « Allah ! Anéantis ce matin celui des deux camps qui a le plus gravement rompu les liens du sang et qui a apporté des croyances inconnues jusqu’ici. » (Voir Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَسۡمَعُونَ

english.text: O you who believe, obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not turn away from him after hearing [his command].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous qui croyez ! Obéissez à Allah et à Son Messager. Ne vous détournez pas de lui alors que vous entendez le message qu’il est chargé de vous délivrer.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ

english.text: And do not be like those[10] who say, “We hear,” while they do not actually listen.
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., the hypocrites and/or the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’imitez pas ceux qui affirment : « Nous avons bien entendu », alors qu’ils restent sourds aux exhortations qui leur sont adressées.

renderings.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلۡبُكۡمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: The worst of creatures before Allah are those who are deaf and dumb, and who do not understand.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’est pires créatures pour Allah que ceux qui sont sourds à la vérité, frappés de mutisme et incapables de raisonner.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِمۡ خَيۡرٗا لَّأَسۡمَعَهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ أَسۡمَعَهُمۡ لَتَوَلَّواْ وَّهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: If Allah had known any good in them[11], He would have made them hear, but even if He had made them hear, they would have turned away in aversion.
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., real willingness and intention of good.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Allah avait reconnu en eux quelque vertu, Il leur aurait permis de comprendre Ses enseignements. Mais ils auraient alors tourné le dos à la vérité.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ لِمَا يُحۡيِيكُمۡۖ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَرۡءِ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَأَنَّهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ

english.text: O you who believe, respond to Allah and the Messenger when He calls you to what gives you life[12], and know that Allah comes between a person and his heart[13], and it is to Him that you will all be gathered.
english.footnotes:
[12] A better life with faith both in this life and in the Hereafter.
 [13] Beware of rejecting the command of Allah when it comes to you, for Allah may not enable you to respond to his command afterward, as the hearts are between the two Fingers of Allah Who changes it as He wishes.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous qui croyez ! Répondez à Allah et au Messager lorsqu’il vous appelle à ce qui vous assurera une vie éternelle[10]. Et sachez qu’Allah s’interpose entre l’homme et son cœur[11] et que c’est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés.
french.footnotes:
[10] Ou : à ce qui donne vie à vos cœurs, c’est-à-dire, la foi.
[11] Il s’interpose entre le croyant et l’impiété et entre le mécréant et la foi, si bien que nul ne peut croire ou rejeter la foi que par Sa volonté.

renderings.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنكُمۡ خَآصَّةٗۖ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ

english.text: Beware of a trial that will not only befall the wrongdoers among you, and know that Allah is severe in punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prenez garde à des épreuves qui ne toucheront pas uniquement ceux d’entre vous qui se livrent au péché[12]. Et sachez qu’Allah est terrible lorsqu’Il décide de châtier.
french.footnotes: [12] Allah exhorte ici les croyants à ne pas fermer les yeux sur les péchés commis sous leurs yeux, faute de quoi Il châtiera aussi bien les pécheurs que ceux qui se taisent devant leurs agissements (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرُوٓاْ إِذۡ أَنتُمۡ قَلِيلٞ مُّسۡتَضۡعَفُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمۡ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصۡرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: And remember when you were few in number and oppressed in the land[14], fearing that the people would snatch you away. Then He sheltered you[15], and strengthened you with His help, and provided you with good things, so that you may give thanks.
english.footnotes:
[14] In Makkah.
 [15] In Madinah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Souvenez-vous lorsque vous étiez une poignée d’hommes et de femmes persécutés dans votre patrie[13], redoutant d’être enlevés par vos ennemis. Allah vous a alors offert un asile[14], prêté assistance et comblés de Ses bienfaits afin que vous Lui soyez reconnaissants.
french.footnotes:
[13] La Mecque, avant l’hégire.
[14] A Médine.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَخُونُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوٓاْ أَمَٰنَٰتِكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: O you who believe, do not betray Allah and the Messenger, nor betray your trusts knowingly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous qui croyez ! Gardez-vous de trahir Allah et le Messager, et de manquer sciemment à vos obligations religieuses[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Ou : et de trahir délibérément la confiance placée en vous.

renderings.arabic: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: Know that your wealth and your children[16] are only a trial and that with Allah is an immense reward.
english.footnotes: [16] Due to your love for both of them, you may violate Allah’s commands concerning them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sachez que vos richesses et vos enfants ne sont pour vous que tentation et épreuve, et qu’auprès d’Allah se trouve une immense récompense[16].
french.footnotes: [16] Dont vos richesses et vos enfants ne doivent en aucun cas vous détourner.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ فُرۡقَانٗا وَيُكَفِّرۡ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

english.text: O you who believe, if you fear Allah, He will provide you with an insight[17] to distinguish between right and wrong, absolve you of your sins and forgive you, for Allah is the Lord of great bounty.
english.footnotes: [17] Or a way out of difficulties.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous qui croyez ! Si vous craignez Allah, Il vous accordera la faculté de discerner le vrai du faux[17], effacera vos péchés et vous accordera Son pardon. Les faveurs d’Allah sont infinies.
french.footnotes: [17] Ou : Il vous offrira une victoire décisive, ou encore : une issue à toutes vos difficultés.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ يَمۡكُرُ بِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيُثۡبِتُوكَ أَوۡ يَقۡتُلُوكَ أَوۡ يُخۡرِجُوكَۚ وَيَمۡكُرُونَ وَيَمۡكُرُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمَٰكِرِينَ

english.text: And [remember] when the disbelievers plotted against you[18], to take you as captive, kill you or expel you. They plan, and Allah also plans, but Allah is the Best of those who plan.
english.footnotes: [18] They plotted against the Messenger (ﷺ) in Makkah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Souviens-toi des sombres projets élaborés par les impies pour t’arrêter, t’assassiner ou t’exiler. Ils ont tramé un complot qu’Allah a déjoué. Nul mieux qu’Allah n’est en mesure de déjouer les complots.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالُواْ قَدۡ سَمِعۡنَا لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَقُلۡنَا مِثۡلَ هَٰذَآ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: When Our verses are recited to them, they say, “We have heard. If we wished, we could say something like this. This is nothing but ancient fables.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Nos versets leur sont récités, ils disent : « Nous avons déjà entendu ce genre de récits[18] ! Nous pourrions, si nous le voulions, en produire de semblables. Ce ne sont là que légendes des temps anciens ! »
french.footnotes: [18] Ou : nous t’avons bien entendu.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالُواْ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَٰذَا هُوَ ٱلۡحَقَّ مِنۡ عِندِكَ فَأَمۡطِرۡ عَلَيۡنَا حِجَارَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَوِ ٱئۡتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

english.text: And [remember] when they said, “O Allah, if this is indeed the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the heaven or bring upon us a painful punishment[19].”
english.footnotes: [19] Abu Jahl and other disbelievers invoked this supplication.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et ils disent : « Ô Allah ! Si ce message provient bien de Toi, alors fais-nous périr sous une pluie de pierres ou subir un douloureux châtiment. »

renderings.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمۡ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمۡۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ

english.text: But Allah would not punish them while you [O Prophet] are among them, nor would Allah punish them as long as they seek forgiveness.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, Allah ne saurait les châtier alors que tu te trouves parmi eux, de même qu’Il ne saurait les punir s’ils implorent Son pardon.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا لَهُمۡ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ أَوۡلِيَآءَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Why should Allah not punish them when they prevent [people] from the Sacred Mosque, although they are not its rightful guardians? Its rightful guardians are only those who fear Allah, but most of them do not know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne méritent-ils pas d’être châtiés par Allah, eux qui interdisent aux croyants l’accès à la Mosquée sacrée dont ils ne sont pourtant pas les gardiens ? Seuls, en effet, sont dignes d’en assurer la garde ceux qui craignent Allah, mais la plupart d’entre eux ne le savent pas.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمۡ عِندَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ إِلَّا مُكَآءٗ وَتَصۡدِيَةٗۚ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

english.text: Their prayer at the Sacred House was nothing but whistling and clapping. So taste the punishment[20] for your disbelief.
english.footnotes: [20] Their degrading defeat, killing and captivation at Badr.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: D’autant que leurs prières autour du Sanctuaire sacré ne sont que sifflements et battements de mains[19]. « Goûtez donc le châtiment pour prix de votre impiété ! »
french.footnotes: [19] Les païens de la Mecque effectuaient les circumambulations autour de la Kaaba en étant nus, en sifflant et en battant des mains (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنفِقُونَ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ لِيَصُدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَسۡرَةٗ ثُمَّ يُغۡلَبُونَۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحۡشَرُونَ

english.text: The disbelievers spend their wealth to prevent [people] from the way of Allah. They will continue to spend it, then it will be a source of regret for them, then they will be defeated, and those who disbelieve will be gathered into Hell,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui ont rejeté la foi dépensent leurs biens pour détourner les hommes de la voie d’Allah. Mais ils finiront par regretter toutes ces dépenses et être vaincus. Les impies seront conduits vers la Géhenne où ils seront réunis.

renderings.arabic: لِيَمِيزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَيَجۡعَلَ ٱلۡخَبِيثَ بَعۡضَهُۥ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَيَرۡكُمَهُۥ جَمِيعٗا فَيَجۡعَلَهُۥ فِي جَهَنَّمَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

english.text: so that Allah may separate the wicked from the good, and pile up the wicked all together and then cast them into Hell. It is they who are the losers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah séparera ainsi les êtres bons des mauvais qui seront entassés les uns sur les autres dans la Géhenne. Voilà ceux qui auront perdu leurs âmes.

renderings.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِن يَنتَهُواْ يُغۡفَرۡ لَهُم مَّا قَدۡ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُواْ فَقَدۡ مَضَتۡ سُنَّتُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: Say to those who disbelieve that if they desist[21], their past will be forgiven, but if they persist, then they have a precedent in those who have passed before them.
english.footnotes: [21] From disbelief and disobedience.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis à ceux qui ont rejeté la foi que s’ils renoncent à leur impiété, leurs péchés passés leur seront pardonnés[20]. Mais s’ils s’obstinent, ils connaissent déjà le sort subi par leurs devanciers.
french.footnotes: [20] Le Prophète a dit : « La conversion à l’islam efface les péchés commis avant elle. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَٰتِلُوهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتۡنَةٞ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ كُلُّهُۥ لِلَّهِۚ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوۡاْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ

english.text: Fight them until there is no more persecution[22] and the religion is entirely for Allah; but if they desist, then Allah is All-Seeing of what they do.
english.footnotes: [22] Among the meanings of "fitnah" are: disbelief and its imposition on others, dissension, trial, and torment. See 2:191.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Combattez-les jusqu’à ce que nul ne soit persécuté pour sa foi et que le culte soit exclusivement voué à Allah. S’ils cessent leurs hostilités, alors qu’ils sachent qu’Allah voit parfaitement ce qu’ils font.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ

english.text: But if they turn away, then know that Allah is your Protector. What an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais s’ils persistent, alors sachez qu’Allah est votre Maître. Quel bon Maître et quel excellent Protecteur !

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا غَنِمۡتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُۥ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمۡ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

english.text: Know that whatever spoils you obtain, one-fifth belongs to Allah[23] and the Messenger[24], to his close relatives, the orphans, the needy and the [stranded] travelers – if you truly believe in Allah and in what We sent down to Our slave[25] on the day of Criterion[26] – the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allah is Most Capable of all things.
english.footnotes:
[23] To be spent in the cause of Allah.
 [24] The tribes of Banu Hāshim and Banu Abdul Muṭṭalib, who were not eligible for zakah. The remaining four-fifths are divided among the soldiers.
 [25] Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).
 [26] The Battle of Badr.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sachez que, sur tout butin arraché à l’ennemi, le cinquième revient à Allah, au Messager, à ses proches parents[21], aux orphelins, aux nécessiteux et aux voyageurs démunis[22], si vraiment vous croyez en Allah et en ce que Nous avons révélé à Notre serviteur le jour du discernement[23], jour où les deux troupes se sont affrontées. Allah a pouvoir sur toute chose.
french.footnotes:
[21] La tribu des Bani Hâchim et celle des Bani Al-Mouttalib.
[22] Le Prophète avait l’habitude de partager le butin en cinq parts égales, quatre revenant aux hommes ayant participé aux combats, la cinquième étant elle-même divisée en cinq autres parts destinées au Messager - qui l’utilisait dans l’intérêt des musulmans -, à ses proches parents, aux orphelins, aux pauvres et aux voyageurs sans ressources (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).
[23] Les versets révélés au Prophète ou les miracles produits par le Seigneur lors de la bataille de Badr qui ont conduit à la victoire musulmane. Au cours de cette bataille, Allah a discerné le vrai du faux en faisant triompher la foi.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ أَنتُم بِٱلۡعُدۡوَةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُم بِٱلۡعُدۡوَةِ ٱلۡقُصۡوَىٰ وَٱلرَّكۡبُ أَسۡفَلَ مِنكُمۡۚ وَلَوۡ تَوَاعَدتُّمۡ لَٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡمِيعَٰدِ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَقۡضِيَ ٱللَّهُ أَمۡرٗا كَانَ مَفۡعُولٗا لِّيَهۡلِكَ مَنۡ هَلَكَ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٖ وَيَحۡيَىٰ مَنۡ حَيَّ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٖۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

english.text: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley [of Badr], and they were on the far side, and the caravan was on the lower ground beneath you. If you had made prior arrangements to encounter, you would have failed to keep that appointment. But [it happened] so that Allah might accomplish what had already been decreed, and so that those who chose to perish would perish after seeing clear evidence, and those who chose to survive would survive after seeing clear evidence. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous aviez alors installé votre campement sur le versant de la vallée le plus proche[24], tandis que l’ennemi campait sur le versant le plus éloigné et que la caravane se trouvait en contrebas. Si vous vous étiez donné rendez-vous, vous l’auriez certainement manqué, mais le décret d’Allah devait être exécuté afin que celui qui devait périr périsse sans aucune excuse et que celui qui devait survivre vive en connaissance de cause[25]. Allah entend tout et sait tout.
french.footnotes:
[24] De Médine.
[25] Autre sens : afin que celui qui avait choisi l’impiété n’ait plus aucune excuse et que celui qui avait choisi la foi ait décidé en connaissance de cause.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ يُرِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلٗاۖ وَلَوۡ أَرَىٰكَهُمۡ كَثِيرٗا لَّفَشِلۡتُمۡ وَلَتَنَٰزَعۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَلَّمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

english.text: [Remember] when Allah showed them to you in your dream as few in number; if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and disputed in the matter. But Allah spared you [of that], for He is All-Knowing of what is in the hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Souviens-toi quand Allah te fit voir en songe l’ennemi peu nombreux. S’Il te l’avait montré plus nombreux, vous auriez renoncé par lâcheté et vous vous seriez disputés. Mais Allah, qui connaît si bien le fond de vos pensées, vous en a préservés.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ يُرِيكُمُوهُمۡ إِذِ ٱلۡتَقَيۡتُمۡ فِيٓ أَعۡيُنِكُمۡ قَلِيلٗا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمۡ فِيٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ لِيَقۡضِيَ ٱللَّهُ أَمۡرٗا كَانَ مَفۡعُولٗاۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

english.text: And [remember] when you met, He made them appear as few in your eyes, and made you appear as few in their eyes, so that Allah may accomplish what was already decreed. And to Allah will return all matters.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque les deux armées se firent face, Il fit paraître vos ennemis peu nombreux à vos yeux, de même que vous leur paraissiez peu nombreux, afin que le décret d’Allah soit exécuté. Toute décision appartient à Allah.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا لَقِيتُمۡ فِئَةٗ فَٱثۡبُتُواْ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ

english.text: O you who believe, when you encounter a group [in battle], stand firm and remember Allah much, so that you may triumph[27].
english.footnotes: [27] How to win a victory: 1. To stand firm. 2. To mention Allah profusely and seek His help.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous qui croyez ! Tenez ferme face à l’ennemi et invoquez Allah avec ferveur afin d’obtenir la victoire.

renderings.arabic: وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَنَٰزَعُواْ فَتَفۡشَلُواْ وَتَذۡهَبَ رِيحُكُمۡۖ وَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

english.text: Obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not dispute with one another, or else you will lose courage and your strength will weaken. And be steadfast, for Allah is with those who are steadfast.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Obéissez à Allah et à Son Messager et fuyez les divisions qui ne manqueraient pas de vous affaiblir et de tempérer votre ardeur. Armez-vous de patience. Allah est avec ceux qui font preuve de constance.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بَطَرٗا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطٞ

english.text: Do not be like those[28] who came out of their homes insolently, showing off to people, and preventing others from Allah’s way, for Allah is All-Encompassing of what they do.
english.footnotes: [28] The Quraysh army.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne soyez pas comme ces impies qui, affichant ostensiblement leur puissance, quittèrent leurs terres en paradant, décidés à détourner les hommes de la voie d’Allah[26]. Mais rien de leurs agissements n’échappait à Allah.
french.footnotes: [26] Les païens mecquois qui quittèrent la Mecque pour venir en aide à leur caravane en danger.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَإِنِّي جَارٞ لَّكُمۡۖ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ ٱلۡفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيۡهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّنكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوۡنَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ

english.text: And [remember] when Satan made their misdeeds appealing to them, and said, “No one can overcome you today, and I am your protector.” But when the two armies faced each other, he turned on his heels and said, “I have nothing to do with you, for I see what you do not see. I surely fear Allah, for Allah is severe in punishment.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Satan avait embelli leur entreprise à leurs yeux, leur suggérant : « Nul ne pourra aujourd’hui vous vaincre, je me charge de votre protection. » Mais lorsque les deux troupes furent en vue l’une de l’autre, il tourna le dos en disant : « Je vous désavoue, car je vois des choses[27] que vous ne pouvez voir. Je redoute Allah dont le châtiment est terrible. »
french.footnotes: [27] Les anges, aux côtés des musulmans, précisent les exégètes.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِينُهُمۡۗ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ

english.text: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those who have sickness in their hearts said, “These [believers] are deluded by their religion.” But whoever puts his trust in Allah[29], Allah is indeed All-Mighty, All-Wise.
english.footnotes: [29] Victory is not achieved by mere worldly measures; it only comes from Allah for those who really put their trust in Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les hypocrites et ceux dont les cœurs étaient malades dirent alors à propos des croyants : « Ces gens sont abusés par leur religion. » Or, quiconque s’en remet à Allah saura qu’Il est Tout-Puissant et infiniment Sage.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمۡ وَأَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ

english.text: If only you could see when the angels take the souls of the disbelievers, beating their faces and their backs, “Taste the punishment of the scorching fire!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si tu pouvais voir[28] les anges arracher les âmes des impies et les frapper par devant et par derrière, leur disant : « Goûtez les tourments du Feu
french.footnotes: [28] Le jour de la bataille de Badr, expliquent certains exégètes, pour qui ce verset s’inscrit donc dans le récit de la première grande bataille de l’islam, tandis que d’autres lui donnent une portée plus générale. Ce verset décrirait, selon eux, le moment où les anges de la mort viennent arracher l’âme du mécréant.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ

english.text: This is because of what your hands have sent forth, for Allah is never unjust to [His] slaves.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: pour prix du mal que vous avez commis durant votre vie. Car Allah ne saurait traiter injustement Ses serviteurs. »

renderings.arabic: كَدَأۡبِ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيّٞ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ

english.text: Their case is like the people of Pharaoh and those who came before them[30]. They disbelieved in the signs of Allah, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful and Severe in Punishment.
english.footnotes: [30] The people of ‘Ād, Thamūd and others met the same fate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils sont à l’image du peuple de Pharaon et des nations qui l’ont précédé. Comme eux, ils ont rejeté les signes d’Allah qui les a donc saisis pour prix de leurs péchés. Allah est Fort et terrible lorsqu’Il décide de châtier.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمۡ يَكُ مُغَيِّرٗا نِّعۡمَةً أَنۡعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُواْ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

english.text: This is because Allah would never change the blessings He has bestowed upon a people until they change their own attitude and conduct. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah ne saurait en effet modifier Ses bienfaits envers un peuple tant que ce dernier n’a pas modifié son comportement[29]. Allah entend tout et sait tout.
french.footnotes: [29] Allah ne saurait en effet retirer Ses faveurs à un peuple tant que ce dernier ne s’est pas corrompu.

renderings.arabic: كَدَأۡبِ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَآ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ وَكُلّٞ كَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: Their case is like the people of Pharaoh and those who came before them. They rejected the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them[31] for their sins and drowned the people of Pharaoh; they were all wrongdoers.
english.footnotes: [31] Repetition of the example of the earlier nations is to emphasize the inevitable fate of those who disbelieve or disobey Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils sont à l’image du peuple de Pharaon et des nations qui l’ont précédé qui, comme eux, ont rejeté Nos signes et que Nous avons donc anéantis pour prix de leurs méfaits, noyant sous les eaux Pharaon et ses sujets. Tous se sont comportés avec la plus grande iniquité.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: The worst of moving creatures[32] before Allah are those who persist in disbelief, so they do not believe,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’est pires créatures pour Allah que ces impies qui rejettent obstinément la foi,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتَّ مِنۡهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٖ وَهُمۡ لَا يَتَّقُونَ

english.text: those with whom you [O Prophet] made a treaty, but they break their treaty every time, and they do not fear Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui ne cessent de violer les pactes conclus avec toi, sans être arrêtés par la crainte d’Allah.

renderings.arabic: فَإِمَّا تَثۡقَفَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡبِ فَشَرِّدۡ بِهِم مَّنۡ خَلۡفَهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

english.text: If you encounter them in battle, make a fearsome example of them[33] for those who are behind them, so that they may be deterred.
english.footnotes: [33] i.e., Treat the treacherous who betray their pledges with due severity.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si tu dois un jour les dominer à la guerre, inflige-leur un traitement exemplaire à même de dissuader ceux qui seraient tentés de les imiter.

renderings.arabic: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوۡمٍ خِيَانَةٗ فَٱنۢبِذۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡخَآئِنِينَ

english.text: If you fear betrayal from any people, throw their treaty back at them openly[34], for Allah does not like the treacherous.
english.footnotes: [34] i.e., announce to them its dissolution so that you both be on the same footing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et si tu redoutes d’être trahi par un groupe, alors dénonce ouvertement le pacte qui vous lie, afin d’être sur un pied d’égalité avec lui[30]. Allah n’aime pas les traîtres.
french.footnotes: [30] Chacun saura, en effet, que le traité de paix est caduc et pourra se préparer à la guerre.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا يَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سَبَقُوٓاْۚ إِنَّهُمۡ لَا يُعۡجِزُونَ

english.text: The disbelievers should not think that they are unreachable; they cannot escape.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que ceux qui ont rejeté la foi ne croient surtout pas qu’ils Nous ont échappé. Non ! Ils ne pourront éviter Notre châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَأَعِدُّواْ لَهُم مَّا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن قُوَّةٖ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ ٱلۡخَيۡلِ تُرۡهِبُونَ بِهِۦ عَدُوَّ ٱللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمۡ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُهُمۡۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تُظۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Prepare against them whatever force[35] you can and cavalry, to deter Allah’s enemies and your enemies[36], and others besides them whom you do not know[37], but Allah knows them. Whatever you spend[38] in the cause of Allah will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.
english.footnotes:
[35] All types of power: physical, mental as well as weapons. [36] To make them think twice before invading or fighting them.
 [37] i.e., lurking enemies.
 [38] Funds are necessary for preparing the force.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Préparez, pour les affronter, tout ce que vous pourrez rassembler comme forces et destriers, afin d’effrayer l’ennemi d’Allah et le vôtre, et d’autres encore que vous ignorez mais qu’Allah connaît. Toute dépense que vous ferez pour la cause d’Allah vous sera pleinement restituée, sans que vous soyez lésés.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَإِن جَنَحُواْ لِلسَّلۡمِ فَٱجۡنَحۡ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: If they incline to peace, then incline to it, and put your trust in Allah, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais s’ils t’offrent la paix, accepte leur proposition, en plaçant ta confiance en Allah, Celui qui entend tout et sait tout.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسۡبَكَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصۡرِهِۦ وَبِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: But if they intend to deceive you, then Allah is sufficient for you; it is He Who supported you with His help and with that of the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et s’ils cherchent par cela à te trahir, sache qu’Allah te suffit, Lui qui t’a déjà apporté Son soutien et celui des croyants,

renderings.arabic: وَأَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ لَوۡ أَنفَقۡتَ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مَّآ أَلَّفۡتَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ

english.text: He brought their hearts together[39], even if you had spent all that is on earth, you could not have brought their hearts together, but Allah has brought them together, for He is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
english.footnotes: [39] The joining of the hearts was indeed a great favour, as the extent of enmity among them in the pre-Islamic era was rampant.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qui a uni leurs cœurs. Or, si tu y avais consacré toutes les richesses de la terre, tu n’aurais pu unir leurs cœurs comme Allah, dans Sa toute-puissance et Son infinie sagesse, a pu le faire.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ حَسۡبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: O Prophet, Allah is sufficient for you[40] and for the believers who follow you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prophète ! Sache qu’Allah est un soutien bien suffisant pour toi et pour ceux des croyants qui te suivent au combat[31].
french.footnotes: [31] Ou : sache qu’Allah est pour toi un soutien bien suffisant, de même que ceux des croyants qui te suivent au combat.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡقِتَالِۚ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمۡ عِشۡرُونَ صَٰبِرُونَ يَغۡلِبُواْ مِاْئَتَيۡنِۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّاْئَةٞ يَغۡلِبُوٓاْ أَلۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يَفۡقَهُونَ

english.text: O Prophet, urge the believers to fight. If there are twenty steadfast among you, they will overcome two hundred; and if there are a hundred of you, they will overcome a thousand of the disbelievers, for they are a people who do not understand.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prophète ! Incite sans relâche les croyants au combat. S’il se trouve parmi vous une vingtaine d’hommes endurants, ils en vaincront deux cents, et s’il s’en trouve une centaine, ils triompheront de mille mécréants. Ce sont en effet des gens privés de tout entendement.

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ خَفَّفَ ٱللَّهُ عَنكُمۡ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ ضَعۡفٗاۚ فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّاْئَةٞ صَابِرَةٞ يَغۡلِبُواْ مِاْئَتَيۡنِۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أَلۡفٞ يَغۡلِبُوٓاْ أَلۡفَيۡنِ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

english.text: Now Allah has lightened your burden, for He knew that there is weakness in you. So if there are a hundred steadfast men among you, they will overcome two hundred; and if there are a thousand, they will overcome two thousand, by Allah’s permission. And Allah is with those who are steadfast.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Connaissant votre faiblesse, Allah allège à présent ce commandement[32]. Une centaine de combattants endurants parmi vous viendront à bout de deux cents de vos ennemis et un millier auront raison de deux mille impies par la volonté d’Allah qui est toujours avec ceux qui se montrent endurants.
french.footnotes: [32] En abrogeant le verset précédent qui interdisait aux musulmans de fuir devant un ennemi dix fois plus nombreux.

renderings.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَسۡرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثۡخِنَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ

english.text: It is not befitting for a prophet to take captives[41] until he thoroughly subdues [the enemy] in the land. You desire the gains of this world[42], but Allah desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
english.footnotes:
[41] It is referring to the disbelievers of Quraysh who were taken as captives by the Prophet (ﷺ) in the wake of Badr.
 [42] i.e., material benefits, such as the ransom paid by prisoners.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’appartient pas à un prophète de faire des prisonniers tant qu’il n’a pas étendu son autorité sur terre. Vous convoitez les biens éphémères de ce monde[33], tandis qu’Allah veut pour vous la récompense de l’au-delà. Allah est Tout-Puissant et infiniment Sage.
french.footnotes: [33] Des rançons contre la libération de vos prisonniers.

renderings.arabic: لَّوۡلَا كِتَٰبٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمۡ فِيمَآ أَخَذۡتُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: Were it not for a prior decree[43] from Allah, you would have surely been afflicted with a great punishment for what you have taken [of ransom].
english.footnotes: [43] This ‘decree’: 1) that He would make spoils and ransom lawful, 2) that He would not punish for a matter not explained previously, 3) and that He would not punish the Companions who attended Badr.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sans un décret préalable de ton Seigneur, un terrible châtiment vous aurait été infligé pour prix de ces rançons que vous avez acceptées.

renderings.arabic: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا غَنِمۡتُمۡ حَلَٰلٗا طَيِّبٗاۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: So consume what you have gained in war, for it is lawful[44] and good, but fear Allah. Allah is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english.footnotes: [44] When Allah saw the destitution and helplessness of the Muslims, He made gains of war lawful for them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Disposez donc des prises de guerre qui vous sont entièrement licites et craignez Allah qui, en vérité, est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ قُل لِّمَن فِيٓ أَيۡدِيكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَسۡرَىٰٓ إِن يَعۡلَمِ ٱللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ خَيۡرٗا يُؤۡتِكُمۡ خَيۡرٗا مِّمَّآ أُخِذَ مِنكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: O Prophet, tell those captives who are in your custody, “If Allah knows of any good[45] in your hearts, He will give you something better than what has been taken from you, and will forgive you, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
english.footnotes: [45] i.e., a sincere will to embrace Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prophète ! Dis aux captifs qui sont entre vos mains : « Si Allah sait que vos cœurs sont disposés à croire, Il vous accordera mieux encore que ce qui vous a été enlevé[34] et vous pardonnera. Allah est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux. »
french.footnotes: [34] Les rançons versées contre votre libération.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن يُرِيدُواْ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدۡ خَانُواْ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَأَمۡكَنَ مِنۡهُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

english.text: But if they intend to betray you, they have already betrayed Allah before, so He empowered you over them. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’ils cherchent à te trahir, sache qu’ils ont avant cela trahi Allah[35] qui les a alors mis à votre merci. Allah est Omniscient et d’une sagesse infinie.
french.footnotes: [35] Notamment en rejetant la foi.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَواْ وَّنَصَرُوٓاْ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يُهَاجِرُواْ مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَٰيَتِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُواْۚ وَإِنِ ٱسۡتَنصَرُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٞۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ

english.text: Those who believed, migrated, and fought with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah, and those who provided [the migrants] with shelter and help – they are allies of one another. As for those who believed but did not migrate, you have no obligation to protect them until they migrate. But if they seek your help in religion, it is your obligation to help, except against people with whom you have a treaty. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui, après avoir embrassé la foi, ont émigré et sacrifié leurs biens et leurs vies pour la cause d’Allah[36] sont unis par des liens indéfectibles à ceux qui leur ont offert asile et prêté assistance[37]. Quant à ceux qui se sont convertis sans pour autant quitter leur patrie[38], vous n’avez nullement à leur reconnaître de tels liens tant qu’ils n’ont pas émigré à leur tour. Si toutefois ils réclament votre soutien au nom de votre foi commune, apportez-leur votre assistance, à moins que ce soit contre un groupe auquel vous êtes liés par un pacte. Allah voit parfaitement ce que vous faites.
french.footnotes:
[36] Première catégorie de musulmans décrite ici : les Mouhâjiroun, ceux qui ont émigré de la Mecque à Médine.
[37] Seconde catégorie : les Ansars (les soutiens), qui les ont accueillis à Médine. Ces « liens indéfectibles » impliquaient, selon certains exégètes, que les uns devaient apporter leur soutien aux autres ou, selon d’autres, que les uns devaient hériter des autres. C’est d’ailleurs cette dernière prescription qui sera abrogée par le dernier verset de cette sourate.
[38] Troisième catégorie : ceux qui ont embrassé la foi sans franchir le pas de l’émigration en terre d’islam.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍۚ إِلَّا تَفۡعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتۡنَةٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَفَسَادٞ كَبِيرٞ

english.text: Those who disbelieve are protectors of one another[46]. Unless you do likewise, there will be persecution in the land and great corruption.
english.footnotes: [46] i.e., taking one another as allies and abandoning all bonds with the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants sont solidaires les uns des autres. Si donc vous n’agissez pas vous-mêmes de cette manière[39], la corruption et le désordre règneront sur terre.
french.footnotes: [39] Si vous ne respectez pas les liens qui doivent unir les croyants et ne rompez pas avec les mécréants.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَواْ وَّنَصَرُوٓاْ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ حَقّٗاۚ لَّهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ

english.text: Those who believed, migrated and fought in the cause of Allah, as well as those who gave them refuge and help – it is they who are the true believers; they will have forgiveness and an honorable provision.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui, après avoir embrassé la foi, ont émigré et lutté pour la cause d’Allah, ainsi que ceux qui leur ont offert asile et prêté assistance, voilà les vrais croyants qui obtiendront le pardon de leurs péchés et des dons généreux.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ مَعَكُمۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمۡۚ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِبَعۡضٖ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ

english.text: And those who believed afterwards, migrated and fought along with you – they belong to you. But blood relatives are more entitled to inherit[47] from one another according to the Book of Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of everything.
english.footnotes: [47] This applies only to Muslim relatives; others may be given by bequest. See 4:11.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les croyants qui, par la suite, émigreront et lutteront à vos côtés seront également vos frères. Allah a toutefois décrété que les liens de parenté devaient prévaloir sur les liens de fraternité et tout autre lien. Allah, en vérité, a une parfaite connaissance de toute chose.

renderings.arabic: بَرَآءَةٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

english.text: [This is] a declaration of disassociation[1] by Allah and His Messenger to those polytheists with whom you have made a treaty.
english.footnotes: [1] This surah, unlike all surahs of the Qur’an, is not preceded by al-basmalah (the usual opening statement).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Proclamation solennelle par laquelle Allah et Son Messager dénoncent les pactes vous liant aux idolâtres.

renderings.arabic: فَسِيحُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَرۡبَعَةَ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّكُمۡ غَيۡرُ مُعۡجِزِي ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡزِي ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: “Therefore move freely in the land[2] for four months, but know that you cannot escape Allah and that Allah will humiliate the disbelievers.”
english.footnotes: [2] They were encouraged to repent or find a safe place to depart to.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous pourrez donc, vous idolâtres, durant quatre mois, vous déplacer en toute sécurité dans le pays, mais sachez que vous ne saurez échapper au châtiment d’Allah qui couvrira d’ignominie les impies.

renderings.arabic: وَأَذَٰنٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَجِّ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَرِيٓءٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ فَإِن تُبۡتُمۡ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّكُمۡ غَيۡرُ مُعۡجِزِي ٱللَّهِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

english.text: A declaration from Allah and His Messenger to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage[3], that Allah and His Messenger are free from obligation to the polytheists. If you repent, it is better for you, but if you turn away, then know that you cannot escape Allah[4]. And give the disbelievers tidings of a painful punishment.
english.footnotes: [3] Hajj; ‘Umrah is a minor pilgrimage. [4] i.e., you cannot escape His punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Proclamation adressée aux hommes le jour du grand pèlerinage[1], de la part d’Allah et de Son Messager : Allah est délié de tout engagement envers les idolâtres, de même que Son Messager[2]. Si donc vous vous repentez, cela vaudra mieux pour vous. Si, au contraire, vous vous obstinez dans l’impiété, sachez que vous ne saurez éviter le châtiment d’Allah. Annonce donc un douloureux tourment à ceux qui ont rejeté la foi.
french.footnotes:
[1] Le jour du sacrifice, à Mina, selon la majorité des exégètes.
[2] Qui lui non plus n’est plus tenu par ses engagements à l’égard des païens.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَنقُصُوكُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَمۡ يُظَٰهِرُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَحَدٗا فَأَتِمُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡ عَهۡدَهُمۡ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: Except those polytheists with whom you have a treaty and who have not broken it in the least, nor have backed up anyone against you – so fulfill your treaty with them until the end of their term[5]. Indeed, Allah loves those who fear Him.
english.footnotes: [5] This is an exception from the four months reprieve.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’agissant des idolâtres qui vous sont liés par un pacte dont ils ont honoré toutes les clauses et qui n’ont pas soutenu vos ennemis contre vous, le traité conclu avec eux devra être respecté jusqu’au terme convenu[3]. Allah aime ceux qui se gardent de toute trahison.
french.footnotes: [3] La période de quatre mois au cours de laquelle les polythéistes pourront se déplacer librement avant d’être inquiétés ne concerne donc que ceux qui sont liés aux musulmans par un traité de paix à durée indéterminée ou ceux qu’aucun pacte ne lie aux croyants. Quant à ceux qui ont conclu avec eux une trêve à durée déterminée, ils seront en sécurité jusqu’à expiration de la période convenue, fût-elle supérieure à quatre mois.

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنسَلَخَ ٱلۡأَشۡهُرُ ٱلۡحُرُمُ فَٱقۡتُلُواْ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ حَيۡثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمۡ وَخُذُوهُمۡ وَٱحۡصُرُوهُمۡ وَٱقۡعُدُواْ لَهُمۡ كُلَّ مَرۡصَدٖۚ فَإِن تَابُواْ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَخَلُّواْ سَبِيلَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: Then when the [four] sacred months[6] are over, kill the polytheists wherever you find them, seize them, besiege them and lie in wait for them on every route[7]. But if they repent, establish prayers and give zakah, then set them free, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful[8].
english.footnotes:
[6] i.e., Muharram, Rajab, Dhul-Qa‘dah and Dhul-Hijjah.
 [7] Some prominent scholars of Islam are of the opinion that this applies especially to combatant disbelievers who pose a threat to Muslims.
 [8] The next few verses reveal who these really are and why they deserve such retaliatory measures.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’expiration des mois sacrés[4], vous pourrez tuer les païens où que vous les trouviez. Capturez-les, assiégez-les et dressez-leur des embuscades sur tout chemin. Mais s’ils se repentent, accomplissent la prière et s’acquittent de l’aumône, laissez-les en paix. Allah, en vérité, est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux.
french.footnotes: [4] Les quatre mois de sursis accordés aux polythéistes pour se déplacer librement et mentionnés au verset 2, selon certains exégètes ou, selon d’autres, les quatre mois sacrés du calendrier arabe au cours desquels les combats étaient prohibés.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنۡ أَحَدٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ ٱسۡتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرۡهُ حَتَّىٰ يَسۡمَعَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبۡلِغۡهُ مَأۡمَنَهُۥۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: If any of the polytheists asks you for protection, give it to him, so that he may hear the Word of Allah[9], then escort him to his place of safety; that is because they are a people who do not know.
english.footnotes: [9] Because their belligerence and animosity stem from their ignorance about Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si, toutefois, l’un des idolâtres sollicite ta protection, réponds favorablement à sa requête de manière à ce qu’il entende la parole d’Allah. Puis assure-toi qu’il puisse regagner sa patrie sans être inquiété. Ce sont en effet des gens qui vivent dans l’ignorance.

renderings.arabic: كَيۡفَ يَكُونُ لِلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ عَهۡدٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّمۡ عِندَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِۖ فَمَا ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَقِيمُواْ لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: How can the polytheists have a treaty with Allah and with His Messenger, except those whom you made a treaty with at the Sacred Mosque[10]? Should they fulfill their pledge to you, fulfill your pledge to them[11], for Allah loves those who fear Him.
english.footnotes:
[10] The Treaty of Hudaybiyah made in the environs of the Sacred Mosque.
 [11] i.e., maintain the terms of the treaty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment les idolâtres, excepté ceux avec lesquels vous avez conclu une trêve près de la Mosquée sacrée, pourraient-ils bénéficier d’un pacte avec Allah et Son Messager ? Tant que ces derniers respectent leur engagement, honorez le vôtre. Allah aime ceux qui se gardent de toute trahison.

renderings.arabic: كَيۡفَ وَإِن يَظۡهَرُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَا يَرۡقُبُواْ فِيكُمۡ إِلّٗا وَلَا ذِمَّةٗۚ يُرۡضُونَكُم بِأَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتَأۡبَىٰ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ

english.text: How [can there be a treaty] – if they were to overcome you, they would neither respect ties of kinship nor treaty[12]? They please you with their tongues, while their hearts are averse to it, and most of them are wicked.
english.footnotes: [12] They cannot be trusted because they constantly renege on their pledges and break their promises.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment, alors que s’ils se trouvaient en position de force, ils ne respecteraient ni vos liens de parenté, ni l’engagement contracté ? Ils vous bercent de belles paroles pour vous satisfaire, mais sans que leurs cœurs y adhèrent. La plupart d’entre eux n’ont aucune loyauté.

renderings.arabic: ٱشۡتَرَوۡاْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗا فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: They have sold the verses of Allah for a small price and prevented [people] from His way[13]. Terrible is indeed what they have done!
english.footnotes: [13] In order to maintain their source of income, they barred their people from embracing Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils vendent à vil prix les paroles d’Allah, détournant les hommes de Sa voie. Comme leur comportement est détestable !

renderings.arabic: لَا يَرۡقُبُونَ فِي مُؤۡمِنٍ إِلّٗا وَلَا ذِمَّةٗۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدُونَ

english.text: They do not honor the ties of kinship or treaties with regard to the believers. It is they who are the transgressors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ne respectent, à l’égard des croyants, ni liens de parenté, ni engagement contracté, ne songeant qu’à violer leur parole et à les agresser.

renderings.arabic: فَإِن تَابُواْ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَإِخۡوَٰنُكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِۗ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Yet if they repent, establish prayer and give zakah, then they are your brothers in faith. We explain the verses in detail for people who know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais s’ils se repentent, accomplissent la prière et s’acquittent de l’aumône, ils deviendront vos frères par la foi. Nous exposons clairement Nos enseignements à des gens capables de les comprendre.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن نَّكَثُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ عَهۡدِهِمۡ وَطَعَنُواْ فِي دِينِكُمۡ فَقَٰتِلُوٓاْ أَئِمَّةَ ٱلۡكُفۡرِ إِنَّهُمۡ لَآ أَيۡمَٰنَ لَهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَنتَهُونَ

english.text: But if they break their oaths after making a pledge and revile your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief – whose oaths mean nothing to them – so that they may desist.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’ils rompent leur pacte et s’attaquent à votre religion, combattez les chefs de l’impiété, eux qui sont si peu enclins à honorer leur parole, afin qu’ils mettent fin à leurs hostilités.

renderings.arabic: أَلَا تُقَٰتِلُونَ قَوۡمٗا نَّكَثُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ وَهَمُّواْ بِإِخۡرَاجِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَهُم بَدَءُوكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۚ أَتَخۡشَوۡنَهُمۡۚ فَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخۡشَوۡهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Will you not fight people who broke their oaths, conspired to expel the Messenger[14], and initiated the war against you first[15]? Do you fear them? Rather it is Allah Whom you should fear, if you are [truly] believers.
english.footnotes: [14] From Makkah. [15] By helping the clan of Bakr to kill mercilessly the clan of Khuza‘ah, the allies of the Prophet (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’allez-vous pas combattre des gens qui ont violé leur pacte et tenté d’expulser le Messager, et qui ont eux-mêmes engagé les hostilités ? Se peut-il que vous les redoutiez ? C’est plutôt Allah, si vous êtes vraiment croyants, que vous devez redouter.

renderings.arabic: قَٰتِلُوهُمۡ يُعَذِّبۡهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِأَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيُخۡزِهِمۡ وَيَنصُرۡكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَيَشۡفِ صُدُورَ قَوۡمٖ مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Fight them, Allah will punish them at your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them, and will soothe the hearts of people who believe,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Combattez-les ! Allah, par vos mains, leur infligera le châtiment qu’ils méritent, les couvrira d’opprobre et vous accordera la victoire sur eux. Il apaisera les cœurs des croyants

renderings.arabic: وَيُذۡهِبۡ غَيۡظَ قُلُوبِهِمۡۗ وَيَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

english.text: and He will remove rage from their hearts. Allah turns in forgiveness to whom He wills. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et dissipera leur ressentiment. Puis Allah, par Sa science et Sa sagesse infinies, accueillera le repentir de qui Il voudra parmi eux.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبۡتُمۡ أَن تُتۡرَكُواْ وَلَمَّا يَعۡلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِۦ وَلَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: Do you think that you will be left untested, when Allah has not yet proven who among you strove [in His cause] and did not take any trusted allies other than Allah, His Messenger and the believers? Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pensez-vous que vous ne subirez pas d’épreuves par lesquelles Allah distinguera ceux d’entre vous qui luttent sincèrement pour Sa cause et ne recherchent pas d’autres alliés que le Seigneur, Son Messager et les croyants ? Allah est parfaitement informé de vos agissements.

renderings.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ أَن يَعۡمُرُواْ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ شَٰهِدِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِم بِٱلۡكُفۡرِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ وَفِي ٱلنَّارِ هُمۡ خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: It is not for the polytheists to maintain Allah’s mosques[16] while openly displaying their disbelief. Their deeds have become worthless, and they will abide in the Fire forever.
english.footnotes: [16] i.e., building them and taking care of them, or performing acts of devotional worship.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’appartient aucunement aux païens de fréquenter les mosquées d’Allah alors qu’ils affichent ouvertement leur impiété. Voilà ceux dont les œuvres sont vaines et qui entreront en Enfer pour l’éternité.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَعۡمُرُ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَلَمۡ يَخۡشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۖ فَعَسَىٰٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَن يَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

english.text: The mosques of Allah are only to be maintained by those who believe in Allah[17] and the Last Day, establish prayer, give zakah and fear none but Allah. It is they who are expected to be rightly guided.
english.footnotes: [17] Not associating anyone or anything with Allah in worship.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
