english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A ceux qui croient et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres sont réservées la plus grande félicité et la plus heureuse des retraites.

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ فِيٓ أُمَّةٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهَآ أُمَمٞ لِّتَتۡلُوَاْ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَهُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ قُلۡ هُوَ رَبِّي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ مَتَابِ

english.text: Thus did We send you to a community before which other communities had passed away, so that you may recite to them what We have revealed to you, yet they disbelieve in the Most Compassionate. Say, “He is my Lord; none has the right to be worshiped except Him. In Him I put my trust, and to Him is my return.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous t’avons suscité à un peuple que d’autres ont précédé, afin de lui réciter ce que Nous t’avons révélé. Les mécréants s’obstinent pourtant à renier le Tout Miséricordieux. Dis : « Il est mon Seigneur. Il n’est de divinité digne d’être adorée que Lui. C’est à Lui que je m’en remets entièrement et à Lui que je reviens repentant. »

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ قُرۡءَانٗا سُيِّرَتۡ بِهِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ أَوۡ قُطِّعَتۡ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَوۡ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ جَمِيعًاۗ أَفَلَمۡ يَاْيۡـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعٗاۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُواْ قَارِعَةٌ أَوۡ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبٗا مِّن دَارِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ وَعۡدُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ

english.text: Even if there were a Qur’an that could cause mountains to move[26], or split the earth, or cause the dead to speak, [they would still not believe]. To Allah belongs all matters. Do the believers not know that if Allah had willed, He could have guided all humans? Calamities will continue to befall the disbelievers or strike close to their homes because of their deeds, until the promise of Allah comes to pass, for Allah does not fail in His promise.
english.footnotes: [26] “Had We sent down this Qur’an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and break asunder out of awe of Allah!” See 59:21.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si un livre pouvait déplacer les montagnes, fendre la terre ou faire parler les morts, ce serait bien celui-ci. Toute décision cependant appartient à Allah. Les croyants ne savent-ils pas que, s’Il le voulait, Allah guiderait tous les hommes ? Pour prix de leurs iniquités, les impies ne cesseront d’être frappés de malheurs, qui pourront aussi s’abattre autour d’eux, jusqu’à ce que la menace d’Allah soit mise à exécution. Allah, en vérité, exécute toujours Ses menaces.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

english.text: There were messengers before you who were ridiculed, but I gave respite to those who disbelieved, then I seized them[27]. How [terrible] was My chastisement!
english.footnotes: [27] This is a comforting note to the Prophet (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Des Messagers ont, avant toi, fait l’objet de moqueries. J’ai alors accordé un sursis aux impies dont Je me suis finalement saisi. Quel fut alors Mon châtiment !

renderings.arabic: أَفَمَنۡ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۗ وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلۡ سَمُّوهُمۡۚ أَمۡ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَم بِظَٰهِرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۗ بَلۡ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَصُدُّواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ

english.text: Is He Who watches every soul in whatever it does [like others]? Yet they ascribe partners to Allah. Say, “Name them! Or do you presume to inform Him of something that He does not know on earth, or it is just a show of words?” No, but the falsehood of the disbelievers is made appealing to them, and they are hindered from the [straight] path. Whoever Allah causes to stray, he will have none to guide.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui observe chaque être, tenant le compte précis de ses œuvres, est-Il comparable aux fausses divinités qu’ils associent à Allah ? Dis-leur : « Indiquez-nous quelles sont ces divinités[12] » ! Auriez-vous la prétention d’apprendre à Allah ce dont Il ignorerait jusqu’ici l’existence sur terre ? Ou bien s’agit-il de simples noms ne correspondant à aucune réalité ? En vérité, les pratiques des impies ont été embellies à leurs yeux, si bien qu’ils ont été détournés du droit chemin. Or, nul ne saurait guider celui qu’Allah laisse s’égarer.
french.footnotes: [12] Autre sens : appelez-les divinités (si vous le voulez, cela ne fait pas pour autant de ces idoles de vrais dieux).

renderings.arabic: لَّهُمۡ عَذَابٞ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَقُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٖ

english.text: They will be punished in this life, but the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe, and they will have no protector against Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils seront durement châtiés ici-bas, mais les tourments de l’au-delà seront bien plus terribles. Nul ne pourra les protéger du châtiment d’Allah.

renderings.arabic: ۞ مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٞ وَظِلُّهَاۚ تِلۡكَ عُقۡبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْۚ وَّعُقۡبَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ

english.text: The likeness of Paradise, which is promised to the righteous is that under it rivers flow; its fruit is eternal, so is its shade. Such is the end of those who fear Allah, but the end of the disbelievers is Fire!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tel est le Paradis promis à ceux qui craignent le Seigneur : des jardins traversés de rivières aux fruits et aux ombrages éternels. Voici les délices réservés aux pieux croyants, tandis que les mécréants sont voués au feu de l’Enfer.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَفۡرَحُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعۡضَهُۥۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَلَآ أُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦٓۚ إِلَيۡهِ أَدۡعُواْ وَإِلَيۡهِ مَـَٔابِ

english.text: Those whom We gave the Scripture[28] rejoice at that which is sent down to you [O Prophet], but there are some factions who deny part of it. Say, “I have only been commanded to worship Allah, and associate none with Him. To Him I call and to Him is my return.”
english.footnotes: [28] From the Jews and the Christians.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux auxquels Nous avons confié les Ecritures se réjouissent de ce qui t’a été révélé, tandis que certains, parmi les impies qui se sont ligués contre toi, en renient une partie. Dis : « Il m’est seulement ordonné d’adorer Allah sans rien Lui associer. C’est à Son adoration que j’appelle les hommes et à Lui que je ferai retour. »

renderings.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمًا عَرَبِيّٗاۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بَعۡدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا وَاقٖ

english.text: Thus We have sent it down as a commandment in Arabic. If you were to follow their[29] desires after the knowledge that has come to you, you would have no supporter or protector against Allah.
english.footnotes: [29] i.e., the People of the Book.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous avons révélé le Coran, livre en langue arabe d’une sagesse infinie, afin que tu en appliques les préceptes. Si donc tu te pliais à leurs désirs après avoir reçu la Révélation, nul ne pourrait te soutenir ou te protéger contre Allah.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَذُرِّيَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٖ كِتَابٞ

english.text: We have sent messengers before you and gave them wives and offspring[30]. It was not for any messenger to bring a sign except with Allah’s permission. Every matter has a destined time.
english.footnotes: [30] These are the basic human needs, for Messengers are human beings, not angelic beings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, avant toi, envoyé des Messagers auxquels Nous avons fait don d’épouses et d’enfants. Il n’appartient aucunement à un Messager de produire un miracle si ce n’est par la volonté d’Allah. A toute chose un terme est fixé[13].
french.footnotes: [13] Dans le Livre archétype, où sont inscrits les décrets divins, et qui sera justement mentionné au verset suivant.

renderings.arabic: يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ

english.text: Allah eliminates what He wills or affirms it[31], and with Him is the Master Book[32].
english.footnotes:
[31] Although everything is set in the Record, He decrees whatever He wishes and the angels erase or affirm in the scrolls whatever He dictates.
 [32] The Preserved Tablet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah infirme ou confirme Ses arrêts[14] comme Il l’entend. Auprès de Lui se trouve le Livre archétype.
french.footnotes: [14] Ou : abroge ou maintient Ses lois.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡحِسَابُ

english.text: Whether We show you [O Prophet] part of what We warn them or cause you to die [before that], your duty is only to convey the message, and the reckoning is for Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que Nous leur infligions, de ton vivant, une partie du châtiment dont Nous les menaçons ou que Nous reprenions ton âme avant cela, tu es uniquement chargé de transmettre Notre message et c’est à Nous de leur demander des comptes.

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

english.text: Do they not see that We advance to the land, diminishing it from its sides[33]? It is Allah Who decrees; there is none to reverse His decree, and He is swift in reckoning.
english.footnotes: [33] Referring to the spread of Islam by diminishing the lands controlled by the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants ne voient-ils pas que Nous reculons inéluctablement les limites de leur territoire[15] ? Allah prononce souverainement Ses arrêts, qui sont sans appel, et Il est prompt dans Ses comptes.
french.footnotes: [15] Par les conquêtes musulmanes, selon la majorité des exégètes musulmans.

renderings.arabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ جَمِيعٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡكُفَّٰرُ لِمَنۡ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ

english.text: Those who came before them did devise plans, but Allah has the ultimate plan. He knows what every soul does, and the disbelievers will come to know who will have the final abode.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les peuples du passé se sont livrés aux pires manœuvres contre leurs Messagers, qui toutes sont restées sans effet. Car seule est exécutée la volonté d’Allah qui sait ce que chaque être entreprend. Les mécréants sauront à qui est réservée une fin heureuse.

renderings.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَسۡتَ مُرۡسَلٗاۚ قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ

english.text: Those who disbelieve say, “You are not a messenger.” Say, “Allah is sufficient as a Witness between me and you, as well as those who have knowledge of the Scripture[34].”
english.footnotes: [34] As he is clearly mentioned in their Scripture.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui ont rejeté la foi affirment que tu n’es pas envoyé par Allah. Réponds-leur : « Allah suffit pour témoigner de ma sincérité et de vos mensonges, de même que ceux qui ont la connaissance des Ecritures. »

renderings.arabic: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ لِتُخۡرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ

english.text: Alif Lām Ra[1]. This is a book that We have sent down to you, so that you may bring people out of the depths of darkness into the light, by their Lord’s permission, to the path of the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy.
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Alif-Lâm-Râ.[1] Voici un livre que Nous te révélons afin que, par la volonté de leur Seigneur, tu fasses sortir les hommes des ténèbres vers la lumière et les diriges vers la voie du Tout-Puissant, de Celui qui est digne de toutes les louanges,
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٍ

english.text: Allah, to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah, à qui appartient tout ce qui se trouve dans les cieux et sur la terre. Malheur aux mécréants qui sont voués à un terrible châtiment,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَحِبُّونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا عَلَى ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ

english.text: Those who prefer the life of this world to the Hereafter and prevent [people] from Allah’s way, seeking to make it crooked[2]; it is they who have gone far astray.
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., showing it as defective and imperfect.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: eux qui préfèrent cette vie à celle de l’au-delà et qui s’emploient à détourner les hommes de la voie d’Allah, qu’ils cherchent à rendre tortueuse. Ceux-là sont en plein égarement.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوۡمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمۡۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

english.text: We did not send any messenger but in the language of his people to make things clear for them. Allah causes to stray whom He wills[3] and guides whom He wills, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., those who refuse His guidance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons envoyé aucun Messager qui ne se soit exprimé dans la langue des siens afin de leur exposer clairement Notre message. Allah, le Tout-Puissant, l’infiniment Sage, laisse ensuite s’égarer qui Il veut et guide qui Il veut.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنۡ أَخۡرِجۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرۡهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٖ

english.text: We sent Moses with Our signs [saying], “Bring your people out of the depths of darkness into the light, and remind them of Allah’s days[4]. Indeed, there are signs in this for every patient and grateful person.
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., days of favors upon the Children of Israel, or days of destruction of the former nations.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons ainsi envoyé Moïse, assisté de Nos signes, avec ordre de faire sortir les siens des ténèbres vers la lumière et de leur rappeler les jours mémorables d’Allah[2]. Voilà des signes suffisamment clairs pour quiconque se montre plein de constance et de reconnaissance.
french.footnotes: [2] Expression que l’on retrouve dans la Bible hébraïque (Les jours de Yahvé) où elle désigne les grands événements qui ont vu la manifestation de la puissance d’Allah et de Ses grâces en faveur de Son peuple élu, les fils d’Israël. Elle semble désigner ici les jours mémorables où Allah a sauvé les Hébreux et anéanti leur ennemi, l’orgueilleux Pharaon.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنجَىٰكُم مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: And [remember] when Moses said to his people, “Remember Allah’s favor upon you when He saved you from Pharaoh’s people who were inflicting upon you the worst torment, slaughtering your sons and keeping your women alive; that was a great trial from your Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit à son peuple : « Rappelez-vous les bienfaits d’Allah envers vous lorsqu’Il vous délivra de Pharaon et de ses sujets qui vous infligeaient les pires tourments en égorgeant vos fils, n’épargnant que vos filles. Ce fut là une terrible épreuve de la part de votre Seigneur. »

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٞ

english.text: And [remember] when your Lord declared, ‘If you are grateful, I will surely give you more; but if you are ungrateful, My punishment is severe indeed.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et lorsque votre Seigneur proclama : « Si vous êtes reconnaissants, Je multiplierai certainement Mes faveurs envers vous. Mais si vous vous montrez ingrats, Mon châtiment sera terrible. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكۡفُرُوٓاْ أَنتُمۡ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ

english.text: And Moses said, “If you and all those who are on earth were to disbelieve, indeed Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit encore : « Si vous et tous ceux qui peuplent la terre rejetez la foi[3], sachez qu’Allah peut parfaitement se passer des hommes et qu’Il est digne de toutes les louanges. »
french.footnotes: [3] Ou : vous vous montrez ingrats.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كَفَرۡنَا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَنَآ إِلَيۡهِ مُرِيبٖ

english.text: Have there not come to you the stories of those who came before you – the people of Noah, ‘Ād and Thamūd, and those who came after them? No one knows them except Allah. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, but they shoved their hands into their mouths[5] and said, “We disbelieve in what you are sent with, and we surely doubt what you are calling us to.”
english.footnotes: [5] as a gesture of denial and rejection.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’avez-vous pas su ce qu’il est advenu des peuples ayant vécu avant vous, le peuple de Noé, les ‘Ad, les Thamoud, ainsi que les nations venues après eux et que seul Allah connaît ? Devant les preuves évidentes présentées par leurs Messagers, ils portaient leurs mains à leurs bouches[4], disant : « Nous ne croyons pas au message que vous nous apportez et éprouvons de sérieux doutes au sujet de ce culte que vous nous appelez à adopter. »
french.footnotes: [4] D’étonnement. Toutefois, selon nombre d’exégètes, ces paroles signifient qu’ils se mordaient les doigts de rage.

renderings.arabic: ۞ قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ أَفِي ٱللَّهِ شَكّٞ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأۡتُونَا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: Their messengers said, “Can there be any doubt about Allah, the Creator of the heavens and earth? He calls you so that He may forgive some of your sins, and give you respite for an appointed term.” They said, “You are but humans like us! You want to turn us away from what our forefathers used to worship; then bring us a clear proof.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leurs Messagers dirent : « Peut-on réellement douter de l’unicité d’Allah, Créateur des cieux et de la terre, qui vous exhorte à renoncer à votre impiété afin de vous pardonner une partie de vos péchés et de vous laisser jouir de cette vie jusqu’au terme qui vous est assigné ? » Ils rétorquèrent : « Vous êtes, comme nous, de simples hommes dont le seul but est de nous détourner du culte de nos ancêtres. Apportez-nous donc une preuve claire de votre bonne foi. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَتۡ لَهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ إِن نَّحۡنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأۡتِيَكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Their messengers said to them, “We are no more than human beings like you, but it is Allah Who bestows His favor upon whom He wills of His slaves. It is not for us to bring you proof except with Allah’s permission, and in Allah let the believers put their trust.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leurs Messagers répondirent : « Nous ne sommes, il est vrai, que des hommes comme vous, mais Allah accorde Ses faveurs à qui Il veut parmi Ses serviteurs[5]. Nous ne pouvons d’ailleurs vous apporter de preuves que si Allah le veut. Que les croyants s’en remettent donc à Allah seul.
french.footnotes: [5] Si bien qu’Il choisit certains d’entre eux pour en faire Ses prophètes.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدۡ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَاۚ وَلَنَصۡبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيۡتُمُونَاۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

english.text: Why should we not put our trust in Allah, and it is He Who has guided us to our ways? We will surely be patient against whatever harm you cause us. And in Allah let the faithful put their trust.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’aurions-nous à ne pas nous en remettre à Allah alors qu’Il nous a montré le droit chemin ? Nous supporterons patiemment vos persécutions. C’est à Allah que doivent s’en remettre ceux qui cherchent un appui sûr. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِرُسُلِهِمۡ لَنُخۡرِجَنَّكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِنَآ أَوۡ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَاۖ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ لَنُهۡلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: The disbelievers said to their messengers, “We will surely drive you out of our land unless you return to our religion.” Their Lord then inspired them, “We will certainly destroy the wrongdoers,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants dirent alors à leurs Messagers : « Nous allons vous chasser de notre pays, à moins que vous ne reveniez à notre culte. » Le Seigneur révéla à Ses prophètes : « Nous allons assurément anéantir les impies

renderings.arabic: وَلَنُسۡكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ

english.text: and We will make you dwell in the land after them. This is for those who fear standing before Me[6], and who fear My warning.”
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., for account.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et vous établir après leur disparition dans leur pays. Telle est la récompense réservée à ceux qui redoutent de comparaître devant Moi et craignent Mes menaces. »

renderings.arabic: وَٱسۡتَفۡتَحُواْ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ

english.text: [The messengers] sought victory, and every obstinate tyrant was doomed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les Messagers implorèrent alors la victoire[6], si bien que fut perdu tout être fier et rebelle à la vérité,
french.footnotes: [6] Sur leurs ennemis. Autre sens : les nations impies en appelèrent alors au jugement d’Allah.

renderings.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسۡقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٖ صَدِيدٖ

english.text: Hell awaits him, and he will be made to drink of oozing pus,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: voué à la Géhenne où il sera abreuvé d’un pus infâme

renderings.arabic: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٖۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٞ

english.text: which he will arduously sip but can hardly swallow it, and death will come to him from every direction, yet he will not die. And ahead of him will be a harsh punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qu’il avalera à petites gorgées avec les plus grandes difficultés. Assailli de tous côtés par les affres de la mort, il ne lui sera pas donné de mourir. L’attendront, en effet, d’autres tourments tout aussi horribles.

renderings.arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٖۖ لَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ

english.text: The deeds of those who disbelieve[7] in their Lord are like ashes that are blown away by the wind on a stormy day. They will gain nothing from what they did; that is the farthest misguidance.
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., their good deeds, as they were not based on solid ground of faith.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les œuvres de ceux qui ont renié leur Seigneur sont à l’image de cendres balayées par le vent un jour de tempête. Les impies ne tireront aucun profit des œuvres qu’ils auront accomplies. Peut-on être plus éloigné du droit chemin ?

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَأۡتِ بِخَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ

english.text: Do you not see that Allah has created the heavens and earth for a true purpose? If He wills, He can take you away and replace you with a new creation[8].
english.footnotes: [8] “If you turn away, He will replace you with other people, then they will not be like you.” See 47:38.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas qu’Allah a créé les cieux et la terre selon une sagesse infinie ? Il pourrait, s’Il le voulait, vous faire disparaître et vous remplacer par de nouvelles créatures.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٖ

english.text: That is not difficult for Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà qui n’a rien de difficile pour Allah.

renderings.arabic: وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعٗا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ قَالُواْ لَوۡ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيۡنَٰكُمۡۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَجَزِعۡنَآ أَمۡ صَبَرۡنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٖ

english.text: All will appear before Allah, then those who were weak will say to those who were arrogant, “We were your followers; can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?” They will say, “If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we cry or suffer patiently, we have no escape[9].”
english.footnotes: [9] The pain of these disbelievers is not only physical, but also psychological.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour où les hommes quitteront leurs tombes pour comparaître devant Allah, les impies diront à leurs chefs : « Nous étions vos suiveurs sur terre. Pouvez-vous donc aujourd’hui nous soulager un tant soit peu du châtiment d’Allah ? » Leurs chefs répondront : « Si Allah nous avait guidés, nous aurions pu vous indiquer le droit chemin[7]. Que nous nous affligions ou que nous nous résignions[8], nous ne pourrons y échapper. »
french.footnotes:
[7] Sur terre. Autre sens : si Allah nous avait indiqué une issue (nous permettant de sortir de l’Enfer), nous vous l’aurions indiquée.
[8] Autre traduction : que nous soyons en mesure ou non de supporter le châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِيۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصۡرِخِيَّ إِنِّي كَفَرۡتُ بِمَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمُونِ مِن قَبۡلُۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

english.text: Satan will say when the matter is finally decided, “Allah gave you a true promise; I also gave you a promise, but I betrayed you[10]. I had no authority over you, except that I called you and you responded to me[11]. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves. I cannot rescue you, nor can you rescue me. I deny your previous association of me with Allah. Indeed, for the wrongdoers there will be a painful punishment.”
english.footnotes:
[10] “Satan makes no promises to them except delusion!” See 4:120.
 [11] By obeying me instead of Him during life on earth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque le Jugement aura été prononcé, Satan leur dira : « Allah vous a fait une promesse qu’Il a tenue, tandis que moi j’ai trahi ma promesse. Je ne disposais pourtant d’aucune preuve et n’avais aucun pouvoir sur vous. Il m’a suffi de vous appeler pour que vous me suiviez. Ne me blâmez donc pas, ne vous en prenez qu’à vous-mêmes. Je ne vous suis aujourd’hui d’aucun secours, de même que vous ne m’êtes d’aucun secours. Je renie le culte qu’autrefois vous me rendiez en faisant de moi l’égal d’Allah. En vérité, les impies sont voués à un douloureux châtiment. »

renderings.arabic: وَأُدۡخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ

english.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, by the permission of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be, “Peace!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui auront cru et accompli de bonnes œuvres seront, pour leur part, admis dans des jardins traversés de rivières où, par la volonté de leur Seigneur, ils demeureront pour l’éternité et où ces salutations leur seront adressées : « La paix soit avec vous ! »

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا كَلِمَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗ كَشَجَرَةٖ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٞ وَفَرۡعُهَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ

english.text: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word[12] to a good tree[13]? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky[14],
english.footnotes:
[12] i.e., the testimony of faith.
 [13] i.e., the palm tree.
 [14] i.e., Its foundation is firm in the heart and its branches, the good deeds, are high up in the sky, being constantly raised to Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas comment Allah compare une bonne parole[9] à un arbre béni, aux racines solidement implantées dans le sol et aux branches s’élevant vers le ciel,
french.footnotes: [9] L’attestation de foi du croyant, précisent les commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: تُؤۡتِيٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينِۭ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهَاۗ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

english.text: yielding its fruit all the times[15], by the permission of its Lord. Allah makes such comparisons for people, so that they may take heed.
english.footnotes: [15] i.e., day and night, summer and winter; likewise is the testimony of faith, it never ceases to yield good deeds all the time.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, par la grâce de son Seigneur, produit des fruits à tout instant[10]. Allah propose ainsi des paraboles aux hommes afin de les amener à réfléchir.
french.footnotes: [10] Les bonnes œuvres accomplies par le croyant, fruits de sa foi.

renderings.arabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٖ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجۡتُثَّتۡ مِن فَوۡقِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٖ

english.text: But an evil word[16] is like an evil tree[17], uprooted from the surface of the earth, having no stability.
english.footnotes:
[16] i.e., the word of disbelief and polytheism.
 [17] i.e., the tree of colocynth; it has no stable root and its stalks are so feeble; such is disbelief which is shaky in the heart, and their deeds are not raised to benefit them in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La mauvaise parole[11], quant à elle, est à l’image d’un arbre aux fruits amers qui, dépourvu de toute stabilité, ne tarde pas à être déraciné.
french.footnotes: [11] Les paroles impies.

renderings.arabic: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَۚ وَيَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ

english.text: Allah keeps those who believe steadfast with the firm Word [of faith] in the life of this world[18] and in the Hereafter. But Allah causes to stray the wrongdoers[19]; Allah does whatever He wills.
english.footnotes:
[18] When questioned in their graves by the angels.
 [19] For doing wrong to themselves and others, Allah casts doubts and blindness in their hearts and does not guide them to say what is truthful in this life or in the grave.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah raffermit les croyants ici-bas et dans l’au-delà par cette bonne parole dont Il détourne les mécréants. Allah agit toujours comme Il l’entend.

renderings.arabic: ۞ أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفۡرٗا وَأَحَلُّواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡبَوَارِ

english.text: Did you not see those who exchanged Allah’s blessings with disbelief[20], and led their people to the abode of ruin[21]?
english.footnotes:
[20] They met Allah’s blessings with denial instead of gratitude.
 [21] i.e., the Hellfire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’as-tu pas vu ceux qui ont répondu aux grâces d’Allah par l’ingratitude et établi leur peuple dans la demeure de la perdition,

renderings.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ

english.text: In Hell they will burn; what an evil place to settle in!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: la Géhenne où ils entreront pour y brûler à jamais ? Et quel horrible séjour !

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۗ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

english.text: They set up rivals to Allah to mislead people from His way. Say, “Enjoy yourselves for a while! Your destination will be the Fire.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ont associé de fausses divinités à Allah afin de détourner les hommes de Sa voie. Dis-leur : « Jouissez quelque peu de cette vie ! Vous êtes destinés au feu de l’Enfer. »

renderings.arabic: قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا بَيۡعٞ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

english.text: Tell My slaves who believe to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, before there comes a Day when there will be no bargaining or friendship[22].
english.footnotes: [22] As everyone will have enough affairs and busied away with their own record; nothing will avail a person except his good deeds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis à Mes serviteurs croyants d’accomplir la prière et d’offrir par charité, discrètement ou publiquement, une partie de ce que Nous leur avons accordé, avant l’avènement d’un jour où nul rachat ne sera autorisé et nul ne pourra profiter de ses amitiés.

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ

english.text: It is Allah Who has created the heavens and earth and sent down rain from the sky, producing therewith fruits as provision for you. He has made the ships for your service to sail through the sea by His command and has made for you the rivers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Allah qui a créé les cieux et la terre, et qui fait descendre du ciel une eau par laquelle Il fait pousser toutes sortes de fruits dont vous vous nourrissez. Il vous a soumis les vaisseaux qui, par Sa volonté, voguent en mer, comme Il vous a assujetti les rivières.

renderings.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ

english.text: He has made the sun and the moon for your service, both constant in their courses, and has made for you the night and the day[23].
english.footnotes: [23] i.e., the day in which people go about their living and the night during which they get rest.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a assujetti, pour vous, le soleil et la lune à un mouvement perpétuel, de même qu’Il vous a soumis le jour et la nuit.

renderings.arabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٞ كَفَّارٞ

english.text: And He gave you of all that you have asked for[24]. If you try to count the blessings of Allah, you cannot count them[25]. Indeed, mankind is truly unjust and ungrateful.
english.footnotes:
[24] It is not only these grand favors that Allah grants people, but their prayers are also answered, be they uttered or merely wished for.
 [25] If a person were to ever try to count Allah’s blessings on him, he would never be able to count them, let alone be duly grateful for them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il vous a accordé tout ce dont vous aviez besoin au point que, si vous cherchiez à dénombrer les bienfaits d’Allah, vous ne le pourriez pas. L’homme est si injuste et si ingrat.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ

english.text: And [remember] when Abraham said, “My Lord, make this city [of Makkah] secure and save me and my children from worshiping idols.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne, par ailleurs, cette invocation d’Abraham : « Veuille, Seigneur, faire de cette cité[12] un sanctuaire et me préserver, ainsi que ma postérité, du culte des idoles.
french.footnotes: [12] La Mecque.

renderings.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضۡلَلۡنَ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّيۖ وَمَنۡ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: My Lord, they[26] have led many people astray. So whoever follows me, he belongs to me; and whoever disobeys me, then You are All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english.footnotes: [26] i.e., idols.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celles-ci, Seigneur, ont provoqué l’égarement de bien des hommes. Quiconque suit ma voie est des miens. Quant à celui qui me désobéit, qu’il sache que Tu es Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّيٓ أَسۡكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِي زَرۡعٍ عِندَ بَيۡتِكَ ٱلۡمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجۡعَلۡ أَفۡـِٔدَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهۡوِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱرۡزُقۡهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: Our Lord, I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer[27]. So make the people’s hearts incline towards them, and provide for them fruits, so that they may be grateful.
english.footnotes: [27] Prayer is specifically mentioned here because it is the best, most comprehensive act of worship and that it is key to all good.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seigneur ! J’ai établi une partie de mes descendants[13] dans une vallée aride auprès de Ton sanctuaire afin, Seigneur, qu’ils accomplissent assidûment la prière. Dispose en leur faveur les cœurs d’une partie des hommes et dispense-leur toutes sortes de fruits, en espérant qu’ils Te seront reconnaissants.
french.footnotes: [13] Ismaël, ancêtre des Arabes.

renderings.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِي وَمَا نُعۡلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ

english.text: Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing is hidden from Allah on earth or in heaven.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seigneur ! Tu connais aussi bien ce que nous gardons secret que ce que nous laissons paraître. Rien, sur terre ou dans le ciel, ne saurait être caché à Allah.

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى ٱلۡكِبَرِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

english.text: All praise be to Allah Who has granted me in old age Ishmael and Isaac[28]. Indeed, my Lord is the All-Hearing of prayers.
english.footnotes: [28] This is a practical demonstration of Abraham’s gratitude to Allah for His blessings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Louange à Allah qui, malgré mon âge avancé, m’a fait don d’Ismaël et d’Isaac. Mon Seigneur entend si bien les prières.

renderings.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ

english.text: My Lord, make me steadfast in prayer and those of my offspring. Our Lord, accept my supplication.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rends-moi, Seigneur, assidu à la prière, ainsi qu’une partie de ma descendance. Veuille, Seigneur, exaucer mon invocation.

renderings.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ

english.text: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Veuille, Seigneur, me pardonner, ainsi qu’à mes père et mère et aux croyants, le Jour du jugement dernier. »

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ تَشۡخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ

english.text: Never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do[29]; He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror][30] –
english.footnotes:
[29] It serves both as comfort to the oppressed and as a warning to the oppressors.
 [30] Because of the horrifying sights they see, they will be unblinkingly staring upwards in horror.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne crois surtout pas qu’Allah soit inattentif aux agissements des impies, auxquels Il accorde simplement un sursis jusqu’au Jour où les regards des hommes resteront figés

renderings.arabic: مُهۡطِعِينَ مُقۡنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۖ وَأَفۡـِٔدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٞ

english.text: rushing forward with their heads raised up, eyes not blinking[31] and hearts void[32].
english.footnotes:
[31] This is their state at the time of resurrection from the graves.
 [32] Their terror-struck hearts are empty; perceiving nothing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et où ces derniers se précipiteront vers le lieu de leur jugement, têtes dressées, yeux exorbités et cœurs désemparés.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِيهِمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ نُّجِبۡ دَعۡوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَۗ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُونُوٓاْ أَقۡسَمۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٖ

english.text: Warn people of the Day when the punishment will come upon them, and the wrongdoers will say, “Our Lord, give us a little more time, so that we may respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” [They will be told], “Did you not swear before that you would never cease to exist?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Avertis les hommes du Jour où, face au châtiment, les impies s’écrieront : « Accorde-nous, Seigneur, un bref sursis afin que nous puissions répondre à Ton appel et suivre les Messagers. » Il leur sera répondu : « Ne juriez-vous pas, au cours de votre vie terrestre, que vous ne quitteriez jamais ce monde ?

renderings.arabic: وَسَكَنتُمۡ فِي مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ

english.text: You lived[33] in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you examples.”
english.footnotes: [33] As Qurayshites would pass by the ruined dwellings of the destroyed nations; on their way to Yemen, they would pass by the dwellings of the ‘Ād tribe, and on their way to the Levant, they would pass by the dwellings of the Thamūd tribe, using them as resting posts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous avez pourtant occupé les terres de ceux qui, avant vous, furent injustes envers eux-mêmes et pu constater le sort exemplaire que Nous leur avons réservé. Nous n’avons cessé de vous exhorter à bien vous comporter. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرُواْ مَكۡرَهُمۡ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَإِن كَانَ مَكۡرُهُمۡ لِتَزُولَ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ

english.text: They hatched their plot[34], but their plot was known to Allah; even if their plot were such that would move mountains[35].
english.footnotes:
[34] i.e., to kill the Prophet (ﷺ).
 [35] But due to its feebleness, their plotting was never to remove mountains.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ont tramé des complots qui ne sauraient échapper à Allah, même si leurs manœuvres étaient de taille à déplacer les montagnes[14].
french.footnotes: [14] Autre sens : d’ailleurs leurs complots ne sauraient déplacer les montagnes.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِفَ وَعۡدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٖ

english.text: Never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers[36]. Allah is All-Mighty, Capable of Retribution.
english.footnotes: [36] i.e., that they would be given victory both in this life and in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne crois donc pas qu’Allah puisse manquer à Sa promesse faite à Ses Messagers. Allah, en vérité, est Tout-Puissant et parfaitement en mesure de se venger.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُۖ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ

english.text: The Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will the heavens[37], and all will appear before Allah, the One, the Subjugator[38].
english.footnotes:
[37] Many exegetes who talk about what befalls the heavens and earth on that Day, opines that the replacement here is of the characteristics (al-sifāt), not of the quintessence (al-dhāt).
 [38] Allah’s revenge will be on the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sa promesse s’accomplira le Jour où la terre sera changée en une autre terre et les cieux en d’autres cieux, et où les hommes quitteront leurs tombes pour comparaître devant le Dieu unique qui a soumis à Son pouvoir l’ensemble de la Création.

renderings.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ

english.text: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains[39],
english.footnotes: [39] i.e., their hands and feet will be chained to their necks. See 40:70-72.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu verras, ce Jour-là, les criminels enchaînés les uns aux autres,

renderings.arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٖ وَتَغۡشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ

english.text: their garments will be of pitch and their faces covered with Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: revêtus de goudron, les visages recouverts du feu de l’Enfer.

renderings.arabic: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

english.text: So that Allah may recompense every soul for what it did. Allah is swift in reckoning.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah rétribuera ainsi chacun selon ses œuvres dont Il est si prompt à faire le compte.

renderings.arabic: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

english.text: This [Qur’an] is a message for all mankind, so that they may be warned thereby and know that He is One God, and so that the people of understanding may take heed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà un message adressé aux hommes afin qu’ils soient mis en garde, qu’ils sachent qu’Allah est la seule divinité digne d’être adorée et que les hommes doués de raison en tirent des leçons.

renderings.arabic: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَقُرۡءَانٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: Alif Lām Ra[1]. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’an.
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Alif-Lâm-Râ.[1] Voici les versets du Livre révélés sous forme d’une lecture parfaitement claire[2].
french.footnotes:
[1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.
[2] Voir note verset 2, sourate 12.

renderings.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ

english.text: The disbelievers will soon[2] wish that they were Muslims.
english.footnotes: [2] On the Judgment Day or upon their death.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants regretteront un jour de ne pas avoir été musulmans.

renderings.arabic: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَأۡكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلۡهِهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَلُۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted with false hope; they will come to know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse-les donc se repaître, jouir de cette vie et se bercer d’espérances. Ils sauront bientôt ce qui les attend !

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ

english.text: We never destroyed any town except that it had a destined time.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons détruit aucune cité avant le terme qui lui a été assigné.

renderings.arabic: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ

english.text: No nation can advance its appointed time, nor can they delay it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nul peuple n’est en mesure d’avancer ou de reculer le terme qui lui est fixé.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

english.text: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder has been sent down, You are surely insane[3]!
english.footnotes: [3] These deriding remarks were very hard on the Prophet (ﷺ), and Allah consoles him in this surah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les impies disent par moquerie : « Toi à qui le Coran a été révélé ! Tu n’es, en vérité, qu’un possédé !

renderings.arabic: لَّوۡمَا تَأۡتِينَا بِٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pourquoi n’es-tu pas accompagné d’anges témoignant de l’authenticité de ta mission, si tu dis la vérité ! »

renderings.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ إِذٗا مُّنظَرِينَ

english.text: We do not send down the angels except for a just cause, and then [the disbelievers] would be granted no respite[4].
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., then they would be destroyed on the spot.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne faisons descendre les anges que pour châtier les impies auxquels nul sursis n’est alors accordé.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

english.text: It is We Who have sent down the Reminder[5], and it is We Who will preserve it[6].
english.footnotes:
[5] As a reminder for people.
 [6] From distortion, alteration, addition, and omission. More than 1400 years have elapsed and not a single word of this Qur’an has been changed, although enemies have tried their utmost.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous, en vérité, qui avons révélé le Coran et c’est Nous qui veillons à son intégrité[3].
french.footnotes: [3] Contrairement à la Bible qui, selon tous les spécialistes, a été transformée au cours des siècles, le Coran reste un texte rigoureusement intact, inchangé depuis plus de quatorze siècles, conformément à cette promesse du Seigneur de le préserver de toute altération.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: We did send messengers before you among the factions of early peoples.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons déjà, avant toi, envoyé aux peuples du passé des Messagers

renderings.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

english.text: No messenger came to them except that they ridiculed him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, tous sans exception, ont été tournés en dérision et raillés.

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

english.text: This is how We let this [denial] enter the hearts of the wicked[7].
english.footnotes: [7] For they rebelled against the Truth and did not submit to it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous faisons pénétrer dans le cœur des criminels l’impiété.

renderings.arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: They will not believe in it, although the examples of the earlier people are well established.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils n’y croiront donc pas, bien que soit connu de tous le sort réservé aux peuples du passé.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ

english.text: Even if We were to open for them a gateway to the heaven, through which they kept ascending,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et si Nous avions ouvert à leur intention une porte du ciel où ils se seraient élevés,

renderings.arabic: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٞ مَّسۡحُورُونَ

english.text: they would still say, “Our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been bewitched.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ils auraient affirmé : « Nous sommes la proie d’une hallucination, à moins que nous soyons tout simplement ensorcelés ! »

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

english.text: We have placed constellations in the heaven and adorned it for the onlookers,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, placé dans le ciel des constellations zodiacales et l’avons paré d’étoiles pour ceux qui l’observent avec attention.

renderings.arabic: وَحَفِظۡنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٍ

english.text: and We have guarded it from every accursed devil,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et Nous l’avons mis à l’abri de tout démon maudit.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: except the one who manages to eavesdrop, he will then be pursued by a visible burning flame.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains d’entre eux parviennent parfois à écouter à la dérobée les secrets du ciel, mais sont aussitôt atteints par un météore brillant parfaitement visible.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مَّوۡزُونٖ

english.text: As for the earth, We have spread it out and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein everything in due proportion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à la terre, Nous en avons fait une vaste étendue où Nous avons solidement planté des montagnes[4] et où Nous avons fait pousser, dans une juste proportion, une végétation variée.
french.footnotes: [4] Qui en assurent la stabilité.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

english.text: And We have made therein for you means of sustenance and for those[8] whom you do not provide.
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., the children, servants, and livestock that one is blessed with.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons dotée, à votre intention, de moyens de subsistance et Nous avons mis à votre disposition des créatures[5] que vous n’êtes pas en charge de nourrir.
french.footnotes: [5] Comme les bestiaux et les montures.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ

english.text: There is nothing except that We have its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a determined measure.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous détenons les trésors de toute chose que Nous ne dispensons aux créatures que dans une mesure bien déterminée[6].
french.footnotes: [6] Selon leurs besoins.

renderings.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
