english.text: And We send fertilizing winds[9], and send down rain from the sky for you to drink, and it is not you who could store it.
english.footnotes: [9] Causing precipitation in rainclouds or carrying pollen.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous faisons souffler les vents fécondants[7] au moyen desquels Nous faisons descendre du ciel une eau que Nous mettons à votre disposition et que vous êtes incapables par vous-mêmes de conserver[8].
french.footnotes:
[7] Les vents qui, par leur action sur les nuages, donnent naissance à la pluie et qui participent à la fécondation des arbres en transportant le pollen.
[8] C’est Nous qui la conservons sous forme notamment de sources, de puits et de rivières, afin qu’elle reste à la disposition des hommes tout au long de l’année.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ

english.text: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors [of all things].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous, en vérité, qui donnons la vie et la mort, et c’est Nous qui hériterons de la Création.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَـٔۡخِرِينَ

english.text: We surely know those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous connaissons, parmi vous, les générations passées et les générations futures

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ

english.text: It is your Lord Who will gather them together. He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, toutes, seront rassemblées par Ton Seigneur, infiniment Sage et Omniscient.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ

english.text: We have created man from sounding clay, made of aging mud[10].
english.footnotes: [10] Salsāl: clay left to ferment and turn hard so that it clinks when tapped on. Hama’: transformed or blackened clay. Masnūn: the smell of which has turned foul or left for some time.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, créé l’homme[9] d’une argile desséchée et sonore, tirée d’un limon noir et malodorant,
french.footnotes: [9] Adam.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

english.text: And the jinn[11] We created before that, from smokeless fire.
english.footnotes: [11] The jinn: They are the creatures of Allah, who are different from humans. There are some among them who are righteous, while others are wicked. They are not humans or a species of humans.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tandis que Nous avons créé, avant lui, les djinns d’un feu ardent.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ

english.text: And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay, made of aging mud.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur s’adressa ainsi aux anges : « Je vais créer un être humain à partir d’une argile desséchée et sonore, tirée d’un limon noir et malodorant.

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

english.text: When I have shaped him and breathed into him of My spirit[12], then fall down before him in prostration.”
english.footnotes: [12] The spirit which Allah created for that body, not His own Spirit (as some mistakenly believe). Allah attributed it to Himself as a sign of honoring him, as in nāqat Allah (the she-camel of Allah).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Je lui aurai donné une forme accomplie et aurai insufflé en lui de Mon Esprit[10], vous vous prosternerez devant lui. »
french.footnotes: [10] Ou : de Mon souffle de vie.

renderings.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ

english.text: Thereupon, all of the angels fell down in prostration,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tous les anges, sans exception, se sont prosternés.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english.text: except for Iblīs, who refused to be with those who prostrated[13].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à Satan, il a refusé de les imiter.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english.text: Allah said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you were not with those who prostrated?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Qu’est-ce qui t’a empêché, Satan, de te prosterner avec eux ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ

english.text: He said, “I am not such to prostrate before a human whom You created from sounding clay, made of aging mud.[14]”
english.footnotes: [14] He said: “I am better than him; You created me from fire and created him from clay.” See 7:12.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Je ne saurais me prosterner devant un être humain que Tu as créé d’une argile desséchée et sonore, tirée d’un limon noir et malodorant. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ

english.text: He said, “Then get out of here[15], for you are accursed,
english.footnotes: [15] i.e., from the heaven.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Sors d’ici ! Te voilà maudit,

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

english.text: and the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: poursuivi par la malédiction jusqu’au Jour de la rétribution. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

english.text: Iblīs said, “My Lord, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Satan dit : « Accorde-moi, Seigneur, un sursis jusqu’au Jour où les hommes seront ressuscités. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ

english.text: Allah said, “You are of those who are granted respite[16],
english.footnotes: [16] As a trial; to sift out His obedient servants from those who obey Iblīs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur répondit : « Tu es de ceux auxquels un sursis est accordé,

renderings.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ

english.text: until the Day of the Appointed Time[17].”
english.footnotes: [17] i.e., the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: jusqu’à l’avènement d’un jour bien connu. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray[18], I will surely make [sins] alluring to them on earth and mislead them all,
english.footnotes: [18] Satan set the record for being the first to use predestination (al-qadar) as a pretext for disobeying Allah’s command (al-’amr).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Satan jura : « Puisque Tu m’as égaré, Seigneur, je m’emploierai à égarer tous les hommes en embellissant à leurs yeux les plaisirs terrestres et le péché,

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

english.text: except for Your chosen slaves among them.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: excepté ceux de Tes serviteurs que Tu as élus pour leur sincérité. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيمٌ

english.text: Allah said, “This is a straight path leading to Me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Voici une règle d’une parfaite équité que Je me suis imposée :

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ

english.text: You will have no authority over My slaves, except the deviants who follow you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tu n’auras aucune autorité sur Mes serviteurs, excepté ceux qui te suivront parmi les égarés,

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: And Hell is certainly the promised place for them, all together.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui tous sont voués à la Géhenne.

renderings.arabic: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبٖ لِّكُلِّ بَابٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٞ مَّقۡسُومٌ

english.text: It has seven gates[19]; each gate will have its allotted share of them.”
english.footnotes: [19] The doors of Hell are plenty; according to the crime.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celle-ci possède sept portes. Chacune sera franchie par un nombre déterminé de damnés[11]. »
french.footnotes: [11] Autre sens : celle-ci dispose de sept niveaux. Chacun accueillera un nombre déterminé de damnés.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ

english.text: The righteous will be in gardens and springs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui craignent le Seigneur sont, quant à eux, promis à des jardins arrosés de sources vives,

renderings.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

english.text: “Enter in peace and safety[20]!”
english.footnotes: [20] i.e., safe from all ills, troubles, and all that might put a dent in their happiness.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où ils seront accueillis par ces mots : « Entrez-y en paix, vous y vivrez en toute sécurité. »

renderings.arabic: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

english.text: We will remove all ill feelings from their hearts[21]; like brothers, seated on couches facing one another.
english.footnotes: [21] This is in perfection of their bliss, by having no ill-will whatsoever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous aurons retiré de leurs cœurs toute trace de haine si bien qu’ils s’aimeront comme des frères, se faisant face sur des lits somptueux.

renderings.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ

english.text: No fatigue will ever touch them therein[22], nor will they ever be made to leave.
english.footnotes: [22] i.e., untainted by drawbacks of toil or uneasiness about the future.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils n’y connaîtront aucune lassitude et ne seront jamais chassés de ce lieu.

renderings.arabic: ۞ نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english.text: Inform My slaves that I am indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Informe Mes serviteurs que Je suis le Très Clément, le Très Miséricordieux,

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ٱلۡأَلِيمُ

english.text: and that My punishment is the most painful punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais aussi que Mon châtiment est des plus douloureux.

renderings.arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَن ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

english.text: And inform them about the guests of Abraham.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Relate-leur l’histoire des hôtes d’Abraham

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ

english.text: When they entered upon him and said, “Peace!” He said, “We are afraid of you[23].”
english.footnotes: [23] When he saw that their hands did not reach the roasted calf he presented to them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui se présentèrent à lui en le saluant : « La paix soit avec toi ! » Abraham dit : « Nous avons peur de vous. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ

english.text: They said, “Do not be afraid; We give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy[24].”
english.footnotes: [24] i.e., Isaac; of great religious knowledge.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils répondirent : « Ne crains rien ! Nous sommes seulement venus t’annoncer la naissance d’un garçon plein de savoir. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

english.text: He said, “Do you give me glad tidings despite my old age? What glad tidings are you giving me?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Abraham s’étonna : « M’annoncez-vous cela alors que j’ai atteint un âge avancé ? Que m’annoncez-vous donc là ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ

english.text: They said, “We have given you glad tidings in truth, so do not be of those who despair[25].”
english.footnotes: [25] Abraham (عليه السلام) might have shown signs of doubt at believing such news.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Nous t’avons annoncé la vérité. Ne sois donc pas de ceux qui désespèrent. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

english.text: He said, “Who would despair of his Lord’s mercy except those who are misguided[26]?”
english.footnotes: [26] Abraham’s (عليه السلام) reply disproves the assumption that he was despondent of Allah’s Mercy.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dit : « Qui peut désespérer de la miséricorde de son Seigneur sinon un égaré ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: He said, “So, what is your mission, O messengers?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il ajouta : « Quel est l’objet de votre visite, envoyés du Seigneur ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ

english.text: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people[27],
english.footnotes: [27] i.e., the people of the prophet Lot (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils répondirent : « Nous avons pour mission d’anéantir un peuple criminel,

renderings.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: except the household of Lot; we will surely save them all,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à l’exception de la famille de Loth dont tous les membres seront épargnés.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

english.text: except his wife[28]; We have decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.”
english.footnotes: [28] For she has collaborated with the evildoers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons toutefois décrété que son épouse serait, avec les autres, exterminée. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: When the messengers came to the household of Lot[29],
english.footnotes: [29] Details of the first three nations destroyed are given in this and the following verses, which were en route of the famous trading journeys of the Qurayshites: the people of Prophet Lot, those of the thicket (the people of Shu‘ayb), and those of Hegra (Madā’in Sālih).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque la famille de Loth reçut la visite des messagers,

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ

english.text: he said, “You are unfamiliar people.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lot leur dit : « Vous m’êtes étrangers. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ

english.text: They said, “We have come to you with that [punishment][30] which they have doubted.
english.footnotes: [30] i.e., the divine punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Nous sommes seulement venus infliger à ton peuple le châtiment dont il n’a cessé de douter.

renderings.arabic: وَأَتَيۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

english.text: We have come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous t’apportons la vérité, nous sommes véridiques.

renderings.arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٖ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱتَّبِعۡ أَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدٞ وَٱمۡضُواْ حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُونَ

english.text: So travel with your household in the dark of night and go behind them; none of you should look back[31], and keep going to where you are commanded.”
english.footnotes: [31] To be more persistent in their walk and strike some distance before dawn, or not to be frightened and traumatized by catching sight of the horrific punishment of their folks.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quitte la cité en pleine nuit avec les tiens. Ferme la marche et que nul ne se retourne en chemin. Allez là où vous en recevrez l’ordre. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوعٞ مُّصۡبِحِينَ

english.text: We conveyed this decree to him that these [people] will be exterminated by early morning.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons révélé à Loth Notre décision d’exterminer son peuple au matin.

renderings.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ

english.text: The people of the city came [to Lot] rejoicing[32].
english.footnotes: [32] At the news of his visitors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les habitants de la cité arrivèrent alors tout joyeux[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Informés de la présence chez Loth de jeunes invités, les habitants de Sodome arrivèrent, ivres d’allégresse, sans savoir qu’il s’agissait d’anges à l’apparence humaine.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ

english.text: Lot said, “These are my guests, so do not bring shame on me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Loth leur lança : « Ces hommes sont mes hôtes. Gardez-vous de me déshonorer.

renderings.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ

english.text: Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Craignez Allah ! Epargnez-moi cette humiliation ! »

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: They said, “Did we not forbid you from [protecting] people?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Ne t’avons-nous pas défendu d’accueillir qui que ce soit chez toi ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ

english.text: He said, “These are my daughters [to marry], if you must[33].”
english.footnotes: [33] i.e., the women of my community or my own daughters in a lawful marriage.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dit : « Voici mes filles[13], si vous voulez assouvir vos désirs ! »
french.footnotes: [13] C’est-à-dire, les femmes de mon peuple, selon nombre d’exégètes, que Loth semble les inviter ici à prendre pour épouses.

renderings.arabic: لَعَمۡرُكَ إِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

english.text: By your life [O prophet], they were wandering blindly in their intoxication [of lust][34].
english.footnotes: [34] Admonition is of no use, no matter how reasonable it is, when someone is drunk in their lust.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ta vie ! Ils étaient en plein délire.

renderings.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِينَ

english.text: So they were seized by the blast at sunrise,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils furent donc foudroyés au lever du jour.

renderings.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

english.text: and We turned their cities upside down[35] and rained down on them stones of baked clay.
english.footnotes: [35] Their nature was twisted, so their punishment was of its like.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons renversé la cité et envoyé contre ses habitants une pluie de pierres d’argile.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

english.text: Indeed, there are signs in this for those who discern[36].
english.footnotes: [36] i.e., those who look deeply into signifying signs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà des signes suffisamment clairs pour ceux qui savent les méditer.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٖ مُّقِيمٍ

english.text: And their place is located by a known route[37].
english.footnotes: [37] i.e., on the highway to the Levant, where the Dead Sea is now.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les vestiges de cette cité se trouvent d’ailleurs sur une route encore fréquentée.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Indeed, there are signs in this for the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà un signe parfaitement clair pour les croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: And the people of the Forest[38] were wrongdoers.
english.footnotes: [38] i.e., the people of the thicket, i.e. the people of Prophet Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام) who lived in Madian, not far from the people of Lot.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les adorateurs d’Al-Aykah[14] furent si injustes envers eux-mêmes
french.footnotes: [14] Nom du bosquet d’arbres touffus et entrelacés que vénérait ce peuple auquel fut envoyé le prophète Chou’ayb (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: So We punished them in retribution, and both [places][39] are by a clear highway.
english.footnotes: [39] i.e., both the dwellings of the people of Prophet Lot (عليه السلام) and Prophet Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que Nous nous sommes vengé d’eux. Les ruines de ces deux cités[15] sont d’ailleurs encore visibles sur une route toujours fréquentée.
french.footnotes: [15] Celle du peuple de Loth et celle du peuple de Chou’ayb.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡحِجۡرِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

english.text: Surely the people of Al-Hijr[40] also rejected the messengers.
english.footnotes: [40] i.e., Thamūd: the people of Prophet Sālih (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les habitants d’Al-Hijr ont également traité les Messagers d’imposteurs,

renderings.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ

english.text: We gave them Our signs, but they kept turning away from them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: se détournant de tous les signes que Nous avons produits sous leurs yeux.

renderings.arabic: وَكَانُواْ يَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

english.text: They carved houses in the mountains, feeling secure[41].
english.footnotes: [41] These mountainous strongholds gave them a false sense of security against any consequences.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils taillaient dans le roc des demeures où ils se croyaient en sécurité.

renderings.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِينَ

english.text: So they were seized by the blast early in the morning.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils furent pourtant, au matin, foudroyés.

renderings.arabic: فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

english.text: Nothing of what they earned was of any avail to them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leurs richesses et leurs forteresses ne leur furent d’aucune utilité.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةٞۖ فَٱصۡفَحِ ٱلصَّفۡحَ ٱلۡجَمِيلَ

english.text: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose. The Hour is certainly coming, so bear with them graciously[42].
english.footnotes: [42] This final passage puts things into perspective, addressing the Prophet (ﷺ) - that all people, including those who tormented him, will be justly held accountable for their deeds, and asking him to overlook their taunts and not censure them for it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons pas créé les cieux, la terre, et ce qui se trouve entre eux, en vain mais selon une sagesse infinie. L’Heure sonnera inéluctablement. Accorde donc un généreux pardon aux impies.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: Indeed, your Lord is the Absolute Creator, the All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur, en vérité, est le Créateur de toute chose, l’Omniscient.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ

english.text: We have surely given you the seven oft-repeated verses[43] and the great Qur’an.
english.footnotes: [43] i.e., Seven of al-Mathāni (seven repeatedly recited verses), referring to Surat al-Fātihah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous t’avons donné les sept versets sans cesse répétés[16] et le sublime Coran.
french.footnotes: [16] Les sept versets de la première sourate du Coran (Al-Fâtihah) que les fidèles répètent à plusieurs reprises en prière, selon la majorité des exégètes, ou les sept plus longues sourates du Coran, selon d’autres.

renderings.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Do not look longingly at the pleasures We have given certain classes[44] of them[45], nor grieve over them[46], but lower your wing [in humility] to the believers[47].
english.footnotes:
[44] Azwāj: literally means pairs; here it means those who are alike in prosperity, as not all of them were rich and prosperous. [45] So as to test them therein.
 [46] The Prophet (ﷺ) felt sad that they would not believe and save themselves from Hellfire.
 [47] The favor of the Qur’an far surpasses all other favors and worldly gains.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne porte donc pas ton regard avec envie sur les jouissances éphémères que Nous avons accordées à certains mécréants et ne sois pas affligé par leur comportement. Montre-toi humble et bienveillant envers les croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَقُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

english.text: And say, “I am indeed a clear warner.” –
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et dis : « Je suis chargé de vous mettre clairement en garde contre le châtiment. »

renderings.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُقۡتَسِمِينَ

english.text: just as We sent down [punishment] upon those who divided [their religion][48],
english.footnotes: [48] i.e., the People of the Book, who accepted some portions of the Torah and rejected some.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Châtiment que Nous avons déjà fait descendre sur ceux qui ont divisé le Livre révélé[17],
french.footnotes: [17] Selon certains commentateurs, ce verset, directement lié au verset 87 - les versets 88 et 89 n’étant qu’une incidente -, signifie en réalité : (Nous t’avons donné les sept versets sans cesse répétés et le sublime Coran) de même que Nous avons fait descendre Notre parole sur ceux qui ont divisé le Livre révélé.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عِضِينَ

english.text: those who split the Qur’an into different portions[49].
english.footnotes: [49] i.e., calling it magic, divination, or poetry.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: acceptant une partie de la Révélation, rejetant obstinément l’autre à leur gré.

renderings.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: By your Lord, We will surely question them all
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ton Seigneur ! Nous les interrogerons certainement jusqu’au dernier,

renderings.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: concerning what they used to do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: les sommant de répondre de leurs agissements et de leur comportement passé.

renderings.arabic: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

english.text: Then proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate partners with Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Proclame haut et fort le message dont tu es en charge, sans prêter attention aux idolâtres.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِينَ

english.text: We will surely suffice you against the mockers[50],
english.footnotes: [50] For this command will be tough, Allah gave him assurance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous saurons, en vérité, nous charger pour toi des moqueurs

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: those who set up beside Allah another god; they will come to know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui associent d’autres divinités au culte du Seigneur. Mais ils sauront bientôt !

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

english.text: We know that you are distressed by what they say.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous savons parfaitement que ton cœur est oppressé par leurs propos.

renderings.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english.text: So glorify your Lord with praise and be among those who prostrate [to Him][51],
english.footnotes: [51] The remedy is in resorting to Allah Almighty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les louanges, célèbre donc la gloire de ton Seigneur et sois de ceux qui se prosternent humblement en prière.

renderings.arabic: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكَ ٱلۡيَقِينُ

english.text: and worship your Lord until the certainty [of death] comes to you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et adore ton Seigneur jusqu’à ce que te vienne la certitude[18].
french.footnotes: [18] La mort, selon la majorité des commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

english.text: Allah’s decree is coming[1], so do not seek to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him[2]!
english.footnotes:
[1] Allah’s punishment is imminent and certain, as the Hour is approaching.
 [2] Shirk (associating partners with Allah) is the most egregious of all sins, as He warned against it right after mentioning the imminence of the Hour. Allah stresses against Shirk or calls for pure Tawhīd (monotheism) in the two subsequent verses as well.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’ordre d’Allah sera bientôt exécuté. Ne cherchez donc pas à le précipiter. Gloire à Lui ! Il est bien au-dessus des fausses divinités qu’ils peuvent Lui associer.

renderings.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ

english.text: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whom He wills of His slaves, [saying], “Warn that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so fear Me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il fait descendre les anges de la Révélation sur ceux de Ses serviteurs qu’Il choisit, auxquels Il ordonne de mettre en garde les hommes et de leur rappeler que Lui seul doit être adoré et redouté.

renderings.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

english.text: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a créé les cieux et la terre selon une sagesse infinie. Il est bien au-dessus de tous les faux dieux qu’ils peuvent Lui associer.

renderings.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: He created man from a sperm-drop, and then he becomes a clear adversary[3].
english.footnotes: [3] As soon as he becomes strong and independent. The ones who are meant here are, especially, the disbelievers who deny resurrection, argue against the Truth, and are ungrateful to Allah’s favors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a créé l’homme d’un liquide insignifiant[1] et voilà que ce dernier se transforme en disputeur acharné.
french.footnotes: [1] Le sperme.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: And He has created the livestock for you as a source of warmth and other benefits[4], and from them you eat.
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., in clothing, tents, furnishings, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a créé pour vous les bestiaux dont vous tirez des vêtements chauds et bien d’autres avantages, et dont vous vous nourrissez.

renderings.arabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ

english.text: There is beauty for you in them when you bring them home to rest and when you take them out to graze[5].
english.footnotes: [5] Their bringing back is mentioned before their setting off to pasture because that is when their udders and waists are full and thus more pleasing to the beholder.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous en admirez la beauté quand, le soir, vous les ramenez au bercail et lorsque, le matin, vous les menez au pâturage.

renderings.arabic: وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that you could not reach without great hardship. Indeed, your Lord is Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils transportent vos fardeaux vers de lointaines contrées que, sans leur aide, vous ne pourriez atteindre qu’avec la plus grande difficulté. Votre Seigneur, en vérité, est toute miséricorde et toute bonté.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡخَيۡلَ وَٱلۡبِغَالَ وَٱلۡحَمِيرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةٗۚ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and for adornment, and He creates other things that you do not know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a également créé pour vous les chevaux, les mulets et les ânes qui vous servent de montures et pour l’apparat. Et Il crée bien d’autres choses que vous ignorez.

renderings.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصۡدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآئِرٞۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: It is upon Allah to show the straight path, while other ways are deviant. If He had willed, He could have guided you all.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il incombe à Allah d’indiquer le droit chemin, mais bien des voies empruntées par les hommes s’en sont écartées. Or, s’Il l’avait voulu, Il vous aurait tous guidés.

renderings.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٞ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرٞ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

english.text: It is He Who sends down rain from the sky, from it you drink, and by it plants thrive on which you pasture your livestock.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui fait descendre du ciel cette eau dont vous vous abreuvez et qui fait pousser par elle une végétation qui sert de pâturage à vos bestiaux.

renderings.arabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرۡعَ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english.text: He causes to grow therewith crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines and all kinds of fruits[6] for you. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who reflect.
english.footnotes: [6] It highlight the great wonder that although all these are irrigated with the same water, yet they come in different kinds, tastes, colors and shapes.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par elle encore, Il fait pousser pour vous céréales, oliviers, dattiers, vignes et toutes variétés d’arbres fruitiers. Voilà bien un signe pour des hommes capables de le méditer.

renderings.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتُۢ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: And He has subjected for you the night and day, the sun and moon, and the stars[7] are made subservient by His command. Indeed, there are signs in this for people of understanding.
english.footnotes: [7] Stars are crucial for knowing the directions in the darkness of the sea and the land.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il vous a soumis le jour et la nuit, le soleil et la lune. Les étoiles vous sont également assujetties par Sa volonté. Voilà des signes suffisamment clairs pour des hommes capables de raisonner.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

english.text: And He has created for you various kinds of things on earth[8]. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who take heed.
english.footnotes: [8] Such as animals, minerals, plants and inanimate objects.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il vous a soumis par ailleurs des créatures aux couleurs et aux formes les plus variées qu’Il a dispersées pour vous sur terre. Voilà assurément un signe pour des hommes capables de réfléchir.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: It is He Who has subjected the sea, so that you may eat from it tender meat and extract ornaments to wear. And you see the ships cleaving their way through its waves[9], so that you may seek His bounty and so that you may give thanks.
english.footnotes: [9] Another great sign of Allah, that heavy ships and vessels run smoothly on the surface of water without sinking.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui aussi qui vous a soumis la mer dont vous tirez des poissons frais qui vous servent de nourriture et des joyaux qui vous servent de parure. On peut y voir les vaisseaux fendre les flots afin de vous permettre d’aller à la recherche des faveurs de votre Seigneur. Peut-être Lui en serez-vous reconnaissants !

renderings.arabic: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗا وَسُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: And He has placed into the earth firm mountains, so it does not tremor with you, and there are rivers[10] and pathways so that you may find your way,
english.footnotes: [10] Rivers are like bloodlines spreading life in the land; people drink from them along with their livestock, grow crops, and travel through them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a solidement planté dans la terre des montagnes qui l’empêchent de trembler sous vos pieds, y a fait couler des rivières et y a tracé des voies qui vous permettent de vous déplacer et de vous diriger.

renderings.arabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٖۚ وَبِٱلنَّجۡمِ هُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: and landmarks and the stars by which they find their way[11].
english.footnotes: [11] With landmarks to find the way during the daytime and with the stars at night.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il y a placé d’autres repères encore, tandis que les étoiles permettent aux hommes de s’orienter.

renderings.arabic: أَفَمَن يَخۡلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخۡلُقُۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english.text: Is then He Who creates equal to one who cannot create? Will you not then take heed?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui crée est-Il comparable à celui qui est incapable de créer ? Ne réfléchissez-vous donc pas ?

renderings.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: If you try to count Allah’s favors, you will not be able to enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous cherchiez à dénombrer les bienfaits d’Allah, vous ne le pourriez pas. Allah est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ

english.text: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah connaît aussi bien ce que vous gardez secret que ce que vous laissez paraître.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ

english.text: But those whom they invoke besides Allah do not create anything; rather, they themselves are created.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant aux divinités qu’ils invoquent en dehors d’Allah, elles sont incapables de créer, n’étant elles-mêmes que des objets créés de toutes pièces,

renderings.arabic: أَمۡوَٰتٌ غَيۡرُ أَحۡيَآءٖۖ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ

english.text: They are dead, not living[12]; not even knowing when they will be resurrected.
english.footnotes: [12] i.e., inanimate or without understanding.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: inertes et sans vie, n’ayant aucune idée du Jour où ils seront ressuscités.

renderings.arabic: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٞ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ

english.text: Your God is One God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts refuse to know, and they are arrogant[13].
english.footnotes: [13] Arrogance and snobbery are the underlying reasons for denying Allah’s Signs and rejecting the Truth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre véritable Dieu est un dieu unique. Vérité que renient les cœurs pétris d’orgueil de ceux qui ne croient pas en l’autre vie.

renderings.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ

english.text: Undoubtedly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal[14]. Indeed, He does not like those who are arrogant.
english.footnotes: [14] He will hold them to account over them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah, à n’en point douter, connaît aussi bien ce qu’ils gardent secret que ce qu’ils laissent paraître. En vérité, Il n’aime pas ceux qui refusent par orgueil de L’adorer.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: When it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Ancient fables!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’il est demandé aux païens : « Qu’a révélé votre Seigneur au Messager ? », ils répondent : « Il ne lui a rien révélé, ce ne sont là que des légendes du passé ! »

renderings.arabic: لِيَحۡمِلُوٓاْ أَوۡزَارَهُمۡ كَامِلَةٗ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَمِنۡ أَوۡزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

english.text: They will bear their burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge[15]. How terrible is what they will bear!
english.footnotes: [15] The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever calls to misguidance will incur as much sin as that of whoever follows him.” [Muslim: 2674].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils porteront donc, le Jour de la résurrection, tout le poids de leurs péchés, ainsi qu’une partie du fardeau des ignorants qu’ils auront égarés. Quel terrible fardeau devront-ils porter !

renderings.arabic: قَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنۡيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّقۡفُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

english.text: Those who came before them plotted, so Allah uprooted their buildings from their foundations and the roof fell down on top of them[16], and the punishment came on them from where they could not imagine.
english.footnotes: [16] i.e., Allah caused their plot to fail and exposed their plan.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les peuples qui ont vécu avant eux se sont livrés aux pires manœuvres à l’encontre de leurs Messagers. Mais Allah a déjoué leurs complots qui se sont retournés contre eux. Le châtiment est alors venu les emporter de l’endroit le plus inattendu.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يُخۡزِيهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمۡۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ إِنَّ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say, “Where are My [so-called] partners for whose sake you used to oppose [the truth]?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Today disgrace and misery will befall the disbelievers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis, le Jour de la résurrection, Allah les couvrira d’humiliation et leur demandera : « Où sont ces divinités que vous M’avez associées et pour lesquelles vous vous êtes opposés aux croyants ? » Ceux qui auront reçu la science diront : « Les mécréants subiront aujourd’hui la plus cruelle humiliation et les plus affreux tourments. »

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ فَأَلۡقَوُاْ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُ مِن سُوٓءِۭۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: Those whose souls are seized by the angels while they wrong themselves will then offer submission, “We did not do anything evil.” “Yes, indeed you did! Allah knows well what you used to do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux dont les anges reprendront l’âme en état de péché feront acte de soumission et diront : « Nous ne commettions aucun mal ! » « Bien au contraire, répondront les anges, Allah connaît parfaitement vos agissements passés.

renderings.arabic: فَٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

english.text: So enter the gates of Hell, abiding therein forever. What a terrible abode for those who were arrogant!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Franchissez les portes de la Géhenne pour y demeurer éternellement. » Infâme demeure que celle des orgueilleux !

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡۚ قَالُواْ خَيۡرٗاۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ خَيۡرٞۚ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: And it will be said to those who fear Allah, “What has your Lord sent down?” They will say, “All that is good.” For those who do good in this world, there is a good reward[17]; and the home of the Hereafter is far better. What an excellent home for those who fear Allah!
english.footnotes: [17] Of a plentiful and satisfying life in this world.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et lorsqu’il est demandé à ceux qui craignent Allah : « Qu’a révélé votre Seigneur ? », ils répondent : « Un grand bien ![2] » Ceux qui accomplissent de bonnes œuvres obtiendront une belle récompense ici-bas. Mais la demeure de l’au-delà est bien meilleure. Sublime demeure que celle des hommes qui craignent leur Seigneur !
french.footnotes: [2] Que l’on se souvienne que la même question fut posée aux mécréants (verset 24) dont la réponse fut toute différente.

renderings.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: They will enter the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish[18]. This is how Allah rewards those who fear Him,
english.footnotes: [18] Unlike this worldly life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils seront admis dans les jardins d’Eden traversés de rivières où tous leurs désirs seront assouvis. C’est ainsi qu’Allah récompense les pieux croyants.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: those whose souls the angels take while they are in a state of purity[19], saying, “Peace be upon you; enter Paradise for what you used to do.”
english.footnotes: [19] Their souls will be purified from polytheism, sins, and ill feelings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux dont les anges reprendront l’âme en état de pureté[3] s’entendront dire par ces derniers : « La paix soit avec vous ! Entrez au Paradis en récompense des œuvres que vous avez accomplies ! »
french.footnotes: [3] Par opposition aux impies dont les anges reprendront l’âme en état de péché (verset 28).

renderings.arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

english.text: Are [the disbelievers] waiting for the angels to come to them[20] or for the command of your Lord to come[21]? Those who came before them did the same. It was not Allah Who wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves.
english.footnotes:
[20] To take their souls while they are unjust to themselves.
 [21] To punish them in this worldly life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’attendent-ils sinon que les anges se présentent à eux ou que l’ordre de ton Seigneur soit prononcé ? Ils ne font, en réalité, qu’imiter leurs devanciers qu’Allah n’a aucunement lésés, mais qui se sont eux-mêmes lésés.

renderings.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

english.text: They were afflicted by the evil consequences of their deeds, and they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils furent cernés par le châtiment même dont ils s’étaient moqués, subissant les conséquences funestes de leurs péchés.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖ نَّحۡنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

english.text: Those who associate partners with Allah say, “If Allah had willed, neither we nor our forefathers would have worshiped anything besides Him, nor would we have prohibited anything without His command[22].” Those who came before them did the same.
