renderings.arabic: شَاكِرٗا لِّأَنۡعُمِهِۚ ٱجۡتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: He was grateful for His favors; He chose him and guided him to a straight path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais sut, au contraire, reconnaître les bienfaits d’Allah qui en fit Son élu et le mit sur le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english.text: We gave him good in this world, and in the Hereafter, he will surely be among the righteous[76].
english.footnotes: [76] Sālihīn (righteous) are the prophets and the messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons comblé ici-bas et il sera, dans l’au-delà, du nombre des saints.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

english.text: Then We revealed to you [O Prophet] to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining to true faith[77], and he was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.
english.footnotes: [77] i.e., Islamic Monotheism.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis Nous t’avons révélé de suivre la religion d’Abraham, monothéiste pur et sincère qui ne fut point du nombre des païens[30].
french.footnotes: [30] Autre sens : puis Nous t’avons révélé de suivre, en monothéiste pur et sincère, la religion d’Abraham, qui ne fut point du nombre des païens.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبۡتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

english.text: The Sabbath was only ordained for those who differed about it[78]. Your Lord will surely judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
english.footnotes: [78] To dedicate Sabbath for worshiping Allah away from their daily livelihood, after they deviated from Friday which was enjoined upon them beforehand.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le shabbat ne fut imposé qu’à ceux qui se sont opposés à son sujet. Mais Allah tranchera certainement leur différend le Jour de la résurrection.

renderings.arabic: ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

english.text: Call to the way of your Lord with wisdom[79] and goodly exhortation[80], and reason with them in the best manner[81]. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His way and knows best those who are rightly guided.
english.footnotes:
[79] Accordingly, taking into account the circumstance of the addressee.
 [80] That endears good to people. [81] Being kind, well-spoken, and tolerant to win hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par de sages et douces exhortations, appelle les hommes à suivre la voie de ton Seigneur et discute avec eux avec la plus grande aménité. Ton Seigneur sait parfaitement qui s’est écarté de Sa voie et qui est bien guidé.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنۡ عَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَعَاقِبُواْ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبۡتُم بِهِۦۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرۡتُمۡ لَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لِّلصَّٰبِرِينَ

english.text: If you retaliate, let your retaliation be the like of what you suffered. But if you bear with patience, it is surely best for those who are steadfast.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous devez exercer des représailles, qu’elles soient en proportion du préjudice subi, bien qu’il soit préférable d’y renoncer et de supporter patiemment l’offense ressentie.

renderings.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيۡقٖ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ

english.text: And be patient, for your patience comes only from Allah; do not grieve over them[82], nor be distressed by their evil plots.
english.footnotes: [82] The Prophet (ﷺ) was grieved that they would not believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Supporte donc avec patience le tort qui t’est fait, que tu ne pourras d’ailleurs endurer qu’avec l’aide d’Allah. Ne sois ni affligé par leur comportement, ni angoissé par leurs manœuvres.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحۡسِنُونَ

english.text: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who do good.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah, en vérité, est avec ceux qui fuient le péché et ne cessent de faire le bien.

renderings.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَسۡرَىٰ بِعَبۡدِهِۦ لَيۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡأَقۡصَا ٱلَّذِي بَٰرَكۡنَا حَوۡلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ

english.text: Glory be to the One Who took His slave [Muhammad] by night from the Sacred Mosque [in Makkah] to the Aqsā Mosque [in Jerusalem] whose surroundings We have blessed, so that We may show him some of Our signs. Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gloire à Celui qui, de nuit, fit voyager Son serviteur[1] de la Mosquée sacrée de la Mecque à la Mosquée éloignée de Jérusalem, dont Il a béni les alentours, afin de lui montrer certains de Ses signes. Il est, en vérité, Celui qui entend tout et voit tout.
french.footnotes: [1] Le prophète Mouhammad.

renderings.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هُدٗى لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُواْ مِن دُونِي وَكِيلٗا

english.text: We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guide for the Children of Israel, “Do not take besides Me anyone as a Disposer of Affairs[1].
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., rely upon none except Allah, for He alone is the Disposer of Affairs of the whole universe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons confié à Moïse les Ecritures dont Nous avons fait un guide pour les fils d’Israël auxquels Nous avons dit : « Ne vous en remettez à nul autre dieu que Moi,

renderings.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبۡدٗا شَكُورٗا

english.text: O descendants of those whom We carried [on board] with Noah[2]. He was indeed a grateful slave.”
english.footnotes: [2] The Children of Israel are given the reference of Prophet Noah (عليه السلام); to follow him for being dutiful and thankful to Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: vous les descendants de ceux que Nous avons transportés dans l’Arche avec Noé, qui était en vérité un serviteur hautement reconnaissant. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَتُفۡسِدُنَّ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَّتَيۡنِ وَلَتَعۡلُنَّ عُلُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا

english.text: We declared to the Children of Israel in the Scripture, “You will surely spread corruption on earth twice, and you will surely become exceedingly arrogant[3].
english.footnotes: [3] Allah foretold them out of infinite knowledge about future events.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons annoncé aux fils d’Israël dans les Ecritures qu’ils répandraient par deux fois le mal sur terre et afficheraient un orgueil démesuré.

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ عِبَادٗا لَّنَآ أُوْلِي بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ فَجَاسُواْ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِۚ وَكَانَ وَعۡدٗا مَّفۡعُولٗا

english.text: When the first of the two warnings came to pass, We sent against you some of Our slaves of great might, and they ravaged through the land[4]; this warning was bound to be fulfilled[5].
english.footnotes:
[4] killing them and plundering.
 [5] i.e., the punishment they were promised for their first transgressions.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque s’accomplira la première de ces deux prédictions[2], Nous susciterons contre vous certains de Nos serviteurs dotés d’une force redoutable qui sèmeront le chaos dans votre cité et investiront vos demeures[3]. Le décret d’Allah devra être exécuté.
french.footnotes:
[2] Lorsque vous répandrez une première fois le mal sur terre.
[3] Il pourrait s’agir de la première destruction du Temple de Jérusalem par l’armée de Nabuchodonosor, suivie de l’exil du peuple juif, déporté en Babylonie, et ce, avant l’avènement de Jésus.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡكَرَّةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ أَكۡثَرَ نَفِيرًا

english.text: Then We gave you the upper hand over them and strengthened you with wealth and children, and made you greater in number.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous permettrons ensuite de prendre le dessus sur vos ennemis, multiplierons vos richesses et vos enfants, et augmenterons votre nombre[4].
french.footnotes: [4] Référence possible au retour d’exil des israélites qui pourront même reconstruire le Temple détruit.

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ أَحۡسَنتُمۡ أَحۡسَنتُمۡ لِأَنفُسِكُمۡۖ وَإِنۡ أَسَأۡتُمۡ فَلَهَاۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لِيَسُـُٔواْ وُجُوهَكُمۡ وَلِيَدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَلِيُتَبِّرُواْ مَا عَلَوۡاْ تَتۡبِيرًا

english.text: If you do good, it is for your own good, but if you do evil, it is to your own loss. Then when the second warning came to pass, your enemies would disgrace and suppress you[6], and enter the Temple [of Jerusalem][7] as they entered it the first time, and utterly destroy whatever fell into their power[8].
english.footnotes:
[6] By killing, taking hostage, submission and humiliation.
 [7] Bayt al-Maqdis.
 [8] It would be a total wreckage.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous faites le bien, vous le ferez dans votre seul intérêt, et si vous faites le mal, vous seuls en subirez les effets. Lorsque s’accomplira la seconde de ces deux prédictions, Nous vous mettrons à la merci d’autres ennemis qui vous infligeront une humiliation qui se lira sur vos visages, profanant le Temple[5] comme il le fut une première fois et détruisant tout sur leur passage.
french.footnotes: [5] De Jérusalem, dont la destruction par les Romains, à laquelle ce verset pourrait faire allusion, sera cette fois définitive, et ce, après l’avènement du Messie, Jésus, renié par les juifs.

renderings.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يَرۡحَمَكُمۡۚ وَإِنۡ عُدتُّمۡ عُدۡنَاۚ وَجَعَلۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا

english.text: Your Lord may bestow mercy upon you, but if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment][9]. And We have made Hell a prison for the disbelievers.”
english.footnotes: [9] After this great affliction, Allah would give them back their lost sovereignty, but if they revert back to their old rebellious ways then the way of Allah is never changing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il se peut que votre Seigneur vous fasse miséricorde en vous mettant à l’abri de vos ennemis. Mais si vous récidivez, Nous en ferons de même. Nous avons fait de la Géhenne une infâme prison pour les impies.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ يَهۡدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقۡوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا كَبِيرٗا

english.text: Indeed, this Qur’an guides to what is most upright and gives glad tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Coran que voici guide les hommes vers la voie la plus droite. Il annonce aux croyants qui accomplissent le bien une immense récompense

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

english.text: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et à ceux qui ne croient pas en l’au-delà, que Nous leur avons préparé un douloureux châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَيَدۡعُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلۡخَيۡرِۖ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولٗا

english.text: Man prays for evil as he prays for good, for man is ever hasty[10].
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., becomes impatient and acts without forethought.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme appelle le malheur sur lui avec le même empressement qu’il implore les faveurs du Seigneur. L’homme est par nature impatient.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيۡنِۖ فَمَحَوۡنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَجَعَلۡنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبۡصِرَةٗ لِّتَبۡتَغُواْ فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَلِتَعۡلَمُواْ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلۡحِسَابَۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٖ فَصَّلۡنَٰهُ تَفۡصِيلٗا

english.text: We have made the day and night as two signs. We darkened the night and made the day bright, so that you may seek your Lord’s bounty and know the number of years and calculation [of time]. And We have expounded everything in detail.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons fait de la nuit et du jour deux signes, faisant de l’obscurité et de la lune, le signe de la nuit et de la lumière émise par le soleil, celui du jour, afin que vous puissiez rechercher les faveurs de votre Seigneur, compter les années et calculer le temps. Nous avons exposé toute chose de la manière la plus claire.

renderings.arabic: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلۡزَمۡنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِي عُنُقِهِۦۖ وَنُخۡرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبٗا يَلۡقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا

english.text: We have bound every man’s deeds to his neck[11]. On the Day of Resurrection, We will bring forth for him a record which he will find spread open.
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., after showing guidance for him, he is responsible for his own destiny.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Chaque homme est l’otage de ses œuvres. Le Jour de la résurrection, Nous lui présenterons le registre de ses actions qui sera déployé sous ses yeux.

renderings.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفۡسِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكَ حَسِيبٗا

english.text: [It will be said,] “Read your record; this Day you are sufficient to take account of yourself[12].”
english.footnotes: [12] Everyone will be dealt with justly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Lis le registre de tes œuvres. Tu suffis amplement aujourd’hui pour faire le compte de tes actes. »

renderings.arabic: مَّنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبۡعَثَ رَسُولٗا

english.text: Whoever accepts guidance, it is only for his own good; and whoever goes astray, it is only for his own loss. No bearer of burden will bear the burden of another, nor do We punish until We have sent a messenger[13].
english.footnotes: [13] The disbelievers will have no excuse whatsoever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quiconque suit le droit chemin, le fait dans son seul intérêt, tandis que celui qui s’en écarte en subira seul les effets. Nul n’aura à supporter le forfait d’un autre. Nous ne saurions, de même, châtier un peuple avant de lui avoir envoyé un Messager.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نُّهۡلِكَ قَرۡيَةً أَمَرۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُواْ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهَا تَدۡمِيرٗا

english.text: Whenever We decide to destroy a town, We command its affluent ones [to obey Allah] but they defiantly disobey, so the punishment becomes inevitable, and We destroy it completely.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et lorsque Nous décidons d’anéantir une cité, Nous ordonnons à ses habitants les plus puissants de Nous obéir, mais ils s’y livrent au péché[6]. L’arrêt divin est alors prononcé contre ses habitants qui sont exterminés jusqu’au dernier.
french.footnotes: [6] Autre sens : Nous plaçons à sa tête ses habitants les plus aisés qui s’y livrent au péché. Voir sourate 6, verset 123.

renderings.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ نُوحٖۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرَۢا بَصِيرٗا

english.text: How many generations We have destroyed since the time of Noah[14]! Your Lord is sufficient as All-Aware and All-Seeing of the sins of His slaves[15].
english.footnotes:
[14] Warning them of the consequences of the previously destroyed nations.
 [15] The address here shifts to Muhammad (ﷺ) to assure him that Allah will bring them to account.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de peuples avons-Nous anéantis depuis Noé ! Ton Seigneur suffit pour connaître les péchés de Ses serviteurs qui ne sauraient Lui échapper.

renderings.arabic: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلۡنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَىٰهَا مَذۡمُومٗا مَّدۡحُورٗا

english.text: Whoever desires this fleeting life[16], We hasten therein whatever We will to whoever We please. Then We prepare for him Hell, which he will enter, despised and rejected.
english.footnotes: [16] i.e., worldly pleasures.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que celui qui ne convoite que la vie immédiate sache qu’il n’obtiendra de ce bas monde que ce que Nous voudrons bien lui accorder. Nous l’introduirons ensuite dans la Géhenne où il brûlera, réprouvé et rejeté.

renderings.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَرَادَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعۡيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعۡيُهُم مَّشۡكُورٗا

english.text: But whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it as he should, being a believer – it is those whose efforts will be appreciated[17].
english.footnotes: [17] Allah will accept their good deeds, multiply their reward, and overlook their sins.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à celui, parmi les croyants, qui aspire à l’autre monde et fournit pour l’obtenir les efforts appropriés, il verra ses efforts récompensés.

renderings.arabic: كُلّٗا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنۡ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحۡظُورًا

english.text: We give both – the latter and the former – from the bounty of your Lord, and Your Lord’s bounty is not restricted[18].
english.footnotes: [18] Allah gives provision for all in the life of this world without exception.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous accordons aux uns et aux autres de Nos faveurs[7], sans que nul ne soit privé des dons de ton Seigneur.
french.footnotes: [7] A ceux qui agissent en vue de l’au-delà, comme à ceux qui choisissent ce bas monde.

renderings.arabic: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ فَضَّلۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ أَكۡبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٖ وَأَكۡبَرُ تَفۡضِيلٗا

english.text: See how We have favored some over others [in this world], but the Hereafter has higher ranks and greater degrees of excellence for some over others[19].
english.footnotes: [19] In beauty, wealth, power, knowledge, etc; as a test for them, to see how they react.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vois comment Nous favorisons ici-bas les uns par rapport aux autres. Mais les faveurs de l’au-delà seront bien plus immenses et les degrés y seront autrement plus élevés.

renderings.arabic: لَّا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَذۡمُومٗا مَّخۡذُولٗا

english.text: Do not set up with Allah any other god, or else you will be despised and forsaken[20].
english.footnotes: [20] Having none to thank them for it, nor support them in the least.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Garde-toi d’associer d’autres divinités à Allah, car tu serais à jamais réprouvé et abandonné.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۚ إِمَّا يَبۡلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلۡكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوۡ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفّٖ وَلَا تَنۡهَرۡهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوۡلٗا كَرِيمٗا

english.text: Your Lord has ordained that you worship none but Him, and show kindness to parents. If one or both of them reach old age in your care, do not say to them a word of annoyance[21] nor scold them, rather speak to them noble words,
english.footnotes: [21] ’uff: an expression of irritation and disapproval.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur a ordonné que Lui seul soit adoré et que les père et mère soient traités avec bonté. Si l’un d’eux, ou tous deux, doivent atteindre auprès de toi un âge avancé, garde-toi de leur montrer le moindre signe d’agacement ou de les rudoyer, mais adresse-leur des paroles délicates.

renderings.arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرٗا

english.text: and lower to them the wing of humility[22] out of mercy, and say, “My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small[23].”
english.footnotes:
[22] It is a metaphor; i.e., shows the parents the utmost humbleness like a bird lowering its wing as it hugs its young or so.
 [23] For they are at their weakest phase of life, similar to what he was in his early childhood.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Adopte envers eux une attitude pleine d’humilité et de tendresse, et dis : « Veuille, Seigneur, te montrer clément envers eux, comme ils l’ont été envers moi lorsqu’ils m’ont élevé tout petit ! »

renderings.arabic: رَّبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِي نُفُوسِكُمۡۚ إِن تَكُونُواْ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلۡأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورٗا

english.text: Your Lord knows best what is in your hearts. If you are righteous, He is All-Forgiving to those who constantly turn to Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre Seigneur connaît parfaitement vos intentions. Si celles-ci sont pures, sachez qu’Il traitera avec la plus grande indulgence ceux qui ne cessent de revenir à Lui.

renderings.arabic: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ وَٱبۡنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرۡ تَبۡذِيرًا

english.text: Give relatives their due, and the needy and the stranded travelers, and do not spend wastefully.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Donne ce qui leur revient de droit aux proches parents, aux nécessiteux et aux voyageurs démunis, mais évite toute prodigalité.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓاْ إِخۡوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورٗا

english.text: Indeed, the wasteful are Satans’ brothers[24], and Satan is ever ungrateful to his Lord[25].
english.footnotes:
[24] Islam is a religion of moderation and good consideration; neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderate.
 [25] Disbelievers are the most ungrateful ones as they rebel against Allah's commands instead of showing obedience to Him, for they follow the way of the devil towards Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les prodigues ne font que suivre la voie des démons[8]. Or, Satan est, envers son Seigneur, d’une ingratitude sans nom.
french.footnotes: [8] Littéralement : les prodigues sont les frères des démons.

renderings.arabic: وَإِمَّا تُعۡرِضَنَّ عَنۡهُمُ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ رَحۡمَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرۡجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمۡ قَوۡلٗا مَّيۡسُورٗا

english.text: But if you must turn away from [those in need] while hoping to receive bounty from your Lord[26], then say to them words of comfort.
english.footnotes: [26] i.e., if you have nothing to give them now.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et si tu dois te détourner d’eux[9], adresse-leur des paroles bienveillantes en attendant de recevoir quelque faveur de ton Seigneur.
french.footnotes: [9] Des proches parents, des nécessiteux et des voyageurs démunis que tu n’as pas les moyens d’assister.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ يَدَكَ مَغۡلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبۡسُطۡهَا كُلَّ ٱلۡبَسۡطِ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَلُومٗا مَّحۡسُورًا

english.text: Do not be too tight-fisted[27], nor too open-handed[28], for you will end up blameworthy and destitute.
english.footnotes: [27] i.e., stingy. [28] i.e., extravagant.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne garde pas la main fermée par avarice, et ne te montre pas non plus prodigue, donnant à pleines mains, au risque d’être blâmé pour ton attitude et de te retrouver totalement démuni.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرَۢا بَصِيرٗا

english.text: Your Lord extends provision to whom He wills or restricts it[29]. He is All-Aware and All-Seeing of His slaves.
english.footnotes: [29] He gives or withholds wealth according to what is best for the person concerned and what they would do with it if he is provided with it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur dispense Ses faveurs à qui Il veut, comblant certaines de Ses créatures, accordant aux autres avec mesure. Il connaît parfaitement Ses serviteurs dont aucun secret ne Lui échappe.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَكُمۡ خَشۡيَةَ إِمۡلَٰقٖۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُهُمۡ وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ إِنَّ قَتۡلَهُمۡ كَانَ خِطۡـٔٗا كَبِيرٗا

english.text: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty[30], for We provide for them and for you. Indeed, killing them is a great sin.
english.footnotes: [30] Abdullāh ibn Mas‘ūd (رضي الله عنه) reported: “I said: “O Messenger of Allah, what is the greatest sin?” He said: “That you set up rivals with Allah, when He is the One Who created you!” Then I said: “What is next?” He said: “That you kill your child because he eats with you!” [Al-Bukhāri: 6811].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne tuez pas vos enfants par crainte de la pauvreté. C’est Nous qui pourvoyons à leurs besoins et aux vôtres. Les tuer constituerait un crime d’une grande gravité.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةٗ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: Do not go near adultery[31], for it is indeed a shameful act and an evil way.
english.footnotes: [31] i.e., avoid all things that might lead to it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fuyez le péché de la chair, acte infâme et pratique des plus odieuses !

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظۡلُومٗا فَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَلَا يُسۡرِف فِّي ٱلۡقَتۡلِۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورٗا

english.text: Do not kill any soul that Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice. If anyone is killed wrongfully, We have given his heir authority [of compensation], but he should not exceed the bounds in killing, for he is already supported [by law].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’enlevez pas sans droit la vie qu’Allah a rendue sacrée. Nous avons donné aux héritiers de celui qui serait injustement tué le droit de réclamer justice. Mais qu’ils n’outrepassent pas leurs droits en se vengeant du meurtrier. Car la loi est de leur côté.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ مَالَ ٱلۡيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥۚ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِٱلۡعَهۡدِۖ إِنَّ ٱلۡعَهۡدَ كَانَ مَسۡـُٔولٗا

english.text: Do not approach the property of an orphan except with good [intent][32], until he reaches maturity; and fulfill the covenant, for you will certainly be questioned about the covenant.
english.footnotes: [32] i.e., to improve, increase, or preserve it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’usez des biens de l’orphelin que dans son intérêt jusqu’à ce qu’il ait atteint la maturité. Soyez fidèles à vos engagements, car vous aurez à répondre de vos engagements.

renderings.arabic: وَأَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ إِذَا كِلۡتُمۡ وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَحۡسَنُ تَأۡوِيلٗا

english.text: Give full measure when you measure, and weigh with accurate scales; that is fair and best in the end[33].
english.footnotes: [33] Fair dealing is best, for it brings blessing, psychological calm, and reward in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Faites bonne mesure lorsque vous êtes amenés à mesurer et bon poids lorsque vous devez peser. Voilà la meilleure conduite à adopter, celle dont les suites seront les plus heureuses.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَقۡفُ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٌۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡبَصَرَ وَٱلۡفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنۡهُ مَسۡـُٔولٗا

english.text: Do not follow[34] that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight, and the heart, all of them will be called to account.
english.footnotes: [34] i.e., do not say or assume.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’affirme rien dont tu ne sois certain. De l’ouïe, de la vue et du cœur, de tout cela, chacun devra répondre.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخۡرِقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَن تَبۡلُغَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ طُولٗا

english.text: Do not walk on the earth arrogantly; you cannot cleave the earth, nor can you reach the mountains in height[35].
english.footnotes: [35] Man is indeed a weak and small creature, then why arrogance?!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne marche pas avec insolence, car tu ne saurais fendre la terre[10], ni te hisser à la hauteur des montagnes[11].
french.footnotes:
[10] Par ta démarche insolente.
[11] Avec ton maintien hautain.

renderings.arabic: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكۡرُوهٗا

english.text: The evil of all these actions is hateful to your Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tous ces péchés sont réprouvés du Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةِۗ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلۡقَىٰ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومٗا مَّدۡحُورًا

english.text: This is part of the wisdom that your Lord has revealed to you [O Prophet]. Do not set up any other god with Allah, or you will be thrown into Hell, blameworthy and rejected[36].
english.footnotes: [36] i.e., self-reproached and blamed by others for this miserable end, as well as shut away from all good.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce sont là certains des préceptes, pleins de sagesse, qui te sont révélés par ton Seigneur. Prends garde d’associer d’autres divinités à Allah, car tu serais précipité, honni et maudit, dans la Géhenne.

renderings.arabic: أَفَأَصۡفَىٰكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوۡلًا عَظِيمٗا

english.text: Has your Lord favored you with sons and has taken for Himself angels as daughters[37]? You are indeed making a monstrous claim.
english.footnotes: [37] Their feeble argument is debunked and refuted concerning the issue of purity of Faith and Monotheism. Although preferring male over female is a heathen way; yet, how would Allah, the Omnipotent Creator, accept for Himself what they do not accept for themselves? (cf. 37:149-155). They worshiped the angels based on the claim that they were Allah’s daughters. (cf. 43:19-20).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre Seigneur vous aurait-Il réservé les garçons en se choisissant des filles parmi les anges ? Vous prononcez là un infâme blasphème.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمۡ إِلَّا نُفُورٗا

english.text: We have explained things in various ways in this Qur’an, so that they may take heed, but it only increases them in aversion[38].
english.footnotes: [38] “We send down the Qur’an as a healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.” See below 17:82.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons clairement exposé Nos enseignements dans le Coran afin qu’ils puissent les méditer, mais cela ne fait qu’exacerber leur répulsion pour la vérité.

renderings.arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٞ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذٗا لَّٱبۡتَغَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: Say, “If there were other gods besides Him – as they claim – they would have surely sought a way to the Lord of the Throne[39].”
english.footnotes: [39] To please Him or take over His Throne.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Si, comme ils le prétendent, il existait d’autres divinités avec Lui, celles-ci chercheraient elles-mêmes à se rapprocher du Maître du Trône[12]. »
french.footnotes: [12] Par les actes d’adoration. Autre sens : celles-ci chercheraient à Lui disputer Son Trône.

renderings.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا

english.text: Glorified and Highly Exalted is He far above what they claim!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gloire à Lui ! Il est bien au-dessus de leurs blasphèmes.

renderings.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبۡعُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفۡقَهُونَ تَسۡبِيحَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورٗا

english.text: The seven heavens and the earth, and all those in them glorify Him. There is not a single thing that does not glorify Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification. Indeed, He is Most Forbearing, All-Forgiving.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les sept cieux, la terre et tous ceux qui les peuplent célèbrent Sa gloire. Il n’est rien qui ne célèbre Sa gloire par les louanges, mais vous êtes incapables de comprendre leur manière de Le glorifier[13]. Il est Longanime et Très Clément.
french.footnotes: [13] Cette règle s’applique aux règnes animal, végétal et minéral. Tous les éléments de la Création célèbrent la gloire et la sainteté du Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ جَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حِجَابٗا مَّسۡتُورٗا

english.text: When you recite the Qur’an, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier[40].
english.footnotes: [40] Preventing guidance from them, for their aversion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque tu récites le Coran, Nous plaçons un voile invisible entre toi et ceux qui ne croient pas en l’au-delà.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرۡتَ رَبَّكَ فِي ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَلَّوۡاْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِمۡ نُفُورٗا

english.text: We have placed covers on their hearts so that they do not understand it, and deafness in their ears[41]. When you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’an, they turn their backs in aversion.
english.footnotes: [41] This is in return for their hatred toward the truth and the ingrained disease of doubt in their hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons recouvert leurs cœurs de voiles qui les empêchent d’en saisir les enseignements et rendu leurs oreilles sourdes à la vérité. Et lorsque, en récitant le Coran, tu proclames l’unicité de ton Seigneur, ils tournent le dos par répulsion.

renderings.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَسۡتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذۡ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِذۡ هُمۡ نَجۡوَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلٗا مَّسۡحُورًا

english.text: We are well aware of what they wish to hear when they listen to you, and what they say when they converse in private, when the wrongdoers say, “You are not following but a bewitched man.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous connaissons parfaitement l’intention des impies qui viennent t’écouter et leurs discussions secrètes lorsqu’ils affirment : « Vous ne suivez là qu’un homme ensorcelé ! »

renderings.arabic: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: See how they call you names[42]! Thus they have gone astray and cannot find a way.
english.footnotes: [42] i.e., a poet, a madman, bewitched, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vois à quoi ils osent te comparer, incapables dans leur égarement de trouver la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ خَلۡقٗا جَدِيدٗا

english.text: They say, “What! When we are turned into bones and dust, will we really be resurrected as a new creation?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Est-il possible, disent-ils, que nous soyons rendus à une nouvelle vie, une fois nos os réduits en poussière ? »

renderings.arabic: ۞ قُلۡ كُونُواْ حِجَارَةً أَوۡ حَدِيدًا

english.text: Say, “Be you stones or iron[43],
english.footnotes: [43] i.e., even if you could be stones or iron in hardness or in power.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Soyez pierre ou fer,

renderings.arabic: أَوۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّمَّا يَكۡبُرُ فِي صُدُورِكُمۡۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَاۖ قُلِ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۚ فَسَيُنۡغِضُونَ إِلَيۡكَ رُءُوسَهُمۡ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَۖ قُلۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبٗا

english.text: or any other substance you think is harder[44] to bring back to life.” They will then say, “Who will bring us back [to life]?” Say, “The One Who created you the first time.” They will shake their heads[45] at you and say, “When will that be?” Say, “Perhaps it is soon.”
english.footnotes:
[44] Such as the heavens and the earth.
 [45] In ridicule and disbelief.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ou toute autre matière impossible selon vous à recréer[14]. » Ils diront alors : « Qui donc nous fera revenir à la vie ? » Réponds-leur : « Celui-là même qui vous a créés une première fois. » Moqueurs, ils hocheront la tête en demandant : « Quand cela arrivera-t-il ? » Réponds-leur : « Il se peut que cela soit imminent. »
french.footnotes: [14] Allah ne manquera pas de vous ressusciter.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ فَتَسۡتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

english.text: On the Day when He calls you, you will respond by praising Him, thinking that you had not stayed [on earth] except for a little while.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, vous répondrez à Son appel[15], loué soit-Il[16], persuadés de n’y être restés que peu de temps.
french.footnotes:
[15] A sortir de vos tombes.
[16] Ou : vous répondrez à Son appel en Le louant. Ou encore : vous répondrez à Son appel, entièrement soumis à Sa volonté.

renderings.arabic: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُواْ ٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوّٗا مُّبِينٗا

english.text: Tell My slaves that they should say what is best[46], for Satan sows discord among them. Indeed, Satan is a sworn enemy to mankind.
english.footnotes: [46] i.e., they should be considerate and kind, well-spoken, and tolerant to win hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis à Mes serviteurs de s’adresser aux autres de la manière la plus douce car Satan, l’ennemi déclaré des hommes, tente par tous les moyens de semer la discorde entre eux.

renderings.arabic: رَّبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡۖ إِن يَشَأۡ يَرۡحَمۡكُمۡ أَوۡ إِن يَشَأۡ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡۚ وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَكِيلٗا

english.text: Your Lord knows you best: if He wills, He will have mercy on you; or if He wills, He will punish you. We have not sent you [O Prophet] to be in charge of them[47].
english.footnotes: [47] The mission of the Prophet (ﷺ) was only delivering the Message; their guidance and holding to account is up to Allah Almighty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre Seigneur vous connaît parfaitement. S’Il le veut, Il se montrera envers vous Miséricordieux[17] et s’Il le veut, Il vous infligera un châtiment rigoureux[18]. Quant à toi, Nous ne t’avons pas envoyé aux hommes afin de les contraindre à embrasser la foi.
french.footnotes:
[17] En vous guidant vers la foi, vous mécréants.
[18] En vous abandonnant à votre impiété.

renderings.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَلَقَدۡ فَضَّلۡنَا بَعۡضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورٗا

english.text: Your Lord knows best all those in the heavens and on earth[48]. We have surely favored some prophets over others, and We gave David the Psalms[49].
english.footnotes:
[48] Allah knows all and what they deserve.
 [49] Al-Zabūr is revealed to Prophet David (عليه السلام); al-zabūr (pl. zubūr) originally is every book that contains wisdom. See 3:184.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur connaît parfaitement ceux qui peuplent les cieux et la terre. Nous avons, en vérité, élevé certains prophètes au-dessus des autres, confiant ainsi les Psaumes à David.

renderings.arabic: قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ كَشۡفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡوِيلًا

english.text: Say, “Call upon those whom you claimed [to be gods] besides Him; they have no power to remove harm or avert it from you.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Invoquez donc ceux qui, selon vos prétentions, sont au même titre qu’Allah dignes d’adoration et voyez s’ils ont le pouvoir de vous délivrer d’un mal ou de le détourner. »

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ يَبۡتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلۡوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمۡ أَقۡرَبُ وَيَرۡجُونَ رَحۡمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحۡذُورٗا

english.text: Those whom they call upon seek means of nearness to their Lord, each trying to become closer, hoping for His Mercy and fearing His punishment[50]. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is fearsome.
english.footnotes: [50] Such as angels, prophets, righteous believers, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: En réalité, ceux qu’ils implorent cherchent eux-mêmes, à qui mieux mieux, à se rapprocher de leur Seigneur, espérant Sa miséricorde et redoutant Son châtiment. Le châtiment de ton Seigneur est en effet redoutable.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحۡنُ مُهۡلِكُوهَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَوۡ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗاۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَسۡطُورٗا

english.text: There is no [disbelieving] town except that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it severely[51]. This is written in the Record[52].
english.footnotes: [51] Due to the disbelief and sins of its inhabitants. [52] i.e., the Preserved Tablet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’est pas de cité impie qui ne soit anéantie avant le Jour de la résurrection ou dont Nous ne châtions les habitants, conformément à ce qui est consigné dans le Livre[19].
french.footnotes: [19] Archétype.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرۡسِلَ بِٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَۚ وَءَاتَيۡنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبۡصِرَةٗ فَظَلَمُواْ بِهَاۚ وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ بِٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ إِلَّا تَخۡوِيفٗا

english.text: Nothing prevents Us from sending signs except that the earlier people denied them[53]. We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a clear sign, but they wrongfully rejected her[54]. We do not send signs except as a warning.
english.footnotes:
[53] So that the pagans of Makkah do do not face the consequences of the earlier nations.
 [54] i.e., they committed an injustice by hamstringing the she-camel.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La seule raison qui Nous empêche de produire les miracles qui te sont réclamés est qu’ils furent reniés par les peuples du passé. Nous avons ainsi envoyé aux Thamoud la chamelle, signe parfaitement clair qu’ils ont pourtant rejeté injustement. Nous ne produisons des miracles qu’à titre d’avertissement.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِۚ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا ٱلرُّءۡيَا ٱلَّتِيٓ أَرَيۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلۡمَلۡعُونَةَ فِي ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمۡ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمۡ إِلَّا طُغۡيَٰنٗا كَبِيرٗا

english.text: And [remember, O Prophet] when We told you, “Your Lord encompasses all people [with His knowledge and might][55].” We did not make the sight which We showed you[56] except as a test for people, as well as the cursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’an. We keep threatening them, yet it only increases them to greater transgression.
english.footnotes:
[55] i.e., Allah will protect you (ﷺ) from their harm.
 [56] During the journey of mi‘rāj (ascension) to the heavens.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Souviens-toi lorsque Nous t’avons affirmé que Ton Seigneur tenait les hommes en Son pouvoir[20]. Nous ne t’avons permis de voir tant de signes[21] et n’avons mentionné l’arbre maudit dans le Coran[22] que pour éprouver les hommes. Mais Nos menaces ne font qu’ajouter à leur impiété.
french.footnotes:
[20] Remplis donc ta mission sans crainte.
[21] Lors du Voyage nocturne, mentionné au premier verset de cette sourate, selon la majorité des exégètes.
[22] L’arbre Zaqqoum dont se nourriront les damnés de l’Enfer et cité à trois reprises dans le Coran, notamment au verset 52 de la sourate 56.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسۡجُدُ لِمَنۡ خَلَقۡتَ طِينٗا

english.text: And [remember] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate to Adam;” they all prostrated except Iblīs, who said, “Should I prostrate to whom You created from clay?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Nous avons ordonné aux anges de se prosterner devant Adam, tous se sont exécutés, excepté Satan qui dit : « Vais-je me prosterner devant celui que Tu as créé d’argile ?

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيۡتَكَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كَرَّمۡتَ عَلَيَّ لَئِنۡ أَخَّرۡتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَأَحۡتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

english.text: He added, “Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If you give me respite until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely overpower his offspring, except for a few[57].”
english.footnotes: [57] i.e., tempt and lead them astray.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Tu m’accordes un sursis jusqu’au Jour de la résurrection, je ne manquerai pas de dévoyer, à l’exception d’un petit nombre, la descendance de cet être que Tu as honoré plus que moi. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ ٱذۡهَبۡ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ مَّوۡفُورٗا

english.text: Allah said, “Be gone[58]! Whoever among them follows you, Hell will be an ample recompense for you all.
english.footnotes: [58] This and the next commands were actually a threat.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Va-t’en[23] ! La Géhenne sera une rétribution amplement suffisante pour toi et tous ceux parmi eux qui te suivront.
french.footnotes: [23] Le délai réclamé t’est accordé.

renderings.arabic: وَٱسۡتَفۡزِزۡ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتَ مِنۡهُم بِصَوۡتِكَ وَأَجۡلِبۡ عَلَيۡهِم بِخَيۡلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكۡهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰلِ وَٱلۡأَوۡلَٰدِ وَعِدۡهُمۡۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا

english.text: Entice with your voice whoever of them you can; mobilize against them your cavalry and infantry; manipulate them in their wealth[59] and children[60], and make promises to them.” But Satan does not promise them except delusion[61].
english.footnotes:
[59] i.e., earning and spending them sinfully.
 [60] i.e., having and raising them sinfully and giving them polytheistic names.
 [61] i.e., deception and fraudulence.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Efforce-toi, par tes suggestions, de séduire tous ceux que tu pourras parmi eux. Lance contre eux toutes les forces à ta disposition, associe-toi à leurs biens et à leur progéniture, et fais-leur toutes sortes de promesses. » Mais Satan, par ses promesses, ne fait que bercer les hommes d’illusions.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلٗا

english.text: “You will have no authority over My slaves.” And sufficient is your Lord as a Guardian.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Tu n’auras toutefois aucun pouvoir sur Mes serviteurs croyants. » Ton Seigneur est en effet, pour eux, un protecteur amplement suffisant.

renderings.arabic: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُزۡجِي لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ لِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمۡ رَحِيمٗا

english.text: It is your Lord Who makes the ships sail for you through the sea, so that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever Merciful to you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est votre Seigneur qui, pour vous, fait voguer en mer les vaisseaux à bord desquels vous partez à la recherche de Ses faveurs. Il est, envers vous, Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدۡعُونَ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُۖ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ أَعۡرَضۡتُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ كَفُورًا

english.text: When hardship strikes you at sea, you forget all those whom you invoke besides Him[62]. Then when He brings you safe to the land, you turn away. Mankind is ever ungrateful.
english.footnotes: [62] Upon the conquest of Makkah, ‘Ikrimah ibn Abī Jahl along with his companions fled to the sea. He pledged in the sea that if he was saved from the storm that hit their boat, he would embrace Islam, so he fulfilled his pledge and announced his Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque vous courez un danger en mer, vous oubliez les fausses divinités que vous invoquiez, vos prières se tournant exclusivement vers le Seigneur. Mais dès qu’Il vous a ramenés sains et saufs à terre, vous vous détournez de Lui. L’homme est par nature ingrat.

renderings.arabic: أَفَأَمِنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلۡبَرِّ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُواْ لَكُمۡ وَكِيلًا

english.text: Do you feel secure that He will not make some part of the land swallow you up, or send against you a storm of stones? Thereupon you will find none to protect you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Etes-vous si sûrs qu’Allah ne vous fera pas engloutir par la terre ou sous une pluie de pierres, sans que nul ne puisse vous sauver ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ أَمِنتُمۡ أَن يُعِيدَكُمۡ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ فَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ قَاصِفٗا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغۡرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرۡتُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُواْ لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعٗا

english.text: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back [to sea] once again, and send upon you a violent storm to drown you on account of your disbelief? Thereupon you will find none to help you against Us[63].
english.footnotes: [63] To demand restitution.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou qu’Il ne vous ramènera pas une autre fois en mer pour soulever contre vous un vent destructeur et vous engloutir sous les eaux pour prix de votre impiété, sans que nul ne puisse ensuite vous venger ?

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ كَرَّمۡنَا بَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٖ مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَا تَفۡضِيلٗا

english.text: We have honored the children of Adam, carried them on land and sea, provided for them good things[64] and favored them above many of those whom We have created.
english.footnotes: [64] By bestowing them with intellectual abilities and making angels prostrate to their father, Adam. Furthermore, Allah subjected other creatures to them, as they mount with dignity their means of transportation both on land and in the sea. Allah also provided them with good food, drinks, and spouses, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons honoré les fils d’Adam, mettant à leur disposition toutes sortes de moyens de transport sur terre et en mer, leur procurant les nourritures les plus pures et les favorisant largement par rapport à nombre de Nos créatures.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَدۡعُواْ كُلَّ أُنَاسِۭ بِإِمَٰمِهِمۡۖ فَمَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَقۡرَءُونَ كِتَٰبَهُمۡ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ فَتِيلٗا

english.text: On the Day when We will summon every community with its leader[65]. Those who are given their record in their right hand will read their record [happily]; they will not be wronged even as much as the thread of a date stone.
english.footnotes: [65] Or what they followed in their worldly life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous appellerons un jour chaque nation avec son livre[24]. Celui auquel le registre de ses œuvres sera remis dans la main droite le lira avec joie, sans être en rien lésé.
french.footnotes: [24] Le Livre qui lui a été révélé ou encore le registre des œuvres de chaque individu. La première interprétation est retenue par At-Tabari, la seconde par Ibn Kathîr. Cette dernière interprétation est d’ailleurs appuyée par la suite du verset. D’autres, enfin, donnant au terme arabe employé ici un autre sens, expliquent que chaque nation sera appelée, le Jour de la résurrection, par le nom du prophète qui lui a été envoyé.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن كَانَ فِي هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَعۡمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: But whoever was blind [from the truth][66] in this life will be even blinder in the Hereafter and further astray from the right way.
english.footnotes: [66] i.e., refused to see the truth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à celui qui aura été aveugle ici-bas, il sera frappé de la même cécité dans l’au-delà, et encore plus égaré.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن كَادُواْ لَيَفۡتِنُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ لِتَفۡتَرِيَ عَلَيۡنَا غَيۡرَهُۥۖ وَإِذٗا لَّٱتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلٗا

english.text: They were about to tempt you away from what We have revealed to you [O Prophet] so that you would fabricate something else and attribute it to Us; then they would have surely taken you as a close friend.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ont failli te détourner de ce que Nous t’avons révélé en te poussant à Nous attribuer d’autres paroles. Ils t’auraient alors déclaré leur amitié.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن ثَبَّتۡنَٰكَ لَقَدۡ كِدتَّ تَرۡكَنُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا قَلِيلًا

english.text: Had We not made you stand firm, you would nearly have inclined to them a little.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous ne t’avions pas raffermi, tu aurais pu pencher quelque peu vers eux.

renderings.arabic: إِذٗا لَّأَذَقۡنَٰكَ ضِعۡفَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعۡفَ ٱلۡمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيۡنَا نَصِيرٗا

english.text: In that case, We would have made you taste double punishment, both in this life and after death. Thereupon you would have found no helper against Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous t’aurions alors doublement châtié dans cette vie et dans la mort, sans que nul ne puisse te protéger.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن كَادُواْ لَيَسۡتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيُخۡرِجُوكَ مِنۡهَاۖ وَإِذٗا لَّا يَلۡبَثُونَ خِلَٰفَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

english.text: They were about to provoke you so as to drive you out of the land [of Makkah], but then they would not have remained after you, except for a little while[67].
english.footnotes: [67] Makkah was completely cleared of the Prophet's enemies only ten years after his emigration.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ont failli te pousser à quitter ta patrie. Mais ils n’y seraient pas restés bien longtemps après ton départ.

renderings.arabic: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَاۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحۡوِيلًا

english.text: Such was Our way with the messengers We sent before you, and you will find no change in Our way.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Telle fut la règle, immuable, appliquée à ceux de Nos Messagers envoyés avant toi.

renderings.arabic: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ إِنَّ قُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ كَانَ مَشۡهُودٗا

english.text: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night, and the recitation of dawn [prayer][68], for the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed [by the angels][69].
english.footnotes:
[68] i.e., the zuhr, asr, maghrib, and ‘ishā’ prayers.
 [69] i.e., the fajr prayer, in which the recitation of the Qur’an is prolonged, for it is witnessed by angels. This verse alluded to all five obligatory daily prayers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Accomplis la prière du déclin du soleil[25] jusqu’à l’obscurité de la nuit, ainsi que la prière de l’aube à laquelle les anges viennent assister[26].
french.footnotes:
[25] Au moment où le soleil, à son zénith, commence à décliner, marquant le début de l’heure de la prière de midi (Dhouhr).
[26] Le début de ce verset ferait donc allusion à quatre prières obligatoires : celle de midi, celle de l’après-midi, celle du crépuscule et celle de la nuit, puis la suite du verset à la cinquième et dernière prière quotidienne, celle de l’aube.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَتَهَجَّدۡ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةٗ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامٗا مَّحۡمُودٗا

english.text: And wake up during the night and pray, as an additional prayer for you [O Prophet], so your Lord may raise you to a praised status[70].
english.footnotes: [70] Al-Maqām al-Mahmūd (the position of the Grand Intercession) is granted to the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Interromps ton sommeil la nuit pour réciter le Coran au cours de prières surérogatoires pour toi afin que ton Seigneur t’élève, le Jour de la résurrection, à un rang d’honneur.
