renderings.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَقُولُ نَادُواْ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّوۡبِقٗا

english.text: And [beware of] the Day when He will say, “Call upon those whom you claimed to be My partners.” So they will call them, but they will not respond to them[31], and We will make them share the same doom.
english.footnotes: [31] The false deities they took besides Allah will let them down when they need them most on Judgment Day.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour de la résurrection, Allah dira aux païens : « Faites appel à ceux que vous prétendiez être Mes égaux. » Ils les appelleront au secours, mais en vain. Nous aurons placé entre eux une vallée de perdition.

renderings.arabic: وَرَءَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ عَنۡهَا مَصۡرِفٗا

english.text: The wicked will see the Fire and realize that they are bound to fall into it, and they will find no escape from it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voyant le feu de l’Enfer, les criminels seront persuadés d’y être précipités, sans le moindre espoir d’y échapper.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖۚ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَكۡثَرَ شَيۡءٖ جَدَلٗا

english.text: We have surely diversified in this Qur’an every kind of example for people[32], but man is the most quarrelsome of all beings[33].
english.footnotes:
[32] So that people may become mindful and be guided.
 [33] Humans always defend their position instead of yielding to the truth. It pertains to disbelievers more than anyone else.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons proposé aux hommes, dans le Coran, toutes sortes de paraboles et d’exemples édifiants. Mais l’homme est bien le plus acharné des disputeurs.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ قُبُلٗا

english.text: Nothing prevents people from believing when guidance comes to them and from seeking forgiveness from their Lord except that the fate of the earlier nations should come to them, or that the punishment should come before their eyes.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’est-ce qui empêche les hommes de croire au message de vérité qui leur a été apporté et d’implorer le pardon de leur Seigneur ? Attendent-ils de subir le sort de leurs devanciers ou de voir de leurs propres yeux le châtiment fondre sur eux ?

renderings.arabic: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَۚ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَمَآ أُنذِرُواْ هُزُوٗا

english.text: We do not send the messengers except as bearers of glad tidings and warners. But those who disbelieve seek to undermine the truth with false arguments, and they take My verses and warnings in ridicule.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’envoyons les Messagers que pour annoncer la bonne nouvelle et mettre en garde l’humanité. Mais les mécréants usent de faux arguments pour réfuter la vérité, tournant en dérision Mes enseignements et Mes avertissements.

renderings.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُۚ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۖ وَإِن تَدۡعُهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهۡتَدُوٓاْ إِذًا أَبَدٗا

english.text: Who could be more wrong than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord, but he turns away from them and forgets what his hands have sent forth? We have placed veils on their hearts so that they cannot understand it, and deafness in their ears. Even if you call them to guidance, they will never be guided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qui donc se charge d’une plus grande iniquité que celui qui, exhorté à méditer Nos signes, s’en détourne en oubliant les méfaits qu’il a perpétrés ? Nous avons recouvert leurs cœurs de voiles qui les empêchent d’en saisir le sens et rendu leurs oreilles sourdes à la vérité. Tu auras beau les inviter à suivre le droit chemin, ils ne répondront jamais à ton appel.

renderings.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحۡمَةِۖ لَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُواْ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوۡعِدٞ لَّن يَجِدُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوۡئِلٗا

english.text: But your Lord is the All-Forgiving, Lord of Mercy. If He were to take them to task for what they did, He would have hastened their punishment. Yet there is an appointed time for them from which they will find no escape.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur est le Très Clément, le Dieu de miséricorde. Il pourrait dès à présent châtier les impies pour prix de leurs agissements, précipitant ainsi leur ruine, mais un terme est fixé pour leur châtiment auquel ils ne sauraient échapper.

renderings.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ وَجَعَلۡنَا لِمَهۡلِكِهِم مَّوۡعِدٗا

english.text: Those are the towns We destroyed when they persisted in wrongdoing, and We set an appointed time for their destruction.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voyez ces cités que Nous avons anéanties en raison de leur iniquité. Nous avions assigné un terme pour leur destruction.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبۡرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَمۡضِيَ حُقُبٗا

english.text: And [remember] when Moses said to his servant, “I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas, or I travel for ages.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse adressa un jour ces paroles à son serviteur : « Je n’aurai de cesse de progresser tant que je n’aurai pas atteint le lieu où se rejoignent les deux mers, dussé-je voyager de longues années. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَيۡنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبٗا

english.text: But when they reached the junction of the two seas, they forgot their fish, which made its way into the sea, slipping away.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, parvenus à l’endroit indiqué, les deux hommes oublièrent leur poisson qui se fraya un passage dans la mer.

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدۡ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبٗا

english.text: When they traveled further, he said to his servant, “Bring us our morning meal; this journey has truly exhausted us.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Après avoir quitté les lieux, Moïse dit à son serviteur : « Apporte-nous notre déjeuner. Ce voyage nous a durement éprouvés. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيۡتَ إِذۡ أَوَيۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخۡرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ ٱلۡحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَنۡ أَذۡكُرَهُۥۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ عَجَبٗا

english.text: He said, “You remember when we rested by the rock, I forgot the fish; it was none who made me forget to mention it except Satan, and it made its way into the sea amazingly.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Te souviens-tu lorsque nous nous sommes arrêtés près du rocher ? Eh bien, j’ai oublié à cet endroit le poisson. Seul Satan d’ailleurs a pu me le faire oublier. » Le poisson s’est frayé de façon étonnante un passage dans la mer[17].
french.footnotes: [17] Cette dernière phrase ferait donc partie des paroles d’Allah. Autre sens : « J’ai oublié à cet endroit de te parler du poisson qui, chose étonnante, s’est frayé un passage dans la mer. Seul Satan d’ailleurs a pu me le faire oublier. » Selon cette seconde interprétation, le serviteur a seulement oublié de parler à Moïse de la disparition du poisson qu’il a vu se frayer de façon étonnante un passage dans la mer.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِۚ فَٱرۡتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصٗا

english.text: Moses said, “That is exactly what we were looking for.” So they turned back, retracing their footsteps.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit : « Voilà justement le signe que nous attendions[18]. » Les deux hommes revinrent donc sur leurs pas.
french.footnotes: [18] En effet, expliquent les commentateurs, Moïse fut informé par révélation que lorsqu’il perdrait le poisson qu’il avait emporté avec lui, il serait arrivé à destination, à l’endroit où devait se faire sa rencontre avec l’homme vertueux auquel la tradition musulmane donne le nom de « Khadir » et dont il sera fait mention au verset suivant.

renderings.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدٗا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمٗا

english.text: There they found one of Our slaves[34] upon whom We bestowed Our mercy[35] and We taught him from Our Own knowledge[36].
english.footnotes:
[34] i.e., Al-Khidr.
 [35] i.e., Prophethood or being a righteous servant of Allah.
 [36] i.e., the knowledge that Allah gave him such as knowledge of some unseen events, of which others were unaware.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils finirent par trouver près du rocher l’un de Nos serviteurs que Nous avions comblé de Nos faveurs et doté d’un immense savoir.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلۡ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمۡتَ رُشۡدٗا

english.text: Moses said to him, “May I follow you so that you may teach me some knowledge that you have been taught?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse lui fit cette demande : « Puis-je t’accompagner afin d’être initié à la sagesse qui t’a été enseignée ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

english.text: He said, “You will never be able to have patience with me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme répondit : « Tu ne pourras supporter ma compagnie.

renderings.arabic: وَكَيۡفَ تَصۡبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ خُبۡرٗا

english.text: How can you have patience with that which you have no knowledge about?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment, en effet, pourras-tu te taire devant des actes que tu ne parviendras pas à t’expliquer ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرٗا وَلَآ أَعۡصِي لَكَ أَمۡرٗا

english.text: Moses said, “You will find me patient, if Allah wills; and I will not disobey any of your orders.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit : « Tu trouveras en moi, par la volonté d’Allah, un homme patient et toujours obéissant. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَنِي فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِي عَن شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحۡدِثَ لَكَ مِنۡهُ ذِكۡرٗا

english.text: He said, “Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I mention it to you.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme dit : « Si tu dois m’accompagner, ne m’interroge sur aucun de mes gestes, mais attends que je t’en donne moi-même l’explication. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَاۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقۡتَهَا لِتُغۡرِقَ أَهۡلَهَا لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا إِمۡرٗا

english.text: So they both set out, until when they boarded a ship, he made a hole in it. Moses said, “Did you make a hole in it to drown its people? You have done something terrible!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils se mirent donc en route avant de monter à bord d’un bateau auquel l’homme fit une brèche. Moïse s’indigna : « Pour quelle raison l’as-tu endommagé, pour en noyer les occupants ? Ton geste est inqualifiable ! »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُلۡ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

english.text: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will never be able to have patience with me?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme dit : « Ne t’ai-je pas averti que tu ne pourrais supporter ma compagnie ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرۡهِقۡنِي مِنۡ أَمۡرِي عُسۡرٗا

english.text: Moses said, “Do not take me to task for what I forgot, and do not make it too difficult for me to follow you.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse s’excusa : « Ne m’en veux pas pour cet oubli. Montre-toi, au contraire, indulgent envers moi. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمٗا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا زَكِيَّةَۢ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٖ لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـٔٗا نُّكۡرٗا

english.text: Then they proceeded until they met a boy, and the man killed him. Moses said, “Did you kill an innocent soul who killed none? You have done something monstrous!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Reprenant la route, ils rencontrèrent un garçon que l’homme tua. Moïse s’écria : « Tuer ainsi sans raison un être innocent ? Voilà un acte odieux ! »

renderings.arabic: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

english.text: The man said, “Did I not tell you that you will never be able to have patience with me?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme dit : « Ne t’ai-je pas averti que tu perdrais rapidement patience en ma compagnie ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِن سَأَلۡتُكَ عَن شَيۡءِۭ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبۡنِيۖ قَدۡ بَلَغۡتَ مِن لَّدُنِّي عُذۡرٗا

english.text: Moses said, “If I ask you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company, for then you would be excused concerning me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit : « Si je t’interroge encore une fois, tu pourras te séparer de moi. Tu as été suffisamment patient avec moi. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةٍ ٱسۡتَطۡعَمَآ أَهۡلَهَا فَأَبَوۡاْ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارٗا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥۖ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرٗا

english.text: Then they went on until they came to the people of a town[37]. They asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. They found there a wall that was about to collapse, but he repaired it. Moses said, “If you wished, you could have taken some payment for it.”
english.footnotes: [37] Who were extremely mean folk.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Poursuivant leur route, Moïse et son compagnon arrivèrent dans une cité dont les habitants, auxquels les deux hommes réclamèrent à manger, leur refusèrent l’hospitalité. Là, ils trouvèrent un mur sur le point de s’écrouler que l’homme décida de redresser. Moïse lui fit remarquer : « Tu pourrais, si tu le voulais, réclamer un salaire pour ce travail. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنِكَۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأۡوِيلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا

english.text: The man said, “This is the parting of ways between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that which you could not bear with patience.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme dit : « Voici donc venu le moment de nous séparer. Mais je vais avant cela t’expliquer les actes que tu n’as pu t’empêcher de condamner.

renderings.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٞ يَأۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصۡبٗا

english.text: “As for the ship, it belonged to some poor people who worked at sea. I wanted to make it defective because there was a king ahead of them who seized every [good] ship by force.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’agissant du bateau, il appartenait à de pauvres travailleurs de la mer. J’ai voulu l’endommager car ils allaient au-devant d’un roi qui s’emparait de force de toute embarcation en bon état.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَٰنٗا وَكُفۡرٗا

english.text: “As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them with his rebellion and disbelief[38].
english.footnotes: [38] Even though the parents were believers, the son was to become a disbeliever, and it was feared that he would make them fall into disbelief out of their love for him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant au garçon, nous avons eu peur qu’il ne pousse ses parents, qui étaient croyants, à transgresser la loi et à renier la foi.

renderings.arabic: فَأَرَدۡنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُ زَكَوٰةٗ وَأَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمٗا

english.text: So we hoped that their Lord would give them another in his place, more righteous and tender-hearted.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons voulu que leur Seigneur leur donne en échange un fils plus vertueux et plus affectueux.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيمَيۡنِ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهُۥ كَنزٞ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحٗا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبۡلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهُۥ عَنۡ أَمۡرِيۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأۡوِيلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرٗا

english.text: As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was a treasure under it that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man, so your Lord willed that they should reach their maturity and retrieve their treasure[39], as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do it of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that which you could not bear with patience.”
english.footnotes: [39] Had they not mended the wall, it would have subsequently fallen; they, being young, weak, and surrounded by mean people, would certainly have lost their treasure.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: En ce qui concerne le mur, il appartenait à deux jeunes orphelins de la ville dont le père fut un homme vertueux. Sous le mur avait été enfoui un trésor à leur intention. Ton Seigneur, dans Sa miséricorde, a voulu que les deux orphelins déterrent eux-mêmes leur trésor une fois devenus adultes. Je n’ai à aucun moment agi de ma propre initiative[19]. Telle est l’explication des gestes que tu n’as pu t’empêcher de condamner. »
french.footnotes: [19] Mais sur les ordres du Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِي ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِۖ قُلۡ سَأَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًا

english.text: They ask you about Dhul-Qarnayn[40]. Say, “I will tell you something about him.”
english.footnotes: [40] The Two-Horned Sovereign, about whom the Quraysh pagans asked the Prophet (ﷺ), along with that of the Companions of the Cave, testing his prophethood. He was named thus because he reached the rising point and the setting point of the sun; or two generations (qarns) of people passed away during his reign; or he had two long locks of hair; or his crown had two horns.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils t’interrogent au sujet de Dhou Al-Qarnayn[20]. Réponds-leur : « Je vais vous relater les faits les plus marquants de son épopée. »
french.footnotes: [20] Littéralement : « l’homme aux deux cornes », roi qui domina une grande partie de la terre et qui, selon nombre de commentateurs, serait Alexandre le Grand, effectivement représenté sur les pièces de monnaie frappées à son effigie avec deux cornes de béliers. Celui qui est considéré comme le plus grand conquérant de l’Histoire atteignit les extrémités occidentale (avec l’Europe) et orientale (avec l’Inde) du monde connu à son époque en quelques années seulement, puisqu’il devint roi à seulement vingt ans et mourut à trente-trois ans. Le Coran précise toutefois, dès le début de son histoire, qu’il ne doit aucunement ce titre à son génie mais bien à l’assistance divine. Certains commentateurs doutent néanmoins que « l’homme aux deux cornes » du Coran, décrit comme un pieux croyant, puisse être Alexandre le Grand, connu pour son paganisme. Rappelons cependant qu’Alexandre le Grand est mentionné dans la Bible hébraïque.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ سَبَبٗا

english.text: We established him on earth and gave him the means to achieve everything[41].
english.footnotes: [41] Such as soldiers, weaponry, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons assis son autorité sur terre en lui indiquant toutes les voies du succès[21].
french.footnotes: [21] Militaire, notamment. Ce qui lui permit de conquérir la terre d’est en ouest, comme le montreront les versets suivants.

renderings.arabic: فَأَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا

english.text: He pursued a course[42],
english.footnotes: [42] Utilizing these means.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il emprunta donc une voie

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِي عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةٖ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوۡمٗاۖ قُلۡنَا يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمۡ حُسۡنٗا

english.text: until when he reached the far west, he found the sun setting in a dark body of water, and he found some people nearby. We said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, either punish them or treat them with kindness.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui le conduisit jusqu’au Couchant[22] où il lui sembla que le soleil se couchait dans une source boueuse[23] et où il trouva un peuple. Nous lui dîmes : « Dhou Al-Qarnayn ! Tu as le choix entre châtier ces gens ou te montrer à leur égard indulgent. »
french.footnotes:
[22] Jusqu’aux limites occidentales de la terre, précisent certains exégètes.
[23] Ou : bouillante.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا

english.text: He said, “As for one who does wrong[43], we will punish him, then he will be brought back to his Lord, and He will punish him grievously.
english.footnotes: [43] By persisting in disbelief and associating partners with Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Quiconque, parmi eux, persistera dans l’impiété sera châtié avant d’être ramené à son Seigneur qui lui infligera d’affreux tourments.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرٗا

english.text: But he who believes and does righteous deeds, he will have the best reward[44], and we will enjoin upon him to do what is easy.”
english.footnotes: [44] i.e., Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à celui qui croit et accomplit de bonnes œuvres, Nous lui accorderons la plus belle récompense et lui adresserons des mots bienveillants[24]. »
french.footnotes: [24] Ou : des ordres faciles à exécuter.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا

english.text: Then he pursued another course,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il suivit ensuite une autre voie

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتۡرٗا

english.text: until when he reached the far east, he found the sun rising on a people for whom We provided no shelter from it[45].
english.footnotes: [45] They had nothing to shade them from the sun; trees, mountains, or buildings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui lui permit d’atteindre le Levant[25] où il vit le soleil se lever sur un peuple que Nous avions laissé sans protection contre sa chaleur.
french.footnotes: [25] Les limites orientales de la terre, précisent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَقَدۡ أَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرٗا

english.text: So it was, and We had full knowledge about him[46].
english.footnotes: [46] i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en fut ainsi. Nous connaissions parfaitement tous les moyens à sa disposition.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا

english.text: Then he pursued another course,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il emprunta encore une autre voie,

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ ٱلسَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوۡمٗا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ قَوۡلٗا

english.text: until when he reached [a valley] between the two mountains, he found beyond them a people who could barely understand a word[47].
english.footnotes: [47] They could not speak except their own language.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: jusqu’à atteindre un défilé situé entre deux montagnes au-delà[26] desquelles il trouva un peuple comprenant difficilement le langage des autres nations.
french.footnotes: [26] Ou : en-deçà.

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِنَّ يَأۡجُوجَ وَمَأۡجُوجَ مُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدّٗا

english.text: They said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in the land. Can we give you some payment in return for you to construct a barrier between us and them?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ces gens lui demandèrent : « Dhou Al-Qarnayn ! Gog et Magog répandent le mal sur terre. Es-tu disposé à dresser entre ces gens et nous un barrage contre salaire ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيۡرٞ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًا

english.text: He said, “What my Lord has given me is better. But help me with manpower, I will construct a barricade between you and them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « L’autorité et les richesses que mon Seigneur m’a conférées valent bien mieux que votre argent. Aidez-moi seulement de vos mains à dresser ce barrage entre vous et ces gens.

renderings.arabic: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ ٱلۡحَدِيدِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيۡنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُواْۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارٗا قَالَ ءَاتُونِيٓ أُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرٗا

english.text: Bring me iron blocks” – until when he leveled between the two mountainsides, he said, “Blow [with bellows],” until when he fired them up to extreme heat, he said, “Bring me molten copper to pour over it.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Apportez-moi des blocs de fer. » Lorsque l’espace compris entre les deux montagnes fut comblé, il ordonna : « Allumez un feu et attisez-le ! » Quand le fer fut porté à incandescence, il dit : « Apportez-moi du cuivre fondu que je puisse verser par-dessus. »

renderings.arabic: فَمَا ٱسۡطَٰعُوٓاْ أَن يَظۡهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ لَهُۥ نَقۡبٗا

english.text: Thus they could not climb over it nor could they pierce it[48].
english.footnotes: [48] They could not climb the dam for its smooth surface as well as it was as high as the mountains, and could not pierce it for its fortitude.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gog et Magog ne purent donc franchir le barrage, et encore moins y pratiquer une brèche.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّيۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَۖ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي حَقّٗا

english.text: He said, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass[49], He will raze it to the ground. The promise of my Lord is ever true.”
english.footnotes: [49] Before the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dhou Al-Qarnayn affirma : « Ce barrage est une grâce de mon Seigneur. Mais le jour où s’accomplira Sa promesse, il sera, par Sa volonté, entièrement rasé. La promesse de Mon Seigneur se réalisera inéluctablement. »

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعۡضٖۖ وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعۡنَٰهُمۡ جَمۡعٗا

english.text: On that Day[50] We will let some of them surge like waves over others, and the Trumpet will be blown, then We will gather them all together.
english.footnotes: [50] When the dam is destroyed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce jour-là, Nous les laisserons déferler les uns sur les autres. Il sera ensuite soufflé dans la Corne et tous les hommes seront, sur Notre ordre, rassemblés.

renderings.arabic: وَعَرَضۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَرۡضًا

english.text: On that Day We will show Hell to the disbelievers clearly[51],
english.footnotes: [51] Before they enter it on the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, Nous ferons clairement apparaître la Géhenne aux mécréants

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتۡ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِي غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكۡرِي وَكَانُواْ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَمۡعًا

english.text: those whose eyes were blind to My signs[52] and they were unable to hear [the truth][53].
english.footnotes: [52] Or of the Qur’an. [53] To believe in it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui étaient aveugles à Nos signes et incapables d’entendre Nos avertissements.

renderings.arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِي مِن دُونِيٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۚ إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلٗا

english.text: Do the disbelievers think that they can take My slaves as allies instead of Me? We have prepared Hell as a dwelling place for the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui ont rejeté la foi pensent-ils pouvoir prendre Mes créatures pour maîtres en dehors de Moi ? Nous avons, en vérité, préparé pour les impies la Géhenne qui sera leur demeure éternelle.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ أَعۡمَٰلًا

english.text: Say, “Shall we inform you of the greatest losers in terms of their deeds?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Voulez-vous connaître les hommes dont les œuvres sont les plus vaines ?

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا

english.text: Those whose efforts in the life of this world are wasted, while they think that they are doing well[54].”
english.footnotes: [54] For they follow other than their Lord’s path, and justify their deviant actions until they finally believe that they are on the right path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce sont ceux qui croient bien agir ici-bas alors qu’en réalité ils œuvrent en pure perte. »

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَزۡنٗا

english.text: It is those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and their meeting with Him; their deeds will be nullified, and We will give no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection[55].
english.footnotes: [55] It shows the ghastly fate of the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà ceux qui, pour avoir renié les signes de leur Seigneur et Sa rencontre, ont perdu le bénéfice de leurs œuvres. Nous ne leur accorderons donc aucune valeur[27] le Jour de la résurrection.
french.footnotes: [27] Littéralement : aucun poids. Certains commentateurs expliquent donc ce verset ainsi : leurs œuvres n’auront aucun poids dans la Balance.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُواْ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا

english.text: That is their recompense: Hell, because of their disbelief and taking My verses and messengers in ridicule.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà ceux qui sont voués à la Géhenne pour avoir rejeté la foi et tourné Mes signes et Mes Messagers en dérision.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًا

english.text: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have gardens of Paradise[56] as a dwelling place[57],
english.footnotes:
[56] i.e., al-Firdaus: the highest level of Paradise.
 [57] It shows the regal fate of the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui auront cru et accompli de bonnes œuvres seront, quant à eux, reçus dans les plus hauts degrés du Paradis

renderings.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبۡغُونَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلٗا

english.text: abiding therein forever, never desiring to leave.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où ils séjourneront pour l’éternité, sans jamais désirer le quitter.

renderings.arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادٗا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّي وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدٗا

english.text: Say, “If the ocean were ink for [writing] the Words of my Lord, the ocean would surely run dry before the Words of my Lord[58] are finished, even if We brought its like to resupply it.”
english.footnotes: [58] i.e., His unlimited Knowledge, or words describing His Attributes and His Grandeur.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Si l’eau de la mer était une encre servant à transcrire les paroles de mon Seigneur, celle-ci se viderait avant que ne s’épuisent les paroles de mon Seigneur, même si Nous devions y ajouter d’autres mers encore. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدَۢا

english.text: Say, “I am only a man like you; it has been revealed to me that your God is One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous deeds and associate none in the worship of his Lord.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Je ne suis qu’un homme comme vous auquel il est révélé que votre Dieu est un dieu unique. Que celui donc qui espère rencontrer son Seigneur accomplisse de bonnes œuvres et n’associe nulle divinité au culte de son Seigneur. »

renderings.arabic: كٓهيعٓصٓ

english.text: Kāf Ha Ya ‘Ayyn Sād[1]
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Kâf-Hâ-Yâ-‘Âyn-Sâd.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ

english.text: This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous allons te relater comment ton Seigneur, par un effet de Sa miséricorde, a exaucé la prière que Son serviteur Zacharie

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيّٗا

english.text: When he called upon his Lord in private.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lui avait adressée secrètement.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبٗا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّٗا

english.text: He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head,[2] yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord.
english.footnotes: [2] Lit., "ignited." The spread of white hair across the head is likened to igniting of fire in the bush.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Zacharie dit : « Seigneur ! Mes os sont devenus fragiles et mes cheveux tout blancs. Jamais, Seigneur, je n’ai été déçu en T’implorant.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنِّي خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَٰلِيَ مِن وَرَآءِي وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٗا فَهَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّٗا

english.text: And I fear my kinsmen after me,[3] and my wife is barren; so grant me from Yourself an heir,
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., my successors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je redoute, après ma disparition, l’attitude de mes proches parents. Or, ma femme est stérile. Accorde-moi donc, par un effet de Ta grâce, un descendant

renderings.arabic: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيّٗا

english.text: who will inherit [prophethood] from me and from the house of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, well pleasing to You.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui hérite[2] de moi et de la famille de Jacob et qui Te soit, Seigneur, obéissant. »
french.footnotes: [2] La mission prophétique.

renderings.arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسۡمُهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ سَمِيّٗا

english.text: [Allah said], “O Zachariah, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be John – a name that We have not given to anyone before.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Zacharie ! Nous t’annonçons la naissance d’un fils qui sera appelé Jean. Nul jusqu’ici n’a porté ce nom que Nous avons choisi pour cet enfant. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٗا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيّٗا

english.text: He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have reached an extremely old age?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Zacharie dit : « Comment, Seigneur, aurais-je un fils alors que mon épouse est stérile et que je suis moi-même un vieillard usé par les ans. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞ وَقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـٔٗا

english.text: [The angel] said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; I did create you before when you were nothing.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Il en sera ainsi. Ton Seigneur a dit : “Cela M’est facile”. Ne t’ai-Je pas toi-même auparavant tiré du néant ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةٗۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٖ سَوِيّٗا

english.text: Zachariah said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three nights,[4] despite being sound.”
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., without being ill.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Zacharie dit : « Seigneur ! Donne-moi un signe. » Le Seigneur dit : « Ce signe est que tu ne pourras t’adresser aux gens trois jours durant, tout en étant bien portant. »

renderings.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةٗ وَعَشِيّٗا

english.text: Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify Allah morning and evening.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il quitta alors son oratoire[3] et fit signe à son peuple de célébrer la gloire du Seigneur matin et soir.
french.footnotes: [3] Probablement le sanctuaire du Temple de Jérusalem.

renderings.arabic: يَٰيَحۡيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٖۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيّٗا

english.text: [Allah said], “O John, hold the Scripture with all your strength.” And We gave him wisdom when he was still a child,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Jean[4] ! Conforme-toi scrupuleusement aux Ecritures. » Nous l’avons doté d’une grande sagesse dès son plus jeune âge.
french.footnotes: [4] Il est sous-entendu que l’enfant promis, Jean le Baptiste, est né et a grandi.

renderings.arabic: وَحَنَانٗا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةٗۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيّٗا

english.text: as We made him compassionate and righteous, and he was fearing Allah,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et il fut, par Notre grâce, plein de tendresse et de vertu. Animé par la crainte de son Seigneur,

renderings.arabic: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيّٗا

english.text: and dutiful to his parents, and he was not an oppressor or disobedient.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: il fut un fils pieux envers ses père et mère, obéissant envers son Seigneur, humble à l’égard des hommes.

renderings.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيّٗا

english.text: Peace be on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up to life again!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que la paix soit avec lui le jour de sa naissance, le jour de sa mort et le Jour où il sera rendu à la vie.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ أَهۡلِهَا مَكَانٗا شَرۡقِيّٗا

english.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place towards the east.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne dans le Livre l’histoire de Marie qui s’éloigna un jour de sa famille en direction de l’est

renderings.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتۡ مِن دُونِهِمۡ حِجَابٗا فَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرٗا سَوِيّٗا

english.text: She screened herself from them, then We sent to her Our Spirit [Gabriel] and he appeared before her in the form of a perfect human being.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où elle se déroba aux regards. Nous lui envoyâmes alors Notre Esprit[5] qui se présenta à elle sous la forme d’un homme accompli.
french.footnotes: [5] L’ange Gabriel.

renderings.arabic: قَالَتۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيّٗا

english.text: She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you; [do not approach me] if you fear Allah.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Marie dit : « J’implore contre toi la protection du Tout Miséricordieux. Ne m’approche donc pas, si tu crains Allah. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمٗا زَكِيّٗا

english.text: He said, “I am only a messenger from your Lord to grant you a righteous son.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Je suis seulement envoyé par ton Seigneur pour te faire don d’un garçon vertueux. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَتۡ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرٞ وَلَمۡ أَكُ بَغِيّٗا

english.text: She said, “How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Elle s’étonna : « Comment aurais-je un garçon, moi que nul homme n’a touchée et qui ne suis pas une débauchée ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٞۖ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرٗا مَّقۡضِيّٗا

english.text: He said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; We make him a sign for people and a mercy from Us. This matter has already been decreed.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Il en sera ainsi. Ton Seigneur a dit : “Cela M’est facile”. Nous ferons de lui un signe et une bénédiction pour les hommes. L’arrêt en est déjà prononcé. »

renderings.arabic: ۞ فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتۡ بِهِۦ مَكَانٗا قَصِيّٗا

english.text: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.[5]
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., Bethlehem, around 6 miles (10 km) to the south of Jerusalem.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Enceinte de l’enfant[6], elle alla se retirer loin des siens.
french.footnotes: [6] L’ange Gabriel, dit-on, souffla dans le col de l’habit qu’elle portait. Le souffle descendit alors à travers le vêtement jusqu’à atteindre sa matrice. Par la volonté d’Allah, elle tomba enceinte de Jésus.

renderings.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ قَالَتۡ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسۡيٗا مَّنسِيّٗا

english.text: The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, would that I had died before this and had been completely forgotten!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les douleurs de l’accouchement l’obligèrent à s’adosser au tronc d’un palmier. Elle s’exclama : « Que je fusse morte avant ce jour et totalement oubliée ! »

renderings.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيّٗا

english.text: Then he[6] called her from beneath her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided a stream beneath you.
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., the archangel Gabriel or the baby.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Une voix[7] s’éleva alors vers elle : « Ne sois pas triste. Par la grâce de ton Seigneur, un ruisselet se trouve à tes pieds.
french.footnotes: [7] Celle de l’enfant Jésus, selon certains exégètes, ou de Gabriel, selon d’autres.

renderings.arabic: وَهُزِّيٓ إِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ تُسَٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبٗا جَنِيّٗا

english.text: Shake the trunk of the palm tree towards yourself; fresh ripe dates will drop upon you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tire vers toi le tronc du palmier qui laissera tomber sur toi des dattes fraîches.

renderings.arabic: فَكُلِي وَٱشۡرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيۡنٗاۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡبَشَرِ أَحَدٗا فَقُولِيٓ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ صَوۡمٗا فَلَنۡ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِنسِيّٗا

english.text: Eat and drink, and be glad. And if you see any human being, say, ‘I have vowed silence[7] to the Most Compassionate, so I will not talk to any human being today.’”
english.footnotes: [7] Sawm: literally means to abstain or fast from food, speech, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mange donc, bois et réjouis-toi. Et si tu dois rencontrer quelqu’un, dis-lui que tu as fait vœu de silence au Tout Miséricordieux et que tu n’adresseras donc aujourd’hui la parole à personne[8]. »
french.footnotes: [8] Après cela. Autre traduction : si tu rencontres quelqu’un, fais-lui comprendre par un signe que, ayant fait vœu de silence au Tout Miséricordieux, tu n’adresseras aujourd’hui la parole à personne.

renderings.arabic: فَأَتَتۡ بِهِۦ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـٔٗا فَرِيّٗا

english.text: Then she came to her people carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something monstrous!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Portant l’enfant, elle retourna auprès des siens qui, la voyant arriver, dirent : « Marie ! Tu as commis une infamie !

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأُخۡتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمۡرَأَ سَوۡءٖ وَمَا كَانَتۡ أُمُّكِ بَغِيّٗا

english.text: O sister of Aaron,[8] your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”
english.footnotes: [8] Aaron was a pious man at the time of Mary, or she was from the descendants of Aaron, Moses’ brother.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sœur d’Aaron ! Ton père n’était pas un débauché, ni ta mère une femme de mauvaise vie. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَشَارَتۡ إِلَيۡهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيّٗا

english.text: Thereupon she pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk to someone who is still a baby in the cradle?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Marie leur fit alors signe de s’adresser à l’enfant. « Comment, s’étonnèrent-ils, pourrions-nous parler à un enfant au berceau ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيّٗا

english.text: Jesus said, “I am a slave of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais celui-ci prit la parole : « Je suis le serviteur d’Allah qui m’a confié l’Ecriture et a fait de moi un prophète.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوۡصَٰنِي بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيّٗا

english.text: He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I am alive,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a fait de moi une bénédiction pour les hommes où que je sois et m’a prescrit la prière et la charité tant que je serai en vie.

renderings.arabic: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارٗا شَقِيّٗا

english.text: and has made me dutiful to my mother, and has not made me an oppressor or disobedient.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a fait de moi un fils pieux envers sa mère, obéissant envers son Seigneur, humble à l’égard des hommes.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوۡمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ أُبۡعَثُ حَيّٗا

english.text: Peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die and the day I will be resurrected.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que la paix soit avec moi le jour de ma naissance, le jour de ma mort et le Jour où je serai rendu à la vie. »

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ

english.text: Such was Jesus, son of Mary – a word of truth about which they are in doubt.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Telle est la vérité au sujet de Jésus fils de Marie dont ils doutent pourtant.

renderings.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٖۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

english.text: It is not befitting for Allah to beget a son. Glory be to Him[9]! When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., far exalted is He above any such need.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il ne sied pas à Allah de se donner un fils. Gloire à Lui ! Il Lui suffit, lorsqu’Il décrète une chose, de dire : « Sois ! » et celle-ci s’accomplit.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

english.text: [Jesus said], “Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jésus ajouta : « Allah, en vérité, est mon Seigneur et le vôtre auquel vous devez un culte exclusif et sincère. Telle est la voie du salut. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english.text: But the factions differed among themselves[10] [about him]. So woe to the disbelievers from the scene of a momentous Day!
english.footnotes: [10] Some believed that Jesus was God or the son of God, whereas those who truly followed him considered him only as Allah's messenger.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais bientôt les sectes[9] se divisèrent à son sujet. Malheur donc aux mécréants qui auront à affronter le châtiment d’un jour terrible.
french.footnotes: [9] Chrétiennes, précisent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: How sharp they will hear and see on the Day they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly misguided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comme ils entendront distinctement et verront clairement le Jour où ils viendront à Nous. Mais les injustes, manifestement égarés, sont aujourd’hui sourds et aveugles à la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَسۡرَةِ إِذۡ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ وَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Warn them of the Day of Remorse when all matters will be decided, but they are heedless and they do not believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Avertis les hommes du Jour de tous les regrets, Jour où Notre arrêt sera prononcé mais que, dans leur insouciance, ils préfèrent aujourd’hui renier.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: It is We Who will inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they will be returned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui hériterons de la terre et de ceux qui la peuplent, c’est à Nous qu’ils seront tous ramenés.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيًّا

english.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. He was indeed a man of truth and a prophet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne dans le Livre l’histoire d’Abraham, un croyant sincère et un prophète.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنكَ شَيۡـٔٗا

english.text: When he said to his father, “O my dear father, why do you worship something that neither hears nor sees nor benefits you in any way?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dit un jour à son père : « Père ! Pourquoi adores-tu des idoles incapables d’entendre et de voir, et qui ne te sont d’aucune utilité ?

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدۡ جَآءَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعۡنِيٓ أَهۡدِكَ صِرَٰطٗا سَوِيّٗا

english.text: O my dear father, there has come to me some knowledge that has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to a straight path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Père ! Une science que tu n’as pas reçue m’a été révélée. Suis donc ma voie, je t’indiquerai le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَصِيّٗا

english.text: O my dear father, do not worship Satan. Indeed, Satan is rebellious against the Most Compassionate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Père ! N’adore pas les idoles par obéissance à Satan qui s’est révolté contre le Tout Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٞ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيّٗا
