english.text: O my dear father, I truly fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate may afflict you and that you may become a companion of Satan [in Hell].”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Père ! Je crains fort que tu ne sois châtié par le Tout Miséricordieux et ne subisses en Enfer le sort de Satan. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيّٗا

english.text: He said, “Are you turning away from my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Keep away from me for a long time!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Son père répliqua : « Te détournerais-tu, Abraham, de mes divinités ? Si tu ne cesses pas de les dénigrer, je te ferai lapider. Eloigne-toi de moi pour longtemps. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيّٗا

english.text: Abraham said, “Peace be on you[11]. I will seek my Lord’s forgiveness for you. Indeed, He is Most Gracious to me.
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., You are secure from me, so I will not harm you in the least.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Abraham dit : « Que la paix soit avec toi ! J’implorerai pour toi le pardon de mon Seigneur qui s’est toujours montré d’une grande bonté envers moi.

renderings.arabic: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيّٗا

english.text: I will distance myself from you and from all that you supplicate besides Allah, and I will supplicate my Lord; perhaps my supplication to my Lord will not go unanswered.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je me sépare de vous et des idoles que vous adorez en dehors d’Allah et j’implore les faveurs de mon Seigneur, en espérant ne pas être déçu en L’invoquant. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيّٗا

english.text: When he distanced himself from them and what they worshiped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made each one of them a prophet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’il se fut séparé de son peuple et des idoles que ce dernier vénérait en dehors d’Allah, Nous lui avons fait don d’Isaac et de Jacob que Nous avons tous deux élevés au rang de prophètes.

renderings.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيّٗا

english.text: We bestowed upon them of Our mercy and blessed them with a highly-esteemed reputation[12].
english.footnotes: [12] As part of the prayer, Muslims invoke Allah’s blessings upon Muhammad (ﷺ) and his family and Abraham (ﷺ) and his family, on a daily basis.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons comblé de Nos faveurs chacun d’entre eux dont les vertus, par Notre grâce, sont passées à la postérité[10].
french.footnotes: [10] Puisque juifs, chrétiens et musulmans célèbrent leurs mérites jusqu’à ce jour.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصٗا وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا

english.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Moses. He was indeed a chosen one and was a messenger and a prophet[13].
english.footnotes: [13] A messenger (rasūl) is one who was sent by Allah to reform society with a new law, such as Moses, Jesus, Muhammad, etc. A prophet (nabī) is one who is charged by Allah to reform society following the law of the messenger before him, such as Jacob, Isaac, Solomon, etc. Prophets are more numerous than messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne, dans le Livre, Moïse qui fut Notre serviteur dévoué et que Nous avons élu en faisant de lui un prophète et un Messager.

renderings.arabic: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيّٗا

english.text: We called him from the right side of Mount Tūr [in Sinai] and We brought him near by conversing with him in private.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons appelé du versant du mont Sinaï qui se trouvait sur sa droite, lui ordonnant de s’approcher, et lui avons adressé la parole.

renderings.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيّٗا

english.text: And We granted him, by Our mercy, his brother Aaron, as a prophet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par un effet de Notre grâce, Nous l’avons assisté de son frère Aaron que Nous avons également élevé au rang de prophète.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا

english.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Ishmael. He was true to his promise and was a messenger and a prophet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne dans le Livre Ismaël qui se montrait toujours fidèle à ses engagements et fut un prophète et un Messager.

renderings.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيّٗا

english.text: He used to command his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il exhortait les siens à accomplir la prière et à faire la charité, et était en grâce auprès de son Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيّٗا

english.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Idrīs[14]. He was a man of truth and a prophet.
english.footnotes: [14] i.e., Prophet Enoch (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne dans le Livre Idriss[11], un croyant sincère et un prophète
french.footnotes: [11] Qui pourrait être l’Enoch de la Bible.

renderings.arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

english.text: And We raised him to a high status[15].
english.footnotes: [15] Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) met Prophet Idrīs (ﷺ) in the fourth heaven.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que Nous avons élevé à un haut rang[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Les termes employés peuvent également signifier qu’il fut élevé au Ciel, comme le relate la Bible (Genèse 5, 24).

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحٖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدٗاۤ وَبُكِيّٗا۩

english.text: These are the prophets whom Allah has favored from among the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We carried with Noah [in the Ark], and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and from those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the verses of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici ceux qu’Allah a comblés de Ses faveurs parmi les prophètes de la descendance d’Adam, de la postérité des hommes que Nous avons transportés dans l’Arche avec Noé, de la descendance d’Abraham et d’Israël, et parmi tous les prophètes que Nous avons élus et guidés. Lorsque les versets du Tout Miséricordieux leur étaient récités, ils se jetaient face contre terre et éclataient en sanglots.

renderings.arabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا

english.text: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and pursued their desires; so they will meet their doom[16],
english.footnotes: [16] i.e., a valley in Hell or the consequence of their evil deeds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais leur succédèrent des générations toutes plus misérables les unes que les autres qui, préoccupées uniquement par l’assouvissement de leurs passions, négligèrent le culte du Seigneur. Elles sont donc vouées à la perdition.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا

english.text: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds – it is they who will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in the least.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’exception de ceux qui se sont repentis, ont cru en leur Seigneur et ont accompli de bonnes œuvres, qui entreront au Paradis où ils ne seront en rien lésés.

renderings.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيّٗا

english.text: Gardens of Eternity which the Most Compassionate has promised His slaves who have not seen them. His promise will surely be fulfilled.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils seront, au contraire, admis dans les jardins d’Eden que le Tout Miséricordieux a promis de toute éternité à Ses adorateurs. Sa promesse s’accomplira de façon inéluctable.

renderings.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةٗ وَعَشِيّٗا

english.text: They will not hear therein any idle talk, except greetings of peace, and they will have their provision morning and evening[17].
english.footnotes: [17] Whenever they wish in a successive manner, not that there will be days and nights, rather they will know the elapse of time through lights and illuminations.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils n’y entendront aucune futilité, mais seulement les mots les plus agréables : « La paix soit avec vous », et y recevront matin et soir les nourritures les plus désirables.

renderings.arabic: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيّٗا

english.text: Such is the Paradise which We will give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who feared Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tel est le Paradis dont Nous ferons hériter ceux de Nos serviteurs qui étaient habités par Notre crainte.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيّٗا

english.text: [Gabriel said][18], “We do not descend except with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is never forgetful.
english.footnotes: [18] In reply to the Prophet’s wish that Gabriel would visit him more frequently.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Nous ne descendons que sur ordre de ton Seigneur qui est le Maître de notre avenir, de notre passé et de notre présent[13], et qui n’oublie jamais rien », disent les anges.
french.footnotes: [13] Ou : de l’au-delà, de ce bas monde et du monde intermédiaire.

renderings.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّٗا

english.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux. Attache-toi donc patiemment à Son culte. Connais-tu quelqu’un qui Lui soit semblable ou qui porte son Nom ?

renderings.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا

english.text: Man says, “Once I am dead, will I be raised to life again?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme s’étonne : « Me fera-t-on, une fois mort, sortir de ma tombe vivant ? »

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـٔٗا

english.text: Does man not remember that We created him beforehand when he was nothing?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme ne se souvient-il pas que Nous l’avons, avant cela, tiré du néant ?

renderings.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيّٗا

english.text: By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them all around Hell on their knees[19].
english.footnotes: [19] i.e., out of terror they will be on their knees or dragged unwillingly while on their knees.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ton Seigneur ! Nous rassemblerons ceux qui renient la Résurrection, accompagnés de leurs démons, puis les conduirons autour de la Géhenne où ils se tiendront à genoux.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيّٗا

english.text: Then We will surely drag out of every group those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous arracherons alors de chaque groupe ceux qui furent les plus rebelles au Tout Miséricordieux[14].
french.footnotes: [14] Qui seront châtiés en premier, expliquent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيّٗا

english.text: For indeed We know best those who are most deserving to burn therein.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous savons parfaitement qui mérite le plus de brûler dans le feu de l’Enfer.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمٗا مَّقۡضِيّٗا

english.text: There is none among you except that he will pass over it[20]; a decree from your Lord that must be fulfilled.
english.footnotes: [20] Referring to the bridge of As-Sirāt, which is placed over Hell. Everyone will pass on it. The believers will cross it easily, each according to their faith, whereas the disbelievers and the hypocrites will fall into the Fire from the bridge.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’est pas un seul d’entre vous qui ne doive l’affronter, conformément au décret irrévocable de ton Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيّٗا

english.text: Then We will save those who fear Allah and will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous sauverons alors ceux qui auront craint le Seigneur et y abandonnerons les impies à genoux[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Selon certains exégètes, le pronom « vous » au verset précédent désigne uniquement les impies qui entreront tous en Enfer, tandis que les croyants seront sauvés. Selon d’autres, ces paroles s’adressent également aux croyants qui, soit entreront en Enfer momentanément, mais sans en subir les affres, soit s’en approcheront seulement sans y entrer, soit traverseront le Pont qui enjambe l’Enfer, mais sans y tomber, contrairement aux mécréants.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرٞ مَّقَامٗا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيّٗا

english.text: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two parties is better in terms of dwellings and superior in social gatherings?”[21]
english.footnotes: [21] In regard to the life of this world.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Nos versets, parfaitement clairs, leur sont récités, les mécréants disent aux croyants : « Qui, de vous ou de nous, jouit de la situation la plus avantageuse et dispose des plus nombreux partisans ? »

renderings.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثٗا وَرِءۡيٗا

english.text: How many generations We have destroyed before them who were superior in terms of wealth and outward appearance!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de peuples avons-Nous anéantis avant eux, autrement plus opulents et d’un faste plus éclatant.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندٗا

english.text: Say, “Whoever is following misguidance, the Most Compassionate will give him respite, until they see what they were warned of – be it the punishment [in this world] or the Hour – only then will they realize who is in a worse abode and who has a smaller following.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Le Tout Miséricordieux laissera s’enfoncer dans l’impiété ceux qui sont égarés, jusqu’à ce qu’ils voient de leurs propres yeux ce dont ils sont menacés : le châtiment ou l’avènement de l’Heure. Ils sauront alors qui occupe la position la moins enviable et dispose des soutiens les plus fragiles. »

renderings.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدٗىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٞ مَّرَدًّا

english.text: Allah increases in guidance those who are guided, and the righteous deeds of lasting merit are better with your Lord in reward and better in return.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’inverse, Allah raffermira la foi de ceux qui suivent le droit chemin, dont les bonnes œuvres trouveront à jamais auprès de ton Seigneur la récompense la plus généreuse et auront les conséquences les plus heureuses.

renderings.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالٗا وَوَلَدًا

english.text: Have you seen the one[22] who rejects Our verses and says, “I will surely be given wealth and children [if I am resurrected]?”
english.footnotes: [22] Al-‘Ās ibn Wāi’l, a staunch enemy of Islam in Makkah, not only disbelieved in resurrection; rather, he expected that he would be given wealth and children if resurrected.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: As-tu vu celui qui, après avoir renié Nos signes, prétend : « Si je devais être ressuscité, il me sera certainement accordé richesses et enfants » ?

renderings.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا

english.text: Has he obtained knowledge of the unseen, or has he taken a pledge with the Most Compassionate?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Est-il capable de lire l’avenir ou alors en aurait-il reçu l’engagement du Tout Miséricordieux ?

renderings.arabic: كَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدّٗا

english.text: Never! We will write down what he says and will prolong his punishment extensively.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sûrement pas ! Nous consignerons chacune de ses paroles et accroîtrons ses tourments.

renderings.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدٗا

english.text: We will inherit what he boasts of[23], and he will come to Us all alone.
english.footnotes: [23] He is falsely aspiring for wealth and children in the Hereafter, not only Allah will not give him anything in the Hereafter; rather, He will seize what he owned in the worldly life at the time of his death.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous, au contraire, qui hériterons de ses richesses et de ses enfants, si bien qu’il viendra à Nous, seul et sans le sou.

renderings.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزّٗا

english.text: They have taken gods other than Allah, in order that they may protect them [from punishment].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les païens vouent un culte à d’autres divinités qu’Allah dans l’espoir de bénéficier de leur soutien.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا

english.text: Never! They will deny their worship and will become their enemies.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pourtant, ils renieront un jour leur adoration et leur déclareront leur animosité[16].
french.footnotes: [16] Autre sens : il n’en sera rien. Ces divinités renieront au contraire leur adoration et leur déclareront leur animosité.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزّٗا

english.text: Do you not see that We sent devils against the disbelievers constantly inciting them to sin?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas que Nous livrons les mécréants aux démons qui ne cessent de les pousser au péché et à la rébellion ?

renderings.arabic: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدّٗا

english.text: So do not be in haste about them; We are surely counting down their days[24].
english.footnotes: [24] i.e., their breaths or evil deeds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne cherche donc pas à précipiter leur châtiment. Nous tenons le compte précis des jours qui leur restent à vivre et de leurs agissements.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدٗا

english.text: The Day when We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as honored guests,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Un jour, sur Notre ordre, les pieux croyants seront rassemblés avec tous les honneurs devant le Tout Miséricordieux,

renderings.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدٗا

english.text: and We will drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tandis que les mécréants, tourmentés par la soif, seront poussés vers la Géhenne.

renderings.arabic: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا

english.text: None will have the power to intercede except those who have taken permission from the Most Compassionate[25].
english.footnotes: [25] Through firmly believing in Him and worshiping Him alone.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ces derniers ne bénéficieront d’aucune intercession[17], contrairement à ceux qui en auront obtenu la promesse du Tout Miséricordieux parmi les croyants.
french.footnotes: [17] Et ne pourront eux-mêmes intercéder en faveur des autres.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗا

english.text: They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten a son.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils prétendent que le Tout Miséricordieux s’est donné un enfant.

renderings.arabic: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدّٗا

english.text: You have made a monstrous statement,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous proférez là, assurément, un odieux blasphème.

renderings.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا

english.text: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Peu s’en faut que les cieux ne s’entrouvrent à ces mots, que la terre ne se fende et que les montagnes ne s’écroulent,

renderings.arabic: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٗا

english.text: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: parce qu’ils ont attribué au Tout Miséricordieux un enfant.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

english.text: It is not appropriate for the Most Compassionate to beget a son.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, il ne sied pas au Tout Miséricordieux de se donner un enfant.

renderings.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدٗا

english.text: There is none in the heavens and earth except that he will come to the Most Compassionate in full submission.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tous les êtres qui peuplent les cieux et la terre se présenteront en toute soumission devant le Tout Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدّٗا

english.text: He has counted them and numbered them precisely.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il les a recensés du premier au dernier, sans qu’un seul ne manque à l’appel.

renderings.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا

english.text: Each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Chacun d’eux, le Jour de la résurrection, se présentera seul devant Lui.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدّٗا

english.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Compassionate will endear them [to His creation][26].
english.footnotes: [26] And He will love them as well.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Tout Miséricordieux accordera Son amour et celui de Ses serviteurs aux croyants qui accomplissent de bonnes œuvres.

renderings.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمٗا لُّدّٗا

english.text: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your language so that you may give thereby glad tidings to the righteous and warn people who are contentious.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous en avons facilité la compréhension en le révélant dans ta langue afin que, par lui, tu annonces l’heureuse nouvelle à ceux qui Nous craignent et que tu avertisses un peuple rebelle.

renderings.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا

english.text: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you sense a single one of them or even hear from them a whisper?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de peuples avons-Nous anéantis avant eux ! En vois-tu un seul survivant, en perçois-tu le moindre murmure ?

renderings.arabic: طه

english.text: Tā Ha[1]
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tâ-Hâ.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ

english.text: We have not sent down the Qur’an to you [O Prophet] to cause you distress,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne t’avons pas révélé le Coran pour t’accabler,

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ

english.text: but as a reminder for those who fear Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais pour inciter ceux qui craignent Allah à méditer.

renderings.arabic: تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى

english.text: A revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est la révélation du Créateur de la terre et des cieux haut placés,

renderings.arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ

english.text: The Most Compassionate rose over the Throne[2].
english.footnotes: [2] See footnote 7:54
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le Tout Miséricordieux, qui s’est élevé sur le Trône en toute majesté.

renderings.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ

english.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, and all that is between them, and all that is beneath the soil.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il possède tout ce qui se trouve dans les cieux, sur la terre et entre eux, ainsi que ce qui se trouve sous terre.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى

english.text: Whether you speak loudly [or not], He surely knows what is secret and what is even more hidden.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que tu élèves la voix ou non, sache qu’Il connaît les secrets les mieux gardés et les pensées les plus intimes.

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ

english.text: Allah – none has the right to be worshiped except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le vrai Dieu et la seule divinité digne d’être adorée. Il possède les noms les plus sublimes.

renderings.arabic: وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

english.text: Has there come to you the story of Moses?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’histoire de Moïse t’est-elle parvenue[2] ?
french.footnotes: [2] Moïse qui, en provenance de Madian, se dirigeait vers l’Egypte qu’il avait dû quitter dix années auparavant après avoir tué involontairement un Egyptien.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارٗا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدٗى

english.text: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay here. I have spotted a fire; I may bring you a flaming brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire[3].”
english.footnotes: [3] They lost their way in the dark while traveling from Midian to Egypt.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ayant vu un feu au loin, il dit aux siens : « Restez ici ! J’ai aperçu un feu. En espérant que je pourrai vous en rapporter un tison pour vous réchauffer ou trouver quelqu’un en mesure de nous orienter[3]. »
french.footnotes: [3] Il s’était en effet égaré.

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ

english.text: When he came to it, he was called, “O Moses,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’étant approché du feu, il fut interpelé : « Moïse !

renderings.arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى

english.text: Indeed, I am your Lord, so take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je suis ton Seigneur. Retire tes sandales, car tu te trouves dans la vallée sainte de Touwâ.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ

english.text: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed:
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sache que Je t’ai élu. Ecoute donc attentivement ce qui va t’être révélé.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ

english.text: ‘Indeed, I am Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer to remember Me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je suis Allah. Il n’est de divinité en droit d’être adorée que Moi. Veille à me vouer un culte exclusif et sincère et à accomplir la prière afin d’y mentionner Mon nom et de te souvenir de Moi.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ

english.text: The Hour is certainly coming, but I almost keep it hidden[4], so that every soul will be recompensed for what it strives.
english.footnotes: [4] Allah keeps its knowledge hidden from all except its portents which the believers know through the information provided by the Prophet (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’Heure, que J’ai failli dissimuler aux hommes[4], sonnera inéluctablement afin que chaque être soit rétribué selon ses œuvres.
french.footnotes: [4] Mais dont Je les ai informés afin qu’ils s’y préparent, sans toutefois leur préciser le jour de son avènement que Je tiens soigneusement secret.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ

english.text: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it[5], or you will perish.’”
english.footnotes: [5] Or from preparation for the Hour.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que ceux qui ne croient pas en son avènement, préférant suivre leurs penchants, ne t’en détournent surtout pas, car tu serais alors perdu.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: What is that in your right hand, O Moses?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que tiens-tu dans la main droite, Moïse ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ

english.text: He said, “It is my staff. I lean on it and beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and I have other uses for it.”[6]
english.footnotes: [6] Moses could only say, “A staff.” But he instead gave details about the staff, for he was interested in prolonging the conversation with Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « C’est mon bâton, répondit-il, sur lequel je m’appuie et avec lequel je secoue les arbres pour en faire tomber les feuilles dont se nourrissent mes moutons. Et j’en fais d’autres usages encore. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur ordonna : « Jette-le, Moïse. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ

english.text: He threw it down, and it suddenly became a slithering snake.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse jeta donc le bâton qui se transforma aussitôt en un serpent se déplaçant rapidement.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

english.text: Allah said, “Pick it up and have no fear. We will restore it to its former state.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Reprends-le sans crainte. Nous allons lui rendre sa forme initiale.

renderings.arabic: وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ

english.text: Put your hand under your armpit; it will come out shining white without blemish, as another sign[7],
english.footnotes: [7] Moses had dark skin, so putting his hand under his armpit and then taking it out shining white without blemish or disease was a real miraculous sign.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Place ensuite ta main contre ton flanc[5], elle en ressortira toute blanche, sans que cette couleur soit due à la maladie. Ce sera là un autre miracle.
french.footnotes: [5] Ta main droite sous le bras gauche.

renderings.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى

english.text: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons ainsi voulu te montrer certains de Nos prodiges.

renderings.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

english.text: Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rends-toi auprès de Pharaon dont l’impiété ne connaît plus de limites. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي

english.text: He said, “My Lord, reassure my heart for me,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit : « Veuille, Seigneur, dissiper l’angoisse qui m’oppresse,

renderings.arabic: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي

english.text: and ease my task for me,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: me faciliter l’accomplissement de ma mission,

renderings.arabic: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي

english.text: and loosen the knot from my tongue[8],
english.footnotes: [8] When Moses (ﷺ) was being tested by Pharaoh, he took an amber and put it in his mouth, which hindered his speech when he grew up. So, he asked Allah to help him overcome this hurdle, and Allah answered his prayer.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et me débarrasser de mes difficultés d’élocution,

renderings.arabic: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي

english.text: so that they may understand my speech.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin qu’ils saisissent parfaitement mes paroles.

renderings.arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرٗا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي

english.text: And appoint for me a helper from my family,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Veuille aussi m’accorder un assistant issu de ma famille

renderings.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِي

english.text: Aaron, my brother.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: en la personne de mon frère Aaron,

renderings.arabic: ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي

english.text: Increase my strength through him,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: en faire pour moi un précieux soutien,

renderings.arabic: وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي

english.text: and let him share my task,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: en l’associant à ma mission.

renderings.arabic: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرٗا

english.text: so that we may glorify You much,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous pourrons ainsi sans cesse célébrer Ta gloire

renderings.arabic: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

english.text: and remember You much.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et invoquer assidûment Ton nom.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرٗا

english.text: For indeed You are All-Watchful over us.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu nous connais si bien. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: Allah said, “You are granted your request, O Moses.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Ta prière est exaucée, Moïse.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ

english.text: And We had already conferred favor upon you before,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous t’avons déjà, avant cela, comblé de Nos faveurs,

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ

english.text: when We inspired your mother, saying,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: lorsque Nous avons inspiré ce qui suit à ta mère :

renderings.arabic: أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةٗ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ

english.text: ‘Put him into the casket, then cast it into the river. The river will carry it to the shore, and he will be picked up by one who is an enemy to Me and enemy to him.’ I bestowed upon you love from Myself[9] so that you would be brought up under My [watchful] Eye.
english.footnotes: [9] Allah put his love into the hearts of people, so Pharaoh and his wife accepted to keep him or adopt him as a son when he was still a baby.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: “Place-le[6] dans un coffre que tu laisseras flotter sur les eaux du Nil. Les flots l’entraîneront alors jusqu’à la rive où il sera recueilli par Mon ennemi[7] et le sien”. J’ai alors suscité dans le cœur de Mes serviteurs[8] un vif amour pour toi afin que tu sois élevé sous Mes Yeux.
french.footnotes:
[6] Moïse, encore nourrisson, afin de le sauver des hommes de Pharaon qui, craignant l’avènement d’un Hébreu qui causerait la chute de son royaume, avait ordonné que soit tué tout nouveau-né hébreu de sexe masculin.
[7] Pharaon.
[8] Pharaon et son entourage, notamment.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: When your sister was going along and said, ‘Shall I show you someone who will nurse him?’ Thus We brought you back to your mother, so that she may rejoice and not grieve[10]. Then you killed a man [by mistake][11], but We saved you from distress, and We put you through several trials. You stayed among the people of Midian for several years, then you came [here] at a destined time, O Moses.
english.footnotes:
[10] Because Moses had refused all wet-nurses who were brought to nurse him beforehand.
 [11] The Coptic person died after Moses struck him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ta sœur, qui suivit ta trace, dit[9] : “Puis-je vous indiquer une famille qui saura prendre soin de lui ?” Nous t’avons donc rendu à ta mère qui put ainsi se consoler et se réjouir de ta présence. Tu as ensuite[10] tué un homme, mais Nous avons dissipé ton angoisse. Nous t’avons ainsi soumis à de terribles épreuves. Puis tu as vécu des années durant au milieu du peuple de Madian avant de venir en ce lieu au moment voulu.
french.footnotes:
[9] A l’entourage de Pharaon qui avait recueilli l’enfant et qui était à la recherche d’une nourrice capable de l’allaiter, puisque Moïse refusait systématiquement le sein des nourrices.
[10] Une fois devenu adulte.

renderings.arabic: وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي

english.text: I have chosen you for Myself.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je t’ai élu pour être Mon Messager.

renderings.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي

english.text: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not slacken in remembering Me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allez, toi et ton frère, assistés de Mes signes, sans cesser d’invoquer Mon nom.

renderings.arabic: ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

english.text: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has certainly transgressed all bounds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allez trouver Pharaon dont l’impiété ne connaît plus de limites.

renderings.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ

english.text: But speak to him gently, so that he may take heed or fear Allah.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Adressez-lui des paroles bienveillantes qui l’inciteront peut-être à réfléchir ou à craindre son Seigneur. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ

english.text: They said, “Our Lord, we fear that he may hasten to punish us or transgress all bounds.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse et Aaron dirent : « Nous craignons Seigneur qu’il ne s’empresse de nous châtier ou qu’il nous traite injustement. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

english.text: He said, “Do not be afraid; I am with you both, hearing and seeing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « N’ayez aucune crainte. Je suis avec vous, Je vous entends et vous vois.

renderings.arabic: فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

english.text: So go to him and say, ‘We are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord, and peace[12] be upon he who follows the true guidance.
english.footnotes: [12] i.e., safety from the punishment of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Présentez-vous à lui et dites-lui : “Nous sommes tous deux envoyés par ton Seigneur. Cesse d’oppresser les fils d’Israël, laisse-les partir avec nous. Nous t’apportons des signes de la part de ton Seigneur. Seul sera sauvé celui qui suivra le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

english.text: It has been revealed to us that the punishment awaits those who reject [the truth] and turn away.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il nous est révélé que le châtiment est réservé à ceux qui renient la vérité et se détournent des signes du Seigneur”. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: Pharaoh said, “So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon leur demanda[11] : « Qui donc est votre Seigneur, Moïse ? »
french.footnotes: [11] Lorsqu’ils furent en sa présence.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

english.text: He said, “Our Lord is the One Who gave everything its form and then guided it.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Notre Seigneur est Celui qui a assigné à chaque créature sa propre nature avant de la guider vers ce qu’Il lui a prédestiné[12]. »
french.footnotes: [12] Autre sens : qui a attribué à chaque créature ce dont elle a besoin, tout en lui indiquant comment en tirer avantage.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

english.text: Pharaoh said, “Then what about the former [disbelieving] nations?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon dit : « Qu’en est-il alors des générations passées[13] ? »
french.footnotes: [13] Qui, avant nous, ont renié ton Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى

english.text: He said, “Its knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit : « Leurs œuvres sont consignées dans un livre auprès de mon Seigneur qui n’est sujet ni à l’oubli, ni à l’erreur. »

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّن نَّبَاتٖ شَتَّىٰ

english.text: It is He Who spread out the earth for you and made therein pathways for you, and sent down rain from the sky; and We brought forth thereby various types of plants.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui, pour vous, a fait de la terre une vaste étendue[14] où Il a tracé des routes que vous pouvez aisément emprunter et qui fait descendre du ciel une eau par laquelle Il fait pousser une végétation diverse et variée.
french.footnotes: [14] Parfaitement adaptée à la vie et d’une grande stabilité. Littéralement : une couche.

renderings.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ

english.text: Eat and graze your livestock. Indeed, there are signs in this for people of sound intellect.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Consommez-en une partie et laissez-y paître votre bétail. Voilà des signes suffisamment clairs pour des hommes doués de raison.

renderings.arabic: ۞ مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ

english.text: From this [earth] We created you, and to it We will return you, and from it We will raise you once again.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons créés de cette terre où Nous vous ferons retourner et dont Nous vous ferons sortir une nouvelle fois.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ

english.text: We showed Pharaoh all Our signs, but he rejected them and refused to believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons produit tous les miracles devant Pharaon qui, refusant obstinément la vérité, a préféré les renier.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dit : « Es-tu venu, Moïse, nous chasser de notre pays au moyen de ta magie ?

renderings.arabic: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانٗا سُوٗى

english.text: We will surely bring you similar magic. So appoint a day between us that neither you nor we will fail to keep, in a convenient place[13].”
english.footnotes: [13] i.e., a midway place between us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous allons t’opposer une magie semblable. Fixe-nous, en un lieu qui convienne à chacun de nous, un rendez-vous que ni toi, ni nous, ne devrons manquer. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحٗى

english.text: Moses said, “Your appointment is the festival day[14]; let the people be gathered at forenoon[15].”
english.footnotes:
[14] So that more people could witness the event.
 [15] So that people could see Allah’s signs clearly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse répondit : « Le rendez-vous est fixé le jour des festivités, lorsque la population se sera rassemblée dans la matinée. »

renderings.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ

english.text: So Pharaoh went away and put together his scheme, then came forth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon se retira et, après avoir réuni les magiciens de son pays, se présenta au rendez-vous.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ

english.text: Moses said to them, “Woe to you, do not fabricate lies against Allah[16], lest He exterminate you with a punishment. Those who fabricate lies are bound to fail.”
english.footnotes: [16] By considering Allah’s miracles as magic.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse lança aux magiciens : « Malheur à vous ! Prenez garde de mentir sur Allah qui pourrait alors vous anéantir. Celui qui ose mentir sur Allah est assurément perdu. »

renderings.arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ

english.text: Then they disputed the matter among themselves and kept their talk private.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les magiciens se mirent alors à discuter secrètement de la stratégie à adopter.

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ
