english.text: They said, “These two are merely magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and destroy your exemplary way of life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains dirent : « Voilà deux magiciens qui, au moyen de leur magie, veulent nous chasser de notre pays et se réserver l’exercice de notre art[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Dans lequel nous sommes passés maîtres : la magie.

renderings.arabic: فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفّٗاۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ

english.text: So gather your scheme, then line up in a row. Whoever prevails today is indeed the victor.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Unissons donc nos forces et serrons les rangs, car celui qui prendra le dessus aujourd’hui triomphera. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ

english.text: They said, “O Moses, either you throw or shall we be the first to throw!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis ils dirent : « Moïse ! Veux-tu jeter ton sort en premier ou nous laisser commencer ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ

english.text: He said, “No; you throw first.” Suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him, owing to their magic, as if they were slithering.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Soyez les premiers à jeter. » Ils jetèrent donc leurs cordes et leurs bâtons qui, par l’effet de leur magie, lui donnèrent l’impression de ramper.

renderings.arabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةٗ مُّوسَىٰ

english.text: Then Moses sensed fear within himself.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse en fut, au fond de lui, effrayé.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

english.text: We said, “Do not be afraid; it is you who will prevail.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons alors rassuré : « Ne crains rien. C’est toi qui vas triompher.

renderings.arabic: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرٖۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ

english.text: Throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have contrived. They have only contrived a magic trick, and the magician will never prosper, wherever he goes.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jette ce que tu tiens dans la main droite[16]. Il engloutira tous leurs artifices qui ne sont que des tours de magie. Or, l’entreprise des magiciens, où qu’ils se trouvent, est vouée à l’échec. »
french.footnotes: [16] Ton bâton.

renderings.arabic: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدٗا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

english.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration[17], saying, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
english.footnotes: [17] They realized that the miracles of Moses were not impressions of magic, but absolute realities.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Se jetant face contre terre, les magiciens s’exclamèrent : « Nous croyons au Seigneur d’Aaron et de Moïse ! »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابٗا وَأَبۡقَىٰ

english.text: Pharaoh said, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission! He must be your master who taught you magic! I will surely cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees; you will surely know whose punishment is more severe and more lasting!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon dit : « Osez-vous croire en lui avant que je ne vous y autorise ? Voici certainement votre maître qui vous a initiés à la magie. Je vais vous faire couper la main et le pied opposé et crucifier sur des troncs de palmiers. Vous saurez alors qui[17] inflige les tourments les plus terribles et les plus durables. »
french.footnotes: [17] De moi ou du Seigneur de Moïse.

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنَاۖ فَٱقۡضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍۖ إِنَّمَا تَقۡضِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ

english.text: They said, “We will never prefer you over the clear signs that have come to us, or over the One Who created us[18]. So decide whatever you will. You can only make a decision about the life of this world.
english.footnotes: [18] It can also be interpreted as an oath, i.e., “By the One Who created us, we will never prefer you over...”.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les magiciens dirent : « Nous n’allons pas te suivre et rejeter les preuves éclatantes qui nous ont été apportées, et te préférer à Celui qui nous a créés. Agis comme bon te semble. Ton pouvoir ne s’exerce qu’en ce bas monde.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحۡرِۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ

english.text: We surely believe in our Lord so that He may forgive us our sins and the magic that you have compelled us to practice, for Allah is best [in reward] and more lasting [in punishment].”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous proclamons notre foi en notre Seigneur dans l’espoir qu’Il nous pardonne nos erreurs et la pratique de la magie à laquelle tu nous as contraints. La récompense d’Allah est meilleure et plus durable[18]. »
french.footnotes: [18] Ou : le châtiment d’Allah est plus terrible et plus durable.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأۡتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجۡرِمٗا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ

english.text: Whoever comes to his Lord as an evildoer, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live[19].
english.footnotes: [19] He will neither die to relax from punishment, nor live a pleasant life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quiconque comparaîtra, chargé de crimes, devant son Seigneur est voué à la Géhenne où il n’y aura pour lui ni mort à même de le délivrer de ses souffrances, ni vie véritable.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن يَأۡتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنٗا قَدۡ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلۡعُلَىٰ

english.text: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done righteous deeds, it is they who will have the highest ranks:
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à celui qui comparaîtra devant Lui, en croyant sincère ayant accompli le bien sur terre, il sera élevé aux plus hauts degrés

renderings.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

english.text: Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Such is the reward of those who purify themselves[20].
english.footnotes: [20] From disbelief and sins.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et admis dans les jardins d’Eden traversés de rivières où il demeurera pour l’éternité. C’est ainsi que sera récompensé celui qui aura su se préserver du péché.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقٗا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسٗا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكٗا وَلَا تَخۡشَىٰ

english.text: We inspired Moses, “Travel by night with My slaves, and strike for them a dry path across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be afraid [of drowning].”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons révélé à Moïse : « Quitte le pays à la faveur de la nuit avec Mes serviteurs auxquels tu ouvriras un passage à sec dans la mer sans redouter d’être rejoint, ni éprouver aucune crainte. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ

english.text: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, but they were completely overwhelmed by the sea[21].
english.footnotes: [21] i.e., not only drowning in water but other things which are only known to Allah such as terror, pain, regret, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon et ses armées, lancés à leur poursuite, furent alors submergés par les flots.

renderings.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ

english.text: Thus Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon égara son peuple, le détournant du droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوَٰعَدۡنَٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰ

english.text: O Children of Israel, We rescued you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you[22] on the right side of Mount Tūr [in Sinai], and sent down for you manna and quails[23],
english.footnotes:
[22] i.e., with your prophet to talk to him and receive the Tablets for your guidance.
 [23] They were provided with manna (bread or honey-like food) and quails in the wilderness after they left Egypt.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fils d’Israël ! Après vous avoir délivrés de votre ennemi, Nous vous avons donné rendez-vous sur le versant droit du mont Sinaï et avons fait descendre sur vous la manne et les cailles.

renderings.arabic: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۖ وَمَن يَحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدۡ هَوَىٰ

english.text: [saying], “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not exceed the limits therein, or My wrath will befall you, for anyone upon whom My wrath befalls is perished.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mangez des nourritures pures et saines que Nous vous avons dispensées sans commettre d’excès, car Ma colère pourrait s’exercer sur vous. Or, quiconque attire Ma colère sur lui est perdu.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٞ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا ثُمَّ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

english.text: I am indeed Most Forgiving to those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds, then stay on the right path.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je suis, en vérité, infiniment Clément envers quiconque se repent, préserve sa foi et fait le bien sans jamais dévier du droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَعۡجَلَكَ عَن قَوۡمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english.text: [Allah asked], “What made you hasten from your people, O Moses?”[24]
english.footnotes: [24] Moses chose a delegation of seventy people from the Children of Israel to go to Mount Tūr to receive the Tablets. He was in haste to meet his Lord, so he rushed to the appointment and arrived before his people, leaving them behind. See (7:143-145)
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Pour quelle raison, Moïse, as-tu devancé les tiens ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ هُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضَىٰ

english.text: He said, “They are following my footsteps; I hastened to You, my Lord, to please You.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Ils sont sur mes pas, Seigneur. Quant à moi, je me suis hâté pour T’être agréable. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ

english.text: Allah said, “We have certainly tested your people in your absence, and Sāmiri[25] has led them astray.”
english.footnotes: [25] i.e., the Samaritan (a man from Samaria), a hypocrite who led the Children of Israel to the worship of the calf, or to idol-worship.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Nous avons, en ton absence, mis à l’épreuve ton peuple que le Samiri a détourné du droit chemin[19]. »
french.footnotes: [19] En l’incitant à adorer le Veau d’or.

renderings.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًاۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡعَهۡدُ أَمۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُم مَّوۡعِدِي

english.text: So Moses returned to his people, angry and sorrowful. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise[26]? Was my absence too long for you, or did you want the wrath from your Lord to befall you, so you broke your promise to me[27]?”
english.footnotes: [26] To send down the Torah for your guidance. [27] Of worshiping Allah alone until Moses comes back to them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De retour auprès des siens, Moïse, furieux et affligé, dit : « Mon peuple ! Votre Seigneur ne vous a-t-Il pas fait une belle promesse ? Avez-vous été incapables d’attendre qu’elle s’accomplisse ? Ou vouliez-vous plutôt, en violant votre engagement envers moi, subir la colère de votre Seigneur ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَآ أَوۡزَارٗا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ

english.text: They said, “We did not break our promise to you out of our own free will, but we were made to carry loads of the people’s jewelry, so we threw them [into the fire], and so did the Sāmiri throw.”[28]
english.footnotes: [28] They carried loads of jewelry of the people of the Pharaoh that they had with them, so they threw them into the fire in order to get rid of them. As for the Sāmiri, he threw the dust that he collected from the hoof-print of Gabriel’s horse.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Nous n’avons pas manqué à notre parole de notre plein gré. Mais nous étions chargés de bijoux appartenant aux Egyptiens que Nous avons jetés au feu, comme le fit le Samiri. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلٗا جَسَدٗا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٞ فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ

english.text: Then he molded for them an image of a calf that made a mooing sound. They said, “This is your god and Moses’ god, but he has forgotten.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce dernier avait façonné pour eux[20] un veau, un corps sans vie émettant comme un mugissement[21]. Certains Hébreux s’étaient alors exclamés : « Voici notre Dieu et le Dieu de Moïse qu’il a laissé ici ! »
french.footnotes:
[20] A partir des bijoux ainsi fondus.
[21] Le son était en réalité produit par le vent léger qui s’y engouffrait (Voir Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا

english.text: Do they not see that it does not respond a word to them, nor does it have the power to harm or benefit them?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne voyaient-ils pas que ce veau ne pouvait ni leur répondre, ni leur nuire, ni leur être utile ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبۡلُ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرِي

english.text: Aaron told them beforehand, “O my people, you are being tested with it. Your Lord is the Most Compassionate, so follow me and obey my command.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aaron les avait pourtant mis en garde : « Mon peuple ! Ce veau n’est qu’une tentation. Votre seul Seigneur est en vérité le Tout Miséricordieux. Suivez-moi donc et obéissez à mes ordres. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ

english.text: They said, “We will never cease to worship it until Moses comes back to us.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais les adorateurs du Veau avaient rétorqué : « Nous ne cesserons de le vénérer jusqu’au retour de Moïse. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذۡ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوٓاْ

english.text: Moses said, “O Aaron, what prevented you when you saw them going astray,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse, à son arrivée, interpella son frère : « Aaron ! Qu’est-ce qui t’a empêché, les voyant ainsi s’égarer,

renderings.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِۖ أَفَعَصَيۡتَ أَمۡرِي

english.text: from following me? Did you disobey my command?”[29]
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: de me rejoindre ? As-tu transgressé mes instructions ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأۡسِيٓۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِي

english.text: Aaron said, “O son of my mother, do not seize me by my beard or by my head! I feared that you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not heed my words.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aaron se justifia : « Fils de ma mère ! Cesse de me tirer par la barbe et par la tête. J’ai craint que tu ne me reproches d’avoir semé la division parmi les fils d’Israël et de ne pas avoir respecté tes recommandations. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِيُّ

english.text: Moses said, “What is the matter with you, O Sāmiri?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Se tournant vers le Samiri, Moïse dit : « Et toi Samiri, qu’est-ce qui t’a poussé à agir ainsi ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُواْ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةٗ مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِي نَفۡسِي

english.text: He said, “I saw something they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the hoof-print of the horse of the messenger [Gabriel] and cast it [into the fire][30]. This is what my mind prompted me.”
english.footnotes: [30] While Moses and the Children of Israel were crossing the sea, the Sāmiri saw Gabriel on a horse leading the way, so he took a handful of dust from the hoof-prints of his horse and later threw it at the calf that was made out of the melted ornaments so it started making a bellowing sound.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « J’ai vu des choses qui leur ont échappé. J’ai alors recueilli sur les traces laissées par le messager[22] une poignée de terre que j’ai jetée[23]. Voici ce que mon âme m’a suggéré. »
french.footnotes:
[22] L’ange Gabriel, selon la majorité des exégètes.
[23] Sur les bijoux fondus.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذۡهَبۡ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّن تُخۡلَفَهُۥۖ وَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِي ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفٗاۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا

english.text: Moses said, “Begone then! Your [punishment] in this life will be to say, ‘Do not touch me,’[31] but there awaits you an appointed time for your reckoning that you cannot escape[32]. Now look at your so-called god which you kept worshiping; We will surely burn it and then scatter it in the sea.
english.footnotes:
[31] So he was completely shunned by all people, alienated in the desert.
 [32] On the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse s’exclama : « Va-t’en ! Ton châtiment consistera ici-bas à te déclarer intouchable, tandis que dans l’au-delà t’est fixé un rendez-vous inéluctable. Regarde à présent ton dieu[24] auquel tu as voué un culte assidu. Nous allons le brûler avant d’en disperser les restes dans la mer. »
french.footnotes: [24] Le Veau d’or.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمٗا

english.text: [O people], your god is only Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Him. He encompasses everything in knowledge.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous n’avez d’autre divinité qu’Allah qui seul est en droit d’être adoré. Sa science embrasse toute chose.

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرٗا

english.text: This is how We relate to you [O Prophet] from the stories of the past, and We have given you a Reminder[33] from Us.
english.footnotes: [33] i.e., the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous te relatons certains récits du passé. Tu as reçu de Notre part un livre plein d’enseignements.

renderings.arabic: مَّنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وِزۡرًا

english.text: Whoever turns away from it will bear a heavy burden on the Day of Resurrection,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quiconque s’en détournera sera, le Jour de la résurrection, chargé d’un lourd fardeau

renderings.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ حِمۡلٗا

english.text: abiding therein forever[34]. What a terrible burden they will carry on the Day of Resurrection!
english.footnotes: [34] i.e., in the state of sin and punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dont il ne pourra jamais se soulager. Quel terrible fardeau devra-t-il en ce Jour porter,

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ وَنَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ زُرۡقٗا

english.text: the Day when the Trumpet will be blown; on that Day We will gather together the wicked sightless[35] [from horror].
english.footnotes: [35] i.e., blind, blue-eyed, blue-faced out of terror.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jour où il sera soufflé dans la Corne et où Nous rassemblerons les criminels, les visages livides[25].
french.footnotes: [25] Ou : aveugles. Ou encore : assoiffés.

renderings.arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا عَشۡرٗا

english.text: They will whisper to one another, “You stayed no more than ten days [on earth].”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les uns murmureront alors aux autres : « Nous ne sommes restés qu’une dizaine de jours sur terre. »

renderings.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذۡ يَقُولُ أَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا يَوۡمٗا

english.text: We know best what they will say – the most discerning among them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous savons parfaitement ce qu’ils diront lorsque les plus sensés d’entre eux affirmeront : « Nous n’y sommes restés en réalité qu’un seul jour ! »

renderings.arabic: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسۡفٗا

english.text: They ask you about the mountains, say, “My Lord will scatter them into dust,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils t’interrogent au sujet des montagnes. Réponds-leur : « Mon Seigneur les réduira en poussière,

renderings.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعٗا صَفۡصَفٗا

english.text: and He will leave the earth level and plain,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: laissant à leur place un sol totalement uniforme

renderings.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجٗا وَلَآ أَمۡتٗا

english.text: you will not see therein any troughs or peaks.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où ni dénivellation, ni relief ne sera visible. »

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ إِلَّا هَمۡسٗا

english.text: On that day, they will follow the summoner[36]; none will dare to deviate. All voices will be hushed in awe before the Most Compassionate; you will hear nothing except a whisper[37].
english.footnotes: [36] To the gathering for reckoning. [37] Or the sound of footsteps.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, les hommes répondront sans détour à l’appel qui leur sera lancé. Les voix s’abaisseront devant le Tout Miséricordieux, seuls des murmures[26] se feront entendre.
french.footnotes: [26] Ou : de légers bruits de pas.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا

english.text: On that day, no intercession will be of any use except to whom the Most Compassionate gave permission and approved his word.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aucune intercession ne sera acceptée ce Jour-là sans l’autorisation du Tout Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٗا

english.text: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them[38], but they do not encompass it[39] with their knowledge.
english.footnotes:
[38] i.e., what awaits them in the Hereafter and what they did in the world.
 [39] i.e., His knowledge.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il sait ce qui se trouve devant eux comme ce qui se trouve derrière eux[27], tandis qu’eux ne peuvent Le cerner de leur science.
french.footnotes: [27] Leur avenir comme leur passé, selon nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلۡوُجُوهُ لِلۡحَيِّ ٱلۡقَيُّومِۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمٗا

english.text: All faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, Self-Sustaining. Those burdened with wrongdoing[40] will be in a total loss.
english.footnotes: [40] i.e., sins, evil deeds, or wrongdoing towards others.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les visages s’humilieront devant le Dieu Vivant et Eternel. Seront perdus tous ceux qui porteront le poids de leur iniquité.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلۡمٗا وَلَا هَضۡمٗا

english.text: But whoever does righteous deeds, being a believer, will have no fear of being wronged or deprived.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant aux croyants qui auront accompli de bonnes œuvres, ils n’auront à craindre ni injustice[28], ni frustration[29].
french.footnotes:
[28] Rien ne sera ajouté à leurs mauvaises actions.
[29] Rien ne sera enlevé à leurs bonnes œuvres.

renderings.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا وَصَرَّفۡنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ أَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا

english.text: We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’an and diversified its warnings, so that they may fear Allah or it may cause them to take heed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous avons révélé le Livre sous forme d’une récitation en langue arabe et y avons multiplié les avertissements afin qu’ils soient incités à se préserver du péché et à méditer Nos enseignements.

renderings.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا

english.text: So Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign[41]. Do not hasten to [recite] the Qur’an before its revelation to you is concluded[42], and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
english.footnotes:
[41] Of everything in existence.
 [42] Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) was eager to recite the Qur’an while it was being revealed, so Allah Almighty told him to avoid being in haste in order to learn them before the verses are properly delivered; rather, listen to them attentively.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exalté soit Allah, le seul et véritable Souverain. Ne répète pas avec empressement le Coran qui t’est révélé avant que sa récitation ne soit achevée[30]. Et dis : « Veuille, Seigneur, accroître mon savoir ! »
french.footnotes: [30] Mais garde le silence jusqu’au moment où l’ange Gabriel aura fini de te le réciter, alors seulement tu pourras le répéter après lui, sans craindre de l’oublier.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهُۥ عَزۡمٗا

english.text: We had already given a command to Adam before, but he forgot, and We found him lacking a firm resolve[43].
english.footnotes: [43] To resist the temptation of eating from the forbidden tree.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, bien avant cela, donné un ordre[31] à Adam qu’il finit par transgresser. Nous l’avons trouvé bien peu résolu à se soumettre à Nos commandements.
french.footnotes: [31] Celui de ne pas manger des fruits de l’arbre défendu, selon nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ

english.text: When We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” they all prostrated, except Iblīs[44], who refused.
english.footnotes: [44] See footnote 2:34.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avions auparavant ordonné aux anges de se prosterner devant Adam. Tous s’étaient exécutés, tandis que Satan s’y était refusé.

renderings.arabic: فَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوّٞ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقَىٰٓ

english.text: We said “O Adam, this is an enemy to you and to your wife, so do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for then you will fall into misery.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avions alors dit : « Adam ! Celui-ci est, pour toi et ton épouse, un ennemi. Prends garde qu’il ne vous fasse chasser du Paradis, car tu endurerais alors toutes les peines du monde.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ

english.text: Here you will neither go hungry nor naked,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu n’auras en revanche à redouter au Paradis ni la faim, ni la nudité,

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُاْ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضۡحَىٰ

english.text: nor will you suffer from thirst or from scorching heat.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et n’auras à souffrir ni de la soif, ni de la chaleur du soleil. »

renderings.arabic: فَوَسۡوَسَ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكٖ لَّا يَبۡلَىٰ

english.text: Then Satan whispered to him, and said, “O Adam, shall I show you the tree of immortality and a kingdom that will never decay?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais Satan le tenta, lui suggérant : « Adam ! Veux-tu que je t’indique l’arbre qui, si tu manges de ses fruits, te rendra immortel et te permettra de posséder un royaume éternel ? »

renderings.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفَانِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ

english.text: So they both ate from the tree, then their nakedness was revealed to each other, and they began to put together leaves from Paradise to cover themselves. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord and fell into error[45].
english.footnotes: [45] Unlike the Bible, the Qur’an does not put the blame on Eve for Adam’s sin, for which they were ousted from the Garden and sent down to the earth. See: (Genesis 3).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Adam et Eve mangèrent donc des fruits de l’arbre défendu. Leur apparut alors leur nudité qu’ils se mirent à couvrir avec les feuilles du Paradis. En désobéissant ainsi à son Seigneur, Adam s’égara.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدَىٰ

english.text: Thereafter his Lord chose him, accepted his repentance, and guided him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Son Seigneur l’a ensuite élu, acceptant son repentir et le remettant sur le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيعَۢاۖ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقَىٰ

english.text: Allah said, “Get down, both of you, from here altogether [with Satan] as enemies to one another. Then when there comes to you guidance from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray nor fall into misery[46].
english.footnotes: [46] Neither go astray (in this life) nor fall into misery (in the Hereafter).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Descendez tous deux d’ici ! Vous serez ennemis les uns des autres. Des enseignements à même d’assurer votre salut vous seront transmis de Ma part. Celui qui les suivra ne pourra s’égarer ici-bas ou connaître un sort misérable dans l’au-delà.

renderings.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَن ذِكۡرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةٗ ضَنكٗا وَنَحۡشُرُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ

english.text: But whoever turns away from My Reminder[47] will have a miserable life, and on the Day of Resurrection We will raise him blind.”
english.footnotes: [47] i.e., the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à celui qui se détournera de Mon message, il connaîtra une existence malheureuse et sera frappé de cécité lorsque Nous le ressusciterons le Jour dernier. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيٓ أَعۡمَىٰ وَقَدۡ كُنتُ بَصِيرٗا

english.text: He will say, “My Lord, why have you raised me blind when I was able to see before?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dira : « Pourquoi, Seigneur, m’as-Tu ressuscité aveugle alors que sur terre je voyais clairement ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَاۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُنسَىٰ

english.text: Allah will say, “Similarly Our verses came to you, but you ignored them, so you will be ignored Today.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dira : « De même que tu as délaissé les signes que Nous avons envoyés, de même tu seras aujourd’hui abandonné à ton sort et délaissé. »

renderings.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَنۡ أَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ

english.text: This is how We recompense those who transgress the limits and do not believe in the verses of his Lord; and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting[48].
english.footnotes: [48] Than that of the worldly life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous rétribuons quiconque se livre au péché et renie les signes de son Seigneur. Mais le châtiment de l’au-delà sera plus terrible et plus durable.

renderings.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ

english.text: Is it not yet clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they still walk about? There are signs in this for people of sound intellect.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’ont-ils pas été édifiés par le sort subi avant eux par tant de peuples impies, anéantis par Nous et dont ils foulent aujourd’hui les terres ? Voilà, pour des hommes doués de raison, des signes suffisamment clairs.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامٗا وَأَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى

english.text: Were it not for a prior decree from your Lord[49] [O Prophet] and a time already set, they would have already been punished[50].
english.footnotes:
[49] That He will not punish until the argument is established on them on the Day of Judgment.
 [50] He would have punished the disbelievers in the life of this world as He did with the destroyed nations of the past.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’eût été un décret préalable de ton Seigneur repoussant leur châtiment à un terme déjà fixé, celui-ci les aurait inévitablement frappés.

renderings.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوبِهَاۖ وَمِنۡ ءَانَآيِٕ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَأَطۡرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضَىٰ

english.text: So be patient with what they say, and glorify your Lord with praise before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him during the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased [with the reward].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Supporte patiemment leurs attaques et célèbre, par les louanges, la gloire de ton Seigneur avant le lever du soleil et avant son coucher. Exalte également Sa gloire au cours de la nuit et aux extrémités du jour. Peut-être seras-tu satisfait[32] !
french.footnotes: [32] De la récompense qui te sera accordée si tu accomplis les œuvres mentionnées ici et qui, selon la majorité des exégètes, sont les cinq prières quotidiennes.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ

english.text: Do not turn your eyes covetously towards the various forms of splendor of this life that We have given some of the [disbelievers] to enjoy, as a trial for them. But the provision of your Lord is far better and more lasting.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne porte pas ton regard avec envie sur les jouissances éphémères que Nous avons accordées à certains d’entre eux, éclat trompeur de ce monde par lequel Nous les mettons à l’épreuve. Les faveurs de ton Seigneur sont bien meilleures et plus durables.

renderings.arabic: وَأۡمُرۡ أَهۡلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاۖ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقٗاۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَۗ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰ

english.text: Enjoin your household to perform prayer and adhere to it firmly. We ask no provision from you; rather, it is We Who give you provision. And the best outcome is for those who fear Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ordonne aux tiens d’accomplir la prière que tu observeras toi-même avec constance. Nous ne te demandons nullement d’assurer toi-même ta subsistance[33]. C’est Nous qui pourvoyons à tes besoins. Une fin heureuse est réservée à celui qui Nous craint.
french.footnotes: [33] Et celle des hommes et n’attendons de toi aucune offrande.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا يَأۡتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

english.text: They say, “Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?” Has there not come to them [the Qur’an as] a confirmation of what is in the earlier Scriptures[51]?
english.footnotes: [51] Concerning Muhammad’s prophethood and the Qur'an as a lasting miracle.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils disent : « Si seulement il produisait sous nos yeux un miracle de la part de son Seigneur ! » N’ont-ils pas reçu un livre qui vient confirmer le contenu des Ecritures antérieures[34] ?
french.footnotes: [34] Ou : un prophète annoncé par ces mêmes Ecritures.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّآ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٖ مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولٗا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزَىٰ

english.text: If We had destroyed them with a punishment before this[52], they would have said, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger so that we would have followed Your verses before being humiliated and disgraced.”
english.footnotes: [52] Before sending Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) or before sending the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, si Nous les avions anéantis avant son avènement[35], ils auraient certainement affirmé[36] : « Si seulement, Seigneur, Tu nous avais envoyé un Messager ! Nous aurions suivi Tes enseignements, évitant ainsi d’être couverts d’humiliation et d’opprobre. »
french.footnotes:
[35] De Mouhammad ou la révélation du Coran.
[36] Le Jour dernier, précisent nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ كُلّٞ مُّتَرَبِّصٞ فَتَرَبَّصُواْۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

english.text: Say, “Each of us is waiting[53], so wait! You will come to know who are the people of the straight path and who are rightly guided.”
english.footnotes: [53] For the end result of this matter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Chacun de nous est dans l’attente. Attendez donc ! Vous saurez alors qui de vous ou de nous est sur la bonne voie et qui suit le droit chemin. »

renderings.arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مُّعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: The reckoning of the people has drawn near, yet they are turning away heedlessly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le jugement des hommes approche. Mais ces derniers, insouciants, se détournent de Nos avertissements.

renderings.arabic: مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسۡتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ

english.text: Whenever new revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it in jest,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aucune nouvelle révélation de leur Seigneur ne leur est transmise sans qu’ils ne l’écoutent avec amusement,

renderings.arabic: لَاهِيَةٗ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۖ أَفَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: with their hearts heedless. The wrongdoers whisper to one another in secret, “Is this but a human being just like yourselves? Will you then follow his magic, although you openly see?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le cœur distrait. Les impies se disent en secret : « N’est-il pas un simple homme comme nous ? Allons-nous croire à ce qui est manifestement de la magie ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: He said, “My Lord knows every word spoken in the heavens and earth, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Prophète dit : « Mon Seigneur, Celui qui entend tout et sait tout, connaît parfaitement ce qui se dit au ciel et sur terre. »

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَضۡغَٰثُ أَحۡلَٰمِۭ بَلِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٞ فَلۡيَأۡتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٖ كَمَآ أُرۡسِلَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ

english.text: Yet they say, “This [Qur’an] is a set of jumbled dreams! Rather, he has fabricated it! Rather, he is a poet! So let him bring us a sign just as the earlier messengers were sent with[1].”
english.footnotes: [1] Such as the staff of Moses (عليه السلام), the camel of Salih (عليه السلام) and the like.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils disent encore au sujet du Coran : « Ce n’est là qu’un tissu de rêves, à moins qu’il ne l’ait inventé ou qu’il ne s’agisse tout simplement de l’œuvre d’un poète. Qu’il produise donc sous nos yeux un miracle comme le firent les premiers prophètes. »

renderings.arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآۖ أَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Not a single town We destroyed before them had believed[2]. Will they then believe?
english.footnotes: [2] Although they witnessed signs and miracles.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aucune cité, parmi celles que Nous avons anéanties avant eux, n’a ajouté foi aux miracles. Se peut-il que ceux-ci y croient ?

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: We did not send before you [O Prophet] except men to whom We gave a revelation, so [O people] ask the People of the Scriptures if you do not know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons suscité avant toi, pour recevoir Nos révélations, que de simples mortels. Interrogez donc, pour vous en convaincre, les nations auxquelles ont été confiées les Ecritures.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ جَسَدٗا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَٰلِدِينَ

english.text: We did not give them bodies that needed no food[3], nor were they immortal.
english.footnotes: [3] Such as the angels.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’en avons pas fait des corps pouvant se passer de nourriture, ni des êtres immortels.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡوَعۡدَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

english.text: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them: We saved them[4] and those whom We willed, and destroyed those who transgressed all bounds.
english.footnotes: [4] After they conveyed the message.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons ensuite tenu Notre promesse envers eux, les sauvant avec ceux que Nous avons choisis et anéantissant ceux qui n’ont cessé de les traiter d’imposteurs.

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا فِيهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: We have sent down to you [O people] a Book in which there is honor for you[5]. Do you not then understand?
english.footnotes: [5] As you have been mentioned and addressed in the Qur’an, or there is a reminder for you in it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons, en vérité, révélé un livre édifiant qui fera votre gloire et votre renommée. Etes-vous donc dépourvus de toute raison ?

renderings.arabic: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٖ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةٗ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english.text: [Imagine] how many towns of wrongdoers We have destroyed[6], and raised after them another people!
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., who were persisting in wrongdoing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de cités impies avons-Nous brisées avant de remplacer ses habitants par d’autres hommes.

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأۡسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُونَ

english.text: When they sensed Our punishment, they started running away from it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voyant Nos rigueurs s’approcher, ils se sont précipités à l’extérieur de leur cité.

renderings.arabic: لَا تَرۡكُضُواْ وَٱرۡجِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ

english.text: “Do not run away, but return to your luxuries and dwellings[7], perhaps you will be questioned.”
english.footnotes: [7] This is said to them in sarcasm and ridicule.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Ne vous précipitez pas ! Revenez à vos foyers et aux plaisirs dont vous jouissiez. Vous serez peut-être interrogés ! »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: They said, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Malheur à nous ! Nous avons vécu dans l’impiété ! »

renderings.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ

english.text: They kept crying this out loud until We mowed them down, lifeless[8].
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., extinguished like ashes.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Paroles qu’ils ne cessèrent de répéter jusqu’au moment où Nous en fîmes des corps sans vie, fauchés par la mort.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

english.text: We did not create the heavens and earth and all that is between them for fun.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons pas créé le ciel, la terre et tout ce qui se trouve entre eux, par jeu.

renderings.arabic: لَوۡ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوٗا لَّٱتَّخَذۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

english.text: If We had wished for a pastime[9], We could have had it from Our own, if We were to do so.
english.footnotes: [9] Such as a wife or a child.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous avions voulu une distraction, Nous l’aurions trouvée auprès de Nous. Si telle avait été notre intention.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٞۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

english.text: Rather, We hurl the truth at falsehood, and it crushes it[10], so it vanishes. Woe to you for what you falsely ascribe [to Allah][11]!
english.footnotes:
[10] Lit. "strikes its brain," disabling or killing it.
 [11] Claiming that He has a son, a wife, or a partner.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais Nous faisons éclater la vérité qui aussitôt fait disparaître le faux. Malheur donc à vous pour les blasphèmes que vous proférez !

renderings.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُونَ

english.text: To Him belongs all those who are in the heavens and earth. Those [angels] who are with Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they ever grow weary.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le Maître de tous les êtres qui peuplent les cieux et la terre. Les anges qui se trouvent auprès de Lui ne refusent jamais par orgueil de L’adorer et ne se lassent jamais de Le vénérer.

renderings.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُونَ

english.text: They glorify Him day and night tirelessly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils célèbrent nuit et jour, avec la même ferveur, la gloire de leur Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنشِرُونَ

english.text: Or have they taken gods from the earth who [cannot even] resurrect the dead?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ont-ils adopté sur terre[1] des divinités capables de ressusciter les morts ?
french.footnotes: [1] Ou : ont-ils tiré de la terre. Les idoles païennes étaient généralement de bois ou de pierre.

renderings.arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english.text: If there had been gods besides Allah in the heavens and earth, both realms would have fallen in disorder. Glory be to Allah – Lord of the Throne – far above what they ascribe [to Him].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’il se trouvait au ciel ou sur terre d’autres divinités qu’Allah, tous deux seraient livrés au chaos. Gloire donc à Allah, Maître du Trône, que leurs blasphèmes ne sauraient atteindre !

renderings.arabic: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُونَ

english.text: He cannot be questioned for what He does, but they will be questioned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur n’a aucunement à répondre de Ses actes, tandis que Ses serviteurs devront rendre compte de leurs agissements.

renderings.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗۖ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡۖ هَٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَن قَبۡلِيۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ فَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof. Here is the Book of those who are with me, and the Book of those who came before me[12].” Yet most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.
english.footnotes: [12] The Prophet (ﷺ) is addressed to challenge the pagans to produce their proof for the existence of other gods; whereas, the Qur’an, the Torah, and the Gospel are in agreement that there is no god but Allah alone.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ont-ils adopté des divinités en dehors de Lui ? Dis-leur : « Apportez vos preuves du bien-fondé de vos pratiques ! Voici le Livre de ma communauté et les Ecritures révélées aux nations qui l’ont précédée[2]. » Mais la plupart ne veulent pas connaître la vérité dont ils préfèrent se détourner.
french.footnotes: [2] Il n’est nulle part écrit que d’autres divinités qu’Allah méritent d’être adorées.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ

english.text: “We never sent before you [O Prophet] any messenger without revealing to him that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons envoyé avant toi nul Messager sans lui révéler qu’il n’est de divinité en droit d’être adorée qu’Allah qui, seul, doit être vénéré.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۚ بَلۡ عِبَادٞ مُّكۡرَمُونَ

english.text: They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten offspring!”[13] Glory be to Him! In fact, those [angels] are His honored slaves.
english.footnotes: [13] The pagans claimed that angels are the daughters of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les idolâtres prétendent que le Tout Miséricordieux s’est donné des filles. Gloire à Lui ! Les anges sont au contraire des serviteurs honorés

renderings.arabic: لَا يَسۡبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُم بِأَمۡرِهِۦ يَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: They do not speak before He speaks, and they only do as He commands.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui se gardent de prendre la parole avant Lui et de transgresser Ses ordres.

renderings.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهِۦ مُشۡفِقُونَ

english.text: He knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them[14]. They cannot intercede except for whom He pleases, and they are fearful in awe of Him.
english.footnotes: [14] See footnote 2:255.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah sait ce qui se trouve devant eux comme ce qui se trouve derrière eux. Ils n’intercèdent qu’avec Sa permission et sont remplis de crainte envers Lui.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِلَٰهٞ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: If anyone of them were to say, “I am god besides Him,” We would punish him with Hell. This is how We punish the wrongdoers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.
