french.text: Quiconque parmi ces anges prétendrait être une divinité en dehors du Seigneur serait voué à la Géhenne. C’est ainsi que Nous rétribuons les impies.

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقٗا فَفَتَقۡنَٰهُمَاۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّۚ أَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and earth were joined together and then We split them apart? We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants ne savent-ils pas que les cieux et la terre formaient un tout[3] avant que Nous procédions à leur séparation ? Et que Nous avons créé à partir de l’eau toute chose vivante ? Vont-ils se décider à croire ?
french.footnotes: [3] Les cieux étant « collés » ou « soudés » à la terre, précisent nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجٗا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: We have set on the earth firm mountains so it does not shake with them, and We have made therein broad pathways so that they may find their way.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons solidement fixé dans la terre des montagnes qui l’empêchent de trembler sous les pieds de ses habitants et y avons tracé de larges voies leur permettant de s’y déplacer et de s’y diriger aisément.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقۡفٗا مَّحۡفُوظٗاۖ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, yet they turn away from its signs[15].
english.footnotes: [15] Such as the sun and the moon.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons fait du ciel un toit protégé dont les merveilles les laissent pourtant indifférents.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ

english.text: It is He Who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon – each floating in its orbit.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui a créé le jour et la nuit, de même que le soleil et la lune, chacun décrivant une orbite bien déterminée.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ ٱلۡخُلۡدَۖ أَفَإِيْن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: We did not grant immortality to any human being before you [O Prophet]. So if you die, will they live forever?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons conféré l’immortalité à nul homme avant toi. Espèrent-ils, quant à eux, vivre éternellement après toi ?

renderings.arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۗ وَنَبۡلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةٗۖ وَإِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: Every soul will taste death; We test you with bad and good as a trial, then to Us you will all be returned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: En réalité, chaque être est appelé à mourir. Nous avons fait de la vie une succession de peines et de joies afin de vous éprouver[4]. Puis c’est à Nous que vous serez tous ramenés.
french.footnotes: [4] Eprouver votre patience face au malheur et votre gratitude face au bonheur.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذۡكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ

english.text: When the disbelievers see you, they only take you in ridicule, [saying], “Is this the one who speaks ill of your gods?” while they reject even the mention of the Most Compassionate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque les mécréants te voient, ils te tournent en dérision, disant : « Est-ce là celui qui ose dénigrer nos divinités ? » Or, eux-mêmes n’hésitent pas à renier la révélation[5] du Tout Miséricordieux.
french.footnotes: [5] Ou : le nom.

renderings.arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِنۡ عَجَلٖۚ سَأُوْرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ

english.text: Man is created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme est par nature impatient. Je vous ferai voir tôt ou tard la réalisation de Mes avertissements. Ne me pressez donc pas[6].
french.footnotes: [6] Vous, les impies, qui par défi et moquerie demandez à ce que le châtiment s’abatte sur vous ou vous, les croyants, qui êtes pressés de voir les mécréants être châtiés.

renderings.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les impies demandent : « Quand donc se réalisera cette menace, si vous dites la vérité ? »

renderings.arabic: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

english.text: If only the disbelievers knew the moment when they would be unable to ward the Fire off their faces or their backs, nor would they be helped[16].
english.footnotes: [16] The completion of the sentence is "...they would not be asking for the punishment."
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si les mécréants pouvaient être conscients du châtiment qui les attend au moment où ils ne pourront repousser le Feu de leurs visages et de leurs dos, ni espérer le moindre secours, ils ne demanderaient pas avec autant d’empressement l’exécution de Nos menaces.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ تَأۡتِيهِم بَغۡتَةٗ فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ

english.text: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and stun them; they will not be able to avert it, nor will they be given respite.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais celui-ci les saisira soudainement, les frappant de stupeur sans qu’ils puissent le repousser ou espérer un délai.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

english.text: Indeed, there were messengers before you who were ridiculed, but those who mocked them were encompassed by what they used to ridicule.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Des Messagers ont été tournés en dérision avant toi, mais ceux qui les raillaient ont finalement été cernés par le châtiment même dont ils se moquaient.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: Say, “Who can protect you by night and by day against the Most Compassionate?” Yet they turn away from the admonition of their Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Qui donc, de jour comme de nuit, saurait vous préserver du châtiment du Tout Miséricordieux ? » Ils restent pourtant indifférents à la révélation et aux exhortations de leur Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞ تَمۡنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَاۚ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُونَ

english.text: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? They cannot even help themselves, nor will they be protected from Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien auraient-ils des dieux en mesure de les protéger de Notre châtiment ? Ceux-ci sont pourtant incapables de se défendre eux-mêmes, ni de trouver une protection contre Nos rigueurs.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَآۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ

english.text: Nevertheless, We have provided for them and their forefathers luxuries which they enjoyed for a long time. Do they not see that We gradually reduce the land from its outlying sides?[17] Is it they who will then prevail?
english.footnotes: [17] See footnote 13:41.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous les avons en réalité laissés jouir, eux et leurs ancêtres, si longtemps de cette vie que celle-ci les a leurrés. Ne voient-ils pas que Nous repoussons progressivement les limites de leur territoire[7] ? Pensent-ils sortir vainqueurs de cette confrontation ?
french.footnotes: [7] Par la destruction des cités impies et par les victoires remportées par les croyants, selon nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلۡوَحۡيِۚ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

english.text: Say, “I only warn you by divine revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Je ne fais que vous transmettre les avertissements qui me sont révélés. » Mais les sourds ne sauraient entendre les mises en garde qui leur sont adressées.

renderings.arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٞ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: If a mere breath of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would surely say, “Woe to us! We were indeed wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si le plus léger châtiment de ton Seigneur venait à les toucher, ils s’écrieraient certainement : « Malheur à nous ! Nous avons vraiment été injustes ! »

renderings.arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلۡمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ أَتَيۡنَا بِهَاۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ

english.text: We will place the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection, and no soul will be wronged in the least. Even if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed[18], We will bring it forth. Sufficient are We as Reckoners.
english.footnotes: [18] i.e., as small or insignificant as a mustard seed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour de la résurrection, Nous dresserons les balances de la justice. Nul ne sera donc lésé. Chaque action, aussi insignifiante soit-elle[8], sera pesée. Nous suffisons pour tenir le compte de leurs œuvres.
french.footnotes: [8] Littéralement : fût-elle de la taille d’un grain de sénevé. Que l’on se rappelle ici la parabole du grain de sénevé, dans l’Evangile de Matthieu, où il est dit que « ce grain est la plus petite de toutes les semences ».

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءٗ وَذِكۡرٗا لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: We certainly gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, shining light and admonition[19] for the righteous,
english.footnotes: [19] These are Torah’s three qualities.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons confié à Moïse et Aaron les Ecritures permettant de discerner le vrai du faux dont Nous avons fait une lumière et une exhortation pour les pieux croyants

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُونَ

english.text: those who fear their Lord without seeing Him[20], and are apprehensive of the Hour.
english.footnotes: [20] Or when they are in private and not seen by others.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, loin des regards, craignent leur Seigneur et redoutent l’avènement de l’Heure.

renderings.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُۚ أَفَأَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

english.text: And this [Qur’an] is a blessed reminder which We have sent down. Are you still denying it[21]?
english.footnotes: [21] i.e., pretending ignorance or refusing to acknowledge it?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et ceci est un livre béni que Nous avons révélé à l’humanité. Allez-vous donc le renier ?

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ رُشۡدَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: Indeed, We had given Abraham sound judgment before[22], for We know him well.
english.footnotes: [22] i.e., before Moses, or in his early youth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avions auparavant mis Abraham sur le droit chemin, sachant qu’il en était digne,

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ

english.text: When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: lui qui, un jour, dit à son père et à son peuple : « Que sont ces statues auxquelles vous vouez un culte assidu ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ

english.text: They said, “We found our forefathers worshiping them.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Nous avons trouvé nos ancêtres attachés à leur culte », répondirent-ils.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنتُمۡ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: He said, “Indeed, you and your forefathers were clearly misguided.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Abraham dit : « Vous vous êtes, vous et vos ancêtres, manifestement égarés. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ أَمۡ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ

english.text: They said, “Have you come to us with the truth, or are you joking?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Es-tu sérieux ou en train de plaisanter ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

english.text: He said, “Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth, Who created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il répondit : « Je suis au contraire de ceux qui témoignent en toute vérité que votre unique Seigneur est le Maître et Créateur des cieux et de la terre. »

renderings.arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصۡنَٰمَكُم بَعۡدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدۡبِرِينَ

english.text: By Allah, I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned and gone away.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis Abraham jura en secret : « Par Allah ! Je m’attaquerai à vos idoles dès que vous aurez le dos tourné. »

renderings.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرٗا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: So he broke them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so that they might come back to it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il mit donc les idoles en pièces, n’épargnant que la plus grande, afin qu’ils puissent se tourner vers elle[9].
french.footnotes: [9] Pour l’interroger sur ce qui s’est passé, expliquent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is indeed one of the wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A leur retour, ils dirent : « Quel est le criminel qui a osé traiter ainsi nos divinités ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا فَتٗى يَذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ

english.text: They said, “We heard a young man, speaking ill of them, who is called Abraham.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains répondirent : « Nous avons entendu un jeune homme appelé Abraham dire du mal d’elles.

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ فَأۡتُواْ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُونَ

english.text: They said, “Bring him then before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial][23].”
english.footnotes: [23] Or his confession about what he did.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’on le fasse venir devant le peuple afin que chacun puisse témoigner. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلۡتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ

english.text: They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Une fois en leur présence, il fut interrogé : « Est-ce toi, Abraham, qui a fait cela à nos divinités ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمۡ هَٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوهُمۡ إِن كَانُواْ يَنطِقُونَ

english.text: He said, “Rather, it was this biggest one who did it. So ask them, if they can speak!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Non ! C’est la plus grande d’entre elles que voici, répondit-il. Interrogez-les si toutefois elles peuvent s’exprimer ! »

renderings.arabic: فَرَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

english.text: So they turned back to one another, and said, “Indeed, it is you who are the wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prenant conscience de leur égarement, ils se dirent : « Ce sont nous, en réalité, les criminels. »

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسُواْ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

english.text: Then they turned to their obstinacy[24], [saying], “You already know that they cannot speak.”
english.footnotes: [24] After first admitting their error.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis, retombant dans leurs anciens errements, ils dirent : « Tu sais très bien que ces idoles ne peuvent parler. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَفَتَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ

english.text: Abraham said, “Do you then worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm you in the least?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Comment pouvez-vous alors, dit Abraham, adorer en dehors d’Allah des objets incapables de vous nuire et qui ne vous sont d’aucune utilité ?

renderings.arabic: أُفّٖ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: Fie upon you[25] and upon all that you worship besides Allah! Do you not have any sense?”
english.footnotes: [25] An expression of anger and displeasure.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fi de vous et de ce que vous adorez en dehors d’Allah ! Etes-vous donc dépourvus de toute raison ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ

english.text: They said, “Burn him and avenge your gods if you must do something.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Jetez-le au feu, si vous êtes décidés à venger vos divinités ! »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

english.text: We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[26]
english.footnotes: [26] It is reported in an authentic Hadīth that Abraham said, while being thrown into the fire, “Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Protector.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous dîmes alors au bûcher : « Sois pour Abraham d’une fraîcheur inoffensive. »

renderings.arabic: وَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ

english.text: They plotted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils voulurent lui causer du tort, mais Nous avons ruiné tous leurs espoirs.

renderings.arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَا لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: And We saved him and Lot [and brought him] to the land[27] that we have blessed for all people.
english.footnotes: [27] i.e., the Levant. Abraham and his nephew, Lot, were saved from their enemy Nimrod and his people, as they migrated from the land of Babel, Iraq to Jerusalem.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons sauvé, ainsi que Loth, leur permettant à tous deux d’émigrer vers la terre[10] que Nous avons bénie pour toute l’humanité.
french.footnotes: [10] Le pays de Canaan.

renderings.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةٗۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا صَٰلِحِينَ

english.text: And We gave him Isaac, and then Jacob, a grandson, and We made all of them righteous.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous lui avons fait don d’Isaac[11] et lui avons également accordé Jacob[12]. Nous avons fait d’eux des hommes vertueux
french.footnotes:
[11] En réponse à son invocation.
[12] Ajoutant donc ce petit-fils vertueux au fils qu’Abraham avait demandé dans ses prières.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ

english.text: And We made them leaders, guiding people by Our command, and We inspired them to do righteous deeds, establish prayer and give zakah[28]; and they were Our true worshipers.
english.footnotes: [28] The term "zakah" denotes purification and growth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et des guides qui, sur Notre ordre, appelaient les hommes à Notre adoration. Nous les avons exhortés, par Nos révélations, à pratiquer la vertu, à accomplir la prière et à s’acquitter de l’aumône. Ils furent Nos fervents adorateurs.

renderings.arabic: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗا وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَت تَّعۡمَلُ ٱلۡخَبَٰٓئِثَۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَٰسِقِينَ

english.text: To Lot We gave sound judgment and knowledge, and We saved him from the town that was engrossed in shameful practices. They were Indeed an evil and rebellious people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à Loth, Nous l’avons doté de sagesse et de science, et l’avons sauvé de la cité dont les habitants, pervers et corrompus, se livraient aux actes les plus odieux.

renderings.arabic: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english.text: And We admitted him to Our mercy, for he was one of the righteous.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons admis dans Notre miséricorde. Il était du nombre des vertueux.

renderings.arabic: وَنُوحًا إِذۡ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

english.text: And [remember] Noah, when he called out[29] to Us before, so We responded to him and saved him and his household[30] from the great distress.
english.footnotes:
[29] i.e., supplicated against his people who had persisted in denial.
 [30] i.e., the believers of his household.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne également Noé qui, avant eux, Nous avait imploré et que Nous avons exaucé en le délivrant, lui et les siens, de la détresse qui les submergeait.

renderings.arabic: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: And We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs. They were indeed evil people, so We drowned them all.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons sauvé de son peuple qui avait renié Nos signes et avons englouti jusqu’au dernier ces êtres corrompus.

renderings.arabic: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ إِذۡ يَحۡكُمَانِ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡثِ إِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شَٰهِدِينَ

english.text: And [remember] David and Solomon, when they passed judgment about the tillage into which some people’s sheep had strayed at night[31], and We were witnesses to their judgment.
english.footnotes: [31] Destroying the crops and eating therefrom.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne également David et Salomon, et le jugement prononcé par chacun d’entre eux à propos d’un champ endommagé par un troupeau de moutons venu y paître la nuit, jugement dont Nous étions témoin.

renderings.arabic: فَفَهَّمۡنَٰهَا سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيۡنَا حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗاۚ وَسَخَّرۡنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحۡنَ وَٱلطَّيۡرَۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

english.text: We made Solomon understand it[32], although We gave each of them sound judgment and knowledge. We subjected the mountains and birds to glorify Allah along with David. It was We Who did all this.
english.footnotes: [32] A man’s flock of sheep strayed into another man’s tillage. When the two men came to David for judgment, he ruled that the shepherd must give his sheep in compensation for the damage. Nonetheless, Solomon suggested that the sheep be kept with the owner of the tillage, so he may benefit from their milk and wool, while the shepherd should work on the land to restore it to its former state. Thus, the farmer would take back his tillage in perfect condition, and the sheep would be returned to its owner. David was impressed by his son’s insightful and fair judgment and approved it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons inspiré à Salomon un jugement équitable[13] et avons doté l’un et l’autre de sagesse et de science. A David, Nous avons soumis les montagnes et les oiseaux qui Nous glorifiaient en même temps que lui. Nous avons bel et bien agi ainsi.
french.footnotes: [13] David, dit-on, jugea que les moutons devaient revenir au propriétaire du vignoble. Son fils Salomon, quant à lui, prononça le jugement que voici : le champ devait être confié aux propriétaires des moutons avec obligation de l’entretenir jusqu’à ce qu’il retrouve son état initial, tandis que les brebis devaient être confiées au propriétaire des vignes qui pouvait jouir de leur lait jusqu’à ce que le vignoble retrouve son état initial. Le champ de vignes devait alors revenir à son propriétaire et les brebis à leurs maîtres (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوسٖ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأۡسِكُمۡۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُمۡ شَٰكِرُونَ

english.text: And We taught him[33] the art of making coats of mail for you to protect yourselves in your battle. Will you then be grateful?
english.footnotes: [33] i.e., David apart from Solomon.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous lui avons aussi enseigné l’art de fabriquer les cottes de mailles qui vous protègent des coups de vos ennemis. Allez-vous donc vous montrer reconnaissants ?

renderings.arabic: وَلِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةٗ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَاۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: And to Solomon [We subjected] the raging wind, to blow by his command to the land We had blessed. It is We Who have full knowledge of everything.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A Salomon, Nous avons soumis le vent impétueux qui, par sa volonté, soufflait vers la terre que Nous avons bénie[14]. Notre science s’étend à toute chose.
french.footnotes: [14] La Palestine.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعۡمَلُونَ عَمَلٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ

english.text: And among the devils [We subjected] those who dived for him[34] and performed other duties. It is We Who were watching over them[35].
english.footnotes:
[34] Bringing him pearls.
 [35] Preventing any disobedience from Solomon's instructions and protecting him from being harmed by them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous lui avons aussi soumis certains démons chargés, sous Notre surveillance, d’explorer pour lui les fonds marins et d’exécuter d’autres travaux encore.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

english.text: And [remember] Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “I have been struck by adversity[36], and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.”
english.footnotes: [36] i.e., loss of health, wealth, and children.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne également Job qui adressa cette prière à son Seigneur : « Je suis accablé d’épreuves. Or, Ta miséricorde est sans égale ! »

renderings.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرّٖۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰبِدِينَ

english.text: So We responded to him and relieved his adversity, and We restored to him his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for Our worshipers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par un effet de Notre grâce, Nous l’avons exaucé, l’avons soulagé de ses maux et lui avons rendu sa famille au double afin d’en faire un modèle de patience pour Nos adorateurs.

renderings.arabic: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدۡرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

english.text: And [remember] Ishmael, Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl[37]; they were all steadfast.
english.footnotes: [37] Idrīs (Enoch); Dhul-Kifl (Ezekiel, or Isaiah).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne également Ismaël, Idriss, et Dhou Al-Kifl[15], qui tous se vouaient patiemment à Notre culte.
french.footnotes: [15] Qui, pour l’exégète tunisien Ibn ‘Achour, serait le prophète juif Abdias et pour d’autres, le prophète Ezéchiel.

renderings.arabic: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english.text: And We admitted them to Our mercy, for they were truly righteous.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous les avons admis dans Notre miséricorde. Ils étaient du nombre des vertueux.

renderings.arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبٗا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[38], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[39], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.
english.footnotes:
[38] Due to the disbelief of his people.
 [39] The darkness of the night, the sea, and the whale's belly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne aussi l’homme au poisson[16] qui, irrité, quitta son peuple sans connaître le sort que Nous lui réservions. Il implora alors dans les ténèbres[17] : « Il n’est de divinité en droit d’être adorée que Toi. Gloire à Toi ! Je me suis comporté en homme injuste ! »
french.footnotes:
[16] Le prophète Jonas qui, désespérant de convertir son peuple à la foi, le quitta sans en avoir reçu l’autorisation d’Allah. Après avoir pris place à bord d’une embarcation, il fut avalé par un poisson.
[17] Les ténèbres du ventre du poisson, ajoutées aux ténèbres de la mer, auxquelles s’ajoutent les ténèbres de la nuit, selon plus d’un commentateur.

renderings.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons exaucé et délivré de son affliction. C’est ainsi que Nous sauvons les croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ

english.text: And [remember] Zachariah, when he cried out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me childless, for You are the Best of Inheritors.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne également Zacharie qui adressa cette prière à son Seigneur : « Ne me laisse pas, Seigneur, sans héritier[18], bien que Tu sois le plus parfait des héritiers[19] ! »
french.footnotes:
[18] Sans un fils qui hérite de ma mission et préserve Ta religion.
[19] Le plus à même de préserver Ta religion après ma disparition.

renderings.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ وَأَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهُۥ زَوۡجَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَيَدۡعُونَنَا رَغَبٗا وَرَهَبٗاۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ

english.text: So We answered his prayer and gave him John, and made his wife fertile. They used to hasten in doing good deeds and used to call upon Us with hope and fear, and they were humble before Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons exaucé, lui faisant don de Jean après avoir rendu à son épouse sa fécondité. Tous s’empressaient d’accomplir le bien et Nous invoquaient pleins d’espoir et de crainte. Tous se soumettaient humblement à Notre volonté.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا وَٱبۡنَهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: And [remember Mary] who guarded her chastity; We breathed in her [garment] through Our Spirit [Gabriel] and made her and her son a sign for all people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mentionne aussi celle qui sut préserver sa chasteté[20] que Nous avons récompensée en insufflant en elle[21] de Notre Esprit[22], faisant d’elle et de son fils un signe pour l’humanité.
french.footnotes:
[20] La vierge Marie. Pour certains, l’expression « préserver sa chasteté » signifie qu’elle vécut loin du péché de la chair. Mais quel intérêt y aurait-il à attribuer à la sainte Marie une qualité partagée par la majorité des femmes, en particulier dans la société où elle vivait. D’aucuns expliquent donc que cette formule sert à innocenter la mère de Jésus des odieuses accusations portées contre elle. Mais comment expliquer alors le lien qui semble être établi entre sa vie pleine de chasteté et son élection. D’autres expliquent donc que le choix divin s’est porté sur Marie car elle avait fait vœu de chasteté ou tout au moins choisi de rester chaste, que ce soit dans le cadre du mariage, les textes chrétiens lui attribuant un époux, Joseph, ou à travers le célibat.
[21] Par l’intermédiaire de l’ange Gabriel.
[22] Ou : de Notre souffle de vie.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ

english.text: Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me alone.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Telle est votre religion[23], la seule véritable religion. Je suis votre Seigneur, vouez-Moi donc un culte exclusif et sincère.
french.footnotes: [23] Celle de tous les prophètes mentionnés précédemment et qui consiste à n’adorer que le Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيۡنَا رَٰجِعُونَ

english.text: But people have divided themselves into sects, yet they will all return to Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais les hommes se sont ensuite divisés en sectes. C’est à Nous cependant qu’ils feront tous retour sans exception.

renderings.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ

english.text: Whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer, his efforts will not be denied[40], for We are recording them all.
english.footnotes: [40] i.e., He will not be deprived of his due reward.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui, mû par la foi, accomplira de bonnes actions ne sera jamais privé de la récompense de ses œuvres que Nous consignons, au contraire, avec la plus grande précision.

renderings.arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: It is not possible for any town that We have destroyed to ever come back [to this world][41],
english.footnotes: [41] To repent to Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est impossible que les habitants d’une cité que Nous avons anéantie reviennent à la vie[24].
french.footnotes: [24] Ou : il est impossible que les habitants d’une cité que Nous avons décidé d’anéantir reviennent de leur égarement.

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَأۡجُوجُ وَمَأۡجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٖ يَنسِلُونَ

english.text: until when Gog and Magog are let loose, swarming swiftly from every mound,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais lorsque le barrage dressé devant Gog et Magog aura cédé, les laissant déferler de toute hauteur,

renderings.arabic: وَٱقۡتَرَبَ ٱلۡوَعۡدُ ٱلۡحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبۡصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: when the True Promise[42] draws near, the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror, [saying], “Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers.”
english.footnotes: [42] i.e., the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: la promesse du Seigneur sera sur le point de s’accomplir[25]. Les mécréants, regards figés de terreur, s’écrieront alors : « Malheur à nous ! Nous avons vécu dans l’insouciance de ce Jour. Pire, nous avons été injustes envers nous-mêmes. »
french.footnotes: [25] L’avènement de l’Heure sera tout proche.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ

english.text: Indeed, you and all that you worship besides Allah will be the fuel for Hell; you will surely enter it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous et les fausses divinités que vous adorez en dehors d’Allah servirez de combustible à la Géhenne où vous serez tous précipités.

renderings.arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةٗ مَّا وَرَدُوهَاۖ وَكُلّٞ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: If these [idols] had truly been gods, they would not have entered it. But they will all abide therein forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si ces idoles étaient de vraies divinités, elles ne seraient pas condamnées à y entrer. Mais celles-ci et leurs adorateurs sont voués pour l’éternité à l’Enfer

renderings.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرٞ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ

english.text: They will groan therein with anguish, and they will not be able to hear anything.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où ces derniers pousseront d’horribles soupirs et ne pourront rien entendre[26].
french.footnotes: [26] Compte tenu des affres qu’ils devront subir.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُونَ

english.text: But those for whom We have decreed the finest reward, they will be far away from it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux que Nous avons prédestinés à une éternelle félicité, ils seront tenus éloignés de l’Enfer

renderings.arabic: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَاۖ وَهُمۡ فِي مَا ٱشۡتَهَتۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: They will not hear its slightest hissing, and they will abide forever in whatever their souls desire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dont ils n’entendront pas même le tumulte, jouissant au contraire de tout ce qu’ils désireront pour l’éternité.

renderings.arabic: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ ٱلۡفَزَعُ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ

english.text: They will not be grieved by the Greatest Terror[43], and the angels will receive them [saying], “This is your Day that you were promised”.
english.footnotes: [43] i.e., the events of the Day of Resurrection.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ne seront pas terrorisés par les affres de ce Jour, mais accueillis au Paradis par les anges qui leur diront : « Voici le Jour qui vous était promis. »

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِۚ كَمَا بَدَأۡنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلۡقٖ نُّعِيدُهُۥۚ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

english.text: On the Day when We roll up the heavens like a scroll of records. Just as We originated the first creation, so We will bring it back. That is Our binding promise, which We will surely do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De même que Nous avons procédé à la première Création, Nous la recommencerons le Jour où Nous plierons le ciel comme le scribe replie un parchemin. Voici une promesse que Nous nous sommes fait un devoir d’honorer et que Nous ne manquerons pas d’accomplir.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ أَنَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ

english.text: We have written in the Psalms[44] after the Preserved Record[45], that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.
english.footnotes:
[44] i.e., the Scriptures.
 [45] i.e., after inscribing it in al-Lawh al-Mahfūz.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons écrit dans les Psaumes, après l’avoir mentionné dans les Ecritures[27], que la terre[28] sera héritée par Mes serviteurs vertueux.
french.footnotes:
[27] Il s’agit, selon certains commentateurs, de ce passage des Psaumes : « Les justes posséderont le pays où ils demeureront à jamais. » (Psaumes 37, 29)
[28] Du Paradis, précisent nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغٗا لِّقَوۡمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ

english.text: Indeed, there is a message in this [Qur’an] for devoted worshipers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est, en vérité, dans le Coran des enseignements bien suffisants pour des hommes disposés à Nous adorer.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a mercy to the worlds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne t’avons suscité que par miséricorde pour l’humanité.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ

english.text: Say, “It is only revealed to me that your God is only One God; will you then submit to Him?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Il m’est seulement révélé que votre Dieu est un dieu unique. Etes-vous donc disposés à vous soumettre à Sa volonté ? »

renderings.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُلۡ ءَاذَنتُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٖۖ وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ

english.text: But if they turn away, say, “I have proclaimed the message to you all alike[46], and I do not know whether what you are warned of[47] is near or far.
english.footnotes:
[46] i.e., We and you know that there is no peace between us.
 [47] i.e., the punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’ils se détournent, dis-leur : « Je vous ai avertis sans que nul ne soit privilégié et sans rien vous dissimuler de ce qui m’a été révélé[29]. Mais j’ignore si le châtiment dont vous êtes menacés est proche ou éloigné.
french.footnotes: [29] Nous sommes donc tous pareillement avertis du danger qui nous attend si nous désobéissons au Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُونَ

english.text: Indeed, He knows what is said openly and knows what you conceal.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah sait aussi bien ce que vous dissimulez que ce que vous exprimez.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِي لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتۡنَةٞ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: I do not know; perhaps this [delay][48] is a test for you[49] and an enjoyment for a while.”
english.footnotes:
[48] i.e., this postponement of punishment.
 [49] To increase sin.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je ne sais si ce sursis qui vous est accordé est une épreuve ou simplement une jouissance de courte durée. »

renderings.arabic: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

english.text: [The Prophet] said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Compassionate Whose help is to be sought against what you describe[50].”
english.footnotes: [50] i.e., of lies and disbelief.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Prophète dit : « Veuille, Seigneur, trancher en toute équité le différend qui nous oppose ! C’est notre Seigneur, le Tout Miséricordieux, que nous appelons à l’aide contre vos mensonges et votre impiété ! »

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ إِنَّ زَلۡزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَيۡءٌ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: O people, fear your Lord; the earthquake of the Hour is something dreadful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ô hommes ! Craignez votre Seigneur. Les affres et le tremblement qui accompagneront l’Heure sont terrifiants.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَوۡنَهَا تَذۡهَلُ كُلُّ مُرۡضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرۡضَعَتۡ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمۡلٍ حَمۡلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰرَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٞ

english.text: On the Day when you see it, every nursing mother will abandon her baby, and every pregnant woman will miscarry. You will see people as though they are drunk, while they are not drunk, but the punishment of Allah is severe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour où vous devrez les affronter, toute mère en oubliera le nourrisson qu’elle sera en train d’allaiter et toute femme enceinte mettra bas l’enfant qu’elle portera en son sein. Et les hommes sembleront ivres alors qu’il n’en sera rien[1], car le châtiment d’Allah est terrible.
french.footnotes: [1] Ils seront simplement ivres d’épouvante.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّرِيدٖ

english.text: There are some people who dispute concerning Allah without knowledge, and they follow every rebellious devil.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est des hommes qui discutent au sujet d’Allah sans aucune connaissance, suivant simplement les suggestions de tout démon rebelle.

renderings.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهۡدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

english.text: It has been decreed that whoever takes him as an ally, he will misguide him and lead him to the punishment of the Blazing Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, il a été décrété que le démon égarerait quiconque le prendrait pour maître, le conduisant ainsi vers le châtiment du Brasier.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡبَعۡثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٖ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضۡغَةٖ مُّخَلَّقَةٖ وَغَيۡرِ مُخَلَّقَةٖ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلٗا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡلَا يَعۡلَمَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ عِلۡمٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَتَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ هَامِدَةٗ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡ وَأَنۢبَتَتۡ مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ

english.text: O people, if you are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then We surely created you[1] from dust, then from a drop of sperm[2], then from a clot[3], then from a lump of flesh[4] – formed or unformed[5] – so that We may make it clear to you [Our power]. We settle in the wombs whatever We will for an appointed term. Then We bring you out as infants, then [We nurture you] so that you may reach your maturity. Then some of you die, while others are left to reach decrepit old age so that they may know nothing after having knowledge. You see the land lifeless, then as soon as We send down rain on it, it stirs and swells to life and brings forth every type of pleasant plant.
english.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Your father, Adam. [2] Nutfah: zygote, which is resulted from the union of male and female gametes (sperm and egg).
 [3] ‘Alaqah: a clinging clot, which resembles a leech. [4] Mudghah: a chewed piece of meat.
 [5] i.e., formed ending into a healthy embryo, or defective ending in miscarriage.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ô hommes ! Si vous avez des doutes au sujet de la Résurrection, alors sachez que Nous vous avons créés[2] de terre, puis[3] d’un liquide insignifiant, puis d’un corps s’accrochant à la matrice de la femme[4] qui se transforme lui-même en une masse de chair[5] qui, petit à petit, prend forme humaine. Nous vous montrons ainsi Notre toute-puissance. Nous maintenons jusqu’au terme de la grossesse tel embryon dans la matrice d’où Nous le faisons sortir à l’état de nourrisson afin qu’il atteigne par la suite sa pleine maturité. Certains parmi vous meurent avant cela, tandis que d’autres tombent dans la sénilité, finissant par oublier tout ce qu’ils avaient appris. On peut voir de même la terre morte et desséchée se gonfler et reprendre vie dès que Nous l’avons arrosée de pluie, se couvrant d’une végétation variée et agréable à regarder.
french.footnotes:
[2] Entendons : Nous avons créé votre ancêtre, Adam.
[3] Ses descendants.
[4] Il peut s’agir de l’œuf qui, comme l’a établi la médecine moderne, « s’accroche » lors de la nidation à la paroi utérine au moyen de villosités. Précisons toutefois que la plupart des exégètes musulmans parlent d’un « caillot de sang. »
[5] L’embryon. Littéralement : une bouchée de chair ou de la chair mâchée. Or, à un certain stade de son développement, l’embryon a bien cet aspect de « chair mâchée » si bien décrit dans le Coran.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

english.text: That is because Allah is the Truth; He alone gives life to the dead, and He is the Most Capable of all things.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en est ainsi parce qu’Allah est la véritable divinité et qu’Il est Celui qui redonnera vie aux morts et qui a pouvoir sur toute chose,

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٞ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡعَثُ مَن فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ

english.text: The Hour is certainly coming; there is no doubt about it, and Allah will surely resurrect those who are in the graves.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que l’Heure sonnera inéluctablement et qu’Allah ressuscitera les morts dans leurs tombes.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ

english.text: There are some people who argue about Allah without knowledge, guidance or an enlightening scripture.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est des hommes qui discutent au sujet d’Allah sans le moindre argument, sans la plus petite preuve et sans se référer à des Ecritures susceptibles de les éclairer.

renderings.arabic: ثَانِيَ عِطۡفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ لَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ

english.text: They turn their faces away [in arrogance] to lead people away from Allah’s way. For them there will be disgrace in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make them taste the punishment of the burning fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Poussés par l’orgueil, ils se détournent de la vérité et éloignent les autres de la religion d’Allah. Ils seront couverts d’humiliation en ce monde, avant que Nous leur infligions, le Jour de la résurrection, le châtiment du Feu.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ

english.text: “This is because of what your hands have sent forth, and Allah is not unjust to His slaves.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Voilà la juste rétribution du mal que tu as commis durant ta vie », sera-t-il dit à l’un d’entre eux. Car Allah ne saurait être injuste envers Ses serviteurs.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعۡبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرۡفٖۖ فَإِنۡ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيۡرٌ ٱطۡمَأَنَّ بِهِۦۖ وَإِنۡ أَصَابَتۡهُ فِتۡنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

english.text: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][6]: if something good comes to them, they are content; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they turn back[7], thus losing both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.
english.footnotes:
[6] i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy, or heedlessness.
 [7] lit., they tumble on their faces, i.e., turn back to disbelief.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est aussi des hommes dont la foi en Allah est chancelante[6]. S’ils jouissent du bonheur, ils demeurent sereinement attachés à la foi, mais s’ils subissent un malheur, ils font volte-face pour retourner à l’impiété, provoquant ainsi leur ruine ici-bas et dans l’au-delà. Est-il ruine plus évidente ?
french.footnotes: [6] Ils restent à la marge de l’islam auquel ils n’ont jamais franchement adhéré.

renderings.arabic: يَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ

english.text: They invoke besides Allah what can neither harm nor benefit them. That is the farthest misguidance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils invoquent, en dehors d’Allah, des divinités qui ne peuvent ni leur nuire, ni leur être d’aucune utilité. Peut-on être plus éloigné de la vérité ?

renderings.arabic: يَدۡعُواْ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقۡرَبُ مِن نَّفۡعِهِۦۚ لَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡعَشِيرُ

english.text: They invoke those whose harm is more likely than their benefit. What a terrible protector and what a terrible associate!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils invoquent des dieux qui leur nuisent bien plus sûrement qu’ils ne leur sont utiles. Quels misérables protecteurs et quels odieux compagnons !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ

english.text: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. Allah surely does what He wills.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant aux croyants qui accomplissent de bonnes œuvres, Allah les admettra dans des jardins traversés de rivières. Allah agit toujours comme Il l’entend.

renderings.arabic: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لۡيَقۡطَعۡ فَلۡيَنظُرۡ هَلۡ يُذۡهِبَنَّ كَيۡدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ

english.text: Whoever thinks that Allah will never help His Prophet in this world and the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope to the ceiling and strangle himself, then let him see if his effort can remove what enrages him[8].
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., Allah will never stop supporting His Prophet (ﷺ), no matter what the disbelievers do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui pense qu’Allah ne fera pas triompher Son prophète ici-bas et dans l’au-delà peut toujours attacher une corde au plafond de sa maison et s’y pendre. Il verra si son geste est de nature à dissiper sa rage.
