renderings.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهۡدِي مَن يُرِيدُ

english.text: This is how We sent down this [Qur’an] as clear verses, and Allah guides whom He wills.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous avons révélé le Coran sous forme de versets parfaitement clairs par lesquels Nous guidons qui Nous voulons.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلۡمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ

english.text: Indeed, those who believe, those who are Jews, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians[9] and those who associate partners with Allah – Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; Allah is Witness over all things.
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., Zoroastrians; fire-worshippers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les croyants, les juifs, les sabéens, les chrétiens, les mazdéens et les païens, tous seront jugés et départagés par Allah le Jour de la résurrection. Allah est témoin de toute chose.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسۡجُدُۤ لَهُۥۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكۡرِمٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ۩

english.text: Do you not see that to Allah prostrate[10] all those who are in the heavens and all those on earth: the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures, and many humans? But there are many to whom the punishment has become due[11]. Whoever Allah disgraces, none can honor him. Allah surely does what He wills.
english.footnotes:
[10] i.e., all things submit to Allah's Will.
 [11] Because they did not submit to Allah's Will.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne sais-tu pas que devant Allah se prosternent toutes les créatures qui peuplent les cieux et la terre, de même que le soleil, la lune, les étoiles, les montagnes, les arbres, les animaux et une grande partie des hommes, tandis que beaucoup d’autres sont voués au châtiment[7] ? Quiconque est humilié par Allah ne saurait être honoré. Allah agit toujours comme Il le veut.
french.footnotes: [7] Tous les éléments de la Création sont soumis à la volonté et aux lois d’Allah. Par conséquent, tous se prosternent à leur manière devant le Seigneur de l’univers, y compris les impies qui néanmoins refusent de poser leur front à terre en signe de soumission à leur Créateur, ce qui leur vaudra le châtiment et l’humiliation mentionnés dans la suite du verset. Car quiconque refuse de s’humilier volontairement devant Allah en se prosternant devant Lui sera immanquablement rabaissé par Lui.

renderings.arabic: ۞ هَٰذَانِ خَصۡمَانِ ٱخۡتَصَمُواْ فِي رَبِّهِمۡۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قُطِّعَتۡ لَهُمۡ ثِيَابٞ مِّن نَّارٖ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوۡقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيمُ

english.text: These are two opponents[12] who are in dispute about their Lord. As for the disbelievers, garments of Fire will be tailored for them, and scalding water will be poured over their heads,
english.footnotes: [12] i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce sont là deux groupes[8] en opposition au sujet de leur Seigneur. Aux mécréants seront taillés des vêtements de feu, tandis que sur leurs têtes sera déversée une eau bouillante
french.footnotes: [8] Celui des croyants et celui des mécréants.

renderings.arabic: يُصۡهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمۡ وَٱلۡجُلُودُ

english.text: melting all that is in their bellies and their skins.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui fera fondre leurs entrailles et leurs peaux.

renderings.arabic: وَلَهُم مَّقَٰمِعُ مِنۡ حَدِيدٖ

english.text: And for [striking] them there will be maces of iron.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils seront de surcroît frappés à coups de maillets en fer.

renderings.arabic: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنۡهَا مِنۡ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ

english.text: Every time, in their anguish, they try to get out of it, they will be forced back into it, “Taste the burning punishment!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Chaque fois que, de détresse, ils tenteront d’en sortir, ils y seront ramenés et s’entendront dire : « Goûtez le supplice du feu de l’Enfer ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيهَا مِنۡ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٖ وَلُؤۡلُؤٗاۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمۡ فِيهَا حَرِيرٞ

english.text: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. They will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments will be of silk.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant aux croyants qui accomplissent de bonnes œuvres, Allah les admettra dans des jardins traversés de rivières où ils seront parés de bracelets en or et de perles, et vêtus de soie.

renderings.arabic: وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ

english.text: They were guided to the best of words[13] and they were guided to the praiseworthy path[14].
english.footnotes:
[13] i.e., the testimony of faith, extolling and praising Allah.
 [14] i.e., Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A ces croyants furent inspirées les plus belles paroles[9] et ils furent guidés vers la religion du Seigneur digne de toutes les louanges.
french.footnotes: [9] Ici-bas, en particulier l’attestation qu’il n’y a de divinité digne d’être adorée qu’Allah. Leur seront également inspirées de belles paroles au Paradis, notamment des louanges.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلۡنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلۡعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلۡبَادِۚ وَمَن يُرِدۡ فِيهِ بِإِلۡحَادِۭ بِظُلۡمٖ نُّذِقۡهُ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

english.text: As for those who disbelieve and prevent people from Allah’s way and from the Sacred Mosque[15] – which We have made for all people, residents and visitors alike – and whoever intends to deviate therein[16] by evildoing, We will cause him to taste a painful punishment.
english.footnotes: [15] In Makkah. [16] As the Sacred Mosque is unique, so mere intention of sin therein is sufficient to bring Allah's punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui rejettent la foi, détournent les hommes de la religion d’Allah et interdisent aux croyants l’accès à la Mosquée sacrée que Nous avons établie pour tous les hommes, ceux qui y résident comme ceux qui y sont de passage, à ceux donc qui seraient tentés d’y commettre une injustice, Nous infligerons un douloureux châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ بَوَّأۡنَا لِإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ أَن لَّا تُشۡرِكۡ بِي شَيۡـٔٗا وَطَهِّرۡ بَيۡتِيَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلۡقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ

english.text: And [remember] when We showed to Abraham the site of the House [Ka‘bah], “Do not associate anything with Me, and purify My House for those who circumambulate it, and those who stand up in prayer, and those who bow and prostrate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en effet, désigné à Abraham l’emplacement de la Demeure sacrée en lui ordonnant de la bâtir à Notre seule gloire et d’en faire un sanctuaire préservé de toute idolâtrie et réservé exclusivement à ceux qui viendront y accomplir les circuits rituels, s’y tenir debout, s’y incliner et s’y prosterner en prière.

renderings.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِي ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَجِّ يَأۡتُوكَ رِجَالٗا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٖ يَأۡتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٖ

english.text: And proclaim the pilgrimage to all people; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel from every distant pathway,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous lui avons ordonné d’appeler les hommes à venir y accomplir le pèlerinage à pied ou sur toute monture efflanquée, en provenance des contrées les plus éloignées,

renderings.arabic: لِّيَشۡهَدُواْ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمۡ وَيَذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ فِيٓ أَيَّامٖ مَّعۡلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِۖ فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا وَأَطۡعِمُواْ ٱلۡبَآئِسَ ٱلۡفَقِيرَ

english.text: so that they may attain benefits[17], and pronounce Allah’s name during the appointed days over the sacrificial animals[18] that He has provided for them; then eat from it and feed the desperately poor.
english.footnotes:
[17] Spiritual benefits such as getting rewards and forgiveness of sins, as well as worldly benefits such as witnessing the unity of Muslims, trading and etc.
 [18] An‘ām: such as camels, cattle, sheep and goats.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin de bénéficier des bienfaits du pèlerinage et d’invoquer, en des jours déterminés, le nom d’Allah au moment de sacrifier les bêtes qu’Il leur a attribuées. Mangez donc une partie de leur viande et nourrissez-en les pauvres dans le besoin.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ لۡيَقۡضُواْ تَفَثَهُمۡ وَلۡيُوفُواْ نُذُورَهُمۡ وَلۡيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ

english.text: Then let them complete their rites, fulfill their vows, and circumambulate the Ancient House [Ka‘bah].”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’ils accomplissent l’ensemble des rites du pèlerinage et tous leurs vœux avant d’effectuer les circuits rituels autour de l’antique Demeure.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦۗ وَأُحِلَّتۡ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلرِّجۡسَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَوۡثَٰنِ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ قَوۡلَ ٱلزُّورِ

english.text: Such [is the pilgrimage]; whoever honors the sacred rituals of Allah, it is best for him with his Lord. All sacrificial animals have been made lawful for you except what is recited to you[19]. So shun the impurity of idolatry and shun the words of falsehood.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tels sont les rites prescrits. Or, quiconque observe les rites sacrés institués par Allah en obtiendra la récompense auprès de son Seigneur. Le bétail vous est licite à l’exception de ce qui vous a déjà été mentionné. Fuyez donc la souillure des idoles et fuyez toute parole blasphématoire.

renderings.arabic: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيۡرَ مُشۡرِكِينَ بِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخۡطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيۡرُ أَوۡ تَهۡوِي بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٖ سَحِيقٖ

english.text: Be exclusively devoted to Allah, associating no partners with Him. Whoever associates partners with Allah, it is as if he has fallen from the sky and has been snatched away by birds or swept away by the wind to a far-off place.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vouez, au contraire, un culte exclusif et sincère à Allah sans rien Lui associer. Quiconque, en effet, associe de fausses divinités à Allah est à l’image de celui qui, tombant du ciel, serait happé au vol et déchiqueté par des oiseaux de proie ou projeté par une violente tempête en de lointaines contrées.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقۡوَى ٱلۡقُلُوبِ

english.text: This is so. And whoever honors the rituals of Allah, it is from the piety of the hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici donc ce qui vous est prescrit. Quiconque respecte les rites institués par Allah et les bêtes destinées au sacrifice témoigne ainsi que son cœur est rempli de la crainte du Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ

english.text: There are benefits for you in these [sacrificial animals] for an appointed term[20], then their place of sacrifice is near the Ancient House[21].
english.footnotes:
[20] Such as milking and riding them until the time of sacrifice.
 [21] i.e., within the precincts of the Haram, which includes Mina.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous pouvez en disposer[10] jusqu’au moment où elles seront immolées auprès de l’antique Demeure.
french.footnotes: [10] Des bêtes vouées au sacrifice qu’il est donc possible par exemple de monter ou de traire.

renderings.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكٗا لِّيَذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِۗ فَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسۡلِمُواْۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُخۡبِتِينَ

english.text: For every community We ordained rites of sacrifice[22] so that they may mention the name of Allah over the sacrificial animals that He has provided for them. Your God is One God, so submit to Him alone, and give glad tidings to the humble,
english.footnotes: [22] Rites of sacrifice have always been part of Allah's religion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons assigné à chaque communauté un rite sacrificiel afin que ses membres invoquent le nom d’Allah au moment d’immoler les bêtes du cheptel qu’Il leur a attribuées. Votre Dieu est un dieu unique. Soumettez-vous donc à Ses commandements. Fais heureuse annonce à ceux qui Lui obéissent humblement,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمۡ وَٱلۡمُقِيمِي ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ

english.text: those whose hearts are filled with awe when Allah is mentioned, and those who patiently endure whatever may befall them, and who establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided for them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux dont les cœurs frémissent de peur à la seule évocation du Seigneur, qui supportent patiemment les épreuves qu’ils subissent, accomplissent assidûment la prière et offrent par charité une partie de ce que Nous leur avons accordé.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡبُدۡنَ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا خَيۡرٞۖ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَا صَوَآفَّۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتۡ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا وَأَطۡعِمُواْ ٱلۡقَانِعَ وَٱلۡمُعۡتَرَّۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرۡنَٰهَا لَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: We have ordained the sacrificial camels [and cattle] among the rituals of Allah, in which there is much good for you. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are lined up, then when they fall down on their sides, eat of them and feed those [poor] who do not beg and those who do. Thus We have made them subservient to you, so that you may be grateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons fait pour vous des chamelles des bêtes sacrificielles où vous trouvez bien des avantages. Prononcez donc sur elles le nom d’Allah lorsqu’elles sont sur le point d’être immolées. Puis, lorsqu’elles gisent sans vie sur le flanc, vous pouvez vous nourrir de leur chair sans oublier d’en distribuer une partie aux nécessiteux qui s’abstiennent de quémander comme aux mendiants. Nous vous les avons ainsi soumises afin que vous vous montriez reconnaissants.

renderings.arabic: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ مِنكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمۡ لِتُكَبِّرُواْ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمۡۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

english.text: It is neither their flesh nor their blood that reaches Allah, but it is your piety that reaches Him. This is how He has subjected them to you, so that you may proclaim Allah’s greatness for having guided you. And give glad tidings to those who do good.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ni leur chair, ni leur sang ne parviendront à Allah. Seules Lui parviennent les œuvres que vous accomplissez dans le but de Lui plaire. C’est ainsi qu’Allah a mis ces bêtes à votre disposition afin que vous Le glorifiiez[11] pour vous avoir guidés. Fais donc heureuse annonce aux adorateurs sincères du Seigneur.
french.footnotes: [11] Ou : afin que vous disiez : « Allahou akbar » au moment de sacrifier ces bêtes.

renderings.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٖ كَفُورٍ

english.text: Indeed, Allah defends those who believe, and Allah does not like every treacherous and ungrateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah protégera toujours les croyants contre leurs ennemis. Allah n’aime pas les hommes sans fidélité et sans foi.

renderings.arabic: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ظُلِمُواْۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصۡرِهِمۡ لَقَدِيرٌ

english.text: Permission [to fight] is given to those who are attacked[23] because they were oppressed, and Allah is indeed Most Capable of granting them victory,
english.footnotes: [23] it is referring to the Prophet's Companions.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui sont attaqués sont à présent autorisés à repousser par les armes l’injustice dont ils sont victimes, bien qu’Allah soit parfaitement capable de les défendre,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخۡرِجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيۡرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُۗ وَلَوۡلَا دَفۡعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لَّهُدِّمَتۡ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٞ وَصَلَوَٰتٞ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذۡكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرٗاۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

english.text: those who have been driven out of their homes for no reason other than they say, “Our Lord is Allah.” If Allah were not to repel some people by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is often mentioned. Allah surely helps those who stand up for His cause. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui ont été chassés de leurs foyers sans droit[12], simplement pour avoir proclamé que leur Seigneur est Allah. Si Allah ne repoussait pas une partie des hommes par une autre, combien de monastères auraient été détruits, combien d’églises, de synagogues et de mosquées où le nom d’Allah est souvent invoqué. Allah, qui est Fort et Tout-Puissant, fera assurément triompher ceux qui défendent Sa cause,
french.footnotes: [12] Les musulmans de la Mecque contraints à s’exiler à Médine.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُواْ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَنَهَوۡاْ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

english.text: It is those who, if We give them power in the land, they establish prayer and give zakah, and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of all matters.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui, si Nous leur accordons le pouvoir sur terre, accomplissent la prière, s’acquittent de l’aumône, incitent les autres à la vertu et condamnent le vice. C’est Allah qui décide de l’issue de toute chose.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَثَمُودُ

english.text: If they reject you [O Prophet], the people of Noah, ‘Ād and Thamūd before them also rejected [their prophets],
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’ils te traitent d’imposteur, sache que le peuple de Noé, les ‘Ad et les Thamoud ont avant eux crié au mensonge,

renderings.arabic: وَقَوۡمُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ

english.text: as did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: de même que les peuples d’Abraham et de Loth,

renderings.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ مَدۡيَنَۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰۖ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

english.text: and the people of Midian. And Moses was [also] rejected. But I gave respite to the disbelievers, then I seized them. How severe was My response!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ainsi que les habitants de Madian. Moïse lui aussi fut traité de menteur. J’ai alors accordé un sursis aux impies dont Je me suis finalement saisi, manifestant ainsi Mon immense réprobation.

renderings.arabic: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٞ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئۡرٖ مُّعَطَّلَةٖ وَقَصۡرٖ مَّشِيدٍ

english.text: How many towns We have destroyed for their persistent wrongdoing, leaving them in total ruin[24]; their wells abandoned and their lofty palaces deserted!
english.footnotes: [24] Lit., "fallen upon its roofs," i.e., after the roofs of their buildings had caved in, the walls collapsed over them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de cités impies, aujourd’hui à l’état de ruine, avons-Nous anéanties ! Que de puits abandonnés ! Que de hauts palais solidement bâtis, mais aujourd’hui désertés !

renderings.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمۡ قُلُوبٞ يَعۡقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوۡ ءَاذَانٞ يَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعۡمَى ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعۡمَى ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِي فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ

english.text: Have they not traveled through the land so that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? It is not the eyes that turn blind, but it is the hearts within the breasts that turn blind.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’ont-ils pas, au cours de leurs voyages, prêté l’oreille au récit des peuples du passé et médité leur funeste destinée ? En réalité, ce ne sont pas les yeux qui sont frappés de cécité, mais bien les cœurs qui, dans les poitrines, sont aveugles à la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخۡلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ يَوۡمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلۡفِ سَنَةٖ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

english.text: They ask you to hasten the punishment, but Allah will not fail in His promise. A single day with your Lord is like one thousand years by your count.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils te pressent, par défi, de hâter le châtiment dont ils sont menacés. Mais Allah mettra assurément Ses menaces à exécution. Or, un jour pour ton Seigneur équivaut à mille ans selon votre notion du temps[13].
french.footnotes: [13] Ou : votre manière de compter.

renderings.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَمۡلَيۡتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٞ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهَا وَإِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

english.text: How many towns did I give respite when they were wrongdoers, and then I seized them. And to Me is the final return.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A combien de cités impies ai-Je accordé un sursis avant de M’en saisir ? C’est à Moi que les hommes feront retour.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: Say, “O people, I am only sent to you as a clear warner.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Ô hommes ! J’ai uniquement pour mission de vous avertir clairement. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ

english.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a generous provision.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui croient et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres obtiendront le pardon de leurs péchés et des dons généreux.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡاْ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

english.text: But those who strive to discredit Our verses[25], they are the people of the Blazing Fire.”
english.footnotes: [25] In order to defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui, persuadés de pouvoir Nous échapper, s’emploient à réfuter Nos signes, ils sont voués au Brasier.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٖ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلۡقَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فِيٓ أُمۡنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلۡقِي ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحۡكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ

english.text: We did not send any messenger or prophet before you except that when he recited, Satan would cast into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah would abolish what Satan casts, then Allah would confirm His verses[26], for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english.footnotes: [26] By clarifying those misunderstood issues, thus removing thereby any doubt.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons envoyé avant toi ni Messager, ni prophète, qui n’ait récité ce qui lui était révélé sans que Satan n’ait tenté de semer la confusion dans sa récitation. Mais Allah repousse sans cesse les suggestions de Satan et préserve Ses versets[14]. Allah est Omniscient et infiniment Sage.
french.footnotes: [14] Autre sens : Nous n’avons envoyé avant toi ni Messager, ni prophète, sans que Satan n’ait tenté, par ses suggestions, de briser ses espoirs de voir son peuple croire en lui. Mais Allah repousse les suggestions de Satan et expose clairement Ses signes.

renderings.arabic: لِّيَجۡعَلَ مَا يُلۡقِي ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِي شِقَاقِۭ بَعِيدٖ

english.text: [That is] so that He may make what Satan casts a trial for those [hypocrites] whose hearts are sick[27] and those [disbelievers] whose hearts are hardened, for indeed the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
english.footnotes: [27] See footnote 2:10.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ces suggestions sataniques, Allah met à l’épreuve ceux dont les cœurs sont malades et endurcis par l’impiété. Les injustes s’opposent gravement à la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهِۦ فَتُخۡبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: And so that those who were given knowledge may know that this [Qur’an] is the truth from your Lord, so they may believe in it and their hearts may become humbled to it. Allah surely guides those who believe to the straight path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais Allah repousse ces suggestions afin que ceux qui ont reçu la science sachent que cette révélation est bien la vérité venant de ton Seigneur, qu’ils y adhèrent sereinement et que leurs cœurs s’y soumettent humblement. Allah guide toujours les croyants vers le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّنۡهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةً أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَقِيمٍ

english.text: Yet the disbelievers will persist in doubt about it until the Hour comes upon them suddenly or there comes upon them the punishment of a barren Day[28].
english.footnotes: [28] The Day of Resurrection is described here as ‘aqīm (barren), for it will terminate all forms of life on earth and no new day will be born thereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les impies ne cesseront de douter de l’authenticité du Coran jusqu’à ce qu’ils soient surpris par l’Heure ou saisis par le châtiment d’un jour funeste.

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english.text: The sovereignty on that Day belongs to Allah[29]; He will judge between them, then those who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Bliss.
english.footnotes: [29] Allah gives authority to some of His slaves in this world, but in the Hereafter none will have any authority except Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah disposera, ce Jour-là, de l’autorité suprême en vertu de laquelle Il jugera les hommes. Ceux qui auront cru et accompli de bonnes œuvres seront admis dans les jardins des délices,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

english.text: But those who disbelieve and reject Our verses, for them there will be a humiliating punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tandis que les mécréants qui auront rejeté Nos signes subiront un châtiment humiliant.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓاْ أَوۡ مَاتُواْ لَيَرۡزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

english.text: As for those who emigrate in the cause of Allah and are killed or died, Allah will surely give them a goodly provision. Indeed, Allah is the Best of Providers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui sont tués ou meurent après avoir émigré pour Allah seront comblés de faveurs par le Seigneur, le plus généreux des pourvoyeurs,

renderings.arabic: لَيُدۡخِلَنَّهُم مُّدۡخَلٗا يَرۡضَوۡنَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٞ

english.text: He will surely admit them to a place that they will be pleased with, and Allah is surely All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui les admettra en un lieu qui les enchantera. Allah, en vérité, est Omniscient et Longanime.

renderings.arabic: ۞ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَنۡ عَاقَبَ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيۡهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ

english.text: That is[30] so. Whoever retaliates against an aggressive act with its like and is wronged again, Allah will surely help him. Indeed, Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving[31].
english.footnotes:
[30] i.e., Allah's admitting of the Companions into Paradise.
 [31] In spite of His ability to take revenge, the verse contains a suggestion that the believers pardon and forgive as well.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en sera ainsi. Quiconque, injustement agressé, se fait justice à lui-même de manière proportionnée, puis subit une nouvelle agression, sera assisté par Allah[15]. Allah, en vérité, est Très Indulgent et Très Clément.
french.footnotes: [15] Allusion possible aux attaques lancées par les musulmans à partir de Médine contre les Mecquois qui, par leurs persécutions, les avaient poussés à l’exil.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ

english.text: That is[32] because it is Allah Who causes the night to merge into the day, and causes the day to merge into the night. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
english.footnotes: [32] i.e., Allah's capability to give assistance or victory to the oppressed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah, en effet, fait pénétrer la nuit dans le jour et le jour dans la nuit, et Il entend tout et voit tout[16].
french.footnotes: [16] Celui qui soumet ainsi toute la Création à Sa volonté est en mesure de faire triompher les croyants injustement agressés.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

english.text: That is[33] because it is Allah Who is the Truth and whatever they invoke besides Him is falsehood, and it is Allah Who is the Most High, the Most Great.
english.footnotes: [33] i.e., Allah's merging of the night into the day and the day into the night.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en est ainsi car Allah est la seule véritable divinité, tandis que ce qu’ils invoquent en dehors de Lui n’est que vanité, et qu’Allah est le Très Haut, le Très Grand.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَتُصۡبِحُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُخۡضَرَّةًۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ

english.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky whereupon the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware[34].
english.footnotes: [34] Of His creation and of the needs of His creatures.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas qu’Allah fait descendre du ciel une eau par laquelle la terre se couvre d’une végétation verdoyante ? Allah, en vérité, connaît les réalités les plus subtiles et les mieux cachées.

renderings.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

english.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, and indeed it is Allah Who is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il possède tout ce qui se trouve dans les cieux et sur la terre. Allah, en vérité, est Celui qui peut parfaitement se passer des hommes et qui est digne de toutes les louanges.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you all that is on the earth and the ships that sail through the sea by His command? He holds the sky from falling down on the earth except by His permission. Indeed, Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas qu’Allah vous a soumis tout ce qui se trouve sur terre, de même que les vaisseaux qui, par Sa volonté, voguent en mer ? Il retient le ciel qui, s’Il le permettait, s’effondrerait sur terre. Allah est, envers les hommes, infiniment Bon et Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ

english.text: It is He Who gave you life, then will cause you to die, then He will bring you back to life. Indeed, man is ever ungrateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui vous donne la vie, puis vous fait mourir et qui un jour vous fera revivre. L’homme, en vérité, est plein d’ingratitude.

renderings.arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكًا هُمۡ نَاسِكُوهُۖ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِۚ وَٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدٗى مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: For every community We ordained ways[35] of worship which they follow, so do not let them dispute with you [O Prophet] in this matter. But call them to your Lord, for you are indeed on the straight guidance.
english.footnotes: [35] All prophets came with the same message of worshiping only One God, doing good and shunning evil; nonetheless, each faith-community had their own law.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons assigné à chaque nation un culte particulier qu’elle se doit d’observer. Qu’ils ne s’opposent donc pas à toi au sujet des lois qui t’ont été révélées. Appelle les hommes à se conformer à la religion de ton Seigneur, car tu suis assurément le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: And if they argue with you, say, “Allah knows best what you are doing.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’ils persistent à te contredire, dis-leur : « Allah, qui connaît parfaitement vos agissements,

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ

english.text: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tranchera vos différends le Jour de la résurrection. »

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِي كِتَٰبٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ

english.text: Do you not know that Allah knows all that is in heaven and on earth? That is all [written] in a Record[36]. This is indeed easy for Allah.
english.footnotes: [36] i.e., the Preserved Tablet (al-Lawh al-Mahfūz).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne sais-tu pas qu’Allah a une parfaite connaissance de ce qui se trouve dans le ciel et sur la terre, tout étant consigné dans un livre[17] ? Voilà qui, pour Allah, est aisé.
french.footnotes: [17] Le Livre archétype.

renderings.arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗا وَمَا لَيۡسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٖ

english.text: Yet they worship other than Allah that for which He has not sent down any authority, and of which they have no knowledge. The wrongdoers will have no helper.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils adorent, en dehors d’Allah, de fausses divinités sans se fonder sur la moindre preuve révélée par Lui et sans que rien ne vienne établir le bien-fondé de leurs pratiques. Nul ne saurait sauver les injustes.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسۡطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَاۗ قُلۡ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرّٖ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُۚ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

english.text: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, you notice disgust on the faces of the disbelievers, as if they are about to attack those who recite Our verses to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something worse than what you feel at present[37]? It is the Fire! Allah has promised it to those who disbelieve; what a terrible destination!
english.footnotes: [37] i.e., worse than the rage you feel against the believers who recite Allah's verses or your threats against them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Nos versets, parfaitement clairs, leur sont récités, l’horreur est lisible sur les visages des négateurs. Peu s’en faut qu’ils ne se jettent sur ceux qui leur récitent Nos paroles. Dis-leur : « Vous indiquerais-je ce qui est plus en droit de susciter votre horreur ? Le Feu promis par Allah à ceux qui ont rejeté la foi. Et quelle infâme demeure !

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٞ فَٱسۡتَمِعُواْ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخۡلُقُواْ ذُبَابٗا وَلَوِ ٱجۡتَمَعُواْ لَهُۥۖ وَإِن يَسۡلُبۡهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيۡـٔٗا لَّا يَسۡتَنقِذُوهُ مِنۡهُۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلۡمَطۡلُوبُ

english.text: O people, a similitude is set forth, so listen to it: those whom you invoke besides Allah can never create even a fly, even if they all come together for that. And if a fly snatches something away from them, they cannot retrieve it. How feeble is the invoker as well as the invoked[38]!
english.footnotes: [38] i.e., How feeble are the seekers of the fly and how feeble is the fly!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ô hommes ! Une parabole vous est proposée, écoutez-la avec attention : les fausses divinités que vous invoquez en dehors d’Allah ne sauraient créer une simple mouche même si, pour cela, ils devaient unir leurs forces. Pire ! Si une mouche venait à leur enlever quelque chose, ils ne pourraient le lui reprendre. Celui qui est sollicité est aussi faible que celui qui le sollicite[18].
french.footnotes: [18] Autrement dit : le faux dieu est aussi faible que l’idolâtre qui l’invoque. Ou : l’idole est aussi faible que la mouche, puisqu’elle est incapable de lui reprendre quoi que ce soit.

renderings.arabic: مَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

english.text: They have not revered Allah the reverence He deserves[39]. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.
english.footnotes: [39] Because they worshiped others besides Him Almighty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les impies ne mesurent pas la vraie grandeur d’Allah qui, en vérité, est Fort et Tout-Puissant.

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَصۡطَفِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ

english.text: Allah chooses messengers from the angels and from mankind. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah choisit des messagers parmi les anges et les hommes. Allah entend tout et voit tout.

renderings.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

english.text: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them[40], and to Allah returns all matters.
english.footnotes: [40] Allah's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il sait ce qui se trouve devant eux comme ce qui se trouve derrière eux. C’est à Allah que tout doit revenir.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱرۡكَعُواْ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ وَٱفۡعَلُواْ ٱلۡخَيۡرَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ۩

english.text: O you who believe, bow down and prostrate, worship Your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous qui croyez ! Inclinez-vous et prosternez-vous en prière. Vouez à votre Seigneur un culte exclusif et sincère et faites le bien dans l’espoir de faire votre bonheur et votre salut.

renderings.arabic: وَجَٰهِدُواْ فِي ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦۚ هُوَ ٱجۡتَبَىٰكُمۡ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ مِنۡ حَرَجٖۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمۡ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَفِي هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَتَكُونُواْ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِۚ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ

english.text: Strive in the cause of Allah in a due manner. He has chosen you and has not imposed upon you any hardship in religion – the faith of your father Abraham. He named you as Muslims earlier and in this [Qur’an] so that the Messenger might be a witness over you and you might be witnesses over mankind. So establish prayer, give zakah, and hold fast to Allah, for He is your Protector; what an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Luttez de toutes vos forces pour la cause d’Allah. C’est Lui qui vous a choisis, ne vous imposant aucune gêne dans l’exercice de votre religion, celle de votre ancêtre Abraham. C’est Lui qui, dans les Ecritures précédentes, vous a désignés comme les « soumis », ainsi que dans ce Livre, afin que le Messager témoigne contre vous[19] et que vous portiez vous-mêmes témoignage contre les nations[20]. Accomplissez donc la prière, acquittez-vous de l’aumône et attachez-vous exclusivement à Allah en cherchant refuge auprès de Lui. Il est votre seul Maître. Quel bon Maître et quel puissant Protecteur !
french.footnotes:
[19] Qu’il vous a bien transmis le message.
[20] Que vous témoigniez, le Jour de la résurrection, que les prophètes leur ont bien transmis le message.

renderings.arabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: The believers have attained true success:
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Bienheureux sont les croyants, en vérité,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي صَلَاتِهِمۡ خَٰشِعُونَ

english.text: those who humble themselves in their prayers,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui prient avec recueillement et humilité,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَنِ ٱللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: and those who turn away from all that is vain,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: se détournent dignement de toute futilité,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ

english.text: and those who give zakah[1],
english.footnotes: [1] Zakah (lit.,) purification and growth. Paying alms purifies and increases wealth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: s’acquittent de l’aumône légale par charité,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ

english.text: and those who guard their sexual desires[2],
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., illegal sexual acts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et préservent vertueusement leur chasteté

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ

english.text: except with their wives or slave women they may own, for then they are free of blame.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: - n’ayant de rapports qu’avec leurs épouses ou leurs esclaves[1], auquel cas ils ne sauraient être blâmés,
french.footnotes: [1] Parmi les femmes.

renderings.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ

english.text: But whoever seeks anything beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: contrairement à ceux qui recherchent d’autres relations, qui seuls sont coupables de transgression -,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ

english.text: And those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui ne trompent jamais la confiance placée en eux, honorent fidèlement leurs engagements

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ

english.text: and those who properly observe their prayers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et accomplissent leurs prières assidûment.

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ

english.text: Such will be the inheritors,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce sont eux les héritiers

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: who will inherit Paradise[3]; they will abide therein forever.
english.footnotes: [3] Al-Firdaws: the highest rank in Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui hériteront les hauts lieux du Paradis où ils demeureront pour l’éternité.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٖ مِّن طِينٖ

english.text: We created man[4] from an extract of clay,
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., Adam (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, créé l’homme à partir d’une essence d’argile,

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُطۡفَةٗ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٖ

english.text: then We placed him as a sperm-drop[5] in a safe place,
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., a zygote.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: puis sa descendance d’un liquide insignifiant placé dans un réceptacle sûr[2].
french.footnotes: [2] La matrice de la femme.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلنُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةٗ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةٗ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظَٰمٗا فَكَسَوۡنَا ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ لَحۡمٗا ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُ خَلۡقًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ

english.text: then We made the sperm drop into a clinging clot, then We made the clinging clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We developed it into another creation[6]. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.
english.footnotes: [6] After breathing the spirit into the embryo.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous faisons ensuite de ce liquide un corps s’accrochant à la matrice[3], puis de ce dernier une masse de chair au sein de laquelle se forme le squelette que Nous revêtons finalement d’une masse musculaire avant d’en faire une créature différente[4]. Béni soit Allah, le Créateur par excellence !
french.footnotes:
[3] Voir notes verset 5, sourate 22.
[4] En y insufflant la vie, expliquent nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

english.text: Then after that you will surely die,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous serez ensuite appelés à mourir,

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُونَ

english.text: then on the Day of Resurrection, you will surely be resurrected.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: avant d’être rendus à la vie le Jour de la résurrection.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلۡخَلۡقِ غَٰفِلِينَ

english.text: We have created above you seven levels [of heaven], and We have never been unaware of Our creation.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons créé au-dessus de vous sept cieux superposés. Nous ne sommes jamais inattentif à la Création.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَسۡكَنَّٰهُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابِۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

english.text: We send down water from the sky in due measure and cause it to stay in the earth, and We are surely able to take it away.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous faisons descendre du ciel, dans une juste proportion, une eau que Nous maintenons sous terre, mais que Nous pourrions très bien faire disparaître.

renderings.arabic: فَأَنشَأۡنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ لَّكُمۡ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٞ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: With this [water] We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are many fruits from which you eat,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par cette eau, Nous faisons surgir de terre, pour vous, des palmeraies et des vignobles produisant toutes sortes de fruits dont vous vous nourrissez,

renderings.arabic: وَشَجَرَةٗ تَخۡرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٖ لِّلۡأٓكِلِينَ

english.text: and [olive] tree that grows at Mount Sinai, producing oil and condiments for those who eat.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ainsi qu’un arbre qui pousse sur le mont Sinaï[5] et qui donne une huile dont vous vous enduisez le corps et dans laquelle vous trempez votre pain.
french.footnotes: [5] Ou : né sur le mont Sinaï. Il s’agit de l’olivier.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةٗۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٞ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: And there is certainly a lesson for you in livestock animals. We provide you with a drink out of what they have in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and from their [meat] you eat,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous avez, en vérité, dans les bestiaux matière à méditer. Nous vous abreuvons de ce qui se trouve à l’intérieur de leur corps[6]. Vous en tirez bien d’autres avantages encore et vous vous nourrissez de leur chair.
french.footnotes: [6] Voir note verset 66, sourate 16.

renderings.arabic: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ

english.text: and on them and on boats you are carried.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils vous servent également de montures sur terre, de même que les vaisseaux vous transportent en mer.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english.text: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, envoyé Noé à son peuple auquel il dit : « Mon peuple, adorez Allah ! Vous n’avez d’autre divinité que Lui. Allez-vous donc finir par Le redouter ? »

renderings.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٗ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِيٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “This is only a man like yourselves who wants to be superior to you. If Allah had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard such a thing from our forefathers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les notables de son peuple, qui avaient rejeté la foi, dirent : « Ce n’est qu’un homme comme vous qui veut seulement s’élever au-dessus de vous. Si Allah l’avait voulu, Il aurait fait descendre des anges. Nous n’avons rien entendu de tel[7] chez nos ancêtres les plus éloignés.
french.footnotes: [7] Qu’un homme ait été envoyé comme Messager ou que seul Allah doive être adoré.

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلُۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٞ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: He is just a madman, so bear with him for a while[7].”
english.footnotes: [7] Perhaps he may recover from his insanity or his affair may become clear to people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce n’est, en vérité, qu’un possédé. Supportons-le quelque temps encore. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

english.text: Noah said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Noé dit : « Venge-moi, Seigneur, de ce peuple qui me traite d’imposteur ! »

renderings.arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ أَنِ ٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسۡلُكۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلّٖ زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ

english.text: So We inspired him [saying], “Make the Ark under Our Eyes and according to Our directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts with water[8], take on board a pair of each species and your family, except those against whom the decree has already been passed. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
english.footnotes: [8] Or the fountains of the earth gush forth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous lui avons révélé : « Construis l’Arche sous Nos yeux et selon Nos instructions. Puis le jour où, sur Notre ordre, l’eau se mettra à jaillir de toute la surface de la terre, tu embarqueras dans l’Arche un couple de chaque espèce, ainsi que ta famille - excepté ceux contre qui Notre arrêt a déjà été prononcé[8]. Et cesse d’intervenir en faveur de ces impies qui sont condamnés à périr engloutis.
french.footnotes: [8] La femme de Noé et l’un de ses fils, selon certains commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: Then when you and those who are with you have embarked on the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque tu auras pris place dans l’Arche avec ceux qui t’accompagnent, tu diras : « Louange à Allah qui nous a sauvés de ce peuple impie ! »

renderings.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلٗا مُّبَارَكٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ

english.text: And say: “My Lord, make my landing a blessed landing, for You provide the best landing’”.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu diras aussi : « Seigneur ! Fais-nous débarquer en une terre bénie. Car Toi seul peux nous faire arriver à bon port ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِينَ

english.text: Indeed, there are signs in this, and We always put people to the test.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà assurément des signes. C’est ainsi que Nous mettons les hommes à l’épreuve.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english.text: Then We raised up after them another generation[9],
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., the people of ‘Aad.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.
