french.text: Nous avons, à leur suite, suscité un autre peuple[9]
french.footnotes: [9] Le peuple des ‘Ad, selon certains, puisqu’il vécut immédiatement après le peuple de Noé, ou celui des Thamoud, selon d’autres, puisque ce sont les Thamoud qui furent « foudroyés » comme le décrit la fin de ce récit (verset 41).

renderings.arabic: فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِمۡ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english.text: and We sent to them a messenger[10] from among themselves [saying], “Worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., Prophet Hūd, who was sent to the people of ‘Aad.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: auquel Nous avons envoyé l’un des leurs comme Messager qui leur dit : « Adorez Allah ! Vous n’avez d’autre divinité que Lui. Allez-vous donc finir par Le redouter ? »

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَتۡرَفۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يَأۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُونَ

english.text: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made affluent in the life of this world, said, “He is no more than a man like yourselves; he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les notables de son peuple, qui avaient rejeté la foi et renié la rencontre d’Allah dans l’au-delà, et que Nous avions fait vivre dans le faste ici-bas, dirent : « Ce n’est là qu’un homme comme vous qui mange ce que vous mangez et boit ce que vous buvez.

renderings.arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَطَعۡتُم بَشَرٗا مِّثۡلَكُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ

english.text: If you obey a man like yourselves, you will surely be losers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous obéissez à un homme comme vous, vous serez certainement perdus.

renderings.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ إِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخۡرَجُونَ

english.text: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous annonce-t-il que, une fois morts et vos os réduits en poussière, vous serez rendus à la vie ?

renderings.arabic: ۞ هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

english.text: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are promised![11]
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., How distant and improbable is the resurrection!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Impensable ! Impensable qu’une telle menace puisse se réaliser !

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ

english.text: There is nothing except our life in this world; we die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’y a rien après la mort. Une génération disparaît, une autre naît. Nous ne serons jamais ressuscités.

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: He is no more than a man who has fabricated lies about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce n’est qu’un homme qui forge des mensonges en les attribuant à Allah. Jamais nous ne le croirons. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

english.text: Noah said, “My Lord, help me for they have rejected me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Messager implora : « Venge-moi, Seigneur, de ce peuple qui me traite d’imposteur ! »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٖ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ

english.text: Allah said, “In a little while they will surely be regretful.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah répondit : « Ils ne vont pas tarder à le regretter. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ غُثَآءٗۚ فَبُعۡدٗا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: So the huge blast[12] overtook them in all justice, and We swept them away like scum[13]. So away with the wrongdoing people!
english.footnotes:
[12] i.e., a piercing cry.
 [13] Ghutha’ literally means the froth thrown out by flood waters on the banks.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils furent donc foudroyés, châtiment amplement mérité. Nous les avons réduits à l’état de débris charriés par les torrents. Que les impies soient donc emportés !

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english.text: Then We raised after them other generations.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, à leur suite, suscité d’autres communautés.

renderings.arabic: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ

english.text: No nation can bring its appointed time forward, nor can it delay it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nul peuple n’est en mesure d’avancer ou de reculer le terme qui lui est assigné[10].
french.footnotes: [10] Pour son anéantissement.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةٗ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُۖ فَأَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُم بَعۡضٗا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَحَادِيثَۚ فَبُعۡدٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: every time a messenger came to his people, they rejected him. So We destroyed them, one after the others, and made them mere tales[14]. Away with the people who refuse to believe[15]!
english.footnotes:
[14] i.e., history or lessons for people.
 [15] i.e., those who refuse to believe in the messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons ensuite envoyé Nos Messagers les uns à la suite des autres. Chaque fois qu’un Messager était suscité à son peuple, ce dernier le traitait d’imposteur. Nous avons donc anéanti les peuples impies les uns après les autres, ne laissant d’eux que le récit de leur destruction. Que les mécréants soient donc emportés !

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ

english.text: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs[16] and compelling proof[17]
english.footnotes:
[16] Allah sent them both with nine clear signs or miracles: the staff turning into a snake, the bright hand, famine, shortage of crops, floods, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood.
 [17] i.e., compelling proof that they were Allah’s messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis Nous avons envoyé Moïse et son frère Aaron, assistés de Nos signes et de preuves d’une grande clarté,

renderings.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمًا عَالِينَ

english.text: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they showed arrogance and were haughty people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à Pharaon et aux grands d’Egypte qui, poussés par l’orgueil, les ont rejetés avec fierté.

renderings.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ

english.text: They said, “Should we believe in two men like ourselves when their people are our slaves?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Allons-nous croire en deux hommes comme nous dont le peuple nous est asservi ? »

renderings.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡلَكِينَ

english.text: So they rejected them both and were among those who were destroyed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pour les avoir traités l’un et l’autre de menteurs, ils furent anéantis.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: We gave Moses the Scripture so that they[18] might be guided.
english.footnotes: [18] i.e., the Children of Israel.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons confié à Moïse les Ecritures afin que son peuple soit guidé.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةٖ ذَاتِ قَرَارٖ وَمَعِينٖ

english.text: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign[19] and sheltered them on a hillside – a place of rest and a flowing stream[20].
english.footnotes:
[19] The miraculous birth of Jesus is clear proof of Allah's Omnipotence that Mary gave birth to him without male interference.
 [20] Other Prophets were rejected for being human beings; whereas, people went to two extremes regarding Jesus: some considered him as divine, while some others went to the other extreme by accusing Mary of unchastity, although they were witnesses of the miraculous birth of Jesus and had heard him speak in the cradle.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, par ailleurs, fait du fils de Marie et de sa mère un signe, et leur avons tous deux donné refuge sur une colline accueillante et baignée d’eau vive.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعۡمَلُواْ صَٰلِحًاۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ

english.text: O messengers[21], eat from the lawful things[22] and act righteously, for I am All-Knowing of what you do.
english.footnotes: [21] In this verse, all of the messengers have been addressed together, which indicates that they all belonged to the same community and their message was one. [22] They must be wholesome and earned in lawful ways.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Messagers ! Choisissez les nourritures les plus pures et accomplissez les œuvres les plus vertueuses. Je sais parfaitement ce que vous faites.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُونِ

english.text: Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion[23], and I am your Lord, so fear Me.
english.footnotes: [23] i.e., the religion of Islam, which is submission to the will of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Telle est votre religion, la seule véritable religion. Et Je suis votre Seigneur, craignez-Moi donc. »

renderings.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ

english.text: But people split up their religion into factions, each faction rejoicing in what it has[24].
english.footnotes: [24] Of beliefs, opinions, and customs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais leurs adeptes[11] se sont ensuite divisés en sectes, chacune satisfaite de la voie qu’elle a adoptée, persuadée de détenir la vérité.
french.footnotes: [11] Ceux qui ensuite se sont réclamés de ces prophètes tout en se détournant de leur voie.

renderings.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

english.text: So leave them in their heedlessness for a while.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse-les donc quelque temps à leur égarement.

renderings.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٖ وَبَنِينَ

english.text: Do they think that what We give them wealth and children,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Croient-ils que les richesses et les enfants que Nous leur accordons ici-bas

renderings.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۚ بَل لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ

english.text: that We hasten to them all that is good? No, but they do not perceive it[25].
english.footnotes: [25] They do not perceive that the good things given to them in this world are but a trial for them to increase in sin and disobedience.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: soient un avant-goût des bienfaits qu’ils recevront dans l’au-delà ? Non, mais ils ne savent pas qu’il s’agit simplement d’une épreuve.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ

english.text: Those who are in awe for fear of their Lord[26],
english.footnotes: [26] In spite of their faith and righteousness, they are in awe of their Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui sont remplis de crainte envers leur Seigneur

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: and those who believe in the verses of their Lord,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et croient fermement en Ses signes et aux versets qu’Il a révélés,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ

english.text: and those who do not associate partners with their Lord,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui se gardent de Lui associer de fausses divinités

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ رَٰجِعُونَ

english.text: and those who do whatever [good] they do with their hearts fearful[27], knowing that they will return to their Lord –
english.footnotes: [27] That their deeds may not be acceptable.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres tout en appréhendant de comparaître devant leur Seigneur sans avoir suffisamment œuvré pour être sauvés,

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ

english.text: it is they who hasten to do good deeds, and they are foremost in them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: voilà ceux qui s’empressent vers les bonnes actions qu’ils sont les premiers à réaliser.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتَٰبٞ يَنطِقُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

english.text: We do not burden a soul more than what it can bear. We have a Record [of their deeds][28] that tells the truth, and none will be wronged[29].
english.footnotes: [28] It records every word he utters and every act he does. [29] By wrongfully punishing someone or diminishing the reward of those who did good.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’imposons à une âme que ce qu’elle peut supporter. Auprès de Nous se trouve un livre qui énonce la vérité, sans que nul ne soit lésé[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Le registre des œuvres où tous les actes et toutes les paroles sont consignés, sans que rien n’en soit retranché ou n’y soit ajouté, expliquent nombre d’exégètes. Selon d’autres, il s’agirait du Livre archétype se trouvant auprès d’Allah.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلٞ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ

english.text: But their hearts are oblivious to this[30], and they have other [evil] deeds that they are doing.
english.footnotes: [30] They are heedless of the fact that everything they say or do is recorded in a Record, or that they are heedless of the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, les mécréants accueillent cette vérité avec insouciance et indifférence, ajouté à d’autres péchés qu’ils ne manqueront pas de perpétrer.

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهِم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُونَ

english.text: But as soon as We seize their affluent ones with punishment[31], they start crying for help.
english.footnotes: [31] On the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais lorsque Nous châtierons ceux d’entre eux qui vivaient dans le faste et l’opulence, ils crieront au secours.

renderings.arabic: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

english.text: “Do not cry for help today, for you will receive no help from Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Inutile, aujourd’hui, de crier au secours. Nul ne pourra vous mettre à l’abri de Notre châtiment.

renderings.arabic: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ تَنكِصُونَ

english.text: My verses were recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Mes versets vous étaient récités, vous préfériez vous en détourner,

renderings.arabic: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرٗا تَهۡجُرُونَ

english.text: feeling proud of this [Sacred House], spending night in evil talks [about the Qur’an].”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tirant fierté d’être les gardiens du Sanctuaire sacré autour duquel vous passiez pourtant vos soirées à prononcer des paroles impies et à renier la vérité[13]. »
french.footnotes: [13] Autre sens : lorsque Mes versets vous étaient récités, vous vous en détourniez fièrement, les reniant lors de vos veillées.

renderings.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ أَمۡ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمۡ يَأۡتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: Have they not pondered the Words [of Allah], or has there come to them what did not come to their forefathers?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’ont-ils pas médité la parole d’Allah ? Ou bien leur est-il venu une religion différente de celle reçue par leurs ancêtres les plus éloignés ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

english.text: Or is it that they do not recognize their Messenger, so they deny him?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien connaissent-ils si peu le Messager qui leur a été envoyé pour le renier ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةُۢۚ بَلۡ جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

english.text: Or do they say, “There is madness in him?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou alors prétendent-ils qu’il est possédé ? Non, il leur a seulement apporté la vérité. Mais la plupart d’entre eux ont en horreur la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

english.text: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the heavens and earth, and all those who are therein would have been ruined. In fact, We have given them their Reminder, but they are averse to their Reminder.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si la vérité devait se plier à leurs désirs, les cieux, la terre et tous ceux qui les peuplent seraient livrés au chaos. Nous leur avons, en réalité, apporté un message édifiant qui fera leur gloire et leur renommée, mais dont ils préfèrent se détourner.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجٗا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

english.text: Or do you ask them for some reward[32]? But the reward of your Lord is best[33], and He is the Best of Providers.
english.footnotes:
[32] Which did not actually happen.
 [33] This was another proof of the Prophet’s prophethood, for he was conveying the message without demanding any recompense for it; rather, he staked his peaceful life and relationships with his people for accomplishing his mission.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien leur réclames-tu une récompense ? Mais la récompense de ton Seigneur, le plus généreux des pourvoyeurs, est bien meilleure.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: Indeed, you are calling them to a straight path,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu ne fais, en vérité, qu’appeler les hommes à suivre le droit chemin,

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ

english.text: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from that path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: chemin dont s’écartent ceux qui ne croient pas en l’au-delà.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرّٖ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

english.text: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve their adversity[34], they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
english.footnotes: [34] It refers to the famine which occurred in Makkah some time after the advent of prophethood.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si, par miséricorde envers eux, Nous les avions délivrés de leurs souffrances, ils auraient persisté aveuglément dans l’impiété.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

english.text: We have already seized them with punishment, but they did not humble themselves to their Lord, nor did they supplicate in humility,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le châtiment que Nous leur avons infligé ne les a pas pour autant incités à se soumettre à la volonté de leur Seigneur, ni à L’implorer avec humilité.

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا ذَا عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ

english.text: until when We open for them a gateway of severe punishment, they will be plunged into utter despair.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais lorsque Nous les soumettrons à un terrible châtiment, ils seront totalement désespérés.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: It is He Who gave you hearing, sight and hearts. How little you give thanks[35]!
english.footnotes: [35] The disbelievers, instead of showing gratefulness for the blessings of eyes, ears, mind, and heart; show ingratitude to their Creator.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui vous a dotés de l’ouïe, de la vue et de l’entendement. Mais vous êtes si peu reconnaissants.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ

english.text: And it is He Who spread you on earth, and to Him you will all be gathered.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui aussi qui vous a créés et dispersés sur terre, et c’est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخۡتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: It is He Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day[36]. Do you not understand?
english.footnotes: [36] The One Who possesses all these powers is the only One worthy of worship without any partners with Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui donne la vie et la mort, et qui fait alterner le jour et la nuit. Etes-vous donc incapables de raisonner ?

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُواْ مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ

english.text: But[37] they say the like of what the earlier peoples said.
english.footnotes: [37] Instead of using their understanding and reason.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils se contentent, en vérité, de répéter les arguments avancés par leurs devanciers,

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ

english.text: They say, “Is it that when we die and become dust and bones, will we really be resurrected[38]?
english.footnotes: [38] The One Who created the earth and everything on it from nothing, it is easy for Him to re-create them once again.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: disant : « Serons-nous, une fois morts et nos os réduits en poussière, ressuscités ?

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: This is what we and our forefathers were promised before; this is nothing but ancient fables.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici une menace que nous avons déjà entendue, ainsi que nos ancêtres avant nous. Ce ne sont là que légendes du passé ! »

renderings.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Say, “To whom belong the earth and all those who are on it, if you really know?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande-leur : « A qui appartiennent la terre et tous ceux qui la peuplent, si vous le savez ? »

renderings.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english.text: They will say, “To Allah.” Say, “Will you not then take heed?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « A Allah », répondront-ils. Dis-leur : « Ne réfléchissez-vous donc pas ? »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

english.text: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande-leur : « Qui est le Seigneur des sept cieux et le Maître du Trône glorieux ? »

renderings.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english.text: They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear Him?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « C’est Allah », reconnaîtront-ils. Dis-leur : « N’allez-vous donc pas Le redouter ? »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Say, “In Whose Hand is the dominion of all things – and He gives protection while none can protect against Him – if you really know?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande-leur encore : « Qui règne en Maître absolu sur la Création ? Qui accorde Sa protection à qui Il veut, mais dont nul ne peut être protégé, si vous le savez ? »

renderings.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسۡحَرُونَ

english.text: They will say, “Allah.” Say, “Then how can you be deluded?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « C’est Allah », admettront-ils. Dis-leur : « Comment avez-vous pu ainsi perdre toute raison[14] ? »
french.footnotes: [14] Pour associer d’autres divinités à Allah, alors que vous reconnaissez qu’Il est le Maître absolu de l’univers.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

english.text: In fact, We brought them the truth, but they are certainly liars[39].
english.footnotes: [39] For claiming that Allah has partners and offspring, and that there is no life after death.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons bel et bien apporté la vérité à ces impies qui, pour leur part, ne font que mentir.

renderings.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٖ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍۚ إِذٗا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهِۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english.text: Allah has never begotten a son, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he had created, and each would have tried to gain supremacy over the other[40]. Glory be to Allah far above what they ascribe to Him!
english.footnotes: [40] Then there would have been serious conflicts and wars among different sovereigns and gods.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah ne s’est pas donné d’enfant et il n’y a pas d’autres dieux avec Lui. Sans quoi, chaque divinité exercerait sa souveraineté sur sa création et chercherait à soumettre les autres à sa domination. Gloire donc à Allah que leurs blasphèmes ne sauraient atteindre !

renderings.arabic: عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

english.text: Knower of the unseen and the seen. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lui qui connaît le monde visible comme le monde invisible est bien au-dessus des fausses divinités qu’ils associent à Son culte.

renderings.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ

english.text: Say, “My Lord, if You show me what they[41] are warned of,
english.footnotes: [41] i.e., the pagans of Makkah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Si Tu dois, Seigneur, me montrer le châtiment dont ils sont menacés,

renderings.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِي فِي ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: my Lord, then do not include me among the wrongdoing people[42].”
english.footnotes: [42] Allah’s punishment should be dreaded by all; when it comes, it does not only destroy the wicked but may also involve the righteous.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: veuille, Seigneur, ne pas m’associer au sort de ces impies ! »

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

english.text: We are surely able to show you that of which We have warned them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous sommes, en vérité, parfaitement capable de te montrer ce dont Nous les menaçons.

renderings.arabic: ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَۚ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

english.text: Repel evil with what is best; We know well what they claim[43].
english.footnotes: [43] That there are other gods besides Allah, and that the Prophet is a liar, a poet, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rends le bien pour le mal. Nous connaissons parfaitement leurs allégations.

renderings.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

english.text: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the temptations of the devils.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et dis : « J’implore, Seigneur, Ta protection contre les tentations des démons,

renderings.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحۡضُرُونِ

english.text: And I seek refuge with You, my Lord, that they even come near me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et me mets sous Ta protection, Seigneur, contre leurs infâmes suggestions ! »

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرۡجِعُونِ

english.text: Until when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque la mort se présente à l’un d’entre eux, il dit : « Seigneur ! Rends-moi à la vie,

renderings.arabic: لَعَلِّيٓ أَعۡمَلُ صَٰلِحٗا فِيمَا تَرَكۡتُۚ كَلَّآۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرۡزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

english.text: so that I may do righteous deeds in what I left behind.” No, it is only a word he utters. And behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected[44]
english.footnotes: [44] i.e., Once they die, there will be no chance of returning to the world, and they shall remain in that state until the Day of Resurrection.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin que je puisse accomplir les bonnes actions que j’ai délaissées. » Sûrement pas ! Ce ne sont là que des mots. Ils en seront empêchés jusqu’au Jour où ils seront ressuscités.

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english.text: When the Trumpet is blown[45], there will be no kinship ties between them on that Day, nor will they ask about one another[46].
english.footnotes:
[45] When the Trumpet is blown on the Day of Resurrection by an angel, everyone on earth will die. Then it will be blown a second time, and all will raise for Judgment. See 39:68.
 [46] For everyone will be worried and anxious about his own plight.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour où il sera soufflé dans la Corne, nul ne pourra se prévaloir de ses liens de parenté et nul ne sera sollicité[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Par un autre pour lui venir en aide. Ou : nul ne sera interrogé par un autre.

renderings.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

english.text: So those whose scales [of good deeds] are heavy, it is they who will be successful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Bienheureux, en vérité, ceux dont la balance penchera du bon côté.

renderings.arabic: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: But those whose scales are light, they are the ones who have lost their souls, abiding in Hell forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux dont la balance penchera du mauvais côté, ils auront perdu leurs âmes et seront voués à la Géhenne pour l’éternité.

renderings.arabic: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

english.text: The Fire will scorch their faces, leaving them disfigured[47].
english.footnotes: [47] Kālih means a face whose skin has been removed by scorching until the jaws are exposed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les flammes de l’Enfer leur lécheront les visages qui seront totalement crispés.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

english.text: “Were not My verses recited to you, and you used to reject them?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « N’avez-vous pas renié Mes versets qui vous étaient récités ? » Leur sera-t-il lancé.

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمٗا ضَآلِّينَ

english.text: They will say, “Our Lord, our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we were a people who went astray.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils diront : « Seigneur ! Notre funeste destin a été plus fort que nous. Nous étions totalement égarés.

renderings.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَإِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ

english.text: Our Lord, take us out of this; if we returned [to evil], we would certainly be wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fais-nous sortir, Seigneur, de l’Enfer. Si nous revenons à nos errements, nous ferons preuve de la plus grande iniquité. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ ٱخۡسَـُٔواْ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ

english.text: Allah will say, “Stay therein despised and do not speak to Me[48].
english.footnotes: [48] i.e., Do not plead your case with Me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dira : « Demeurez-y dans l’humiliation, sans plus jamais me parler.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

english.text: There was a group of My slaves who used to pray, ‘Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.’
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Une partie de Mes serviteurs disait : “Seigneur ! Nous avons la foi ! Veuille nous accorder Ton pardon et Ta miséricorde qui est sans égale”.

renderings.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُونَ

english.text: But you took them in mockery until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais vous les avez tournés en dérision au point d’en oublier Ma révélation, occupés que vous étiez par vos moqueries.

renderings.arabic: إِنِّي جَزَيۡتُهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ

english.text: I have rewarded them Today for their patience; it is they who are the successful.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je les récompense aujourd’hui pour leur constance en leur accordant la félicité éternelle au Paradis. »

renderings.arabic: قَٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

english.text: He will say, “How many years did you stay on earth?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il leur demandera : « Combien d’années êtes-vous demeurés sur terre ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٖ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلۡعَآدِّينَ

english.text: They will say, “We stayed for a day or part of a day; ask those who keep count.”[49]
english.footnotes: [49] Compared to the duration and misery of their stay in Hell, their life in this world will seem extremely short to them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils répondront : « Nous y sommes restés un jour ou moins d’une journée. Interroge donc ceux qui tiennent les comptes[16]. »
french.footnotes: [16] Les anges, selon certains commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗاۖ لَّوۡ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Allah will say, “You only stayed for a while, if only you had known[50].
english.footnotes: [50] That the life of this world was transitory and was a test, but you did not realize it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il dira : « Vous n’y êtes demeurés, en vérité, que peu de temps, si seulement vous saviez[17].
french.footnotes: [17] Autre sens : si seulement vous aviez su (le caractère éphémère de cette vie, vous ne l’auriez pas préférée à la vie éternelle).

renderings.arabic: أَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ أَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ عَبَثٗا وَأَنَّكُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: Did you think that We created you with no purpose and that you would not be brought back to Us?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pensiez-vous que Nous vous avions créés en vain et que vous ne seriez jamais ramenés à Nous ? »

renderings.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ

english.text: Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign[51]! None has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Lord of the Honorable Throne.
english.footnotes: [51] The One Who owns everything in existence.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exalté soit Allah, le seul et véritable Souverain ! Il n’est de divinité digne d’être adorée que Lui, Maître du Trône sublime.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

english.text: Whoever invokes another god besides Allah, for which he has no proof, his reckoning will be with his Lord[52]. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.
english.footnotes: [52] i.e., he cannot escape His accountability.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quiconque, sans se fonder sur la moindre preuve, invoque une autre divinité avec Allah devra en payer le prix auprès de son Seigneur. Il n’y a point de salut pour les impies.

renderings.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

english.text: Say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the Best of those who show mercy.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Veuille, Seigneur, m’accorder Ton pardon et Ta miséricorde qui dépasse toute miséricorde ! »

renderings.arabic: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهَا وَفَرَضۡنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

english.text: [This is] a Chapter which We have sent down and ordained, and sent down in it clear commandments so that you may take heed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici une sourate que Nous révélons et dont Nous imposons les prescriptions, une sourate aux versets parfaitement clairs afin de vous amener à réfléchir.

renderings.arabic: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِي فَٱجۡلِدُواْ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٖ مِّنۡهُمَا مِاْئَةَ جَلۡدَةٖۖ وَلَا تَأۡخُذۡكُم بِهِمَا رَأۡفَةٞ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۖ وَلۡيَشۡهَدۡ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: As for the woman and the man who commit fornication; flog each of them a hundred lashes. Do not let pity for them make you lenient concerning the law of Allah, if you believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment[1].
english.footnotes: [1] Fornication has to be proven either by confession or the testimony of four reliable witnesses to having actually seen the act take place. This ruling is applicable to unmarried fornicators. Execution by stoning is confirmed in the sunnah for married adulterers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Infligez cent coups de fouet à quiconque, homme ou femme, se livre à la fornication. Ne renoncez pas, par pitié pour les coupables, à appliquer la loi divine, si vous croyez en Allah et au Jour dernier. Et qu’un groupe de croyants assiste à l’exécution de la peine.

renderings.arabic: ٱلزَّانِي لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوۡ مُشۡرِكَةٗ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوۡ مُشۡرِكٞۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: A man who fornicates would only marry[2] a woman who fornicates or a polytheist, and a woman who fornicates would only marry a man who fornicates or a polytheist. Such marriages are forbidden to the believers[3].
english.footnotes:
[2] i.e., is inclined to marry.
 [3] Such persons cannot be married to believers unless they repent.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le fornicateur ne peut s’adonner au péché de la chair qu’avec une fornicatrice ou une païenne, de même que la fornicatrice ne peut se livrer au péché de la chair qu’avec un fornicateur ou un païen. De telles relations sont interdites aux croyants[1].
french.footnotes: [1] Autre sens : le fornicateur ne peut épouser qu’une fornicatrice ou une païenne, de même que la fornicatrice ne peut devenir la femme que d’un fornicateur ou d’un païen. De telles unions sont interdites aux croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ ٱلۡمُحۡصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَأۡتُواْ بِأَرۡبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجۡلِدُوهُمۡ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلۡدَةٗ وَلَا تَقۡبَلُواْ لَهُمۡ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدٗاۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ

english.text: As for those who accuse chaste women [of adultery] but fail to produce four witnesses, flog them eighty lashes and do not accept their testimony ever, for it is they who are the rebellious,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui portent des accusations[2] contre des femmes chastes, sans produire quatre témoins confirmant leurs dires, se verront infliger quatre-vingts coups de fouet, tandis que leur témoignage ne sera plus jamais admis. Voilà ceux qui ont désobéi à Allah.
french.footnotes: [2] De fornication ou d’adultère.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصۡلَحُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: except those who repent afterward and mend their ways, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui se repentent et s’amendent par la suite, qu’ils sachent qu’Allah est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux[3].
french.footnotes: [3] Après son repentir, affirme la majorité des savants de l’islam, il ne doit plus être considéré comme un pécheur qui a désobéi à Allah (Fâsiq). Son témoignage peut de nouveau être accepté.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ أَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمۡ أَرۡبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتِۭ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english.text: As for those who accuse their wives [of adultery] but have no witnesses except themselves, then the evidence of one of them is to testify four times by Allah that he is telling the truth[4],
english.footnotes: [4] In order that he be spared the punishment for false accusation.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme qui accuse son épouse d’adultère, sans avoir d’autres témoins que lui-même, devra attester quatre fois par Allah qu’il dit la vérité[4].
french.footnotes: [4] Pour échapper à la peine décrite au verset 4.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعۡنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

english.text: and the fifth [oath] is that may Allah curse him if he is telling a lie.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il devra ensuite, par une cinquième formule, appeler la malédiction d’Allah sur lui s’il ment.

renderings.arabic: وَيَدۡرَؤُاْ عَنۡهَا ٱلۡعَذَابَ أَن تَشۡهَدَ أَرۡبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتِۭ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

english.text: But she will be spared the punishment if she testifies four times by Allah that he is telling a lie,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La femme accusée ne pourra alors échapper à la peine légale que si elle jure quatre fois par Allah que son mari a menti.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english.text: and the fifth [oath] is that may Allah’s wrath be upon her if he is telling the truth[5].
english.footnotes: [5] It is called li‘ān; once the husband and the wife swear each five times, the marriage is terminated forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Elle devra ensuite, par une cinquième formule, appeler la colère d’Allah sur elle si celui-ci dit la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ

english.text: Were it not for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, and that Allah is Accepting of Repentance, All-Wise, [He would have punished you][6].
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., ...you would have been punished or scandalized.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sans les faveurs et la grâce d’Allah envers vous, vous auriez subi Ses rigueurs. Mais votre Seigneur, d’une sagesse infinie, accueille sans cesse le repentir de Ses serviteurs.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلۡإِفۡكِ عُصۡبَةٞ مِّنكُمۡۚ لَا تَحۡسَبُوهُ شَرّٗا لَّكُمۖ بَلۡ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُم مَّا ٱكۡتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِۚ وَٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ كِبۡرَهُۥ مِنۡهُمۡ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: Indeed, those who came up with the slander[7] are a group among you. Do not think that it is bad for you, rather it is good for you[8]. Each one of them is responsible for what he earned of the sin, and the one who played the major role[9], for him there will be a grave punishment.
english.footnotes:
[7] It refers to the incident when the Prophet's wife ‘Ā’ishah was falsely accused by the hypocrites.
 [8] For its reward from Allah; believers being distinguished from hypocrites; and ‘Ā’ishah being absolved from false accusation, etc.
 [9] i.e., ‘Abdullah ibn ’Ubayy, leader of the hypocrites in Madinah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’origine de cette calomnie se trouve un groupe d’entre vous[5]. Ne pensez pas que ces événements puissent vous nuire. Ils auront au contraire, pour vous, d’heureux effets. Chacun des coupables devra assumer sa part du forfait. Quant au principal responsable[6], il sera sévèrement châtié.
french.footnotes:
[5] Les dix versets qui suivent furent révélés au sujet de la calomnie lancée par les hypocrites contre ‘Aïchah, l’épouse du Prophète.
[6] Celui qui a lancé la rumeur ou qui a le plus activement participé à sa propagation, ‘Abdoullah ibn Oubayy ibn Saloul, chef des hypocrites de Médine, selon la majorité des exégètes.

renderings.arabic: لَّوۡلَآ إِذۡ سَمِعۡتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ خَيۡرٗا وَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِفۡكٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: If only the believing men and women had thought well of themselves, and said, “This is a clear slander!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si seulement, lorsqu’ils ont entendu ces rumeurs, les croyants et les croyantes avaient eu une meilleure opinion de leurs coreligionnaires et avaient dit : « Il s’agit de toute évidence d’une calomnie. »

renderings.arabic: لَّوۡلَا جَآءُو عَلَيۡهِ بِأَرۡبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَۚ فَإِذۡ لَمۡ يَأۡتُواْ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰذِبُونَ

english.text: Why did they not produce four witnesses to prove it? Now, since they failed to produce witnesses, they are the liars before Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que n’ont-ils produit quatre témoins à l’appui de leurs accusations ? Puisqu’ils n’ont pas présenté de témoins, alors ce sont, selon le jugement d’Allah, des menteurs.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمۡ فِي مَآ أَفَضۡتُمۡ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

english.text: Were it not for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you in this world and in the Hereafter, you would have been afflicted with a great punishment for that [lie] in which you were involved,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sans les faveurs et la grâce d’Allah envers vous ici-bas et dans l’au-delà, un terrible châtiment vous aurait été infligé pour avoir propagé ces rumeurs.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ تَلَقَّوۡنَهُۥ بِأَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفۡوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيۡسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ وَتَحۡسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنٗا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: when you were passing it from one tongue[10] to the other, and saying with your mouths what you had no knowledge of, and were taking it lightly, whereas with Allah it was a grave offense.
english.footnotes: [10] Rather than your ears, i.e., not thinking about what you hear but hastening to pass it on to others without verifying it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous colportiez cette nouvelle sans vous être assurés de sa véracité, pensant que cela était sans gravité alors que, pour Allah, une telle conduite est une infamie.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ إِذۡ سَمِعۡتُمُوهُ قُلۡتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهۡتَٰنٌ عَظِيمٞ

english.text: If only you had said when you heard it, “How can we speak about such a thing! Glory be to You [O Allah]! This is a monstrous slander!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si seulement, en l’entendant, vous aviez dit : « Nous n’avons pas à en parler. Gloire à Allah ! Il s’agit là d’une odieuse calomnie ! »

renderings.arabic: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُواْ لِمِثۡلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Allah admonishes you not to repeat such a thing ever, if you are [truly] believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah vous exhorte, si vous êtes croyants, à ne plus jamais vous comporter ainsi.

renderings.arabic: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

english.text: Allah makes the revelations clear to you, for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah vous expose clairement Ses enseignements. Il est Omniscient et d’une sagesse infinie.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةُ فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Indeed, those who like to see indecency[11] spread among the believers will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter; Allah knows and you do not know[12].
english.footnotes:
[11] i.e., unlawful sexual relations.
 [12] The hidden aspects of all things: what is harmful and what is beneficial.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui aiment voir se propager le vice parmi les croyants subiront un douloureux châtiment ici-bas et dans l’au-delà. Allah sait, tandis que vous, vous ne savez pas.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: Were it not for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, and that Allah is Ever Gracious, Most Merciful [He would have punished you].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’eût été la grâce d’Allah envers vous, Il vous aurait châtiés. Mais Il est toute bonté et toute miséricorde.

renderings.arabic: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعۡ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۚ وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَبَدٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

english.text: O you who believe, do not follow the footsteps of Satan; whoever follows the footsteps of Satan, he only enjoins indecency and evil acts. Were it not for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, none of you would have ever been purified. But Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
