french.text: Ils ne t’adresseront aucune objection sans que Nous ne l’écartions par les arguments les plus convaincants et les réponses les plus éloquentes[7].
french.footnotes: [7] Comme au verset précédent où sont mentionnées à la fois l’objection des mécréants et la réponse d’Allah. De même, en réponse à cet argument : « Qu’a donc ce prétendu Messager à s’alimenter et à fréquenter les marchés ? » (verset 7), Allah dit : « Nous n’avons envoyé avant toi que des Messagers qui se nourrissaient et fréquentaient les marchés » (verset 20).

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحۡشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: Those who will be dragged on their faces to Hell – they will be in the worst position and farthest astray from the right path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ces impies, qui seront traînés sur le visage vers la Géhenne où ils connaîtront le sort le plus affreux, sont aujourd’hui rabaissés au rang le plus abject et sont les plus éloignés de la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرٗا

english.text: We gave Moses the Scripture and appointed along with him his brother Aaron as a helper.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, confié les Ecritures à Moïse et choisi son frère Aaron pour l’assister.

renderings.arabic: فَقُلۡنَا ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيرٗا

english.text: We said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs[17].” Then We destroyed them utterly.
english.footnotes: [17] i.e., the divine teachings reached them through Prophet Jacob and Joseph, and the righteous people of Israel.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous leur avons ordonné de se rendre auprès du peuple qui avait renié Nos signes que Nous avons, pour prix de son impiété, anéanti.

renderings.arabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةٗۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

english.text: Also the people of Noah, when they rejected the messengers[18], We drowned them and made them an example for mankind. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
english.footnotes: [18] Denial of Noah was equal to denying all of Allah’s messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons également exterminé le peuple de Noé, englouti par le Déluge pour avoir traité les Messagers d’imposteurs, et avons fait de lui un exemple pour l’humanité. Nous avons, par ailleurs, préparé un douloureux châtiment aux impies.

renderings.arabic: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونَۢا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرٗا

english.text: Also [We destroyed] ‘Ād and Thamūd, and the people of the Well[19], and many generations between them.
english.footnotes: [19] i.e., people of prophet Shuʿayb, or those mentioned in Surah Yā Sīn (36:13-29), or a tribe of Thamūd, etc. Rass (lit., well); for they killed their prophet by throwing him into or hanging him down an old or dry well. (Well)
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en fut de même des ‘Ad, des Thamoud, des habitants d’Ar-Rass[8] et de nombreux peuples intermédiaires
french.footnotes: [8] Littéralement : les hommes du puits.

renderings.arabic: وَكُلّٗا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَۖ وَكُلّٗا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرٗا

english.text: To each We gave examples [of the previous nations], and each We destroyed completely.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que Nous avons avertis, en leur proposant des exemples édifiants, avant qu’ils ne soient entièrement détruits.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَى ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ أَفَلَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ نُشُورٗا

english.text: They have surely passed by the town[20] that was destroyed by a terrible rain [of stones]. Have they not seen it? But they do not expect to be resurrected[21].
english.footnotes:
[20] i.e., the city of Sodom; the people of Prophet Lot.
 [21] So they do not take lessons from the doom of the past nations.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les tiens ont d’ailleurs traversé les vestiges de la cité frappée par une pluie de pierres[9]. N’en ont-ils pas vu les traces et n’ont-ils pas tiré les leçons de leur funeste destinée ? Mais, en réalité, ils ne croient pas en la Résurrection.
french.footnotes: [9] Sodome, où vivait le peuple de Loth, anéantie elle aussi pour son impiété.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا

english.text: When they see you [O Prophet], they only ridicule you, “Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque les mécréants te voient, ils ne font que se moquer de toi, disant : « Est-ce là celui qu’Allah a envoyé comme Messager ?

renderings.arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَآ أَن صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

english.text: He would have almost led us astray from our gods if we had not been so devoted to them.” But when they see the punishment, they will come to know who is further astray from the right way.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il aurait bien pu nous détourner de nos divinités si nous ne leur étions pas restés patiemment attachés. » Ils sauront, lorsqu’ils verront le châtiment, qui s’est le plus éloigné de la vérité.

renderings.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيلًا

english.text: Have you [O Prophet] seen the one who takes his desire as his god, will you then be a keeper over him?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’as-tu pas vu celui qui s’est entièrement soumis à ses passions[10] ? Est-ce toi qui pourras l’en empêcher ?
french.footnotes: [10] Littéralement : celui qui a fait de ses passions son dieu.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ يَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

english.text: Do you think that most of them hear or understand?[22] They are just like cattle[23], rather they are further astray from the right way.
english.footnotes:
[22] They follow others blindly.
 [23] i.e., like livestock or sheep, that follow without asking wherever they are led.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Penses-tu que la plupart d’entre eux puissent entendre ou comprendre ? Ils sont plutôt à l’image de bestiaux, voire plus asservis à leurs instincts.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنٗا ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيلٗا

english.text: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun an indication of it[24].
english.footnotes: [24] i.e., indication for its existence or making it apparent.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas comment ton Seigneur, par le mouvement du soleil, étend l’ombre qu’Il pourrait tout aussi bien immobiliser,

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضٗا يَسِيرٗا

english.text: Then We gradually draw it towards Us [i.e., Then the sun climbs up]?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: puis comment, petit à petit, par le déplacement de ce même soleil, Il en réduit la portée[11] ?
french.footnotes: [11] A mesure que le soleil s’élève dans le ciel, l’ombre diminue.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا وَٱلنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورٗا

english.text: It is He Who has made the night as a garment[25] for you, and made sleep for rest; and has made daytime for returning to life[26].
english.footnotes:
[25] It covers you in darkness and provides rest.
 [26] To return to your livelihood and activity.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui vous couvrons de l’obscurité de la nuit[12], qui vous offrons dans le sommeil un instant de repos et dans la journée l’occasion de vous disperser sur terre pour vos activités[13].
french.footnotes:
[12] Comme d’un vêtement.
[13] Autre sens : qui faisons de votre sommeil une mort et de votre réveil un retour à la vie.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ طَهُورٗا

english.text: It is He Who sends the winds as harbingers before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui envoyons les vents annonciateurs de Notre grâce[14], puis faisons descendre du ciel une eau purifiante
french.footnotes: [14] La pluie.

renderings.arabic: لِّنُحۡـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗا وَنُسۡقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرٗا

english.text: so that We may revive therewith a dead land, and quench the thirst of countless beasts and humans We have created.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: par laquelle Nous redonnons vie à la terre morte et abreuvons nombre de Nos créatures parmi les bestiaux et les hommes.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورٗا

english.text: We distribute it among them so that they may take heed[27], but most people persist in their ingratitude.
english.footnotes: [27] Such as Allah’s ability to bring the dead to life.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous la répartissons parmi les hommes afin qu’ils en tirent des leçons. Mais la plupart d’entre eux persistent dans l’ingratitude.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٖ نَّذِيرٗا

english.text: If We had willed, We could have sent to each town a warner[28].
english.footnotes: [28] But instead, Allah sent Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) as the final messenger for all people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous l’avions voulu, Nous aurions suscité dans chaque cité un Messager chargé d’avertir ses habitants.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدۡهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادٗا كَبِيرٗا

english.text: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with this [Qur’an] a great striving.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Garde-toi donc de céder aux mécréants, mais appelle-les sans relâche à la foi par le Coran.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٗا وَحِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا

english.text: It is He Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, and He has made between them a barrier and an insurmountable partition[29].
english.footnotes: [29] When salt and fresh waters meet, although both mix together, each still keeps its distinctive qualities, as if a barrier prevents them from mixing completely.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est par Sa volonté que les deux types d’eau, l’eau douce et l’eau salée, se côtoient sans jamais se mélanger, étant séparés par une barrière infranchissable.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرٗا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبٗا وَصِهۡرٗاۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرٗا

english.text: It is He Who created human beings from water[30], then made between them bonds of kinship and marriage, for your Lord is Most Capable.
english.footnotes: [30] i.e., the zygote (the mixture of sperm and egg).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et c’est Lui qui, à partir de l’eau, a créé les hommes avant d’établir entre eux des liens de parenté et d’alliance[15]. Ton Seigneur est Omnipotent.
french.footnotes: [15] Les liens existant entre une personne et la famille de son conjoint.

renderings.arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡۗ وَكَانَ ٱلۡكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرٗا

english.text: Yet they worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm them; the disbeliever always collaborates against his Lord[31].
english.footnotes: [31] i.e., helping and defending those who rebel against Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils adorent pourtant en dehors d’Allah des divinités qui ne peuvent ni leur nuire, ni leur être d’aucune utilité. L’impie se fait toujours l’allié de l’ennemi de son Seigneur[16].
french.footnotes: [16] Satan, selon nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا

english.text: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne t’avons envoyé que pour annoncer la bonne nouvelle et mettre en garde l’humanité.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes to take a path to his Lord[32].”
english.footnotes: [32] By spending in the way of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Je ne vous demande aucun salaire en échange, mais seulement, si vous le voulez, de suivre la voie de votre Seigneur. »

renderings.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

english.text: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Place ta confiance dans le Dieu Vivant et Eternel et, par les louanges, célèbre Sa gloire. Il n’a besoin de personne pour connaître les péchés de Ses serviteurs.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهِۦ خَبِيرٗا

english.text: it is He Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days[33], then rose over the Throne[34]. He is the Most Compassionate, so ask about Him the One Who is All-Aware.
english.footnotes:
[33] The "six Days" does not necessarily mean six 24 hours of time; for a heavenly Day is 1,000 years of our time. (see 22:47), whereas the Day of Judgment will be 50,000 years of our time (see 70:4). Hence, its duration is only known to Allah.
 [34] See footnote 7:54.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui, en six jours, a créé les cieux, la terre et ce qui se trouve entre eux, puis s’est élevé sur le Trône. Il est le Tout Miséricordieux. Interroge donc à Son sujet qui en est bien informé[17].
french.footnotes: [17] Allah Lui-même, selon nombre d’exégètes, qui se connaît mieux que quiconque.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ أَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَأۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُورٗا۩

english.text: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they say, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate?’ Shall we prostrate to what you order us?” And it only increases their aversion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’il leur est demandé de se prosterner devant le Tout Miséricordieux, ils répondent : « Qui est donc le Tout Miséricordieux ? Allons-nous nous prosterner simplement parce que tu nous l’as ordonné ? » Cela ne fait donc que les éloigner de la vérité.

renderings.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجٗا وَقَمَرٗا مُّنِيرٗا

english.text: Blessed is He Who placed in the sky constellations and placed therein a radiant lamp[35] and a luminous moon.
english.footnotes: [35] i.e., the sun.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Béni soit Celui qui, dans le ciel, a placé des constellations zodiacales, un flambeau[18] et une lune qui, la nuit, vous éclaire[19] !
french.footnotes:
[18] Le soleil qui, effectivement, produit à la fois une chaleur intense et de la lumière.
[19] La lune, en effet, ne fait que réfléchir la lumière qu’elle reçoit du soleil, sans produire de chaleur.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةٗ لِّمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوۡ أَرَادَ شُكُورٗا

english.text: It is He Who made the night and the day to follow each other so that everyone who wishes may reflect or become grateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui fait alterner le jour et la nuit pour qui veut méditer et se montrer reconnaissant.

renderings.arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنٗا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا

english.text: The slaves of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on earth humbly[36], and when the ignorant address them, they only say words of peace[37];
english.footnotes: [36] i.e., without arrogance, but with dignity. [37] i.e., words free from evil.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les serviteurs du Tout Miséricordieux sont ceux qui marchent humblement et dignement sur terre et qui, lorsque les ignorants leur adressent des mots blessants, leur répondent par des propos bienveillants,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدٗا وَقِيَٰمٗا

english.text: and those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui, pour plaire au Seigneur, passent la nuit prosternés et debout en prière,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

english.text: and those who say, “Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is unrelenting[38].”
english.footnotes: [38] i.e., ever adhering.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui disent : « Epargne-nous, Seigneur, les tourments de la Géhenne, car son châtiment est sans fin. »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا

english.text: It is an evil place to settle and an evil abode.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La Géhenne est assurément la plus horrible des demeures et le plus affreux des séjours.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامٗا

english.text: And those who neither spend wastefully nor stingily, but are moderate between them;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce sont également ceux qui, dans leurs dépenses, ne se montrent ni prodigues, ni avares, mais savent garder le juste milieu,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامٗا

english.text: and those who do not invoke besides Allah another god, and who do not kill a soul whom Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice, and who do not commit adultery, for whoever does any of this will face the penalty,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui n’invoquent pas d’autre divinité qu’Allah, n’enlèvent pas sans droit la vie qu’Allah a rendue sacrée et ne se livrent pas à la fornication. Ceux qui commettent de telles actions devront en subir la sanction.

renderings.arabic: يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا

english.text: the punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, wherein he will remain disgraced forever,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leurs tourments seront redoublés le Jour de la résurrection. Voués à les subir éternellement, ils seront couverts d’humiliation.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ حَسَنَٰتٖۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا

english.text: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for them Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’exception de ceux qui se repentent, retournent à la foi et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres, dont Allah remplacera les péchés par de bonnes actions. Allah est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابٗا

english.text: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds has turned to Allah with sincere repentance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quiconque se repent et accomplit de bonnes œuvres reviendra ainsi à Allah qui acceptera son repentir.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشۡهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِٱللَّغۡوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامٗا

english.text: And those who do not witness falsehood[39], and when they pass by futility, they pass by with dignity;
english.footnotes: [39] i.e., places of sin, evil, and indecency.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les serviteurs du Tout Miséricordieux sont aussi ceux qui ne sont jamais les témoins complices du péché[20] et qui, lorsqu’ils entendent des futilités, passent leur chemin avec dignité,
french.footnotes: [20] Et ne portent jamais de faux témoignages.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمّٗا وَعُمۡيَانٗا

english.text: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, they do not turn a deaf ear or a blind eye to them;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui ne sont ni sourds à Nos versets qui leur sont récités, ni aveugles à Nos signes qui leur sont montrés,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

english.text: and those who say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us[40], and make us good examples for the righteous.”
english.footnotes: [40] i.e., a source of happiness for their righteousness and adhering to a straight path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui disent : « Veuille, Seigneur, faire de nos épouses et de nos enfants une source de joie pour nous et faire de nous des modèles de piété. »

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةٗ وَسَلَٰمًا

english.text: It is they who will be rewarded with high palaces [in Paradise] for their perseverance, and they will be received therein with salutations and greetings of peace,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà ceux qui, en récompense de leur constance, seront admis dans les plus hauts degrés du Paradis où ils seront accueillis par des saluts et jouiront d’une entière sécurité.

renderings.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا

english.text: abiding therein forever. What an excellent abode and a resting place!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils vivront à jamais dans cette sublime demeure où ils jouiront du séjour le plus agréable.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا

english.text: Say [O Prophet], “My Lord would not care at all about you, were it not for your supplication[41]. Now since you have rejected [the truth], the inevitable is bound to come[42].”
english.footnotes:
[41] i.e., faith and worship.
 [42] Or it will be adhering to you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Mon Seigneur vous a adressé ce message dans le seul souci de vous appeler à la foi que vous avez pourtant rejetée. Votre châtiment est donc inéluctable. »

renderings.arabic: طسٓمٓ

english.text: Tā sīn mīm.[1]
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tâ-Sîn-Mîm.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

english.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici les versets du Livre parfaitement clair.

renderings.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Perhaps you[2] will grieve yourself to death because they do not believe.
english.footnotes: [2] O Muhammad.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu vas peut-être te consumer de tristesse devant leur refus obstiné d’embrasser la foi.

renderings.arabic: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ

english.text: If We willed, We could send down upon them a sign from the heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in humility[3].
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., they would be compelled to believe, being humbled.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, si Nous le voulions, Nous ferions descendre du ciel un signe qui leur ferait courber l’échine.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ

english.text: No new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate except that they turn away from it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aucune nouvelle révélation du Tout Miséricordieux ne leur est transmise sans qu’ils ne s’en détournent

renderings.arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

english.text: They have rejected [the Truth], soon there will come to them the consequences of their ridicule.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: en criant au mensonge. Ils subiront donc un jour les conséquences de leurs moqueries.

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ

english.text: Do they not see the earth, how many fine kinds of plants We grow in it?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’observent-ils pas la terre et la grande variété de plantes, d’une grande utilité et agréables à regarder, que Nous y faisons pousser ?

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them will not believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà assurément un signe, mais la plupart d’entre eux ne sont pas croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english.text: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur, en vérité, est le Tout-Puissant, le Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: And [remember] when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people –
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur appela un jour Moïse : « Va trouver le peuple impie,

renderings.arabic: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

english.text: the people of Pharaoh; will they not fear [the punishment of] Allah?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le peuple de Pharaon. Ces gens ne vont-ils pas Me redouter ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

english.text: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they may reject me,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit : « J’ai peur, Seigneur, d’être traité d’imposteur,

renderings.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ

english.text: and I will feel distressed and my tongue will not be fluent, so send Aaron along [to help me].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: d’être affligé par leur réaction et que ma langue soit embarrassée. Veuille donc associer Aaron à ma mission.

renderings.arabic: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ

english.text: Moreover, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me[4].”
english.footnotes: [4] For killing a Coptic Egyptian by mistake before becoming a prophet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je crains aussi qu’ils ne cherchent à me tuer pour une faute qu’ils ont à me reprocher. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ

english.text: Allah said, “Certainly not! Go, both of you, with Our signs[5]; We are with you, listening.
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., the miracles of the staff and the shining hand, given to Moses.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dit : « Il n’en sera rien. Allez tous deux, assistés de Nos signes. Nous sommes avec vous et Nous écoutons.

renderings.arabic: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are the messengers[6] from the Lord of the worlds,
english.footnotes: [6] The singular form in Arabic denotes that they both were sent with a single message.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allez trouver Pharaon et dites-lui que vous êtes envoyés par le Seigneur de la Création,

renderings.arabic: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

english.text: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qu’il doit laisser partir avec vous les fils d’Israël. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

english.text: Pharaoh said, “Did we not bring you up as a child among us, and you stayed with us several years of your life?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon dit alors à Moïse : « Ne t’avons-nous pas élevé chez nous tout petit ? N’as-tu pas vécu parmi nous plusieurs années de ta vie ?

renderings.arabic: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: Yet you did what you did[7], and you are extremely ungrateful.”
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., striking the Copt in support of a man from your people, who died as a result.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, en ingrat que tu es, tu as commis le méfait que tu sais. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

english.text: He said, “I did it when I had no guidance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse se justifia : « Au moment où je l’ai commis, j’étais encore ignorant.

renderings.arabic: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

english.text: So I fled from you in fear. Then my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Craignant vos représailles, j’ai pris la fuite. Mon Seigneur m’a alors fait don de la sagesse et m’a choisi pour être l’un de Ses Messagers.

renderings.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

english.text: Is this a favor that you remind me with, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?[8]
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., If you had not been cruel to the Israelites, I should not have been brought to your house for upbringing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment peux-tu me rappeler cette faveur[2], alors que tu as réduit en esclavage les fils d’Israël ? »
french.footnotes: [2] M’avoir élevé chez toi.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: Pharaoh said, “What is ‘the Lord of the worlds’?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Qui est donc, dit Pharaon, ce Seigneur de la Création ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

english.text: Moses said, “The Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Le Seigneur des cieux, de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux, si vous avez quelque certitude », répondit Moïse.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ

english.text: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear [what he just said]?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’adressant à son entourage, Pharaon dit : « Avez-vous bien entendu ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: Moses said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse poursuivit : « Il est votre Seigneur et celui de vos ancêtres les plus éloignés. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

english.text: Pharaoh said, “Your messenger who has been sent to you is truly insane!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon dit : « Ce Messager qui vous est envoyé a perdu toute raison. »

renderings.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: Moses said, “Lord of the east and west and all that is between them, if only you had sense!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center

english.text: And it was indeed [mentioned] in the scriptures of the former peoples.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: il a été annoncé par les Ecritures qui l’ont précédé.

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

english.text: Was it not a proof for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel recognized it [to be true][24]?
english.footnotes: [24] e.g., Abdullah ibn Salām, a Jewish scholar, accepted Islam during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ), for he knew that he came with a true message.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’est-ce pas pour eux une preuve suffisante que les docteurs de la loi en soient informés ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَعۡجَمِينَ

english.text: If We had sent it down to any of the non-Arabs,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous l’avions révélé à un homme ne parlant pas l’arabe

renderings.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: and he had recited it to them[25]; still, they would not have believed in it.
english.footnotes: [25] As a miracle from Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que celui-ci l’eût récité devant eux[15], ils auraient mis en doute son authenticité.
french.footnotes: [15] Dans sa propre langue.

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكۡنَٰهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

english.text: This is how We made it [i.e., disbelief] enter the hearts of the wicked.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi que Nous avons fait pénétrer dans le cœur des criminels l’impiété.

renderings.arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ

english.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ne croiront pas au Coran tant qu’ils ne verront pas le douloureux châtiment

renderings.arabic: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

english.text: which will come upon them suddenly when they least expect it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: les saisir soudainement sans qu’ils ne s’y attendent.

renderings.arabic: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلۡ نَحۡنُ مُنظَرُونَ

english.text: They will then say, “Can we be granted some respite?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils s’écriront alors : « Un sursis peut-il nous être accordé ? »

renderings.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

english.text: Do they really seek to hasten Our punishment?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Est-ce Notre châtiment qu’ils cherchent aujourd’hui à hâter ?

renderings.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ إِن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ سِنِينَ

english.text: Tell me [O Prophet] if We give them a life of ease for years,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous les laissons jouir de la vie encore quelques années,

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

english.text: then there came to them what they were warned of,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: avant que ne les emporte le châtiment dont ils sont menacés,

renderings.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ

english.text: what would avail them the life of ease that they were given?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à quoi leur auront bien servi toutes ces jouissances passées ?

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

english.text: We never destroyed any town without sending them warners,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons détruit aucune cité avant qu’un prophète ne lui soit envoyé

renderings.arabic: ذِكۡرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: to admonish them, for We are never unjust.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin de mettre en garde ses habitants. Nous n’avons jamais sévi avec iniquité.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتۡ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

english.text: This [Qur’an] is not sent down by the devils[26],
english.footnotes: [26] As the disbelievers claim; rather, it is brought down by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Non, cette révélation n’a pas été transmise par les démons,

renderings.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ

english.text: it is not for them to do this, nor is it within their capability,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: auxquels ne saurait être confiée une telle mission et qui ne pourraient d’ailleurs s’en acquitter,

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّمۡعِ لَمَعۡزُولُونَ

english.text: for they are strictly barred from overhearing it[27].
english.footnotes: [27] So they cannot eavesdrop on heaven. See 72:9.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: étant empêchés de l’écouter[16].
french.footnotes: [16] Au ciel.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ

english.text: So do not call upon any other god besides Allah, lest you become of those who will be punished.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Garde-toi donc d’invoquer avec Allah d’autres divinités, car tu subirais le même sort que ceux qui seront châtiés.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنذِرۡ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ

english.text: And warn [starting with] the nearest kinsfolk,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Avertis tout d’abord les membres de ton clan qui te sont les plus proches

renderings.arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: and lower your wing [in kindness] to the believers who follow you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: en te montrant humble et bienveillant envers les croyants qui te suivent.

renderings.arabic: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: But if they disobey you, say, “I disown what you do.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux parmi eux qui te désobéissent, désavoue ouvertement leurs agissements.

renderings.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

english.text: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Confie-toi au Tout-Puissant, au Très Miséricordieux,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

english.text: Who sees you when you stand up [for prayer],
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui te voit quand tu te lèves pour prier[17],
french.footnotes: [17] Seul, précisent certains exégètes, la nuit, ajoutent d’autres.

renderings.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english.text: and your movements among those who prostrate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et tes mouvements au milieu des fidèles en prière.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est Celui qui entend tout et sait tout.

renderings.arabic: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

english.text: Shall I inform you upon who the devils descend?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous indiquerai-je sur qui en réalité descendent les démons ?

renderings.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ

english.text: They descend upon every sinful liar,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils descendent sur tous les menteurs et pécheurs endurcis[18]
french.footnotes: [18] Les devins, selon nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ

english.text: who whisper hearsay in the ears, but most of them are liars.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui prêtent l’oreille aux démons, mais qui bien souvent ne font que mentir[19].
french.footnotes: [19] Les démons, expliquent nombre de commentateurs, révèlent les secrets du ciel aux devins qui en informent les hommes au milieu d’une multitude de mensonges.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ

english.text: As for poets, they are followed by the deviants.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant aux poètes, seuls les suivent des esprits totalement égarés[20].
french.footnotes: [20] Ce verset et ceux qui précèdent semblent être une réponse aux païens de la Mecque qui traitaient le Prophète tantôt de devin, tantôt de poète. Voir sourate 69, versets 41-42. Car si les poètes sont suivis par les égarés, le Prophète fut, quant à lui, suivi par les hommes les plus sensés.

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ

english.text: Do you not see that they wander aimlessly in every valley[28],
english.footnotes: [28] Telling lies indiscriminately, praising some, and disparaging others.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vois-tu pas qu’ils se livrent à tous les excès dans leurs poésies

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ

english.text: and that they say what they do not do?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qu’ils s’attribuent des exploits qu’ils n’ont jamais accomplis[21] ?
french.footnotes: [21] Et exhortent les autres à la vertu sans mettre eux-mêmes en pratique leurs bonnes paroles.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ

english.text: Except those who believe, do righteous deeds, remember Allah much and defend themselves[29] after being wronged. The wrongdoers will come to know what end awaits them.
english.footnotes: [29] By replying to the satire of hostile poets through poetry.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’exception de ceux qui croient, font le bien, invoquent souvent le nom d’Allah et se contentent de répondre aux attaques injustement subies[22]. Les impies connaîtront bientôt le sort qui leur est réservé.
french.footnotes: [22] Les satires composées contre les croyants par les poètes mécréants.

renderings.arabic: طسٓۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَكِتَابٖ مُّبِينٍ

english.text: Tā Sīn[1]. These are the verses of the Qur’an and a clear book;
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tâ-Sîn. Voici les versets du Coran, livre parfaitement clair,

renderings.arabic: هُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: a guidance and glad tidings for the believers,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: sûre direction et heureuse annonce pour les croyants

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ

english.text: those who establish prayer and give zakah, and who firmly believe in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui accomplissent la prière, s’acquittent de l’aumône et, en l’au-delà, croient fermement.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

english.text: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds appealing to them, so they wander blindly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui ne croient pas en la vie future, Nous leur embellissons leurs agissements qu’ils commettent aveuglément.

renderings.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ

english.text: Such are those who will have a terrible punishment, and it is they who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà ceux qui subiront les pires tourments et qui, dans l’autre monde, seront les plus grands perdants.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

english.text: Indeed, you are receiving the Qur’an from the All-Wise, All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu reçois, en vérité, le Coran de la part d’un dieu Sage et Omniscient.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٖ قَبَسٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ

english.text: [Remember] when Moses said to his family, “I have spotted a fire. I will bring you some news[2] from there, or bring you a burning brand so that you may warm yourselves.”
english.footnotes: [2] For they lost their way in the dark while traveling from Midian to Egypt.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse dit un jour aux siens : « J’ai aperçu un feu. Je m’en vais vous en rapporter quelque information ou un tison ardent pour vous réchauffer. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: When he came to it, he was called, “Blessed is He Who is at the fire and those who are around it[3]. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., the angels around the fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’étant approché du feu, il fut interpelé : « Béni soit celui qui est dans le feu et celui qui se trouve autour ! Gloire à Allah, Seigneur de la Création !

renderings.arabic: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

english.text: O Moses, verily this is Me – Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse ! Je suis Allah, le Tout-Puissant, l’infiniment Sage.

renderings.arabic: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: Throw down your staff!” But when he saw it slithering as if it were a snake, he turned and ran away without looking back. “O Moses, do not be afraid! Indeed, the messengers should have no fear in My presence,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jette ton bâton ! » Lorsque, s’étant exécuté, il le vit s’agiter comme un serpent[1], il prit la fuite sans même se retourner. Le Seigneur dit : « N’aie aucune crainte, Moïse. Les Messagers ne sauraient avoir peur auprès de Moi,
french.footnotes: [1] Le texte mentionne un type de serpent aux mouvements très rapides.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: except he who does wrong, then substitutes good for evil, then I am indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: excepté celui qui s’est montré injuste envers lui-même qui doit néanmoins savoir que J’accueille avec la plus grande clémence et une infinie miséricorde le repentir de celui qui s’amende.

renderings.arabic: وَأَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖۖ فِي تِسۡعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

english.text: Put your hand into your garment, it will come out shining white without blemish, as one of nine signs to Pharaoh and his people[4], for they are indeed a rebellious people.”
english.footnotes: [4] See footnote 23:45.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Introduis ta main dans le col de ta tunique, elle en ressortira toute blanche, sans que cette couleur soit due à la maladie. C’est là l’un des neuf miracles destinés à Pharaon et à son peuple qui Me refusent obéissance. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةٗ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: But when Our visible signs came to them, they said, “This is clear magic.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais lorsque Nos miracles, pourtant prodigieux, furent produits sous leurs yeux, ils dirent : « Ce n’est là, de toute évidence, que pure magie ! »

renderings.arabic: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمٗا وَعُلُوّٗاۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

english.text: They denied them wrongfully and arrogantly, although their hearts were convinced that they were true. See then how was the end of those who spread corruption!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
