renderings.arabic: يسٓ

english.text: Yā Sīn[1]
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Yâ-Sîn.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

english.text: By the Qur’an, full of wisdom,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le Coran aux enseignements pleins de sagesse !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

english.text: You [O Muhammad] are indeed one of the messengers,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu es assurément du nombre des Messagers,

renderings.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: on a straight path,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: engagé sur une voie parfaitement droite,

renderings.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

english.text: [This is] a revelation from the All-Mighty, Most Merciful,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui t’est révélée par le Tout-Puissant, le Très Miséricordieux,

renderings.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ

english.text: so that you warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin que tu avertisses un peuple dont les ancêtres n’ont pas été avertis, si bien qu’ils vivent dans l’insouciance.

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: The decree [of punishment] has been passed against most of them, for they will not believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ma sentence a déjà été prononcée contre la plupart d’entre eux : ils ne croiront pas.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ

english.text: [It is as if] We have placed shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced to remain up,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est comme si Nous avions enserré leurs cous dans des carcans leur arrivant jusqu’aux mentons et les obligeant à marcher têtes dressées,

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدّٗا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدّٗا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: and We have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have blocked their vision so they cannot see[2].
english.footnotes: [2] Because of their obstinacy and persistence in disbelief.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ou comme si Nous avions placé une barrière devant eux et une autre derrière eux, les rendant aveugles à la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: It is the same to them whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que tu les mettes en garde ou non, ils ne croiront pas.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ

english.text: You can only warn one who follows the Reminder[3] and fears the Most Compassionate unseen. So give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seul entend tes avertissements celui qui suit les enseignements du Coran et qui, loin des regards, craint le Tout Miséricordieux. A celui-là, tu peux annoncer le pardon de ses péchés et une généreuse rétribution.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: It is We Who give life to the dead, and record what they send forth and what they leave behind, and We keep an account of everything in a clear Record[4].
english.footnotes: [4] See footnote 35:11.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui allons ressusciter les morts dont Nous avons consigné les œuvres et les traces laissées par eux sur terre[2]. Tout a été minutieusement recensé dans un livre d’une grande clarté.
french.footnotes: [2] Les conséquences, bonnes ou mauvaises, de leurs actes accomplis de leur vivant sont enregistrées même après leur mort.

renderings.arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: Give them an example of the People of the Town when the messengers came to it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Propose-leur l’exemple des habitants de la cité à laquelle les messagers se sont présentés[3].
french.footnotes: [3] Antioche à laquelle se sont présentés les apôtres envoyés par Jésus, selon la majorité des exégètes.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: When We sent them two [messengers], but they rejected them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, “We are sent to you as messengers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous leur avons tout d’abord envoyé deux messagers qui furent traités d’imposteurs et que Nous avons donc assistés d’un troisième messager. Ils leur dirent : « Nous avons été envoyés à votre cité. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ

english.text: They said, “You are no more than human beings like us, and the Most Compassionate has not sent down anything. You are simply lying.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les habitants répliquèrent : « Vous n’êtes que des hommes comme nous qui ne faites que mentir. Le Tout Miséricordieux n’a absolument rien révélé ! »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are sent to you as messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les messagers répondirent : « Notre Seigneur sait parfaitement que nous sommes envoyés à votre cité.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

english.text: Our duty is only to convey the message clearly.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Notre mission consiste uniquement à vous transmettre le message en toute clarté. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

english.text: The people said, “We consider you as an evil omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and we will inflict upon you a painful punishment.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les habitants dirent : « Nous voyons en vous des oiseaux de malheur. Si vous ne cessez pas, nous vous lapiderons. Un douloureux châtiment vous sera infligé. »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّسۡرِفُونَ

english.text: The messengers said, “Your evil omen is with yourselves [because of your disbelief]. Is it[5] because you are admonished? Rather, you are a people who transgress all bounds.”
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., this threat.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les messagers répondirent : « Vous êtes les seuls responsables de votre malheur. Réagissez-vous ainsi simplement parce que vous êtes exhortés à suivre la vérité ? Vous avez, en réalité, dépassé toutes les limites de l’impiété ! »

renderings.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٞ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

english.text: A man came from the farthest end of the city, rushing, and said, “O my people, follow the messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Accourant du bout de la ville, un homme vint leur dire : « Mon peuple ! Suivez les messagers !

renderings.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرٗا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: Follow those who ask no recompense of you, and who are guided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Suivez ces hommes qui ne vous réclament aucun salaire et qui sont bien guidés.

renderings.arabic: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: Why should I not worship the One Who created me and to Whom you will all be brought back?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’aurais-je à ne pas adorer Celui qui m’a créé et à qui vous serez tous ramenés ?

renderings.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرّٖ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

english.text: Should I take besides Him other gods whose intercession cannot avail me in the least, nor can they come to my rescue, if the Most Compassionate wills to harm me?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Adopterais-je, en dehors de Lui, des divinités qui, si le Tout Miséricordieux me destinait un malheur, ne sauraient en rien le repousser, ni m’en délivrer ?

renderings.arabic: إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

english.text: Surely I would then be clearly misguided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je serais alors manifestement égaré.

renderings.arabic: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ

english.text: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je crois en votre Seigneur, alors écoutez. »

renderings.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: [But they killed him], so he was told[6], “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew[7]
english.footnotes: [6] After he was martyred for the sake of Allah. [7] He said so after Allah admitted him into paradise and he saw the pleasures therein.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il lui fut dit[4] : « Entre au Paradis ! » Il dit : « Si seulement mon peuple pouvait savoir
french.footnotes: [4] Après sa mort, tué par son peuple.

renderings.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ

english.text: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me among the honored ones.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que mon Seigneur m’a pardonné et placé au nombre des hôtes honorés du Paradis ! »

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

english.text: After his death, We did not send down any soldiers from heaven against his people, nor would We have done so.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Après sa mort, Nous n’avons pas eu besoin de faire descendre sur son peuple une armée venant du ciel.

renderings.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ

english.text: It was no more than a single blast, and immediately they were extinguished.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a suffi d’un seul Cri qui en fit des corps sans vie.

renderings.arabic: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

english.text: Alas for the humans! No messenger ever comes to them but they ridicule him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Malheur aux hommes[5] ! Nul messager ne leur est envoyé sans qu’ils ne l’accablent de moqueries.
french.footnotes: [5] Autre sens : quelle tristesse pour les hommes !

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: Do they not see how many generations We destroyed before them who will never come back to them[8]?
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., to the life of this world.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’ont-ils pas appris combien Nous avons anéanti avant eux de nations qu’ils ne verront plus jamais réapparaître

renderings.arabic: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ

english.text: Yet all of them will be brought before Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qui, toutes sans exception, seront devant Nous appelées à comparaître ?

renderings.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: There is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life and produce from it grain for them to eat.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est un signe pour les hommes dans la terre morte que Nous faisons revivre et de laquelle Nous tirons des céréales dont ils se nourrissent,

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ

english.text: And We have made therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dans laquelle Nous disposons des palmeraies et des vignes, et faisons jaillir des sources,

renderings.arabic: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: so that they may eat of its fruit that was not made by their hands[9]. Will they not then give thanks?
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., that which Allah has produced for them without labor on their part.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin qu’ils consomment de leurs fruits qui ne sont point l’œuvre de leurs mains. Ne vont-ils pas faire preuve de reconnaissance ?

renderings.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Glory be to the One Who created all types of things[10] that the earth produces, and of themselves, and of things that they have no knowledge about.
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., all species, all things in pairs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gloire à Celui qui a créé les différentes variétés d’arbres et de plantes, les hommes et les femmes, et diverses espèces de créatures dont ils ignorent jusqu’à l’existence !

renderings.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ

english.text: There is another sign for them in the night: We strip from it the daylight, and they are left in darkness.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est un autre signe pour les hommes dans l’obscurité de la nuit par laquelle Nous dépouillons le jour de sa lumière, si bien qu’ils se retrouvent plongés dans le noir.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ

english.text: The sun is running to its determined course. That is the design of the All-Mighty, All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est un signe également dans le soleil qui, soumis à la loi du Seigneur Tout-Puissant et Omniscient, poursuit sa course jusqu’à un terme[6] déjà fixé,
french.footnotes: [6] Ou : un lieu.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ

english.text: As for the moon, We have determined phases for it, until it becomes like an old palm stalk.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et dans la lune à laquelle Nous avons assigné des mansions, si bien qu’elle finit par ressembler à la tige desséchée et courbée de la branche d’un palmier.

renderings.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ

english.text: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor for the night to outstrip the day. Each is floating in its own orbit.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le soleil ne saurait rattraper la lune, ni la nuit devancer le jour. Chaque astre décrit une orbite bien déterminée.

renderings.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ

english.text: Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring[11] in the loaded Ark,
english.footnotes: [11] "Dhurriyyah" (lit., offspring); however, it is used here to denote ancestors (being the offspring of Noah) who were saved from the flood.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est un autre signe pour eux dans l’Arche bondée, à bord de laquelle Nous avons transporté ceux qui devaient assurer la pérennité de l’humanité.

renderings.arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ

english.text: and We created for them similar things on which they ride.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et Nous avons créé pour eux des vaisseaux identiques dans lesquels ils peuvent embarquer.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ

english.text: If We willed, We could drown them, then there would be no one to respond to their cry, nor could they be rescued,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous le voulions, Nous les engloutirions sous les eaux. Nul ne saurait alors les secourir et ils ne pourraient être sauvés.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: except by a mercy from Us, leaving them to enjoy for a while.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A moins que, par miséricorde pour eux, Nous les laissions jouir quelque temps de cette vie.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

english.text: When it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you and what is behind you[12], so that you may be shown mercy[13].”
english.footnotes:
[12] Of what awaits you in this life and in the Hereafter, or of the sins of the past and the future.
 [13] But they ignored the warning.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’il leur est dit : « Redoutez, afin d’être touchés par la miséricorde d’Allah, le châtiment qui pourrait vous frapper ici-bas et dans l’au-delà », ils tournent le dos.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ

english.text: No sign ever comes to them from their Lord except that they turn away from it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nul signe ne leur parvient de leur Seigneur sans qu’ils ne s’en détournent.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided you with”, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Should we feed those whom Allah could feed if He willed? You are clearly misguided!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et lorsqu’il leur est dit : « Offrez par charité une partie de ce qu’Allah vous a accordé », les mécréants lancent aux croyants : « Allons-nous nourrir ceux qu’Allah, s’Il le voulait, pourrait Lui-même nourrir ? Vous êtes manifestement dans l’erreur ! »

renderings.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: They say, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils disent : « Quand donc se réalisera cette menace, si vous dites la vérité ? »

renderings.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ

english.text: They are not awaiting but a single Blast that will seize them while they are still disputing[14].
english.footnotes: [14] The first blast (lit., a cry or a shriek) of the Trumpet will take them by surprise on the Day of Judgment while they will be disputing in their worldly affairs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils n’attendront pour cela qu’un seul Cri qui les surprendra en pleine dispute[7],
french.footnotes: [7] Le soufflement dans la Corne, annonçant la Résurrection, qui surprendra et foudroiera tous les vivants.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةٗ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: Then they will not be able to make a will, nor will they be able to return to their households.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: leur ôtant toute possibilité de laisser des recommandations ou de regagner leurs foyers.

renderings.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ

english.text: The Trumpet will be blown[15] [again], and at once they will rush from their graves to their Lord.
english.footnotes: [15] i.e., the second blast or blow.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il sera alors soufflé[8] dans la Corne, et voilà que, de leurs tombes, ils se précipiteront vers leur Seigneur,
french.footnotes: [8] Une seconde fois.

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: They will say, “Woe to us! Who has resurrected us from our resting place?” [They will be told,] “This is what the Most Compassionate promised, and the messengers told the truth.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: s’exclamant : « Malheur à nous ! Qui nous a arrachés à notre sommeil ? Voici que s’accomplit la menace du Tout Miséricordieux, les Messagers disaient donc la vérité. »[9]
french.footnotes: [9] Cette dernière phrase sera, selon certains commentateurs, prononcée par les croyants ou les anges.

renderings.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ

english.text: It will only be a single Blast, and at once they will all be brought before Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il suffira d’un seul Cri, et voilà que tous sans exception comparaîtront devant Nous.

renderings.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be recompensed except for what you used to do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, nul ne sera lésé en rien. Vous ne recevrez que la rétribution méritée de vos œuvres.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلٖ فَٰكِهُونَ

english.text: Indeed, on that Day the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les élus du Paradis seront, ce Jour-là, entièrement absorbés par les délices dont ils jouiront

renderings.arabic: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

english.text: they and their spouses will be reclining on couches in the shade.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: eux et leurs épouses, accoudés à l’ombre sur des lits somptueux.

renderings.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

english.text: They will have therein fruits and all what they ask for[16].
english.footnotes: [16] i.e., wish or desire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Là, ils verront tous leurs désirs exaucés et se délecteront des fruits les plus délicieux.

renderings.arabic: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ

english.text: “Peace”: a word from a Most Merciful Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Que la paix soit avec vous ! » Tels sont les mots qui leur seront adressés par le Seigneur, Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

english.text: “Stand apart [from the believers] this Day, O wicked ones!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Quant à vous criminels ! Tenez-vous aujourd’hui à l’écart.

renderings.arabic: ۞ أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: Did I not command you, O children of Adam, not to worship Satan, for he is your sworn enemy,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vous ai-Je pas ordonné, descendants d’Adam, de ne pas adorer Satan, votre ennemi déclaré,

renderings.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

english.text: but to worship Me? This is a straight path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et de Me vouer un culte exclusif et sincère, la seule voie du salut ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلّٗا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: He had already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not then have sense?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a, en vérité, égaré un grand nombre d’entre vous. Etiez-vous donc dépourvus de toute raison ?

renderings.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ

english.text: This is the Hell that you were promised.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici la Géhenne dont vous étiez menacés.

renderings.arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

english.text: Burn in it Today for your disbelief[17].”
english.footnotes: [17] i.e., because you used to disbelieve.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Entrez-y aujourd’hui pour prix de votre impiété. »

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

english.text: Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to all what they used to do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, Nous scellerons leurs bouches, donnant la parole à leurs mains et leurs pieds qui dénonceront tous les péchés qu’ils auront perpétrés.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: If We willed, We could have taken away their sight, so they would rush to find their way, but then how could they see?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous le voulions, Nous pourrions les frapper de cécité. Ils se précipiteraient alors à la recherche de leur chemin. Mais comment pourraient-ils le retrouver ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيّٗا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: And if We willed, We could have paralyzed them in their places[18], so they could neither move forward nor backward.
english.footnotes: [18] i.e., We could turn them into inanimate objects.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous le voulions, Nous pourrions les pétrifier, les empêchant d’avancer ou de reculer.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: Whomsoever We give a long life, We cause his strength to decline[19]. Do they not then understand?
english.footnotes: [19] Humans are born weak, then they reach their prime when they are young, then they grow physically and mentally weak when they are old.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A celui dont Nous prolongeons la vie, Nous retirons peu à peu ses facultés[10]. Sont-ils donc dépourvus de toute raison ?
french.footnotes: [10] Si bien qu’il retrouve l’état de faiblesse qui était le sien à sa naissance.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ وَقُرۡءَانٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is only a Reminder and a clear Qur’an
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne lui avons nullement enseigné la poésie[11] qui ne saurait d’ailleurs lui convenir. Le Coran n’est qu’une sage exhortation et une récitation parfaitement claire,
french.footnotes: [11] Réponse évidente aux païens de la Mecque qui prétendaient que le Prophète était un poète.

renderings.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّٗا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

english.text: so that he may warn those who are truly alive[20] and establish the argument against the disbelievers.
english.footnotes: [20] In heart and mind, i.e., those who have faith.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin que soit averti par lui tout être dont le cœur est encore vivant et que Notre sentence soit prononcée à l’encontre des mécréants.

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ

english.text: Do they not see that We have created for them livestock made by Our Hands, and then they are their owners?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne voient-ils pas que Nous avons créé pour eux, parmi tout ce que Nous avons créé à leur intention, des bestiaux dont ils sont les maîtres,

renderings.arabic: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: And We have made them subservient to them; some they ride, and from others they eat,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que Nous leur avons soumis si bien que des uns ils font leurs montures et des autres ils tirent nourritures,

renderings.arabic: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: and there are other benefits and drinks therein for them. Will they not then give thanks?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: breuvages et bien d’autres avantages. Ne feront-ils pas preuve de reconnaissance ?

renderings.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

english.text: Yet they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping that they may be helped.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ont adopté, en dehors d’Allah, des divinités dans l’espoir d’obtenir leur assistance.

renderings.arabic: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ

english.text: They cannot help them, yet they serve them as their dedicated guards[21].
english.footnotes: [21] Or their idols or so-called gods will be assembled to witness the punishment of their worshipers on the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais celles-ci ne pourront secourir leurs adorateurs qui pourtant prenaient sur terre leur défense[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Autre sens : mais celles-ci ne pourront secourir leurs adorateurs, alors même qu’elles assisteront à leur jugement (ou : à leur supplice).

renderings.arabic: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ

english.text: Do not let their words grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que leurs paroles ne t’affligent pas. Nous savons aussi bien ce qu’ils gardent secret que ce qu’ils laissent paraître.

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: Does man not see that We have created him from a sperm-drop, then[22] he becomes a clear adversary,
english.footnotes: [22] i.e., as soon as he becomes a self-sufficient being.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme ne sait-il pas que Nous l’avons créé d’un liquide insignifiant ? Le voilà pourtant qui se transforme en disputeur acharné.

renderings.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ

english.text: producing arguments[23] against Us while forgetting his own creation[24]. He says, “Who can give life to the bones after they have crumbled to dust?”
english.footnotes:
[23] Trying to prove that there is no life after death.
 [24] That we created him from dead matter to such an extent that he became now a clear disputant before Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Oubliant sa propre création, il dit : « Qui redonnera vie aux os devenus poussière ? »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ

english.text: Say, “The One Who created them in the first place will give life to them, for He has full knowledge of every created being;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Réponds : « Celui qui les a créés la première fois et qui connaît parfaitement tous les éléments de Sa création[13],
french.footnotes: [13] Autre sens : et dont le pouvoir de création est sans limite.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ

english.text: the One Who made for you fire out of the green tree, with which you kindle your fires[25].”
english.footnotes: [25] It alludes to the "markh" and "‘afār" trees in Arabia, whose green branches if struck against each other, it produces sparks.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui, pour vous, fait jaillir du bois vert une étincelle qui vous sert à allumer vos feux. »

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: Is not the One Who created the heavens and earth able to create the like of these [people]? Yes indeed, for He is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui a créé les cieux et la terre n’est-Il pas capable de créer d’autres hommes comme eux ? Si, car Il est le Créateur de toute chose, l’Omniscient !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

english.text: Whenever He wills something to be, He only says to it, “Be”, and it is.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il Lui suffit, lorsqu’Il veut une chose, de dire : « Sois ! » et celle-ci s’accomplit.

renderings.arabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: So glory be to the One in Whose Hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will all be returned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gloire à Celui qui règne en Maître absolu sur toute la Création et à qui vous serez tous ramenés !

renderings.arabic: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفّٗا

english.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les anges parfaitement alignés[1] !
french.footnotes: [1] En adoration devant leur Seigneur, comme le sont les fidèles en prière.

renderings.arabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا

english.text: and those who drive [the clouds],
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les anges chargés de pousser[2] !
french.footnotes: [2] Les nuages, selon la majorité des exégètes.

renderings.arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا

english.text: and those who recite Allah’s words[1],
english.footnotes: [1] Allah swears by three kinds of angels in these three above-mentioned verses to emphasize what comes in the next verse.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les anges qui ne cessent de réciter[3] !
french.footnotes: [3] Les paroles d’Allah qu’ils transmettent aux Messagers, selon la majorité des commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ

english.text: indeed, your God is One,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre Dieu est unique, à n’en point douter,

renderings.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ

english.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seigneur des cieux, de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux, et Seigneur des orients[4].
french.footnotes: [4] Et des occidents, précisent certains exégètes. Le soleil se lève en effet, et se couche, en des lieux différents selon les saisons.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ

english.text: We have adorned the sky with the beauty of the stars,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, paré le ciel le plus proche d’étoiles,

renderings.arabic: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ

english.text: and for safeguarding it against every rebellious devil,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: par lesquelles Nous le protégeons des démons rebelles

renderings.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ

english.text: so that they cannot eavesdrop on the highest assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side[2]
english.footnotes: [2] By meteors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui sont, par des projectiles lancés contre eux de tous côtés, empêchés d’écouter les anges dans le ciel,

renderings.arabic: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ

english.text: to repel them; and for them there will be a perpetual punishment,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: éloignés, puis voués à un châtiment éternel.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ

english.text: except who stealthily snatches away some words, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains parviennent néanmoins à saisir furtivement quelques mots, mais sont aussitôt atteints par un météore perçant.

renderings.arabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ

english.text: So ask them, “Are they more difficult to create or other things We created? We created them[3] from sticky clay.
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., their father Adam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande-leur s’il est plus difficile de les créer eux, que Nous avons créés d’argile visqueuse, ou tout ce que Nous avons créé en dehors d’eux[5] ?
french.footnotes: [5] Comme les cieux, la terre, les étoiles, les anges et les démons qui viennent d’être mentionnés.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ

english.text: Rather you are astonished, while they ridicule it,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu t’étonnes[6], tandis qu’eux te tournent en dérision,
french.footnotes: [6] De leur incrédulité.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ

english.text: and when they are reminded, they pay no heed,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: totalement indifférents à tes exhortations,

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ

english.text: and when they see a sign, they ridicule it,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: se moquant des miracles produits sous leurs yeux.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ

english.text: and they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils disent : « Ce n’est là, de toute évidence, que pure magie !

renderings.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ

english.text: Is it that when we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up again,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

renderings.arabic: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: and they believed, so We let them enjoy for a while.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui tous crurent en lui, si bien que Nous les avons laissés jouir quelque temps de cette vie.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande-leur comment ils peuvent attribuer des filles à ton Seigneur[27], tout en désirant eux-mêmes des garçons ?
french.footnotes: [27] Les païens affirmaient que les anges étaient les « filles d’Allah ».

english.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aurions-Nous créé les anges en leur présence pour qu’ils puissent affirmer qu’ils sont de sexe féminin ?

renderings.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ

english.text: No indeed, it is one of their fabrications when they say,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà un mensonge de leur part que d’affirmer

english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

renderings.arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’avez-vous donc à juger de cette façon ?

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.text: Do you have any compelling proof?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

renderings.arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Apportez donc le livre qui vous aurait été révélé à ce sujet, si vous dites la vérité.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

Précisons néanmoins que, selon la majorité des exégètes, le terme « djinns » désigne ici - la seule fois dans le Coran - les anges présentés par les païens comme les « filles d’Allah ».

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Si seulement nous possédions des Ecritures comme nos devanciers,

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.text: that it is surely they who will be given victory,

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Observe-les, ils verront bientôt ce qui les attend !

renderings.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque celui-ci s’abattra sur eux, ceux qui ont été vainement avertis passeront pourtant un bien mauvais moment.

renderings.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: And turn away from them for a while.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Détourne-toi donc de ces gens quelque temps.

renderings.arabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: Wait and see; soon they will see [their end].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et observe, ils verront bientôt ce qui les attend !

renderings.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english.text: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, far above what they ascribe [to Him],

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gloire à ton Seigneur Tout-Puissant que leurs blasphèmes ne sauraient atteindre !

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que les mérites des Messagers soient à jamais salués !

 [2] The oath's completion is that the Qur’an is inimitable and thus Allah's miracle.

french.text: Que de peuples avons-Nous anéantis avant eux qui crièrent au secours au moment où il n’était plus temps d’échapper au châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ

english.text: They wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves[3], and the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar!
english.footnotes: [3] The disbelievers demanded that an angel be sent to them to convey the message of Allah, not a human like themselves.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’étonnant que l’un des leurs soit venu les avertir, les impies disent : « C’est un sorcier habitué au mensonge !

renderings.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ

english.text: Has he made all gods into one God? Indeed, this is something strange!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Réduira-t-il les divinités à un seul dieu ? Voilà chose bien étrange ! »

renderings.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ

english.text: The leaders among them departed, saying, “Carry on as you are, and stay faithful to your gods. Indeed, there is a motive behind it[4].
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., The Prophet (ﷺ) only wants to gain influence and prestige for himself.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leurs chefs se retirèrent en disant : « Allez ! Et restez fidèles à vos divinités. Tout ceci est accompli dans un but bien précis[2].
french.footnotes: [2] Obtenir le pouvoir et les honneurs, expliquent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ

english.text: We have not heard of this in the last religion[5]. This is nothing but a fabrication.
english.footnotes: [5] It refers to Christianity or pagan Arab beliefs.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons rien entendu de tel dans la dernière religion. Ce n’est là que pure invention !

renderings.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ

english.text: Has the Reminder been sent down to him from among us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder[6], for they have not yet tasted My punishment.
english.footnotes: [6] They do not question the Prophet's (ﷺ) honesty; rather, they question the Qur’an itself. See 6:33.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A-t-il été choisi parmi nous pour recevoir la Révélation ? » N’ayant pas encore goûté Mon châtiment, ils doutent de l’authenticité du Coran.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ

english.text: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Bestower?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Disposent-ils des faveurs de ton Seigneur, le Tout-Puissant, le Grand Donateur[3] ?
french.footnotes: [3] Pour décider qui doit être choisi comme prophète. Ce verset est donc une réponse au verset précédent.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ

english.text: Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them? Then let them ascend by any means[7].
english.footnotes: [7] To manage the affairs of their dominion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A moins qu’ils ne soient les maîtres des cieux, de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux. Qu’ils suivent donc les voies menant au ciel.

renderings.arabic: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
