renderings.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or the one who is clearly misguided?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pourras-tu jamais te faire entendre de celui qui est sourd à la vérité ou guider celui qui est frappé de cécité et celui qui est manifestement égaré ?

renderings.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

english.text: Either We take you away [in death], We will surely exact retribution upon them,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que Nous te fassions disparaître avant de tirer vengeance d’eux

renderings.arabic: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ

english.text: or We will show you what We warned them of, for We have full power over them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ou que Nous leur infligions, de ton vivant, les tourments dont Nous les menaçons, Nous sommes en mesure de les châtier.

renderings.arabic: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: So hold fast to what is revealed to you. You are indeed on a straight path.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Attache-toi donc fermement à ce qui t’est révélé, car tu suis assurément la bonne direction.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ

english.text: This [Qur’an] is surely a glory[15] for you and your people, and you will [all] be questioned.
english.footnotes: [15] i.e., an honor or a reminder.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Cette révélation, sur laquelle vous serez un jour interrogés, fera certainement ta gloire et celle de ta nation[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Autre sens : est un rappel pour toi et ta nation.

renderings.arabic: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ

english.text: Ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before you: Did We appoint gods to be worshiped besides the Most Compassionate?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande donc aux peuples auxquels Nous avons envoyé avant toi Nos Messagers si Nous leur avons désigné, en dehors du Tout Miséricordieux, des divinités dignes d’adoration.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his courtiers, so he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, envoyé Moïse avec Nos signes à Pharaon et aux grands d’Egypte auxquels il dit : « Je suis le Messager du Seigneur de la Création. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ

english.text: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais ils accueillirent les miracles qu’il produisit sous leurs yeux en les tournant en dérision.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

english.text: Every sign We showed them was greater than the one before it[16], and We seized them with punishment[17] so that they may turn in repentance.
english.footnotes:
[16] i.e., the bright hand and the staff turning into a serpent. See 20:17-22.
 [17] i.e., the famine, scarcity of crops, floods, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood. See 7:130-133.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne leur avons pourtant montré aucun miracle qui ne fût plus prodigieux que le précédent, les soumettant à toutes sortes de calamités afin qu’ils renoncent à leur impiété.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ

english.text: They said, “O magician, call upon your Lord for us, by virtue of the covenant He has made with you[18]; we will surely accept guidance.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Toi qui pratiques la magie ! Implore pour nous ton Seigneur en vertu de Sa promesse envers toi[13]. Nous suivrons alors ta voie. »
french.footnotes: [13] De nous délivrer de ce supplice, si nous proclamons notre foi. Chaque fois que les Egyptiens étaient atteints par un fléau (les neuf plaies d’Egypte), ils s’engageaient devant Moïse à croire en lui et à laisser partir avec lui les Hébreux s’il les délivrait de leurs souffrances.

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ

english.text: But as soon We removed the punishment from them, they broke their promise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais dès que Nous mettions fin à leurs tourments, voilà qu’ils violaient leur engagement.

renderings.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, saying, “O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these streams[19] flowing at my feet? Do you not see?
english.footnotes: [19] i.e., branches of the Nile River.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon fit cette proclamation à son peuple : « Mon peuple ! Ne suis-je pas maître du royaume d’Egypte avec tous ces canaux qui coulent à mes pieds ? Ne voyez-vous donc pas ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

english.text: Or am I not better than this contemptible one who can hardly express himself[20]?
english.footnotes: [20] Moses had a speech impediment prior to his mission. However, when he became a prophet he asked Allah to remove his impediment, and his prayer was answered. See 20:25-36.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne suis-je pas meilleur que cet être méprisable qui sait à peine s’exprimer ?

renderings.arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ

english.text: Then why are there not sent down upon him bracelets of gold or come with him angels to support him?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si seulement des bracelets en or avaient été lancés sur lui[14] ou s’il était accompagné d’anges. »
french.footnotes: [14] Signe de son élection.

renderings.arabic: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

english.text: Thus he made a fool of his people and they obeyed him. They were indeed a wicked people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon abusa de l’ignorance de son peuple qui se laissa duper. Son peuple s’était en effet écarté du droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: When they angered Us, We exacted Our retribution and drowned them all.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’ils eurent provoqué Notre courroux, Nous tirâmes vengeance d’eux, les engloutissant tous sous les eaux.

renderings.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ

english.text: Thus We made them a precedent and a lesson[21] for the later generations.
english.footnotes: [21] A precedent for those who do not learn any lesson from their example, and a lesson for those who are keen to learn a lesson.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous fîmes d’eux un exemple et une leçon pour ceux qui viendraient après eux.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ

english.text: When the example of the son of Mary was given, your people laughed and jeered[22],
english.footnotes: [22] When 21:98 was revealed, warning the pagans that all what they worship besides Allah will be in Hell, a poet who was a staunch enemy of Islam, Abdullah ibn az-Ziba‘ra, along with other pagans jeered and laughed arguing that Jesus will be in Hell as well! The Prophet (ﷺ) replied that the verse was talking exclusively about idols, adding that Jesus himself did not ask to be worshiped. Verse 21:101 was later revealed in support of the Prophet declaring that they are exempted.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque est cité en exemple le fils de Marie, voici que ton peuple exulte à grands cris,

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ

english.text: and they said, “Are Our gods better or he[23]?” They only mentioned him to you for the sake of argument. They are indeed a contentious people.
english.footnotes: [23] i.e., Jesus.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: disant : « Est-il meilleur que Nos divinités ? » Ils ne te le donnent en exemple que par goût de la polémique et de la dispute[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Les païens de la Mecque, expliquent nombre d’exégètes, exultèrent pensant avoir invoqué un argument irréfutable contre le Prophète. En effet, selon eux, Jésus n’est pas meilleur que leurs divinités, car si celles-ci sont adorées par eux, Jésus est adoré par les chrétiens. Or, Allah dit dans le Coran : « Vous et les fausses divinités que vous adorez en dehors d’Allah servirez de combustible à la Géhenne. » (21, 98). Argument fallacieux, car Jésus n’a jamais appelé les hommes à l’adorer et les idoles ne sont que des objets inertes. Allah interrogera d’ailleurs Jésus, le Jour de la résurrection, en ces termes : « Jésus, fils de Marie ! Est-ce toi qui as demandé aux hommes de t’élever, toi et ta mère, au rang de divinités en dehors d’Allah ? » Il répondra : « Gloire à Toi ! Il ne m’appartient pas de m’attribuer ce rang sans droit. » (5, 116)

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

english.text: He was only a slave whom We[24] favored and made him an example for the Children of Israel.
english.footnotes: [24] i.e., Allah Almighty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jésus n’est en réalité qu’un de Nos serviteurs que Nous avons comblé de Nos faveurs et dont Nous avons fait un signe pour les fils d’Israël.

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ

english.text: If We willed, We could [destroy you all and] replace you with angels, succeeding you on earth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si Nous le voulions, Nous vous remplacerions par des anges qui se succéderaient les uns aux autres sur terre[16].
french.footnotes: [16] Ou : qui vous succéderaient sur terre.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

english.text: And he [i.e., Jesus] will be a sign of the Hour; so do not have doubt about it and follow me[25]. This is a straight path.
english.footnotes: [25] i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il sera un signe précurseur de l’Heure[17], au sujet de laquelle nul doute n’est permis. Suivez donc Ma voie, qui est la voie du salut.
french.footnotes: [17] Allusion, selon la majorité des exégètes, à la descente de Jésus à la fin des temps. D’autres comprennent ce verset ainsi : la révélation du Coran est un signe de l’imminence de l’Heure.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: Do not let Satan turn you away [from the straight path], for he is your sworn enemy.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vous laissez surtout pas détourner de cette vérité par Satan, votre ennemi déclaré.

renderings.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english.text: When Jesus came with clear signs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of that concerning which you differ; so fear Allah and obey me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Réalisant devant les fils d’Israël des miracles prodigieux, Jésus leur dit : « Je suis venu en tant que prophète pour vous éclairer sur une partie des questions qui vous divisent. Craignez donc Allah et obéissez-moi.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

english.text: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah, en vérité, est mon Seigneur et le vôtre auquel vous devez un culte exclusif et sincère. Telle est la voie du salut. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ

english.text: But the factions differed among themselves [about Jesus]; so woe to the wrongdoers from the punishment of a painful Day!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais bientôt les sectes se divisèrent à son sujet. Malheur à ceux parmi eux qui se montrent injustes, car ils auront à affronter le châtiment d’un jour douloureux.

renderings.arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

english.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them by surprise when they least expect it?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’attendent-ils sinon que l’Heure vienne les surprendre sans qu’ils s’y attendent ?

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

english.text: On that Day, close friends will become enemies to one another, except the righteous,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les amis les plus intimes seront, ce Jour-là, les pires ennemis, excepté ceux qui auront vécu dans la piété[18],
french.footnotes: [18] Toute amitié qui n’aura pas été fondée sur l’amour d’Allah se transformera, le Jour de la résurrection, en animosité.

renderings.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ

english.text: [It will be said to them], “O My slaves, there is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: auxquels il sera dit : « Mes serviteurs ! Vous serez aujourd’hui préservés de toute crainte et de toute affliction,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ

english.text: [those] who believed in Our verses and submitted [to Us as Muslims].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: vous qui avez cru en Nos signes et vécu dans la soumission.

renderings.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ

english.text: Enter Paradise, you and your companions[26], rejoicing in bliss.”
english.footnotes: [26] i.e., your spouses, children, friends, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Entrez, vous et vos semblables[19], au Paradis où vous serez comblés de joie. »
french.footnotes: [19] Ou : vous et vos épouses.

renderings.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: Golden trays and cups will be passed around among them; there will be all that souls desire and eyes delight in, and you will abide therein forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: On fera circuler parmi eux des plats et des coupes en or. Ils y trouveront tout ce qu’une âme peut désirer et y contempleront les spectacles les plus ravissants. « Vous y demeurerez éternellement.

renderings.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: That is Paradise which you will inherit for what you used to do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici le Paradis dont vous avez hérité en récompense de vos œuvres passées.

renderings.arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: You will have therein abundant fruit[27] to eat from.
english.footnotes: [27] It also means everything delicious.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vous y disposerez de toutes les variétés de fruits dont vous vous délecterez. »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

english.text: Indeed, the wicked will be in the punishment of Hell forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les criminels, pour leur part, subiront les tourments éternels de la Géhenne

renderings.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ

english.text: It will not be lightened for them, and they will remain therein in utter despair.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui ne leur seront jamais allégés mais qui, au contraire, les feront sombrer dans un profond désespoir.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: We did not wrong them, but they themselves were the wrongdoers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne les avons pas lésés, mais ils se sont lésés eux-mêmes.

renderings.arabic: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ

english.text: They will cry out, “O Mālik[28], let your Lord put an end to us!” He will say, “You are here to stay.”
english.footnotes: [28] The chief keeper of Hell.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils supplieront : « Mâlik[20] ! Que ton Seigneur en finisse avec nous. » Il répondra : « Vous subirez, au contraire, ces affres pour l’éternité ! »
french.footnotes: [20] Nom du gardien de l’Enfer.

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

english.text: We surely brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Seigneur dira : « Nous vous avons clairement exposé la vérité, mais la plupart d’entre vous avaient en horreur la vérité. »

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ

english.text: Have they devised a plan[29]? We too have devised a plan.
english.footnotes: [29] Against the Prophet (ﷺ); it is referring to the pagans of Makkah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Trament-ils quelque complot ? Nous saurons alors le déjouer.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ

english.text: Do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and private counsels? Yes indeed, and Our angel-messengers are with them recording everything.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien croient-ils que Nous n’entendons pas leurs conversations secrètes et leurs conciliabules ? Bien au contraire ! Nos envoyés[21], à leurs côtés, prennent soin de tout consigner.
french.footnotes: [21] Les anges.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ

english.text: Say, “If the Most Compassionate truly had a son, I would be the first of [his] worshipers[30].”
english.footnotes: [30] Or I would be the first to approve it, as I obey Him in everything; whereas I deny that, for He has no offspring.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Si le Tout Miséricordieux avait un enfant, je serais le premier à l’adorer. »

renderings.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english.text: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the Throne, far above what they ascribe [to Him].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gloire au Seigneur des cieux et de la terre, Seigneur du Trône que leurs blasphèmes ne sauraient toucher !

renderings.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

english.text: So leave them to indulge in falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day that they are promised.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse-les donc à leurs allégations et à leurs futilités, jusqu’au Jour où ils devront affronter le châtiment dont ils sont menacés.

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: It is He Who is God in the heaven and God on earth, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le seul dieu digne d’être adoré dans le ciel et sur la terre, l’infiniment Sage, Celui auquel rien ne peut échapper.

renderings.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

english.text: Blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Béni soit Celui qui règne en Maître absolu sur les cieux, la terre et ce qui se trouve entre eux, qui seul a connaissance de l’avènement de l’Heure et à qui vous serez tous ramenés.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Those whom they supplicate[31] besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly[32].
english.footnotes:
[31] i.e., worship.
 [32] i.e., except those who testify knowingly that none is worthy of worship except Allah, such as Jesus, Ezra, the angels, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les fausses divinités que les idolâtres invoquent en dehors de Lui ne seront pas autorisées à intercéder en leur faveur. Seuls pourront intercéder ceux qui, en toute connaissance, auront témoigné de la vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

english.text: If you ask them who created them[33], they will surely say, “Allah.” How are they then deluded?
english.footnotes: [33] i.e., those who associate partners with Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si tu leur demandes qui les a créés, ils répondront assurément : « C’est Allah ! » Comment peuvent-ils ensuite se détourner ?

renderings.arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying[34], “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
english.footnotes: [34] i.e., Allah knows the complaint of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) about his people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Prophète se plaignit : « Seigneur ! Ces gens refusent de croire. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: So turn away from them and say, “Peace[35].” They will come to know.
english.footnotes: [35] Safety and security, i.e., “I will not harm you.” This was before granting permission to the Prophet (ﷺ) for armed struggle.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Détourne-toi d’eux et dis-leur : « Allez en paix ! » Car ils sauront bientôt.

renderings.arabic: حمٓ

english.text: Hā Mīm[1].
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Hâ-Mîm.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

english.text: By the clear Book.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le Livre parfaitement clair !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

english.text: Indeed, We sent it[2] down on a blessed night, We have been warning about.
english.footnotes: [2] The revelation of the Qur’an started on the Night of Decree (al-Qadr) in the month of Ramadān, the 9th month of the lunar calendar. The Night of Decree is better than one thousand months. See (97:1 and 2:185).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons fait descendre par une nuit bénie[2] - Nous n’avons eu de cesse d’avertir les hommes -,
french.footnotes: [2] La Nuit des décrets divins ou « Nuit du destin ».

renderings.arabic: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ

english.text: On that night, every matter of wisdom is determined[3]
english.footnotes: [3] The angels record and descend with whatever Allah has decreed for the coming year, according to what is inscribed in the Preserved Tablet.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: nuit où toute décision est arrêtée

renderings.arabic: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ

english.text: by Our command. We have always sent messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: conformément à Notre ordre. Nous n’avons cessé d’envoyer des Messagers

renderings.arabic: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: as a mercy from your Lord. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: par un effet de la miséricorde de ton Seigneur, Lui qui entend tout et sait tout.

renderings.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

english.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le Seigneur des cieux, de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux, si vous avez quelque certitude.

renderings.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: None has the right to be worshiped except Him, Who gives life and causes death – your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’est de divinité digne d’être adorée que Lui. Il donne la vie et la mort. Il est votre Seigneur et celui de vos ancêtres les plus éloignés.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ

english.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, remplis de doute, ils ne font que s’amuser.

renderings.arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: So wait for a day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke[4],
english.footnotes: [4] Referring to the drought that affected the pagans of Makkah severely, so they came to the Prophet (ﷺ), begging him to supplicate Allah to remove the affliction from them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Attends donc le jour où, du ciel, viendra une fumée bien visible

renderings.arabic: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

english.text: that will overwhelm the people. This is a painful punishment!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui enveloppera les hommes. « Voilà un châtiment douloureux. »

renderings.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: [They will cry,] “Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; we will surely believe!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils diront : « Si Tu nous libères, Seigneur, de ce châtiment, nous serons croyants[3]. »
french.footnotes: [3] Autre sens : libère-nous, Seigneur, de ce châtiment ! Nous sommes à présent croyants.

renderings.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: How will they take heed, when a messenger who explained things clearly has already come to them?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment pourraient-ils se repentir, alors que s’est présenté à eux un prophète au message parfaitement clair

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ

english.text: Then they turned away from him and said, “[He is] a madman, taught by others.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dont ils se sont pourtant détournés, disant : « C’est un possédé ou un homme qui ne fait que répéter ce qui lui a été enseigné ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ

english.text: We shall hold the punishment back for a while, but you will surely return [to disbelief].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous libérerons quelque temps du châtiment, mais vous reviendrez sûrement à vos errements.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

english.text: On the Day when We seize [them] with the greatest assault, We will surely exact retribution.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le jour où Nous les saisirons violemment, Nous tirerons vengeance d’eux.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ

english.text: Indeed, We tested the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble messenger came to them,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons éprouvé avant eux le peuple de Pharaon auquel un noble Messager était venu dire :

renderings.arabic: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

english.text: [saying], “Hand over to me the slaves of Allah[5]. I am indeed a trustworthy messenger to you,
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., the Children of Israel.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Laissez partir avec moi les serviteurs d’Allah, je suis pour vous un Messager digne de foi.

renderings.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: and do not be arrogant towards Allah. I have certainly come to you with clear proof.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne refusez pas par orgueil d’obéir à Allah, je vous apporte des preuves évidentes.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ

english.text: And I certainly seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death[6].
english.footnotes: [6] Or assault me with your tongues.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: J’implore la protection de mon Seigneur, qui est aussi le vôtre, au cas où vous chercheriez à me lapider.

renderings.arabic: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ

english.text: If you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si vous ne croyez pas en ma mission, alors au moins laissez-moi en paix. »

renderings.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ

english.text: Then he called upon his Lord, “These are wicked people”.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Moïse implora son Seigneur : « Voilà un peuple impie ! »

renderings.arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

english.text: [Allah said], “Leave along with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah ordonna : « Quitte avec Mes serviteurs le pays à la faveur de la nuit et sache que vous serez poursuivis.

renderings.arabic: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ

english.text: And leave the sea parted[7]; for they are surely an army destined to drown.”
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., calm and still, in order that Pharaoh and his soldiers would follow you and be drowned.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse la mer béante, vos ennemis seront engloutis[4]. »
french.footnotes: [4] Lorsque lui et les fils d’Israël eurent traversé la mer à sec, Moïse voulut frapper la mer avec son bâton afin qu’elle retrouve son état initial et qu’elle forme une barrière entre lui et Pharaon, empêchant ce dernier de le rattraper. Mais Allah lui ordonna de la laisser telle quelle et lui annonça que ses ennemis y seraient noyés (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ

english.text: [Imagine] how many gardens and springs they left behind,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de vergers et de sources ont-ils laissés derrière eux,

renderings.arabic: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ

english.text: and crops and splendid mansions,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que de magnifiques plantations et de séjours somptueux,

renderings.arabic: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ

english.text: and luxuries they used to rejoice therein.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que de délices dont ils avaient si longtemps joui,

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english.text: So it was; and We made another people inherit all that.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que Nous avons laissés en héritage à un autre peuple. Il en fut ainsi !

renderings.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ

english.text: Neither the heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they given any respite.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ni le ciel, ni la terre ne les pleurèrent et il ne leur fut accordé aucun sursis.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ

english.text: Thus did We save the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, délivré les fils d’Israël des affres de l’humiliation

renderings.arabic: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

english.text: from Pharaoh. He was indeed arrogant who transgressed all bounds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que leur infligeait Pharaon, tyran plein d’orgueil et porté à la transgression.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

english.text: We chose them[8] knowingly over all other peoples.
english.footnotes: [8] We chose the Children of Israel over all other peoples of their time for their numerous prophets.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en toute connaissance, élu les fils d’Israël parmi les nations

renderings.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ

english.text: And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et produit devant eux des miracles qui furent autant de grâces manifestes à leur intention.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

english.text: Indeed, these [Makkans] say,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux-là osent pourtant affirmer :

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

english.text: “There is nothing after our first death, and we will not be resurrected,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Il n’y a rien après la mort, nous ne serons pas ressuscités.

renderings.arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: then bring back our forefathers if you are truthful.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Faites donc revenir nos ancêtres, si vous dites la vérité ! »

renderings.arabic: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ

english.text: Are they better [in power] or the people of Tubba‘[9] and those who were before them? We destroyed them, for they were truly wicked[10].
english.footnotes:
[9] i.e., the people of Sheba.
 [10] Tubba’ al-Himyari was a righteous Yemeni king of ancient times whose people persisted in disbelief and were destroyed; nonetheless, they were more powerful and superior to the pagans of Makkah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sont-ils supérieurs au peuple de Toubba’[5] et aux nations antérieures que Nous avons pourtant anéantis pour prix de leur impiété ?
french.footnotes: [5] Le peuple de Saba, selon Ibn Kathîr.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

english.text: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them for amusement.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous n’avons pas créé les cieux, la terre et tout ce qui se trouve entre eux, par jeu.

renderings.arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: We have not created them except for a true purpose, but most of them do not know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne les avons créés que pour une juste raison, ce qui échappe à la plupart d’entre eux.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

english.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the time appointed for them all,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour du jugement est le moment fixé pour le grand Rassemblement des hommes,

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

english.text: the Day when no patron[11] will avail another in the least, nor will they be helped,
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., protector, close associate, kith and kin, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jour où nul ne pourra bénéficier de l’aide d’un proche ou d’un quelconque secours,

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english.text: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à l’exception de ceux à qui Allah fera miséricorde. C’est Lui, en vérité, le Tout-Puissant, le Très Miséricordieux.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

english.text: Indeed, the tree of Zaqqūm
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Des fruits de l’arbre Zaqqoum

renderings.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ

english.text: will be the food of the sinful,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: seront nourris les pécheurs endurcis,

renderings.arabic: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ

english.text: like molten metal that will boil in their bellies
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: pareils à du métal en fusion[6], ils bouillonneront dans les entrailles
french.footnotes: [6] Ou : du marc d’huile.

renderings.arabic: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ

english.text: like the boiling of scalding water.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: comme de l’eau en ébullition.

renderings.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

english.text: [It will be said], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Saisissez-le et traînez-le jusqu’au milieu du Brasier !

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ

english.text: Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis versez-lui sur le crâne de l’eau bouillante ! »

renderings.arabic: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ

english.text: “Taste this. You are surely the mighty and honorable![12]
english.footnotes: [12] Abu Jahl, the chief of pagans in Makkah, replied to the warning of punishment in the Hereafter by saying, “How can I be punished when I am the mighty and honorable one!” So Allah killed him in the Battle of Badr and humiliated him, and revealed this verse. He will be taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder of his own words and additional torment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Goûte ce châtiment, toi le puissant, le noble[7] !
french.footnotes: [7] Ces mots lui seront adressés par moquerie.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ

english.text: This is what you [all] used to doubt.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici le châtiment que vous mettiez en doute ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a safe place,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui auront vécu dans la crainte de leur Seigneur seront, quant à eux, dans un lieu sûr,

renderings.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ

english.text: in gardens and springs,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: au milieu de vergers et de sources vives

renderings.arabic: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

english.text: wearing fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où les uns feront face aux autres, vêtus de soie fine et de brocart.

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ

english.text: So it will be, and We will marry them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il en sera ainsi. Nous les aurons unis à de blanches houris aux grands yeux noirs.

renderings.arabic: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

english.text: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, safe and secure.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils obtiendront toutes les variétés de fruits qu’ils demanderont, sans jamais craindre la privation.

renderings.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

english.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ne connaîtront plus jamais la mort et seront préservés des tourments du Brasier

renderings.arabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

english.text: as a grace from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: par ton Seigneur qui les comblera ainsi de Ses faveurs. Voilà le bonheur suprême.

renderings.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

english.text: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your own language, so that they may take heed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est uniquement pour qu’ils en comprennent et méditent les enseignements que Nous avons révélé le Coran dans ta langue.

renderings.arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ

english.text: Then wait; they too are waiting.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Attends donc la suite des événements, eux aussi attendent.

renderings.arabic: حمٓ

english.text: Hā Mīm[1].
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Hâ-Mîm.[1]
french.footnotes: [1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.

renderings.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

english.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Coran est une révélation d’Allah, le Tout-Puissant, l’infiniment Sage.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Indeed, there are signs in the heavens and earth for the believers;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est dans les cieux et sur la terre bien des signes pour les croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ

english.text: and in your creation and the living creatures that He spreads out, there are signs for people who are certain in faith.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre propre création et la diversité des espèces animales qu’Il a dispersées sur terre sont également des signes pour des hommes qui croient fermement.

renderings.arabic: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

english.text: And in the alternation of the night and day, the provision that Allah sends down from the sky[2], reviving thereby the earth after its death, and directing of the winds, there are signs for people of understanding.
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., the rain.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’alternance du jour et de la nuit, la pluie bienfaisante qu’Allah fait descendre du ciel et par laquelle Il redonne vie à la terre morte, la diversité des vents, sont autant de signes pour des hommes capables de raisonner.

renderings.arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: These are the verses of Allah that We recite to you in truth. What message will they believe in after Allah and His verses?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tels sont les versets d’Allah que Nous te récitons en toute vérité. En quelle parole pourront-ils croire s’ils ne croient pas aux versets d’Allah ?

renderings.arabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ

english.text: Woe to every sinful liar,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Malheur à tous les menteurs et pécheurs endurcis

renderings.arabic: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

english.text: who hears the verses of Allah being recited to him, yet he persists in his arrogance, as if he did not hear them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, lorsque les versets d’Allah leur sont récités, s’obstinent par orgueil à les rejeter, comme s’ils ne les avaient pas entendus. Annonce-leur un douloureux châtiment.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

english.text: When he comes to know anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’ils prennent connaissance de certains de Nos versets, ils les tournent en dérision. Voilà ceux qui sont voués à un châtiment humiliant

renderings.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

english.text: Behind them is Hell; neither their gains nor those whom they took besides Allah as protectors will avail them anything, and for them there will be a great punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qui sont destinés à la Géhenne. Les richesses qu’ils ont amassées ne leur seront d’aucune utilité, pas plus que les divinités qu’ils ont adoptées en dehors d’Allah. Ils sont voués à d’horribles tourments !

renderings.arabic: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ

english.text: This [Qur’an] is guidance, and for those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord, there will be a scourge of painful torment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce livre est un guide. Ceux donc qui rejettent les versets de leur Seigneur subiront le châtiment le plus affreux et le plus douloureux.

renderings.arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: It is Allah Who has subjected for you the sea, so that the ships may sail on it by His command, and so that you may seek His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Allah qui vous a soumis la mer sur laquelle, par Sa volonté, voguent des vaisseaux à bord desquels vous partez en quête de Ses faveurs. Peut-être Lui en serez-vous reconnaissants !

renderings.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english.text: And He has subjected for you all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; all is from Him. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.
