french.footnotes: [9] Le démon qui lui suggérait le mal sur terre, selon nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ

english.text: Allah will say, “Do not argue in My presence, for I had already given you the warning.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah leur dira : « Inutile de vous disputer devant Moi, car vous avez suffisamment été avertis par Mes Messagers.

renderings.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ

english.text: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to My slaves.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mes arrêts ne sauraient être modifiés et Mes serviteurs être injustement châtiés. »

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ

english.text: [Beware of] the Day when We will say to Hell, “Have you reached your fill?” It will say, “Are there any more?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, Nous dirons à la Géhenne : « As-tu fait le plein de damnés ? » Et elle répondra : « Peut-on en rajouter[10] ? »
french.footnotes: [10] Ces paroles signifient soit que l’Enfer, effectivement plein, se demandera comment il pourra accueillir d’autres damnés, soit que l’Enfer réclamera d’autres damnés qu’il sera disposé à accueillir.

renderings.arabic: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ

english.text: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Paradis, quant à lui, sera placé à proximité des pieux croyants

renderings.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٖ

english.text: [It will be said], “This is what you were promised; this is for everyone who constantly turned [to Allah] and was dutiful,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: auxquels il sera dit : « Voici ce qui a été promis à tous ceux qui étaient pleins de repentir et de respect pour Nos commandements,

renderings.arabic: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٖ مُّنِيبٍ

english.text: who feared the Most Compassionate unseen[15], and came with a devoted heart.
english.footnotes: [15] Or while he is in private.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui, loin des regards, craignaient le Tout Miséricordieux et qui sont venus à Lui le cœur repentant.

renderings.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ

english.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternity.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Entrez-y en paix ! Voici un jour qui se prolongera éternellement ! »

renderings.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدٞ

english.text: They will have therein all what they wish for, and We have yet more[16].
english.footnotes: [16] Of unimaginable pleasures such as looking at the Face of Allah Almighty. See 10:26 and 75:22-23.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils y obtiendront tout ce qu’ils désireront et trouveront davantage encore auprès de Nous[11].
french.footnotes: [11] Pouvoir contempler le Visage de leur Seigneur, selon la majorité des exégètes.

renderings.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

english.text: How many nations We destroyed before these [Makkans] who were stronger than them in might! They sought refuge in the land. Did they find any escape?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que de peuples avons-Nous anéantis avant eux. Bien plus puissants qu’eux, ceux-ci avaient sillonné le monde et exploité la terre bien plus qu’ils n’ont pu le faire. Ont-ils pu échapper à Nos rigueurs ?

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٞ

english.text: Indeed, in that is a reminder for anyone who has a [mindful] heart or lends an attentive ear.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà assurément une leçon pour quiconque est doué de raison et prête une oreille attentive.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٖ

english.text: Indeed, We created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness touched Us[17].
english.footnotes: [17] It is believed that this verse came in response to the Jews who claimed that after the Lord made the heavens and the earth in six days, He rested on the seventh day. See Exodus 31:17.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, créé les cieux, la terre et ce qui se trouve entre eux, en six jours sans éprouver la moindre peine.

renderings.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ

english.text: So bear patiently [O Prophet] what they say, and glorify the praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset[18].
english.footnotes: [18] This and the following verse refer to the times of the five daily prayers; before the sun rises and sets (i.e., the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Supporte donc patiemment leurs paroles et célèbre, par les louanges, la gloire de ton Seigneur avant le lever du soleil et avant son coucher.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

english.text: And glorify Him in the night[19] and after the prayers.
english.footnotes: [19] The night (the Maghrib, ‘Isha’ prayers).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exalte également Sa gloire une partie de la nuit et après chaque prière[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Ce verset et le précédent feraient allusion aux prières obligatoires et surérogatoires.

renderings.arabic: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ

english.text: And listen! On the Day when the Caller will call out from a nearby place[20],
english.footnotes: [20] The angel who will blow the second trumpet for the Resurrection.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ecoute attentivement l’appel que lancera l’ange[13] d’un lieu tout proche,
french.footnotes: [13] Chargé de souffler dans la Corne, annonce du Jugement dernier.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ

english.text: the Day when they will hear the Blast [of the second Trumpet] in truth[21]. That is the Day of Resurrection.
english.footnotes: [21] See footnote below 50:20.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le Jour où les hommes, entendant le Cri terrifiant de l’Heure, quitteront leurs tombes.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

english.text: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us is the final return.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui donnons la vie et la mort, et c’est à Nous que les hommes feront retour.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرٞ

english.text: On the Day when the earth will be rent asunder for them as they hasten forth [from their graves]; that is an easy gathering for Us.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, la terre se fendra, les laissant quitter précipitamment leurs tombes. Il Nous sera alors aisé de les rassembler.

renderings.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

english.text: We know best what they say, and you are not there to compel them to believe. But remind with the Qur’an those who fear My warning.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous connaissons parfaitement leurs allégations. Tu n’as pas, quant à toi, à les contraindre à embrasser la foi. Exhorte simplement par le Coran quiconque redoute l’exécution de Ma menace.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا

english.text: By the winds that scatter [dust],
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les vents qui dispersent la poussière violemment !

renderings.arabic: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا

english.text: and by the clouds carrying loads of water,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les nuages chargés lourdement !

renderings.arabic: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا

english.text: and by the ships that sail with ease,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les vaisseaux qui voguent légèrement !

renderings.arabic: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا

english.text: and by the angels who distribute [blessings] by His command.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les anges qui répartissent les commandements !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ

english.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce qui vous est promis s’accomplira certainement,

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ

english.text: and the Judgment will surely come to pass.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le Jugement des hommes aura lieu inéluctablement.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ

english.text: By the heaven with its pathways[1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., tracks or orbits.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le ciel si magnifiquement structuré !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ

english.text: Indeed, you [Makkans] have conflicting views[2].
english.footnotes: [2] Concerning the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vos avis sont divergents au sujet du Messager

renderings.arabic: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ

english.text: He who is diverted from it is destined to be diverted.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dont seuls se détournent ceux qui ont été égarés.

renderings.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ

english.text: Doomed[3] are those who base their beliefs on conjecture.
english.footnotes: [3] May they be destroyed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que soient maudits les menteurs invétérés,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ

english.text: those who are steeped in ignorance heedlessly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui vivent dans l’insouciance et l’impiété,

renderings.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

english.text: They ask [mockingly], “When is the Day of Judgment?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et demandent : « Quand viendra le Jour dernier ? »

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ

english.text: It is the Day when they will be punished by the Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jour où, dans le Feu, ils seront pourtant tourmentés

renderings.arabic: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

english.text: [It will be said], “Taste your punishment! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et où il leur sera lancé : « Goûtez le châtiment que vous avez mérité ! Voici les tourments dont vous vouliez hâter l’arrivée ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and springs,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui craignent leur Seigneur seront, quant à eux, au milieu de jardins et de sources,

renderings.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ

english.text: receiving what their Lord will give them, for they were indeed doers of good beforehand.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: jouissant de tous les délices que leur Seigneur aura mis à leur disposition. Ils étaient, en effet, sur terre prompts à accomplir le bien,

renderings.arabic: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ

english.text: They used to sleep only a little at night[4],
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., spending most of the night in prayer, reciting the Qur’an, and in supplication.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ne goûtant au sommeil qu’une petite partie de la nuit,

renderings.arabic: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ

english.text: and before dawn they would seek forgiveness[5],
english.footnotes: [5] Supererogatory prayers and supplications are recommended before dawn.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: implorant le pardon de leur Seigneur peu avant l’aube,

renderings.arabic: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ

english.text: and in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the destitute.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: réservant une partie de leurs biens au mendiant et au démuni.

renderings.arabic: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ

english.text: On earth there are signs for those who are certain in faith,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est sur terre bien des signes pour ceux qui croient avec certitude,

renderings.arabic: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: and also within yourselves. Do you not see?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais aussi en vous-mêmes. Ne voyez-vous donc pas ?

renderings.arabic: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

english.text: And in the heaven is your provision and all that you are promised.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dans le ciel se trouvent votre subsistance[1] et ce qui vous est promis[2].
french.footnotes:
[1] La pluie, selon la majorité des exégètes.
[2] Le Paradis, selon certains commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ

english.text: By the Lord of the heaven and earth, this [resurrection] is certainly as true as the fact that you can speak.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le Seigneur du ciel et de la terre, cette promesse est aussi vraie que le fait pour vous de parler.

renderings.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ

english.text: Has there come to you the story of Abraham’s honored guests[6]?
english.footnotes: [6] Honorable angels with Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le récit des hôtes d’honneur d’Abraham t’est-il parvenu ?

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ

english.text: When they came to him and said, “Peace.” He said, “Upon you be peace.” [saying to himself] “Unknown people!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’étant présentés à lui, ils le saluèrent : « La paix soit avec vous ! » Il leur répondit : « La paix soit avec vous, visiteurs inconnus ! »[3]
french.footnotes: [3] Selon certains commentateurs, Abraham n’a pas prononcé ces deux derniers mots devant ces visiteurs, mais en lui-même, leur disant seulement : « La paix soit avec vous », et ajoutant en lui-même : « Ces visiteurs nous sont inconnus ! »

renderings.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ

english.text: Then he went quickly to his household, and came with a fat [roasted] calf,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il alla discrètement trouver les siens et revint avec un veau gras.

renderings.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

english.text: and placed it before them and said, “Will you not eat?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leur ayant présenté le plat, il s’étonna : « Ne mangez-vous pas ?[4] »
french.footnotes: [4] Ces visiteurs étaient en effet des anges - au nombre de trois, selon certains commentateurs - à l’apparence humaine.

renderings.arabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ

english.text: He felt apprehensive about them[7]. They said, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him glad tidings of a knowledgeable son.
english.footnotes: [7] In their culture, if a guest refused to eat the food provided, it was considered a sign of ill will. See footnote 11:70.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Abraham commença à avoir peur. « Ne crains rien », le rassurèrent-ils, avant de lui annoncer la naissance d’un fils doté d’un grand savoir[5].
french.footnotes: [5] Isaac.

renderings.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ

english.text: His wife cried out loud, and struck her face [in astonishment] and said, “[I am] a barren old woman!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Poussant des cris et se frappant le visage[6], son épouse s’approcha : « Moi, une vieille femme stérile[7] », s’étonna-t-elle.
french.footnotes:
[6] D’étonnement.
[7] Avoir un enfant !

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

english.text: They said, “This is what your Lord said. Indeed, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Ainsi en a décidé ton Seigneur, Lui l’infiniment Sage, l’Omniscient. »

renderings.arabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

english.text: Abraham said, “Then what is your mission, O messengers?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Abraham leur demanda : « Quel est l’objet de votre visite, messagers du Seigneur ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ

english.text: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils répondirent : « Nous avons été envoyés à un peuple pervers[8]
french.footnotes: [8] Le peuple de Loth.

renderings.arabic: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ

english.text: to send down upon them stones of clay,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin de déchaîner contre lui une tempête de pierres d’argile

renderings.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

english.text: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: marquées auprès de ton Seigneur à l’intention des transgresseurs. »

renderings.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: We brought out those believers who were there,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons donc fait sortir de la ville les croyants qui s’y trouvaient,

renderings.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

english.text: but We only found in it one Muslim household[8].
english.footnotes: [8] Lot's family except his wife.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais n’y avons trouvé qu’une seule famille soumise au Seigneur[9].
french.footnotes: [9] Celle de Loth.

renderings.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ

english.text: And We left there a sign[9] for those who fear the painful punishment.
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., the ruins of Sodom or the Dead Sea in Palestine, as a lesson for people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons fait de leur sort une leçon pour ceux qui redoutent le châtiment douloureux.

renderings.arabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: And [there is a sign in the story of] Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proofs,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De même qu’il y a une leçon dans le récit de Moïse que Nous avons envoyé à Pharaon, assisté de miracles prodigieux.

renderings.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ

english.text: But he and his supporters turned away, and he said about [Moses], “A magician or a madman!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, sûr de son autorité, Pharaon tourna le dos à la vérité, disant : « C’est un magicien ou un possédé ! »

renderings.arabic: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ

english.text: So We seized him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea while he was blameworthy[10].
english.footnotes: [10] For his disbelief and arrogance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons alors saisi avec ses armées et l’avons englouti sous les eaux où il a péri en réprouvé.

renderings.arabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ

english.text: And [there is a sign in the story of] ‘Ād, when We sent against them the devastating barren wind[11].
english.footnotes: [11] Devoid of all goodness such as carrying rain or fertilizing trees.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il y a également une leçon dans le sort subi par les ‘Ad contre lesquels Nous avons déchaîné un vent destructeur

renderings.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

english.text: It spared nothing it came upon except that it reduced it to ruin and decay.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui ne laissait rien sur son passage sans le réduire en poussière.

renderings.arabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

english.text: And [there is a sign in the story of] Thamūd, when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while[12].”
english.footnotes: [12] i.e., only three days. See 11:65.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il y a aussi une leçon dans le sort subi par les Thamoud auxquels il fut dit : « Jouissez quelque temps encore de cette vie ! »

renderings.arabic: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ

english.text: But they rebelled against the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them, while they were looking on.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pour avoir orgueilleusement transgressé les ordres de leur Seigneur, ils furent foudroyés tandis qu’ils regardaient[10].
french.footnotes: [10] Ou : alors qu’ils attendaient le châtiment.

renderings.arabic: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ

english.text: They could not withstand it, nor could they ward it off.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ne purent ni se lever pour s’échapper, ni être sauvés.

renderings.arabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

english.text: And the people of Noah [were also destroyed] before them. They were indeed a rebellious people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le même sort fut, avant cela, réservé au peuple de Noé qui vivait dans la désobéissance.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

english.text: We built the heaven with might[13], and We are indeed expanding it.
english.footnotes: [13] ’Ayd does not mean "hands" here. This is not from the verses of Allah's attributes, for Allah Almighty did not add it to Himself, i.e., He did not say, "My ’ayd, or Our ’ayd".
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le ciel, Nous l’avons édifié par une force prodigieuse et Nous en avons largement le pouvoir[11].
french.footnotes: [11] Ou : et Nous en repoussons les limites.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ

english.text: And We spread out the earth. How well did We smooth it out[14]!
english.footnotes: [14] The earth was spread out to accommodate the creatures. Its spherical shape is mentioned in 39:5.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à la terre, Nous en avons fait, en habile artisan, une vaste étendue.

renderings.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

english.text: And We have created everything in pairs[15], so that you may take heed.
english.footnotes: [15] Such as day and night, male and female, light and darkness, sweet and bitter, hot and cold, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons créé toute chose par couple afin de vous inciter à réfléchir[12].
french.footnotes: [12] Tous les éléments de la Création forment des couples : le ciel et la terre, le jour et la nuit, le soleil et la lune, la terre et la mer, la lumière et les ténèbres, la foi et la mécréance, la mort et la vie, le malheur et le bonheur, le Paradis et l’Enfer. Même les animaux et les plantes sont répartis en couples (Tafsîr ibn Kathîr).

renderings.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: So flee to Allah[16]. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.
english.footnotes: [16] From His punishment to His reward by shunning disbelief and sin and by obeying Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Fuyez donc vers Allah qui m’a chargé de vous mettre en garde de la manière la plus claire[13].
french.footnotes: [13] Fuyez Son châtiment en recherchant Sa miséricorde, expliquent certains exégètes. Allah ordonne ici au Prophète de prononcer ces paroles.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: And do not set up another god with Allah. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Gardez-vous d’associer d’autres divinités à Allah qui m’a chargé de vous avertir de façon explicite. »

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ

english.text: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician, or a madman!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De même, aucun Messager ne s’est présenté aux peuples du passé sans être traité de magicien ou de possédé.

renderings.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ

english.text: Did they suggest this to one another[17]? Rather they are transgressing people.
english.footnotes: [17] i.e., Did the previous disbelievers pass on these false allegations to the pagans of Makkah so they repeat their words?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Se seraient-ils passé le mot ? Non, ils partagent seulement la même impiété.

renderings.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ

english.text: So turn away from them [O Prophet], for you are not to blame[18].
english.footnotes: [18] After you have delivered the message.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Détourne-toi donc d’eux sans craindre d’être blâmé[14],
french.footnotes: [14] Car tu as rempli ta mission.

renderings.arabic: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: But keep reminding them, for reminder benefits the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais continue d’exhorter les hommes, car tes exhortations profiteront aux croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ

english.text: I have not created the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je n’ai créé les djinns et les hommes que pour qu’ils M’adorent.

renderings.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ

english.text: I seek no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je n’attends de leur part ni dons, ni nourriture[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Pour Mes créatures, précisent nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ

english.text: Indeed, it is Allah Who is the All-Provider[19], Lord of Power, the Mighty.
english.footnotes: [19] He Provides His creatures with everything they need. Among His provisions is guidance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Allah, en vérité, qui est le Dispensateur de toute grâce et le Détenteur de la force et de la toute-puissance.

renderings.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ

english.text: Indeed, those who do wrong will have a share [of punishment] like that of their predecessors, so let them not ask Me to hasten it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aux mécréants est réservée la même part de tourment qu’à leurs devanciers. Qu’ils ne soient donc pas trop pressés !

renderings.arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

english.text: So woe to those who disbelieve from [the punishment of] the Day which they are promised.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Malheur aux impies qui auront à affronter le Jour dont ils sont aujourd’hui menacés !

renderings.arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ

english.text: By the mount of Tūr[1],
english.footnotes: [1] Where Allah Almighty communicated with Moses (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le mont Sinaï !

renderings.arabic: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ

english.text: and by the Book inscribed[2]
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par l’Ecriture consignée[1]
french.footnotes: [1] La Torah révélée à Moïse, selon certains exégètes qui inscrivent ce verset dans la continuité du précédent. C’est en effet sur le Sinaï que Moïse a reçu la loi.

renderings.arabic: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ

english.text: on an unrolled parchment[3],
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., a spread-out scroll.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: sur un parchemin déployé !

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ

english.text: and by the much-frequented House[4],
english.footnotes: [4] Which is frequented by angels or the Ka‘bah in Makkah which is frequented by pilgrims.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le Temple peuplé[2] !
french.footnotes: [2] D’anges, au ciel, explique la majorité des commentateurs. Il pourrait aussi s’agir de la Kaaba peuplée en permanence de fidèles sur terre.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ

english.text: and by the canopy raised high,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par la voûte[3] élevée !
french.footnotes: [3] Céleste.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ

english.text: and by the sea set on fire[5].
english.footnotes: [5] On the Day of Resurrection, or "by the overflowed sea."
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par la mer prête à déborder !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ

english.text: The punishment of your Lord will surely come to pass;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le châtiment de ton Seigneur ne peut être évité.

renderings.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ

english.text: there is none who can avert it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Rien ni personne ne pourra le repousser

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا

english.text: On the Day when the heaven will convulse violently[6],
english.footnotes: [6] The heavens will be shaken violently, indicating the occurrence of the Hour. The word "maur" originally means turning round, rotating, swinging, swaying, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le Jour où le ciel sera violemment agité

renderings.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا

english.text: and the mountains will move a horrible movement[7].
english.footnotes: [7] They will turn into dust, moving as clouds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et les montagnes seront entièrement déplacées.

renderings.arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

english.text: Then woe to the deniers on that Day,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Malheur, ce Jour-là, à ceux qui rejetaient la vérité,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ

english.text: those who amuse themselves in falsehood.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à ceux qui se complaisaient dans l’impiété.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

english.text: On the Day when they will be shoved into the Fire forcefully,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, ils seront vers la Géhenne violemment poussés.

renderings.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

english.text: [They will be told,] “This is the Fire which you used to deny.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Voici le Feu que vous traitiez de mensonge, leur sera-t-il lancé.

renderings.arabic: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: Is this [punishment] magic, or do you not see?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Est-ce de la magie, ou bien êtes-vous toujours dépourvus de lucidité[4] ?
french.footnotes: [4] Comme lorsque vous affirmiez sur terre que le Coran était de la magie. Autre sens : ou bien ne voyez-vous pas clair ?

renderings.arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: Burn in it, whether you bear it patiently or impatiently, it makes no difference to you[8]; you are recompensed only for what you used to do.”
english.footnotes: [8] He who is patient during afflictions in the life of this world will be rewarded. As for the Hereafter, suffering patiently in Hell will not bring any reward or benefit.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Entrez-y pour y brûler ! Peu importe que vous le supportiez ou pas, vous serez simplement rétribués pour vos œuvres passées. »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and bliss,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les pieux croyants seront, quant à eux, dans les jardins de la félicité

renderings.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

english.text: enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où ils jouiront des dons généreux de leur Seigneur qui les aura préservés des tourments du Brasier.

renderings.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

english.text: “Eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Mangez et buvez en paix pour prix de vos œuvres passées ! »

renderings.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ

english.text: reclining on couches all lined up”. And We will marry them to houris with wide beautiful eyes.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils seront accoudés sur des lits somptueux soigneusement alignés. Nous les aurons unis à de blanches houris aux yeux d’une extrême beauté.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ

english.text: As for those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will cause their offspring to join them, and will not detract anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Everyone will be accountable for what he earned[9].
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., None will be held responsible for the burden of another.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Là, Nous réunirons les croyants à leurs descendants qui les auront suivis dans la foi, sans rien diminuer de leur récompense[5]. Mais chacun devra lui-même répondre de ses péchés.
french.footnotes: [5] Les descendants des croyants, unis à eux par la même foi, seront élevés au même rang que leurs ancêtres, quand bien même leurs œuvres seraient moindres et sans que les croyants ne doivent renoncer à une partie de leur récompense en échange de cette faveur divine.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ

english.text: And We will provide them with whatever fruit and meat they desire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: En outre, Nous leur accorderons toutes les variétés de fruits et de viandes qu’ils pourront désirer.

renderings.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ

english.text: They will pass around to one another a glass [of pure wine] which does not lead to idle talk or sin.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les uns offriront aux autres des coupes d’un vin qui ne les poussera ni à dire des futilités, ni à commettre des péchés.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ

english.text: They will be served by their servant boys, as if they were well-protected pearls.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De jeunes serviteurs circuleront parmi eux, telles des perles précieusement conservées.

renderings.arabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english.text: They will turn to one another with questions[10].
english.footnotes: [10] They will probably ask one another about their worldly lives and what led them to Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Se tournant les uns vers les autres, les élus du Paradis s’interrogeront.

renderings.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ

english.text: They will say, “Before this, we used to be in awe [of Allah] when we were living among our people.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains diront : « Nous vivions sur terre au milieu des nôtres dans la crainte de notre Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

english.text: Therefore Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais Allah, nous comblant de Ses faveurs, nous a préservés de la chaleur de l’Enfer.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english.text: Indeed, we used to call upon Him before. He is indeed the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous L’implorions humblement sur terre. Il est le Bienfaiteur, le Très Miséricordieux. »

renderings.arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ

english.text: So keep exhorting [O Prophet], for you are not, by the grace of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prêche donc les hommes car, par la grâce de ton Seigneur, tu n’es ni un devin, ni un possédé.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ

english.text: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await a misfortune[11]”?
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., inevitable death or so.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien disent-ils : « C’est un poète. Attendons simplement qu’un coup du sort vienne nous en délivrer » ?

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

english.text: Say, “Wait, I too am waiting with you.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Réponds-leur : « Attendez donc ! Je suis, avec vous, parmi ceux qui attendent. »

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ

english.text: Do their minds[12] prompt them to say such things, or are they transgressing people?
english.footnotes: [12] The leaders of pagans in Makkah claimed to be of great minds. Here it questions their intelligence, arguing that a man cannot be a madman and a poet at the same time.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Est-ce leur raison qui leur inspire de telles allégations[6] ? Ou bien sont-ils simplement portés à la rébellion ?
french.footnotes: [6] Dénuées de bon sens, car on ne peut être à la fois devin, possédé et poète !

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: Or do they say, “He has made this [Qur’an] up”? Rather, they are not willing to believe.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou alors diront-ils qu’il l’a inventé ! C’est qu’en vérité ils s’obstinent dans leur impiété.

renderings.arabic: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: Then let them produce a discourse like this, if they are truthful[13].
english.footnotes: [13] Arab pagans were challenged to produce the like of this Quran, ten surahs, or one surah, but the challenge has never been met until the present day. See 2:23, 11:13, 52:34.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’ils produisent donc un texte identique, s’ils disent la vérité.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

english.text: Were they created by none, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’y a-t-il pas à leur origine un créateur ou bien sont-ils eux-mêmes à l’origine de leur création ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

english.text: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Rather, they are not certain in faith.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Auraient-ils créé les cieux et la terre ? Non, mais ils n’ont aucune conviction.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ

english.text: Or do they possess the treasures of your Lord, or do they have full control [of everything]?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Détiendraient-ils les trésors de ton Seigneur ou seraient-ils les maîtres de la Création ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ

english.text: Or do they have a stairway [to the heaven] by which they eavesdrop? Then let those who eavesdrop produce a compelling proof.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien ont-ils les moyens de monter au ciel pour y écouter la Révélation ? Que celui d’entre eux qui prétend écouter les secrets du ciel prouve donc ses affirmations !

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ

english.text: Or does He have daughters while you have sons[14]?
english.footnotes: [14] See footnote 37:149.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aurait-Il des filles et vous des garçons ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ

english.text: Or are you asking them [O Prophet] for a reward so they are overburdened by debt?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien leur réclames-tu un salaire dont ils auraient toutes les peines à s’acquitter ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ

english.text: Or do they have [the knowledge of] the unseen so they are writing it down?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Connaissent-ils les mystères dont ils pourraient rendre compte par écrit ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ

english.text: Or do they intend a plot [against the Prophet]? But the plot of the disbelievers will rebound against themselves.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les impies cherchent-ils à tramer un complot ? Mais celui-ci se retournera certainement contre eux.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

english.text: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien auraient-ils une autre divinité qu’Allah ? Gloire à Allah qui est bien au-dessus des faux dieux qu’ils associent à Son culte !

renderings.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ

english.text: If they were to see pieces of the sky falling down[15], they would still say, “[This is only] a mass of clouds.”
english.footnotes: [15] As a sign of the punishment that they requested.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Verraient-ils le ciel tomber sur eux par pans entiers, qu’ils diraient : « Ce ne sont là que nuages amoncelés ! »

renderings.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ

english.text: So leave them alone until they encounter their Day in which they will be struck down[16],
english.footnotes: [16] i.e., they will be punished on the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse-les donc à leur impiété jusqu’au Jour où ils seront foudroyés,

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

english.text: the Day their plots will not avail them in the least, nor will they be helped.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jour où leurs manœuvres ne leur seront plus d’aucune utilité et où ils ne pourront être sauvés.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: And for the wrongdoers, there will be another punishment before that[17], but most of them do not know.
english.footnotes: [17] In this world such as famine, droughts, or defeat at the battle, or punishment in the grave.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants se verront infliger un premier châtiment[7], mais la plupart d’entre eux n’en sont pas conscients.
french.footnotes: [7] Ici-bas, avant les tourments de l’au-delà.

renderings.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

english.text: Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [Watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Accepte donc patiemment l’arrêt de ton Seigneur, car Nous t’avons sous les Yeux. Célèbre, par les louanges, la gloire de ton Seigneur lorsque tu te lèves.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

english.text: And glorify Him at night and when the stars fade away[18].
english.footnotes: [18] i.e., the early hours of the morning when the stars set; the time of the Fajr Prayer.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exalte également Sa gloire une partie de la nuit et au déclin des étoiles[8].
french.footnotes: [8] A l’aube.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

english.text: By the star when it sets,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les étoiles à leur déclin[1] !
