french.footnotes: [1] Il pourrait s’agir des six étoiles de la Pléiade dans la constellation du Taureau.

renderings.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ

english.text: Your companion [i.e., the Prophet] has neither strayed nor is he deluded.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Votre compagnon[2] ne s’est ni égaré, ni écarté du droit chemin.
french.footnotes: [2] Le Prophète.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ

english.text: Nor does he speak out of his own desire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il ne parle pas sous l’empire de ses passions

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيٞ يُوحَىٰ

english.text: It is but a revelation sent down [to him].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais se contente de répéter ce qu’il reçoit de la Révélation

renderings.arabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ

english.text: He was taught by [an angel of] mighty power[1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., the angel Gabriel.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: transmise par un ange[3] au pouvoir extraordinaire
french.footnotes: [3] L’ange Gabriel.

renderings.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٖ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ

english.text: and of great perfection[2], who manifested himself [in his true form][3]
english.footnotes:
[2] i.e., the strength of body and mind.
 [3] Archangel Gabriel appeared to the Prophet (ﷺ) only twice in his angelic form: once at the outset of the Prophet’s mission (as he manifested himself, filling the horizon, so the Prophet (ﷺ) lost his consciousness), and another time during the Prophet’s ascension to the seventh heaven where he directly received from Allah the order to pray five times a day. See 17:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et à la puissance prodigieuse qui lui est apparu

renderings.arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

english.text: when he was on the higher horizon[4].
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., above the eastern horizon in the sky where the sun rises.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: alors qu’il se tenait à l’horizon suprême.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

english.text: Then he approached [the Prophet] and descended,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puis l’ange s’approcha et descendit plus encore,

renderings.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ

english.text: until he was only two bow-lengths away or even closer.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: se trouvant à deux longueurs d’arc, voire plus près.

renderings.arabic: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ

english.text: Then he revealed to His slave[5] what he had to reveal.
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah révéla alors à Son serviteur ce qu’Il voulut lui révéler.

renderings.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ

english.text: The [Prophet’s] heart[6] did not deny what he saw.
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., his mind or perception.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Son cœur n’a pas démenti ce que ses yeux ont contemplé.

renderings.arabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

english.text: Do you dispute with him concerning what he saw?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allez-vous mettre en doute ce qu’il a vu de ses propres yeux ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ

english.text: He certainly saw him a second time[7]
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., During his ascent (al-Mi‘rāj) to the heavens, he saw Gabriel in his true angelic form.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il l’a pourtant vu une autre fois[4]
french.footnotes: [4] Le Prophète a déjà vu l’ange Gabriel, mais cette fois au ciel, lors de son ascension, comme le montreront les versets qui suivent. Cette première vision est donc plus extraordinaire que celle que vous remettez en cause.

renderings.arabic: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ

english.text: at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary [in the seventh heaven]
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à proximité du Lotus de la limite

renderings.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ

english.text: near which is the Garden of Abode,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: auprès duquel se trouve le Jardin du séjour éternel.

renderings.arabic: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ

english.text: when the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with [divine] splendors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Lotus était recouvert de choses extraordinaires.

renderings.arabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

english.text: His gaze did not wander, nor did it look beyond the limit.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Son regard n’a ni dévié, ni outrepassé les limites[5].
french.footnotes: [5] Le Prophète n’a ni détourné le regard, ni regardé au-delà de ce qui lui était permis.

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ

english.text: He certainly saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ainsi qu’il vit certains des grands signes de son Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ

english.text: Have you [O disbelievers] thought about [the idols of] Lāt and ‘Uzzā,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Avez-vous considéré Al-lât, Al-‘Ouzzâ

renderings.arabic: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ

english.text: and Manāt, the third one as well[8]?
english.footnotes: [8] These were three well-known idols or goddesses worshiped by Arab pagans before the advent of Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et Manât, la troisième de ces divinités[6] ?
french.footnotes: [6] Adorées par les Arabes avant l’islam.

renderings.arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

english.text: Do you choose for yourselves males and for Him females?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Auriez-vous des garçons et Lui des filles ?

renderings.arabic: تِلۡكَ إِذٗا قِسۡمَةٞ ضِيزَىٰٓ

english.text: That is then an unfair division!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà un partage singulièrement injuste !

renderings.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

english.text: These [idols] are no more than names you and your forefathers have made up[9], for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjecture and what their souls desire, although there has come to them guidance from their Lord.
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., You have considered them gods while in fact, they are not.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce ne sont là que des noms sans réalité que vous et vos ancêtres avez inventés sans vous fonder sur la moindre preuve révélée par Allah. Ils ne font que se perdre en conjectures et suivre leurs passions. Pourtant, le droit chemin leur a été clairement indiqué par leur Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

english.text: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes for[10]?
english.footnotes: [10] The pagans worshiped these idols wishing that they would intercede for them on the Day of Resurrection. See 39:3.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme pense-t-il pouvoir obtenir tout ce qu’il désire[7],
french.footnotes: [7] Comme l’intercession des fausses divinités, expliquent nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ

english.text: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and this world.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: oubliant qu’Allah seul détient le pouvoir ici-bas et dans l’au-delà ?

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ

english.text: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will be of no avail except after Allah’s permission to whom He wills and pleases.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que d’anges dans les cieux qui ne sauraient intercéder que si Allah le leur permet et uniquement en faveur de ceux dont Il est satisfait.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

english.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels female names.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceux qui ne croient pas en la vie future font des anges des êtres de sexe féminin.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا

english.text: They have no knowledge about it. They only follow conjecture, but conjecture is of no avail against the truth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils n’en ont pourtant aucune connaissance sûre, se perdant simplement en conjectures. Or, les conjectures ne sauraient fonder une certitude.

renderings.arabic: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا

english.text: So pay no heed to those who turn away from Our message[11] and who only seek the life of this world.
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Détourne-toi donc de ceux qui ont eux-mêmes tourné le dos à Notre message et aspirent uniquement à jouir de cette vie.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

english.text: That is the limit of their knowledge. Indeed, your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way, and He knows best who is guided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voilà à quoi se limite leur savoir. Ton Seigneur sait parfaitement qui s’est écarté de Sa voie et qui suit le droit chemin.

renderings.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى

english.text: To Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, so that He may recompense the evildoers for what they did, and reward those who do good with the best reward[12],
english.footnotes: [12] i.e., Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A Allah appartient tout ce qui se trouve dans les cieux et sur la terre qu’Il a créés afin de punir ceux qui font le mal selon leurs œuvres et d’accorder la plus belle récompense à ceux qui font le bien,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

english.text: those who avoid major sins and shameful acts, except for minor lapses. Indeed, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you best, as He created you from the earth[13] and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers[14]. So do not claim purity for yourselves, for He knows best who is truly righteous.
english.footnotes:
[13] i.e., created your father, Adam.
 [14] See footnote 31:34.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ceux qui fuient les péchés les plus graves et les actes infâmes, commettant uniquement des fautes vénielles[8]. Le pardon de ton Seigneur est infini. Il savait parfaitement à quoi s’en tenir à votre sujet lorsqu’Il vous a créés de terre et lorsque vous n’étiez que des embryons dans le ventre de vos mères. Ne vantez donc pas vos propres mérites. Il sait parfaitement qui Le craint réellement.
french.footnotes: [8] Qu’Allah leur pardonnera.

renderings.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ

english.text: Have you seen the one who turned away [from Islam],
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’as-tu pas vu celui qui a tourné le dos à la foi,

renderings.arabic: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلٗا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ

english.text: who gave a little, and then stopped?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui a peu donné avant de s’en abstenir totalement ?

french.text: Nous l’avons sauvé dans une embarcation formée de planches et de clous

renderings.arabic: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

english.text: sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui voguait sous Nos Yeux, afin de récompenser celui qui avait été renié.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

english.text: We have certainly left it[5] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., the punishment, the Flood, or the Ark.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous en avons fait un signe pour l’humanité. Y a-t-il quelqu’un pour en tirer des leçons ?

renderings.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

english.text: Then how were My punishment and My warnings[6]?
english.footnotes: [6] As a warning to those who came after them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Terrible fut alors Mon châtiment pourtant précédé d’avertissements !

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

english.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons rendu le Coran aisé à comprendre[3]. Y a-t-il quelqu’un pour en méditer les enseignements ?
french.footnotes: [3] Et à mémoriser.

renderings.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

english.text: ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les ‘Ad aussi ont crié au mensonge. Terrible fut alors Mon châtiment pourtant précédé d’avertissements !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ

english.text: We sent against them a furious wind[7] on a day of continuous misfortune,
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., a tumultuous and screaming wind.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons suscité contre eux, en un jour funeste et interminable, un vent glacial

renderings.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ

english.text: sweeping people away[8], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., extracting them from the earth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui arrachait violemment les hommes du sol où ils retombaient comme des troncs de palmiers déracinés.

renderings.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

english.text: Then how were My punishment and My warnings?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Terrible fut alors Mon châtiment pourtant précédé d’avertissements !

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

english.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons rendu le Coran aisé à comprendre. Y a-t-il quelqu’un pour en méditer les enseignements ?

renderings.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

english.text: Thamūd rejected the warnings,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les Thamoud n’ont pas cru en Nos avertissements.

renderings.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ

english.text: They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[9] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., Prophet Sālih (عليه السلام).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Allons-nous suivre un homme isolé parmi nous ? Nous serions alors dans l’erreur et frappés de folie.

renderings.arabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ

english.text: Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A-t-il été choisi parmi nous pour recevoir la Révélation ? C’est au contraire un menteur effronté ! »

renderings.arabic: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ

english.text: Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils sauront bientôt qui est le menteur effronté.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ

english.text: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Nous allons leur envoyer une chamelle afin de les éprouver. Attends patiemment leur réaction et de voir ce qui va leur arriver.

renderings.arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ

english.text: and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[10]; each should take its drink in turn.
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., one day for the tribe of Thamūd and one day for the she-camel.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Informe-les qu’ils auront accès à l’eau à tour de rôle avec la chamelle. »

renderings.arabic: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

english.text: But they called their companion[11], and he undertook the task[12] and hamstrung her.
english.footnotes:
[11] i.e., the worst among them.
 [12] Or took his sword.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais ils firent appel à l’un des leurs qui se chargea d’abattre la chamelle.

renderings.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

english.text: Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Terrible fut alors Mon châtiment pourtant précédé d’avertissements !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ

english.text: We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[13].
english.footnotes: [13] The people of Thamūd were crushed like trampled and trodden twigs and pieces of bush lying around an enclosure for cattle.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons lancé contre eux un seul Cri[4] et les voilà réduits à l’état de paille desséchée.
french.footnotes: [4] Poussé par l’ange Gabriel, précisent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

english.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons rendu le Coran aisé à comprendre. Y a-t-il quelqu’un pour en méditer les enseignements ?

renderings.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

english.text: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le peuple de Loth n’a pas cru en Nos avertissements.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ

english.text: We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons déchaîné contre lui une tempête de pierres. Tous furent anéantis à l’exception de la famille de Loth que Nous avons sauvée à la fin de la nuit

renderings.arabic: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ

english.text: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: par un effet de Notre grâce. C’est ainsi que Nous récompensons ceux qui se montrent reconnaissants.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

english.text: He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Loth les avait pourtant mis en garde contre la violence de Notre châtiment, mais ils avaient ignoré ses avertissements.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

english.text: They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[14], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”
english.footnotes: [14] Whom Allah sent in the form of handsome young men.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils avaient exigé de Loth que ses hôtes leur soient livrés[5], mais Nous les avons frappés de cécité : « Goûtez donc Mon châtiment contre lequel Je vous avais mis en garde ! »
french.footnotes: [5] Ils avaient exigé que ces visiteurs inconnus, des anges à l’apparence humaine envoyés pour les anéantir, soient livrés à leur débauche.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ

english.text: By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Au matin, un châtiment interminable s’abattit sur eux.

renderings.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

english.text: Taste My punishment and My warnings!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Goûtez donc Mon châtiment contre lequel Je vous avais mis en garde ! »

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

english.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons rendu le Coran aisé à comprendre. Y a-t-il quelqu’un pour en méditer les enseignements ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

english.text: Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pharaon et les siens furent eux aussi avertis,

renderings.arabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ

english.text: But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais ils renièrent tous Nos miracles. Nous leur avons donc infligé un châtiment dont seul est capable le Seigneur Tout-Puissant et Omnipotent.

renderings.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ

english.text: Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[15] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?
english.footnotes: [15] i.e., those destroyed peoples.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Vos mécréants valent-ils mieux que ces gens-là[6] ? Ou bien les Livres révélés vous ont-ils assuré quelque immunité ?
french.footnotes: [6] Le Seigneur s’adresse ici au peuple du Prophète : est-il meilleur que les peuples impies mentionnés précédemment, anéantis pour avoir traité leurs prophètes de menteurs.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ

english.text: Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien disent-ils : « Notre unité fera notre invincibilité. »

renderings.arabic: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

english.text: Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[16].
english.footnotes: [16] This foretold event was fulfilled in the Battle of Badr.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leur unité sera pourtant brisée et ils seront contraints à tourner le dos.

renderings.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

english.text: But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et une épreuve plus terrible et plus amère les attend à l’Heure du jugement.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ

english.text: Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[17].
english.footnotes: [17] i.e., will burn in the Hellfire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants, en plein égarement, sont voués à un brasier ardent.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

english.text: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[18]!”
english.footnotes: [18] "Saqar" is one of the names of Hell.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour où ils seront traînés sur leurs visages dans le Feu, il leur sera lancé : « Goûtez les tourments de l’Enfer ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ

english.text: We have surely created everything in a determined measure[19].
english.footnotes: [19] Or perfectly preordained.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons créé toute chose selon un décret préalable.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ

english.text: Our command is but a single word[20], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.
english.footnotes: [20] Our command when We want something, We only say, "Be," and it is.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nos ordres, exécutés en un clin d’œil, se limitent à une seule parole.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

english.text: We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][21]; is there anyone to take heed?
english.footnotes: [21] In rejecting Allah's messengers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, avant vous, anéanti des peuples semblables au vôtre. Y a-t-il quelqu’un pour en tirer des leçons ?

renderings.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ

english.text: Everything they did is in the written records,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Chacun de leurs agissements a été consigné dans les registres

renderings.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ

english.text: and everything, small or big, is written down.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où il n’est pas un fait, aussi insignifiant soit-il, qui ne soit inscrit.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[22],
english.footnotes: [22] Rivers of water, honey, milk, and wine. See 47:15.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les pieux croyants seront, quant à eux, dans des jardins traversés de rivières,

renderings.arabic: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ

english.text: seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dans un séjour véritablement merveilleux, auprès d’un Roi omnipotent.

renderings.arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ

english.text: The Most Compassionate,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Tout Miséricordieux

renderings.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ

english.text: has taught the Qur’an,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: a enseigné le Coran

renderings.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ

english.text: He created man,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à l’homme qu’Il a créé

renderings.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ

english.text: and taught him speech.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et auquel Il a appris à s’exprimer.

renderings.arabic: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ

english.text: The sun and the moon follow their precise courses,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le soleil et la lune obéissent à des lois bien déterminées.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ

english.text: and the stars[1] and trees prostrate [to Allah][2].
english.footnotes:
[1] "Najm" is also a vegetation without a trunk, stalk, or stem.
 [2] i.e., they obediently submit to the laws of Allah. See 22:18.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les herbes[1] et les arbres se prosternent avec humilité.
french.footnotes: [1] Ou : les étoiles.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ

english.text: He raised the heaven and enjoined justice
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a élevé le ciel et établi l’équité[2].
french.footnotes: [2] Littéralement : la balance.

renderings.arabic: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ

english.text: so that you may not transgress the limits of justice.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Fuyez donc toute forme d’iniquité.

renderings.arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ

english.text: Therefore establish weights in justice, and do not give short measure.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pesez équitablement sans jamais frauder.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ

english.text: He has spread out the earth for all creatures,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a fait de la terre un lieu parfaitement adapté à la vie

renderings.arabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ

english.text: in which there are fruits and palm trees with date stalks,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où l’on trouve des arbres fruitiers, tels les dattiers aux régimes entourés de leurs spathes[3],
french.footnotes: [3] Enveloppe recouvrant le spadice qui produira le régime de dattes.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ

english.text: and grain having chaff, and fragrant plants.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: des céréales dans leurs balles[4] et des plantes à l’odeur agréable.
french.footnotes: [4] Le terme employé pourrait à la fois désigner l’enveloppe recouvrant le grain, appelée « balle », et la paille qui demeure après les moissons et qui, l’une et l’autre, servent de nourriture aux bestiaux, bienfait évident du Seigneur qui, par ces céréales, nourrit à la fois les hommes et leur bétail.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you[3] deny?
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., men and jinn.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ

english.text: He created man from dry clay like pottery,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il a créé l’homme d’une argile semblable à celle du potier[5],
french.footnotes: [5] L’argile cuite.

renderings.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ

english.text: and He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et Il a créé les djinns à partir d’un feu pur de toute fumée[6].
french.footnotes: [6] Selon l’interprétation de nombreux exégètes. Littéralement : d’un mélange de feu.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ

english.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets[4].
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., the points of sunrise in the east and sunset in the west in both summer and winter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le Seigneur des deux levants et Celui des deux couchants[7].
french.footnotes: [7] L’un en été, l’autre en hiver, selon nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ

english.text: He merges the two seas meeting together[5],
english.footnotes: [5] Two bodies of water or two sea waters of fresh and salty water.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par Sa volonté, les deux types d’eau se côtoient

renderings.arabic: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ

english.text: yet between them is a barrier so that they do not cross[6].
english.footnotes: [6] See footnote 25:53.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: sans jamais se mélanger, étant séparés par une barrière invisible.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ

english.text: Out of both of them emerge pearls and coral.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De ces eaux sont extraits les perles et le corail.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ

english.text: To Him belong the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui a soumis aux hommes les vaisseaux sillonnant les mers, telles des montagnes altières.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ

english.text: Everyone on earth will perish,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tout ce qui se trouve à la surface de la terre est voué à disparaître.

renderings.arabic: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ

english.text: but there will remain the Face of your Lord[7], full of Majesty and Honor.
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., your Lord Himself.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seul demeurera le Visage, tout de majesté et de gloire, de ton Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ

english.text: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[8].
english.footnotes: [8] Such as giving life and causing death, enriching some and impoverishing others, elevating some and debasing others, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tous ceux qui peuplent les cieux et la terre Lui expriment sans cesse leurs besoins. A chaque instant, Son œuvre se manifeste.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ

english.text: We will attend to you, O two multitudes [of men and jinn].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous allons nous charger de vous[8], hommes et djinns.
french.footnotes: [8] De votre jugement dans l’au-delà, selon nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ

english.text: O assembly of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the realms of the heavens and earth, then pass; you cannot pass without [Our] authority.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Peuples de djinns et d’hommes ! Si vous croyez pouvoir franchir les limites des cieux et de la terre, alors faites-le. Mais vous n’y parviendrez pas sans un certain pouvoir.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lequel des bienfaits de votre Seigneur oserez-vous renier ?

renderings.arabic: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

english.text: There will be sent against you a flame of fire and smoke[9], and you will not be able to defend yourselves.
english.footnotes: [9] It could also mean liquefied brass or copper.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seront projetées contre vous des flammes[9] et une fumée[10] auxquelles vous ne pourrez échapper.
french.footnotes:
[9] Sans fumée, précisent certains exégètes.
[10] Sans flammes, précisent certains. Ou : du cuivre fondu.

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

french.text: Tout ceci est l’absolue vérité, à n’en point douter.

renderings.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

english.text: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exalte donc le nom de ton Seigneur, le Très Glorieux !

renderings.arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

english.text: All that is in the heavens and earth glorifies[1] Allah, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english.footnotes: [1] By praising and exalting Him far above any deficiency or imperfection.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tout ce qui se trouve dans les cieux et sur la terre célèbre la gloire d’Allah, le Tout-Puissant, l’infiniment Sage.

renderings.arabic: لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

english.text: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth; He gives life and causes death, and He is Most Capable of all things.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il règne en Maître absolu sur les cieux et la terre. Il donne la vie et la mort, et Il a pouvoir sur toute chose.

renderings.arabic: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ

english.text: He is the First[2] and the Last[3], the Manifest[4] and the Hidden[5], and He is All-Knowing of everything.
english.footnotes: [2] Before Whom nothing existed; the foremost; the uppermost. [3] Eternal after Whom nothing remains. [4] High, nothing is above Him. [5] Nothing is nearer than Him by way of His knowledge; concealed from our physical senses.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le Premier et le Dernier, l’Apparent[1] et l’Occulte[2], et Il a une parfaite connaissance de toute chose.
french.footnotes:
[1] Son existence se manifeste à la fois par des preuves rationnelles, scripturaires (les Livres révélés) et cosmologiques (Sa Création).
[2] Nul, en effet, ne peut Le voir ici-bas.

renderings.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ

english.text: It is He Who created the heavens and earth in six days, and then rose over the Throne. He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out of it, and all that descends from the heaven and all that ascends to it. He is with you[6] wherever you are, and Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
english.footnotes: [6] By His Knowledge - observing and witnessing all.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui a créé les cieux et la terre en six jours, puis s’est élevé sur le Trône. Il sait ce qui pénètre dans la terre et ce qui en sort, ce qui descend du ciel et ce qui y monte. Il est avec vous où que vous soyez. Allah voit parfaitement ce que vous faites.

renderings.arabic: لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

english.text: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and to Allah will return all matters.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il règne en Maître absolu sur les cieux et la terre, et c’est à Allah que tout doit revenir.

renderings.arabic: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

english.text: He causes the night to merge into the day and the day to merge into the night, and He is All-Knowing of what is in the hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il fait pénétrer la nuit dans le jour et le jour dans la nuit, et Il sait parfaitement ce que renferment les cœurs.

renderings.arabic: ءَامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسۡتَخۡلَفِينَ فِيهِۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَأَنفَقُواْ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ

english.text: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend [in Allah’s cause] out of what He has entrusted you with. For those among you who believe and spend[7], there will be a great reward.
english.footnotes: [7] In the way of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Croyez en Allah et en Son Messager ! Dépensez pour Sa cause une partie de ce qu’Il a momentanément mis à votre disposition. Ceux d’entre vous qui croient et dépensent leurs biens pour la cause d’Allah obtiendront une immense récompense.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا لَكُمۡ لَا تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ وَقَدۡ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

english.text: Why is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Lord, and He has already taken a covenant from you[8], if you will ever believe?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’est-ce qui vous empêche, comme vous y invite le Messager, de croire en votre Seigneur, conformément à l’engagement qu’Il a pris de vous[3], si évidemment vous êtes disposés à croire ?
french.footnotes: [3] Engagement pris des hommes par Allah - avant même qu’ils n’existent - de croire en Lui, expliquent nombre d’exégètes. Voir sourate 7, verset 172.

renderings.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ لِّيُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

english.text: It is He Who sends down clear verses to His slave to bring you out of the depths of darkness into the light. Indeed, Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui révèle à Son serviteur des versets parfaitement clairs afin de vous tirer des ténèbres vers la lumière. Allah est, envers vous, toute bonté et toute miséricorde.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا لَكُمۡ أَلَّا تُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَا يَسۡتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنۡ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبۡلِ ٱلۡفَتۡحِ وَقَٰتَلَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَعۡظَمُ دَرَجَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَقَٰتَلُواْۚ وَكُلّٗا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

english.text: Why is it that you do not spend in the cause of Allah, when Allah alone will inherit the heavens and earth? Those of you who spent and fought before the conquest [of Makkah and those who did not] are not equal. They are much greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterward[9]. Yet Allah has promised each a fine reward, and Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
english.footnotes: [9] Muslims were perceived as weak before the conquest of Makkah. Therefore, those believers who donated and fought in times of weakness and hardship deserve more rewards than those who did so when Muslims were victors and had an upper hand against the enemies.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’est-ce qui vous empêche de dépenser vos biens pour la cause d’Allah alors que c’est à Allah seul que reviendra l’héritage des cieux et de la terre ? Ceux d’entre vous qui ont offert leurs biens et lutté pour la cause d’Allah avant la victoire[4] ne sauraient être comparés à ceux qui ne l’ont fait qu’après. Les premiers occupent un rang bien plus élevé auprès d’Allah. Mais à chacun Il promet la plus belle récompense. Allah est parfaitement informé de ce que vous faites.
french.footnotes: [4] La conquête de la Mecque, selon la majorité des exégètes.

renderings.arabic: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٞ كَرِيمٞ

english.text: Who is there to lend Allah a goodly loan, so He will multiply it for him, and for him there will be a generous reward[10]?
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qui est disposé à faire un prêt sincère à Allah afin de recevoir en retour une récompense décuplée et une généreuse rétribution ?

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَسۡعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشۡرَىٰكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

english.text: [Remember] the Day when you will see the believing men and women, with their light streaming ahead of them and on their right. [They will be told], “Glad tidings for you Today: gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever.” That is the supreme triumph.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Un jour viendra où l’on verra la lumière des croyants et des croyantes courir devant eux et sur leur droite[5]. Il leur sera alors annoncé : « Réjouissez-vous aujourd’hui de votre admission dans des jardins traversés de rivières où vous demeurerez pour l’éternité. » Voilà le bonheur suprême.
french.footnotes: [5] Lumière qui les guidera vers le Paradis, expliquent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقۡتَبِسۡ مِن نُّورِكُمۡ قِيلَ ٱرۡجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمۡ فَٱلۡتَمِسُواْ نُورٗاۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيۡنَهُم بِسُورٖ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُ

english.text: On that Day the hypocrite men and women will say to those who believe, “Wait for us, so that we may have some of your light.” It will be said, “Go back and seek light elsewhere[11].” Then a wall will be placed between them, which will have a gate[12], on the inside of which there will be mercy and on the outside there will be punishment.
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., the worldly life from where the light was acquired. [12] This wall is said to be the barrier between Paradise and Hell, which is called Al-A‘rāf (the heights). See 7:46-49.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.
