Revenez à Allah en vous repentant sincèrement afin que votre Seigneur efface vos péchés et vous accueille dans des jardins traversés de rivières, le Jour où Allah préservera de l’humiliation le Prophète et ceux qui auront cru avec lui qui verront leur lumière courir devant eux et sur leur droite. Ils diront : « Veuille, Seigneur, parfaire notre lumière et nous pardonner ! Tu as pouvoir sur toute chose ! »

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغۡلُظۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

english.text: O Prophet, strive [i.e., fight] against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be harsh with them. Their abode will be Hell. What a terrible destination!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prophète ! Mène une lutte sans merci contre les impies et les hypocrites qui tous sont voués à la Géhenne. Et quelle horrible demeure !

renderings.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ نُوحٖ وَٱمۡرَأَتَ لُوطٖۖ كَانَتَا تَحۡتَ عَبۡدَيۡنِ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيۡنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمۡ يُغۡنِيَا عَنۡهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَقِيلَ ٱدۡخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ

english.text: Allah sets forth an example for the disbelievers: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves, but they betrayed them[3]. Their husbands could not avail them anything against Allah, and they both were told, “Enter the Fire along with those who enter!”
english.footnotes: [3] In the matter of religion, for they both were disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah propose aux mécréants l’exemple de la femme de Noé et celui de la femme de Loth[4]. Leurs maris, qui pourtant étaient au nombre de Nos serviteurs vertueux, ne purent en rien les préserver des rigueurs d’Allah lorsque celles-ci les trahirent[5]. Il leur fut donc dit : « Entrez toutes deux en Enfer avec les damnés. »
french.footnotes:
[4] Autre sens : Allah compare le cas des mécréants à celui de la femme de Noé et celle de Loth.
[5] En refusant de croire en leur mission.

renderings.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِذۡ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english.text: And Allah sets forth an example for the believers: the wife of Pharaoh, who said, “My Lord, build for me a house in Paradise near You, save me from Pharaoh and his [evil] deeds, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et Allah propose aux croyants l’exemple de la femme de Pharaon[6] qui implora : « Veuille, Seigneur, me faire construire auprès de Toi une demeure au Paradis, me délivrer de Pharaon et de ses agissements et me sauver de ce peuple impie ! »
french.footnotes: [6] Autre sens : Allah compare le cas des croyants à celui de la femme de Pharaon.

renderings.arabic: وَمَرۡيَمَ ٱبۡنَتَ عِمۡرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتۡ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ

english.text: Also [the example of] Mary, daughter of ‘Imrān who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her through Our angel [Gabriel][4], and she firmly believed in the words of her Lord and His Scriptures and was one of the obedient.
english.footnotes: [4] Gabriel breathed into the garment of Mary so she conceived Jesus.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et l’exemple de Marie, fille d’Imrân, qui sut préserver sa chasteté et que Nous avons récompensée en insufflant en elle de Notre Esprit[7]. Elle crut en la parole de son Seigneur et en Ses Ecritures, et fut de ceux qui se soumettent humblement à Ses commandements.
french.footnotes: [7] Voir notes verset 91, sourate 21.

renderings.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

english.text: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion, and He is Most Capable of all things.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Béni soit Celui qui règne en Maître absolu sur la Création et qui a pouvoir sur toute chose.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ

english.text: Who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deeds, and He is the All-Mighty, the Most Forgiving.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui a créé la mort et la vie afin de vous mettre à l’épreuve et de voir qui de vous accomplira les œuvres les plus méritoires. Il est le Tout-Puissant, le Très Clément.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ

english.text: Who created seven heavens one above another; you will not see any imperfection[1] in the creation of the Most Compassionate. Look again; can you see any flaw?
english.footnotes: [1] All parts of the universe are well connected and in perfect harmony and coordination. There is no indiscipline, disorder and discordance in the universe, and nothing is disjointed and out of proportion in the creation of Allah. As for birth defects, genetic mutations and other things that we see in the world are part of this great creation, for perfection cannot be noticed except if the opposite is seen, also as a test for humans.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui a créé sept cieux superposés. Tu ne verras aucune disparité dans la création du Tout Miséricordieux[1]. Lève de nouveau les yeux vers les cieux, y vois-tu la moindre faille ?
french.footnotes: [1] Mais, au contraire, une parfaite harmonie.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ

english.text: Then look again and again; your sight will turn back to you humbled and weary.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lève les yeux autant que tu le veux, tes yeux se lasseront avant d’y déceler la moindre imperfection.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

english.text: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and have made them as missiles to stone the devils[2], and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blazing Fire.
english.footnotes: [2] Preventing them thereby from eavesdropping in the heavens. See 72:8-10.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, en vérité, paré le ciel le plus proche d’astres lumineux dont Nous foudroyons les démons[2] auxquels Nous avons préparé le châtiment du Brasier.
french.footnotes: [2] Empêchés - par les météores qui se détachent de ces astres, précisent certains exégètes - d’écouter la Révélation.

renderings.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

english.text: For those who disbelieve in their Lord there will be the punishment of Hell. What a terrible destination!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: De même, ceux qui renient leur Seigneur sont voués aux tourments de la Géhenne. Et quelle horrible demeure !

renderings.arabic: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ

english.text: When they are thrown in it, they will hear its roaring as it boils up,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsqu’ils y seront jetés, ils entendront le grondement de l’Enfer qui bouillonnera

renderings.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ

english.text: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, “Did there not come to you a warner?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: avec une telle fureur qu’il sera sur le point d’éclater. Chaque fois qu’un groupe de damnés y sera jeté, les gardiens de l’Enfer les interrogeront : « Un prophète n’est-il pas venu vous avertir ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ

english.text: They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has not sent down anything; you are greatly misguided.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Si, reconnaîtront-ils, un prophète est bien venu nous avertir, mais nous l’avons traité d’imposteur, affirmant qu’il était profondément égaré et qu’Allah n’avait jamais rien révélé. »

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

english.text: And they will say, “If only we had listened or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of the Blazing Fire.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils ajouteront : « Si nous avions écouté et réfléchi, nous ne serions pas dans les flammes de l’Enfer, au milieu des damnés ! »

renderings.arabic: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقٗا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

english.text: Thus they will confess their sins. So away[3] with the dwellers of the Blazing Fire!
english.footnotes: [3] Away from all good and from the mercy of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils avoueront donc leurs péchés. Que soient maudits les damnés du Brasier !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ

english.text: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui, loin des regards, craignent leur Seigneur, ils obtiendront Son pardon et seront généreusement récompensés.

renderings.arabic: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

english.text: Whether you speak secretly or openly, He is All-Knowing of that which is in the hearts.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que vous vous exprimiez secrètement ou publiquement, Il connaît parfaitement le fond de vos pensées.

renderings.arabic: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

english.text: Does He not know His Own creation[4], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?
english.footnotes: [4] Or does He not know those whom He created?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne connaît-Il pas ceux qu’Il a créés, Lui qui connaît les réalités les plus subtiles et les mieux cachées ?

renderings.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ

english.text: It is He Who made the earth smooth[5] for you, so travel through its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection.
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., subservient and stable.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui qui vous a facilité la vie[3] sur terre. Parcourez donc ses contrées et nourrissez-vous des dons du Seigneur. C’est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés.
french.footnotes: [3] Et vos déplacements.

renderings.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ

english.text: Do you feel secure that He Who is above heaven will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then suddenly convulse[6]?
english.footnotes: [6] In a circular motion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Etes-vous si sûrs que Celui qui est au ciel ne fera pas trembler et crouler la terre sous vos pieds ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ

english.text: Do you feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not send against you a storm of stones? Only then would you know how [serious] My warning was!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Etes-vous si sûrs que Celui qui est au ciel ne déchaînera pas contre vous une tempête de pierres ? Vous comprendrez alors le sens de Mes avertissements.

renderings.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

english.text: Those who came before them rejected [the messengers]; then how severe was My response!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les peuples qui les ont précédés avaient déjà crié au mensonge. Je les ai donc saisis, manifestant ainsi Mon immense réprobation !

renderings.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ

english.text: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out and folding in their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. He is indeed All-Seeing of everything.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’ont-ils pas observé, au-dessus d’eux, les oiseaux planant dans les airs ou battant des ailes ? Seul le Tout Miséricordieux les maintient en l’air, Lui qui connaît parfaitement Sa création.

renderings.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندٞ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ

english.text: Which is your army that can come to your aid against the Most Compassionate? The disbelievers are in utter delusion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quelle armée serait en mesure de vous protéger du châtiment du Tout Miséricordieux ? Les mécréants se bercent simplement d’illusions.

renderings.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوّٖ وَنُفُورٍ

english.text: Who is there to give you provision if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qui pourrait pourvoir à votre subsistance, si Allah décidait de vous en priver ? Ils persistent pourtant à rejeter fièrement la vérité.

renderings.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

english.text: Who is better guided: the one who walks stumbling and falling on his face or the one who walks upright on a straight path?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qui est le mieux guidé : celui qui avance tête courbée ou celui qui avance corps dressé sur une voie droite ?

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ

english.text: Say, “It is He Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and hearts; little do you give thanks.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « C’est Lui qui vous a créés et dotés de l’ouïe, de la vue et de l’entendement. Mais vous êtes si peu reconnaissants !

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ

english.text: Say, “It is He Who has dispersed you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Lui aussi qui vous a dispersés sur terre, et c’est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés. »

renderings.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: They say: “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils demandent : « Quand donc cette menace sera exécutée, si vous dites la vérité ? »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

english.text: Say, “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only a clear warner.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Réponds : « Allah seul le sait. Ma mission se limite à avertir les hommes en toute clarté. »

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ

english.text: Then when they see it[7] approaching closer, the faces of the disbelievers will be distressed, and it will be said, “This is what you were asking for[8].”
english.footnotes:
[7] The punishment on the Day of Judgment of which they were warned.
 [8] As they were challenging their prophets, saying, "Bring upon us the punishment, if you are truthful."
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque les mécréants verront de près le châtiment qui les attend, leurs visages s’assombriront. Il leur sera alors lancé : « Voilà ce que vous réclamiez avec tant d’empressement ! »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

english.text: Say, “What do you think[9], if Allah causes me and those who are with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., Inform me.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis aux impies : « Qu’Allah me fasse périr dès à présent avec mes compagnons[4] ou qu’Il nous laisse en vie par un effet de Sa grâce, qui pourrait vous épargner, à vous, un douloureux châtiment ? »
french.footnotes: [4] Comme vous le souhaitez.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

english.text: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate; we believe in Him and put our trust in Him. You will come to know who is clearly misguided.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis-leur encore : « Il est le Tout Miséricordieux en qui nous croyons et à qui nous nous en remettons. Vous saurez bientôt qui de nous ou de vous était manifestement égaré. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ

english.text: Say, “What do you think, if your water were to sink deep into the earth, who can bring you flowing water?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Si l’eau que vous buvez se perdait dans les profondeurs du sol, qui pourrait de nouveau la faire jaillir à la surface de la terre ? »

renderings.arabic: نٓۚ وَٱلۡقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسۡطُرُونَ

english.text: Nūn[1]. By the pen and what they [i.e., the angels] write [in the Records of deeds],
english.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Noun.[1] Par le calame et par ce qu’ils[2] écrivent !
french.footnotes:
[1] Voir note verset 1, sourate 2.
[2] Les anges, qui consignent les décrets divins dans le Livre archétype ou les œuvres des créatures dans les registres, selon certains, ou bien les hommes, selon d’autres, qui écrivent les paroles d’Allah à l’aide de ce roseau utilisé par les Anciens pour écrire.

renderings.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونٖ

english.text: By the grace of your Lord [O Prophet], you are not a madman.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu n’es pas, par la grâce de ton Seigneur, un possédé.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجۡرًا غَيۡرَ مَمۡنُونٖ

english.text: You will surely have a never-ending reward.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu recevras une récompense dont tu ne seras jamais privé.

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٖ

english.text: Indeed, you are of a great moral character.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu es, en vérité, doté du caractère le plus élevé[3].
french.footnotes: [3] Autre sens : tu professes, en vérité, la religion la plus sublime.

renderings.arabic: فَسَتُبۡصِرُ وَيُبۡصِرُونَ

english.text: Soon you will see and they will see,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu verras, et eux-mêmes verront,

renderings.arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلۡمَفۡتُونُ

english.text: which of you is afflicted with madness.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui de vous a vraiment perdu la raison.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

english.text: Indeed, your Lord alone knows best who has strayed from His way and those who are rightly guided.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur sait parfaitement qui s’est écarté de Sa voie et qui suit la bonne direction.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

english.text: So do not obey the deniers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’écoute donc pas ceux qui renient ta mission.

renderings.arabic: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تُدۡهِنُ فَيُدۡهِنُونَ

english.text: They wish that you would compromise so they would too compromise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils voudraient que tu leur fasses des concessions, étant eux-mêmes disposés à transiger.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافٖ مَّهِينٍ

english.text: And do not obey every disgraceful swearer,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’écoute pas tout homme méprisable qui ne cesse de jurer,

renderings.arabic: هَمَّازٖ مَّشَّآءِۭ بِنَمِيمٖ

english.text: backbiter, gossip-monger,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: de dénigrer son prochain et de semer la zizanie de tout côté,

renderings.arabic: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

english.text: withholder of good, transgressor, sinful,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: si peu enclin à faire le bien, si prompt à léser autrui et à transgresser,

renderings.arabic: عُتُلِّۭ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

english.text: coarse, and furthermore, an illegitimate child[2].
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., falsely claiming a particular lineage. It refers to Al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah (See also 74:11-25) or possibly Al-Akhnas ibn Shurayq.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: d’un caractère violent et de surcroît bâtard.

renderings.arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٖ وَبَنِينَ

english.text: Simply because he has wealth and children,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Se voyant nanti de richesses et entouré d’enfants,

renderings.arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

english.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: il affirme, à l’écoute de Nos versets : « Ce ne sont là que légendes des temps anciens ! »

renderings.arabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ

english.text: We will soon brand him on the snout[3].
english.footnotes: [3] Lit., "trunk," meaning the nose of an elephant or pig. These verses refer to Al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah, a leader of the pagans of Makkah and a staunch enemy of Islam. He called the Prophet (ﷺ) a madman, so the Qur’an responded by mentioning ten of Al-Walīd’s qualities. (See 53:33-35 and 74:11-26). Two of those qualities were not known to him: the fact that he was an illegitimate child and that his nose would be chopped off years later at the Battle of Badr. Khālid ibn al-Walīd and two of his brothers embraced Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous allons le marquer à jamais au museau.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ

english.text: Indeed, We have tested them [i.e., the Makkans] as We tested the people of the garden when they swore to harvest its fruits in the early morning,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous les avons éprouvés[4] comme Nous avons éprouvé les propriétaires du verger qui s’étaient juré d’en faire la récolte de bon matin
french.footnotes: [4] Les païens de la Mecque.

renderings.arabic: وَلَا يَسۡتَثۡنُونَ

english.text: and made no exception [by saying: if Allah wills][4].
english.footnotes: [4] Or without leaving some for the poor.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à leur seul profit, sans prendre soin d’ajouter : « Si Allah le veut. »

renderings.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ

english.text: Then it was struck by an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, durant leur sommeil, une calamité envoyée par ton Seigneur ravagea le verger

renderings.arabic: فَأَصۡبَحَتۡ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ

english.text: and it turned to ashes [as black as night].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui fut transformé en une terre brûlée.

renderings.arabic: فَتَنَادَوۡاْ مُصۡبِحِينَ

english.text: Then in the early morning they called out to one another:
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’aube, les uns se mirent à interpeler les autres :

renderings.arabic: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ

english.text: “Go early to your garden if you really wish to harvest.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Allons très tôt à notre verger, si nous voulons en récolter les fruits. »

renderings.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقُواْ وَهُمۡ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ

english.text: So they set out, whispering to one another,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils se mirent rapidement en route, se disant à voix basse :

renderings.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينٞ

english.text: “Not a single poor person should enter your garden today.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Ne laissons aujourd’hui aucun nécessiteux y pénétrer. »

renderings.arabic: وَغَدَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡدٖ قَٰدِرِينَ

english.text: And they left early, fully determined to stick to their plan[5].
english.footnotes: [5] To implement their plan, fully confident of their ability.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils se dirigèrent donc vers le verger, persuadés qu’ils pourraient en récolter les fruits, décidés à en priver les nécessiteux.

renderings.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهَا قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ

english.text: But when they saw the garden, they said, “We must have lost our way!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, découvrant le verger ravagé, ils dirent : « Nous nous sommes sûrement égarés »,

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ

english.text: Rather, we have been deprived.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: avant d’ajouter[5] : « Non, en réalité nous sommes complètement ruinés ! »
french.footnotes: [5] S’étant assurés qu’il s’agissait bien de leur verger.

renderings.arabic: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

english.text: The best among them said, “Did I not say to you to glorify Allah[6]?”
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., remember Him by saying, "...if Allah wills." Or "praise" and "thank" Allah for His bounty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le plus sensé d’entre eux leur fit remarquer : « Ne vous avais-je pas recommandé de rendre gloire à Allah ? »

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

english.text: They said, “Glory be to our Lord! We were truly wrongdoers.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils dirent : « Gloire à notre Seigneur ! Nous avons vraiment été injustes ! »

renderings.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ

english.text: Then they turned to one another, throwing blame.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les uns se mirent alors à blâmer les autres,

renderings.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ

english.text: They said, “Woe to us! We were surely transgressors.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: disant : « Malheur à nous ! Nous avons transgressé !

renderings.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

english.text: Our Lord may give us something better than this. We certainly turn to our Lord in hope[7].”
english.footnotes: [7] Of His forgiveness and bounty.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Puisse Notre Seigneur, en qui nous plaçons tous nos espoirs, nous accorder mieux que ce verger ! »

renderings.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Such is the punishment [in this world]; but the punishment of the Hereafter is far worse, if only they knew.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici le châtiment réservé à leurs semblables, mais le châtiment de l’au-delà sera bien plus terrible. S’ils pouvaient en être convaincus !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will have gardens of bliss with their Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A ceux qui craignent Allah sont promis, auprès de leur Seigneur, les jardins des délices.

renderings.arabic: أَفَنَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ كَٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

english.text: Should We then treat Muslims like the wicked?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pourrions-Nous réserver à ceux qui Nous sont soumis le même sort qu’aux impies ?

renderings.arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ

english.text: What is the matter with you that you make such a judgment?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’avez-vous donc à juger de cette façon ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ كِتَٰبٞ فِيهِ تَدۡرُسُونَ

english.text: Or do you have a scripture in which you read
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Disposez-vous d’un livre révélé où vous lisez

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

english.text: that you will be given whatever you choose?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que vous obtiendrez tout ce que vous désirez ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ

english.text: Or do you have a solemn promise binding upon Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you decide for yourselves?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien avez-vous reçu Notre engagement formel, valable jusqu’au Jour dernier, de vous accorder ce que vous décrétez ?

renderings.arabic: سَلۡهُمۡ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

english.text: Ask them which of them can guarantee that.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Demande-leur qui d’entre eux peut s’en porter garant.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english.text: Or do they have associate-gods? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods[8], if they are truthful.
english.footnotes: [8] whom they took as partners with Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien d’autres qu’eux confirment-ils leurs dires[6] ? Qu’ils les fassent donc venir, s’ils disent la vérité !
french.footnotes: [6] Autre sens : ou bien ont-ils des divinités qui le leur garantissent.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقٖ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ

english.text: On the Day when the Shin [of Allah] will be uncovered[9], and they are invited to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so.
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., It is a Day that everyone will find before him great difficulty. According to a long and authentic Hadīth of Abu Sa‘īd al-Khudrī, "the Shin" refers to that of Allah Almighty, before which every believer will prostrate on the Day of Judgment when the disbelievers and hypocrites will not be able to prostrate. The text of the Hadith is as follows: "... Then the Lord will uncover His Shank, so they will prostrate to Him...".
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils seront un jour exposés aux affres du Jugement dernier et appelés à se prosterner, mais sans pouvoir s’exécuter.

renderings.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ

english.text: Their eyes will be downcast, overwhelmed with humiliation, for they were invited to prostrate when they were capable[10] [but they refused].
english.footnotes: [10] During the life of this world.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Regards baissés, ils seront couverts d’opprobre. Ils étaient en effet appelés à se prosterner alors qu’ils étaient en parfaite santé et jouissaient de toutes leurs facultés !

renderings.arabic: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: So leave to Me those who reject this message [O Prophet]. We will gradually lead them to their ruin in ways that they do not perceive[11].
english.footnotes: [11] Allah will increase favors upon them in this life as a trial, so they will increase sin, which will lead to their destruction.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse-Moi donc avec ceux qui traitent ce discours de mensonge. Nous allons les laisser s’enfoncer dans l’erreur sans qu’ils s’en rendent compte.

renderings.arabic: وَأُمۡلِي لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ كَيۡدِي مَتِينٌ

english.text: I will give them respite, but My plan is firm.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je leur accorde simplement un répit. Mes manœuvres sont imparables.

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ

english.text: Or are you asking them for a reward, so they find it too burdensome?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leur réclames-tu un salaire dont ils auraient toutes les peines à s’acquitter ?

renderings.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ

english.text: Or do they have knowledge of the unseen, so they write it down?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ou bien connaissent-ils les mystères dont ils pourraient rendre compte par écrit ?

renderings.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ

english.text: So be patient with the decree of your Lord, and do not be like the man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah], when he cried out in anguish[12].
english.footnotes: [12] While inside the belly of the whale. See 21:87 and 37:139-148.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.
