english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Noé dit : « Seigneur ! Ils m’ont désobéi, préférant écouter des hommes dont les richesses et les enfants ne font qu’aggraver l’impiété,

renderings.arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا كُبَّارٗا

english.text: They have contrived a mighty plot,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qui, par leurs manœuvres incessantes, les ont détournés de la vérité,

renderings.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدّٗا وَلَا سُوَاعٗا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرٗا

english.text: They said, ‘Do not abandon your gods; and do not abandon Wadd, Suwā‘, Yaghūth, Ya‘ūq, and Nasr[8].’
english.footnotes: [8] These were the names of idols named after pious men of past generations before the time of Noah, to commemorate them. In later generations, people started worshiping these idols.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: leur disant : “Ne renoncez jamais au culte de vos divinités. N’abandonnez jamais Wadd, Souwâ’, Yaghouth, Ya’ouq et Nasr”.

renderings.arabic: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلٗا

english.text: They have led many astray. So [O Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ces hommes ont ainsi égaré un grand nombre d’entre eux[3]. Que les mécréants s’enfoncent donc, Seigneur, plus encore dans l’égarement ! »
french.footnotes: [3] Autre sens : ces idoles ont été la cause de l’égarement d’un grand nombre.

renderings.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا

english.text: Because of their sins, they were drowned and then were cast into the Fire, and they did not find any helpers against Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pour prix de leurs péchés, ils furent engloutis par les flots, avant d’être livrés au Feu, sans que nul ne puisse les sauver du châtiment d’Allah.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

english.text: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave on earth a single disbeliever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Noé implora : « Ne laisse, Seigneur, nul impie en vie à la surface de la terre.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرٗا كَفَّارٗا

english.text: For if You leave them, they will surely lead Your slaves astray and beget none but wicked disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sans quoi, ils égareront Tes serviteurs et n’engendreront que des hommes sans foi ni loi.

renderings.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا

english.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and all the believing men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers except in ruin.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Veuille, Seigneur, me pardonner, ainsi qu’à mes père et mère, à quiconque franchira le seuil de ma demeure le cœur rempli de foi, et à l’ensemble des croyants et des croyantes. Et veuille enfoncer plus encore les mécréants dans la ruine. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا

english.text: Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened [to the Qur’an,] and they said, ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Il m’a été révélé qu’un groupe de djinns, après m’avoir écouté réciter le Coran, ont affirmé[1] : “Nous avons entendu une lecture étonnante
french.footnotes: [1] A leurs semblables, à leur retour auprès d’eux. Voir sourate 46, verset 29.

renderings.arabic: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا

english.text: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: propre à assurer notre salut et à laquelle nous avons cru. Nous n’associerons donc nulle divinité au culte de notre Seigneur !

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا

english.text: And that He – our exalted and glorified Lord[1] – has neither taken a wife nor a child;
english.footnotes: [1] “Jadd” of Our Lord means His Glory, Grandeur, and Command.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Notre Seigneur, exalté soit-Il, ne s’est donné ni compagne, ni enfant.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا

english.text: and that the fool among us [i.e., Satan] used to say outrageous things about Allah[2],
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., Satan tempted humans to believe that Allah has a wife and children, and that the angels are Allah's daughters.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Des insensés parmi nous[2] proféraient simplement sur Allah d’infâmes mensonges.
french.footnotes: [2] Ou : Satan.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا

english.text: although we thought that humans and jinn would never tell lies about Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous pensions pourtant que ni les hommes ni les djinns ne pouvaient mentir sur Allah[3].
french.footnotes: [3] En lui attribuant une compagne et des enfants.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا

english.text: And there were some men who used to seek refuge with some jinn, but they only increased them in burden.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains hommes imploraient la protection de certains djinns, ce qui ne fit qu’ajouter à leur rébellion[4].
french.footnotes: [4] La rébellion et la transgression des djinns. Autre sens : ce qui ne fit qu’ajouter à l’égarement et à la terreur des hommes.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا

english.text: They thought, just like you [jinn] thought that Allah would never send any messenger.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comme vous, ils pensaient qu’Allah ne susciterait plus jamais de Messager[5].
french.footnotes: [5] Ou : ne ressusciterait pas les morts.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا

english.text: We have sought to reach heaven but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais, ayant tenté de nous approcher du ciel[6], nous l’avons trouvé puissamment protégé par des gardiens[7] et des météores.
french.footnotes:
[6] Comme à notre habitude, afin d’écouter les secrets célestes.
[7] Les anges.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا

english.text: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but now anyone who eavesdrops will find a flaming fire waiting for him[3].
english.footnotes: [3] After the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) was sent as a messenger, the jinn who used to eavesdrop on heaven and then pass it on to fortune-tellers came to an end.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous pouvions auparavant[8] y prendre place pour écouter les secrets célestes. Mais quiconque tente aujourd’hui de surprendre l’un de ces secrets doit affronter un météore prêt à le foudroyer.
french.footnotes: [8] Avant l’avènement du Prophète.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدٗا

english.text: We do not know whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends good for them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ne savons pas si[9] l’on veut du mal aux habitants de la terre ou si leur Seigneur leur veut simplement du bien.
french.footnotes: [9] Ces phénomènes sont le signe que.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا

english.text: Among us are some who are righteous and some who are otherwise, for we follow divergent ways[4].
english.footnotes: [4] In beliefs and religious duties.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains, parmi nous, sont vertueux tandis que d’autres le sont moins[10]. Nous suivons en effet des voies divergentes.
french.footnotes: [10] Autre sens : sont éloignés de toute vertu.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا

english.text: We have realized that we can never escape Allah on earth, nor can we ever escape Him by fleeing.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous savons à présent que nous ne pouvons nous opposer à la volonté d’Allah sur terre, ni Lui échapper.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا

english.text: When we heard the guidance [of the Qur’an], we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord will have no fear of curtailment [from his reward] or injustice[5].
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., nor will the sins of another be placed upon him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque nous avons entendu le message de vérité[11], nous y avons cru. Or, quiconque croit en son Seigneur ne doit redouter ni d’être frustré[12], ni d’être lésé[13].
french.footnotes:
[11] Le Coran.
[12] De ses bonnes actions.
[13] En se voyant ajouter des péchés qu’il n’a pas commis.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا

english.text: Among us are some who are Muslims and some who are deviant[6]. Those who accepted Islam have sought the true guidance,
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., deviant from the right way.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Certains, parmi nous, se sont soumis, tandis que d’autres se sont détournés du droit chemin. Ceux qui se sont soumis sont ceux qui étaient en quête de vérité.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبٗا

english.text: but those who are deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui se sont détournés, ils alimenteront le feu de la Géhenne”. »[14]
french.footnotes: [14] Ici prend fin le long monologue des djinns révélé au Prophète.

renderings.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا

english.text: “If they had remained steadfast on the right way, We would have given them abundant rain,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, si les impies suivaient le droit chemin, Nous ne manquerions pas de les combler de Nos faveurs

renderings.arabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا

english.text: as a test for them[7]. But whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord[8], He will make him suffer an arduous punishment.
english.footnotes:
[7] As to whether they will be grateful for Allah's provisions or not.
 [8] i.e., the Qur’an and obedience to Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: afin de les mettre à l’épreuve. Mais quiconque se détourne du message de son Seigneur sera plongé dans d’insupportables tourments.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا

english.text: The mosques[9] are for Allah alone, so do not supplicate anyone along with Allah.
english.footnotes: [9] "Masjid" here means every place of worship on earth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mosquées étant exclusivement consacrées au culte d’Allah, n’y vénérez nul autre que Lui.

renderings.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا

english.text: Yet when the slave of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they swarmed around him[10].”
english.footnotes: [10] Crowding in the manner of locusts on top of one another in order to hear him (ﷺ). It refers to the jinn or to the Arabs pagans.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque le serviteur d’Allah s’est levé pour L’invoquer, ils ont failli se jeter sur lui[15].
french.footnotes: [15] Le pronom « ils » désigne ici soit les djinns, qui ont failli se jeter sur le Prophète afin de l’écouter réciter le Coran, soit les païens de la Mecque, qui ont failli l’agresser lorsqu’il s’est levé pour leur prêcher l’islam.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا

english.text: Say [O Prophet], “I only supplicate my Lord and I do not associate anyone with Him.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Je voue un culte exclusif à mon Seigneur, sans associer d’autres que Lui à Son adoration. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا

english.text: Say, “I have no power to harm or benefit you[11].”
english.footnotes: [11] i.e., grant you goodness and guidance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis-leur : « Je ne peux ni vous préserver d’un mal, ni vous procurer un bien. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا

english.text: Say, “None can ever protect me from Allah [if I should disobey Him], nor can I ever find refuge except in Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Nul ne saurait me protéger du châtiment d’Allah[16] et je ne pourrais moi-même trouver de refuge contre Ses rigueurs.
french.footnotes: [16] Si je Lui désobéissais.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

english.text: I only convey what I receive from Allah and His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Je peux seulement vous transmettre le message qu’Allah m’a confié. Quiconque désobéira ensuite à Allah et Son Messager sera voué au feu de la Géhenne où il demeurera à jamais. »

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا

english.text: Until when they see what they were promised, they will realize who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voyant le châtiment dont ils étaient menacés, les païens sauront alors qui dispose des soutiens les plus fragiles et des partisans les moins nombreux.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا

english.text: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has appointed a distant time for it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis-leur : « Je ne sais si le châtiment dont vous êtes menacés est imminent ou si mon Seigneur lui a assigné un terme plus éloigné. »

renderings.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

english.text: [He is] the Knower of the unseen, He does not reveal His unseen to anyone,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lui seul connaît les mystères de l’univers qu’Il ne révèle à personne,

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا

english.text: except the messenger whom He chooses, then He appoints angel-guards before him and behind him[12]
english.footnotes: [12] Protecting him so that others do not know what he was informed of the unseen.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: hormis à ceux qu’Il choisit comme Messagers[17], qu’Il place sous la protection vigilante d’anges gardiens postés devant et derrière eux[18].
french.footnotes:
[17] Auxquels Il dévoile une partie seulement des mystères à travers notamment la Révélation.
[18] Au moment où leur sont révélés ces mystères, précisent certains exégètes.

renderings.arabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا

english.text: to ensure[13] that the messengers fully conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses in His knowledge all about them, and keeps count of all things.”
english.footnotes: [13] Or "So He may make evident."
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il sait ainsi que les prophètes ont bien transmis le message de leur Seigneur. Rien d’ailleurs de ce qui les concerne ne Lui échappe, Lui qui connaît dans le plus petit détail Sa Création.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ

english.text: O you the enwrapped one[1],
english.footnotes: [1] Allah is addressing the Messenger (ﷺ), who was wrapped in his garments.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Toi qui t’enveloppes dans tes habits !

renderings.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

english.text: Stand up in prayer at night except a little,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lève-toi pour prier la plus grande partie de la nuit,

renderings.arabic: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا

english.text: half of it, or a little less,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: la moitié, ou un peu moins que celle-ci,

renderings.arabic: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا

english.text: or a little more, and recite the Qur’an at a measured pace.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ou un peu plus, en récitant le Coran posément.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلٗا ثَقِيلًا

english.text: We will send down upon you a heavy Word[2].
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., the revelation, which the Prophet (ﷺ) would feel its great weight when descending upon him. Also, it is heavy for its ordinances, rulings, punishments, ethics, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous allons te révéler des paroles lourdes de sens.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا

english.text: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[3] and more conducive to proper recitation[4].
english.footnotes:
[3] Or "getting up at night is more difficult...," meaning that it can only be done by sincere believers.
 [4] i.e., for reciting, hearing, and understanding of the Qur’an.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les heures de la nuit sont plus propices au recueillement.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا

english.text: In the daytime, you have plenty of time for your worldly matters.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu es tenu, dans la journée, par une foule d’occupations[1].
french.footnotes: [1] Autre sens : tu as suffisamment de temps libre dans la journée pour tes occupations.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا

english.text: And remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself completely to Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Invoque le nom de ton Seigneur et voue-toi exclusivement à Son adoration.

renderings.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا

english.text: [He is] Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, so take Him as the Disposer of your affairs[5].
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., trust in Allah and rely upon Him in all your matters.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il est le Seigneur du levant et du couchant. Il n’est de divinité digne d’être adorée que Lui. Place donc ta confiance en Lui, car Il se charge de ta protection !

renderings.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرٗا جَمِيلٗا

english.text: Bear patiently what they say, and avoid them in a gracious manner.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Supporte patiemment leurs paroles et éloigne-toi d’eux dignement.

renderings.arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا

english.text: Leave to Me the deniers who are having a life of luxury, and bear with them for a little while.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Laisse-Moi avec les négateurs qui jouissent sans retenue de cette vie. Accorde-leur quelque temps.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالٗا وَجَحِيمٗا

english.text: Indeed, We have heavy shackles and a Blazing Fire,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous leur réservons en vérité de lourdes chaînes et un brasier ardent,

renderings.arabic: وَطَعَامٗا ذَا غُصَّةٖ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

english.text: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: des aliments qui leur resteront en travers de la gorge et un douloureux châtiment,

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبٗا مَّهِيلًا

english.text: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will convulse, and the mountains will be like dunes of loose sand.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le Jour où la terre et les montagnes trembleront et que ces dernières ne seront plus que dunes de sable mouvant.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولٗا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولٗا

english.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons envoyé un Messager qui témoignera contre vous, de même que Nous avons envoyé un Messager à Pharaon

renderings.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذٗا وَبِيلٗا

english.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a severe punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, pour avoir désobéi à Notre Messager, fut violemment saisi par Notre châtiment.

renderings.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمٗا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا

english.text: If you disbelieve, then how will you protect yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair gray?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Comment, si vous rejetez la foi, pourrez-vous échapper au châtiment d’un jour si terrible qu’il donnera des cheveux blancs aux enfants

renderings.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا

english.text: It will cause the sky to break asunder[6]. His promise will certainly be fulfilled.
english.footnotes: [6] Out of the terror of that Day.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et qu’il verra le ciel s’entrouvrir. Sa menace devra s’accomplir.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

english.text: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Voici une exhortation. Que celui qui le veut suive donc la voie de son Seigneur !

renderings.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرٗاۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ

english.text: Indeed, your Lord knows that you [O Prophet] stand up in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, as do others among your companions. Allah determines the night and the day; He knows that you [Muslims] cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He pardoned you[7]. Recite then as much of the Qur’an as is easy for you [in the night prayers]. He knows that there are some among you who will be ill, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and others fighting in Allah’s way. So recite as much of it as is easy for you; establish prayer and give zakah; and lend to Allah a goodly loan[8]. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, much better in condition and much greater in reward[9]. And seek forgiveness of Allah, for indeed Allah is All-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
english.footnotes:
[7] The ruling mentioned at the beginning of this surah is lightened here. So from now on, the believers do not have to stick to any of the portions specified there; rather, they can pray whatever they can at night. It is out of the mercy of Allah upon His servants that He does not want hardship for them.
 [8] i.e., giving in charity and for His causes.
 [9] It will be rewarded tenfold, or 700-fold, and Allah gives even more to whoever He wills. See 2:261.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur sait parfaitement que tu pries parfois moins des deux tiers de la nuit, parfois la moitié et parfois à peine le tiers, à l’image d’une partie de tes compagnons. Allah détermine la durée de la nuit et du jour. Il sait que vous ne pourrez jamais estimer précisément le temps de prière et vous conformer à cette obligation qu’Il a donc allégée pour vous. Par conséquent, récitez[2] ce que vous pourrez du Coran. Il sait que certains d’entre vous tomberont malades, que d’autres parcourront le monde en quête de Ses faveurs, tandis que d’autres lutteront pour Sa cause. Récitez-en donc ce que vous pourrez ! Accomplissez la prière, acquittez-vous de l’aumône et faites à Allah un prêt sincère. Et sachez que, quelque bien que vous accomplissiez sur terre en vue de votre salut, vous le retrouverez démultiplié auprès de votre Seigneur. Implorez le pardon d’Allah qui, en vérité, est Très Clément et Très Miséricordieux.
french.footnotes: [2] Au cours de vos prières nocturnes.

renderings.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ

english.text: O you covered [in your cloak][1],
english.footnotes: [1] It refers to the Prophet (ﷺ).
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Toi qui te couvres de tes habits !

renderings.arabic: قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ

english.text: arise and warn,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lève-toi résolument et avertis !

renderings.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرۡ

english.text: and proclaim the greatness of your Lord,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Exalte la grandeur de ton Seigneur !

renderings.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرۡ

english.text: and purify your garments,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
