renderings.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ

english.text: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from the Reminder,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’ont-ils donc à tourner le dos à toute exhortation,

renderings.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ حُمُرٞ مُّسۡتَنفِرَةٞ

english.text: as if they were terrified wild asses,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à l’image de zèbres affolés,

renderings.arabic: فَرَّتۡ مِن قَسۡوَرَةِۭ

english.text: fleeing from a lion?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: fuyant à la vue d’un lion[8] ?
french.footnotes: [8] Ou : de chasseurs.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفٗا مُّنَشَّرَةٗ

english.text: In fact, each one of them desires that open [divine] letters be sent to each of them[11].
english.footnotes: [11] Instead of Muhammad (ﷺ), not due to the lack of proofs or signs presented to them but out of obstinacy and arrogance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais chacun d’entre eux voudrait que lui soit remis un livre révélé[9].
french.footnotes: [9] Confirmant la mission du Prophète, expliquent nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ

english.text: By no means! They rather do not fear the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’est-ce pas plutôt qu’ils ne redoutent pas la Résurrection ?

renderings.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذۡكِرَةٞ

english.text: No indeed! This [Qur’an] is a reminder.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceci, en vérité, est une simple exhortation.

renderings.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

english.text: So whoever wills may take heed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que celui qui le veut en tire donc des leçons.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ

english.text: But they will not take heed unless Allah so wills. He is most worthy to be feared and most worthy to forgive.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais ils n’en tireront des leçons que si Allah le veut. Lui seul mérite leur crainte et peut leur accorder le pardon.

renderings.arabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

english.text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: J’en jure par le Jour de la résurrection !

renderings.arabic: وَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلنَّفۡسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ

english.text: and I swear by the self-reproaching soul[1]!
english.footnotes: [1] Of the believer, which blames oneself whenever falls into sin or error.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: J’en jure par l’âme en proie aux remords[1] !
french.footnotes: [1] L’âme du croyant qui ne cesse de se reprocher ses manquements et ses péchés.

renderings.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجۡمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ

english.text: Does man think that We cannot reassemble his bones?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme croit-il que Nous ne pourrons rassembler ses os ?

renderings.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ

english.text: In fact, We are able to restore even his very fingertips.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous pourrons au contraire reconstituer jusqu’à ses phalanges.

renderings.arabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ

english.text: But man desires to persist in sin[2],
english.footnotes: [2] While denying the coming of the Day of Judgment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais l’homme aspire seulement à continuer à vivre dans le péché[2].
french.footnotes: [2] En niant la Résurrection.

renderings.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

english.text: and asks [mockingly], “When is the Day of Resurrection?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il demande : « Quand donc viendra le Jour de la résurrection ? »

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ

english.text: But when the sight is dazzled,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque les yeux seront exorbités,

renderings.arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلۡقَمَرُ

english.text: and the moon is darkened,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: que la lune aura perdu toute clarté,

renderings.arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ

english.text: and the sun and the moon are brought together[3],
english.footnotes: [3] They both have never been together since they were created. On this Day they will be brought together, darkened, and both will be thrown into the Hell; so that all should know that they were subservient created beings, especially those who worshiped them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que le soleil et la lune seront rassemblés[3],
french.footnotes: [3] Autre sens : se seront éteints.

renderings.arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ أَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَفَرُّ

english.text: on that Day man will say, “Where is the escape?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: l’homme, ce Jour-là, dira : « Où fuir ? »

renderings.arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

english.text: No indeed! There will be no refuge.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nulle part ! Il n’y aura, en effet, aucun refuge.

renderings.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقَرُّ

english.text: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est à ton Seigneur, ce Jour-là, que tous feront retour.

renderings.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

english.text: On that Day man will be informed of what he has sent forth[4] and left behind[5].
english.footnotes:
[4] i.e., of his deeds for the Hereafter.
 [5] i.e., that which he failed to do.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme sera, ce Jour-là, informé de ses actes les plus insignifiants.

renderings.arabic: بَلِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٞ

english.text: In fact, man will be a witness against himself[6],
english.footnotes: [6] His organs will testify against him, as mentioned in 36:65 and 41:20-23.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais il sera lui-même parfaitement conscient de ses agissements,

renderings.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَلۡقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ

english.text: despite the excuses he may put forward.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: quand bien même il invoquerait, pour se justifier, tous les arguments.

renderings.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

english.text: Do not move your tongue [O Prophet] in haste trying to memorize it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne répète pas avec empressement le Coran qui t’est révélé avant que sa récitation ne soit terminée[4].
french.footnotes: [4] Voir note verset 114, sourate 20.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهُۥ وَقُرۡءَانَهُۥ

english.text: It is upon Us to make you memorize and recite it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est à Nous qu’il revient de le fixer dans ta mémoire[5] et de te le faire réciter.
french.footnotes: [5] Littéralement : de le rassembler (dans ton cœur).

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعۡ قُرۡءَانَهُۥ

english.text: Then when We recite it [through Gabriel], follow its recitation attentively;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque Nous te le lisons[6], contente-toi donc d’en suivre la récitation.
french.footnotes: [6] Par l’intermédiaire de Gabriel.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا بَيَانَهُۥ

english.text: then it is upon Us to explain its meanings.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est ensuite à Nous qu’il appartiendra d’en donner l’explication.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ

english.text: No indeed! You [people] love this fleeting world,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est que vous êtes obnubilés par ce bas-monde

renderings.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ

english.text: and neglect the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: au point d’en oublier totalement l’autre monde.

renderings.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاضِرَةٌ

english.text: On that Day some faces will be bright,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il y aura, ce Jour-là, des visages éclatants de beauté

renderings.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٞ

english.text: looking at their Lord[7].
english.footnotes: [7] The dwellers of Paradise will be granted the honor of actually seeing their Lord in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui, vers leur Seigneur, seront résolument tournés[7],
french.footnotes: [7] Contemplant Son Visage.

renderings.arabic: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَاسِرَةٞ

english.text: And on that Day, some faces will be gloomy,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais aussi des visages sombres et crispés,

renderings.arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفۡعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٞ

english.text: knowing that a crushing calamity will befall them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: persuadés de devoir subir une calamité.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ

english.text: Indeed, when the soul reaches the throat[8],
english.footnotes: [8] Upon death.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque l’âme du moribond remonte à la gorge,

renderings.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنۡۜ رَاقٖ

english.text: and it is said, “Is there any healer?”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que ceux qui l’entourent demandent si quelqu’un peut le sauver,

renderings.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡفِرَاقُ

english.text: And he realizes that it is time to depart,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tandis que le mourant est convaincu qu’il va quitter ce monde,

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ

english.text: when legs are brought together [in a shroud][9];
english.footnotes: [9] The difficulties the person faces while leaving this world and moving on to the Hereafter; or the people arrange for the departure of his body, while angels arrange for the departure of his soul.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que, aux affres de la mort, s’ajoutent les affres de l’autre monde[8],
french.footnotes: [8] Autre sens : et que ses jambes sont nouées.

renderings.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ

english.text: on that Day, he will be driven to your Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: c’est vers ton Seigneur, ce jour-là, que l’âme du mourant est menée.

renderings.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

english.text: He neither believed nor prayed;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, l’impie n’a ni cru, ni accompli la prière,

renderings.arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

english.text: rather he denied and turned away,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais a renié la vérité et s’est détourné de la foi,

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ

english.text: then he went to his people, elated with pride,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: puis s’est dirigé vers les siens en se pavanant.

renderings.arabic: أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰ

english.text: Woe to you, and woe!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Malheur à toi, oui malheur ! »

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰٓ

english.text: Again, woe to you, and woe!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Encore une fois : « Malheur à toi, oui malheur ! »

renderings.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتۡرَكَ سُدًى

english.text: Does man think that he will be left neglected[10]?
english.footnotes: [10] i.e., without purpose and responsibility, or without returning to Allah for account.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme croit-il qu’il ne sera ni ressuscité, ni jugé ?

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةٗ مِّن مَّنِيّٖ يُمۡنَىٰ

english.text: Was he not once a drop of semen emitted,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne tire-t-il pas son origine d’un liquide insignifiant répandu[9],
french.footnotes: [9] Dans la matrice de la femme.

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةٗ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

english.text: then he became a clinging clot[11], then He created him and perfected his form,
english.footnotes: [11] "‘Alaqah": an embryo that resembles a leech.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: puis d’un corps s’accrochant à la matrice, avant qu’Allah ne lui donne la vie et n’en fasse un être accompli,

renderings.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ

english.text: and made from him both genders, male and female?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: de sexe masculin ou féminin ?

renderings.arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ

english.text: Is not He able to bring the dead back to life?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui qui a pu créer cet être n’est-Il pas capable de ressusciter les morts ?!

renderings.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا

english.text: Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?
english.footnotes: [1] Before coming into being.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne s’est-il pas passé une longue période avant que l’homme ne vienne à être mentionné ?

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا

english.text: Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[2], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.
english.footnotes: [2] A combination of male and female gametes (sperm and egg) which form the zygote after fertilization in the womb.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons, à partir d’un liquide constitué de divers éléments, créé l’homme afin de l’éprouver et l’avons, pour cela, doté de l’ouïe et de la vue.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

english.text: Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous lui avons indiqué la voie à suivre, qu’il se montre reconnaissant[1] ou ingrat.
french.footnotes: [1] En suivant cette voie.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا

english.text: We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Aux mécréants, Nous avons préparé des chaînes, des carcans et un brasier ardent,

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[3],
english.footnotes: [3] "Kāfoor": a sweet-scent spring in Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tandis que les pieux croyants se délecteront d’un vin mêlé de camphre,

renderings.arabic: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا

english.text: a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: puisé à une source à laquelle se désaltèreront les serviteurs d’Allah et qu’ils feront jaillir à leur gré.

renderings.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرٗا

english.text: They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils étaient en effet fidèles à leurs engagements[2], redoutaient un jour dont le mal se propagera inexorablement
french.footnotes: [2] Envers Allah, à travers notamment les vœux, et envers les hommes.

renderings.arabic: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا

english.text: and they give food, despite their love for it[4], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,
english.footnotes: [4] Or "out of love for Him (Allah)".
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et offraient de la nourriture, pourtant si chère à leurs yeux, au nécessiteux, à l’orphelin et au captif,

renderings.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا

english.text: [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: disant : « Nous vous nourrissons uniquement pour plaire à Allah, n’attendant de vous ni récompense, ni reconnaissance.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا

english.text: We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous redoutons l’avènement d’un jour, décrété par notre Seigneur, si terrible que les visages en seront contractés de terreur. »

renderings.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةٗ وَسُرُورٗا

english.text: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah les préservera donc des affres de ce Jour, leurs visages seront éclatants de beauté et rayonnants de joie.

renderings.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا

english.text: and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pour leur constance, le Seigneur les introduira au Paradis où ils seront revêtus de soie,

renderings.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسٗا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرٗا

english.text: They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[5] nor freezing cold.
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., the sun.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: accoudés sur des lits somptueux, à l’abri de la chaleur du soleil et de la rigueur du froid,

renderings.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلٗا

english.text: with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à l’ombre des arbres, tout proches, du Paradis dont les fruits seront à portée de main.

renderings.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٖ مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠

english.text: They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: On fera circuler parmi eux des plats en argent et des coupes de cristal -

renderings.arabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٖ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرٗا

english.text: crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: de cristal argenté[3] - remplies à leur convenance.
french.footnotes: [3] Ces coupes, selon certains exégètes, auront la couleur de l’argent et l’éclat et la pureté du cristal.

renderings.arabic: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

english.text: They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Leur sera aussi servi un vin mêlé de gingembre,

renderings.arabic: عَيۡنٗا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلٗا

english.text: from a spring therein called Salsabīl.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: puisé à une source du Paradis appelée Salsabîl.

renderings.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٗا مَّنثُورٗا

english.text: They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Parmi eux circuleront des serviteurs d’une éternelle jeunesse que l’on prendrait pour des perles éparpillées[4].
french.footnotes: [4] Tant ils seront éclatants de beauté et tant ils s’activeront en vue de satisfaire les élus du Paradis.

renderings.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمٗا وَمُلۡكٗا كَبِيرًا

english.text: If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Tu y découvriras d’ineffables délices et un royaume incommensurable.

renderings.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرٞ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٞۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٖ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابٗا طَهُورًا

english.text: They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les élus du Paradis seront vêtus de soie fine de couleur verte et de brocart, parés de bracelets d’argent et abreuvés par leur Seigneur d’une boisson d’une grande pureté.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا

english.text: [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Telle est la récompense méritée de vos œuvres qui ont été acceptées. »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا

english.text: Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui t’avons révélé le Coran[5], à n’en point douter.
french.footnotes: [5] De manière progressive, précisent nombre de commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا

english.text: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Soumets-toi donc patiemment à la volonté de ton Seigneur, sans écouter ceux d’entre eux qui se livrent au péché et vivent dans l’impiété.

renderings.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا

english.text: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[6],
english.footnotes: [6] This and the next verse refer to the five daily prayers: here it refers to the dawn prayer, then the noon and afternoon prayers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Invoque le nom de ton Seigneur matin et soir.

renderings.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا

english.text: and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[7].
english.footnotes: [7] It refers to the sunset and night prayers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Prosterne-toi devant Lui une partie de la nuit, au cours de laquelle tu célèbreras longuement Sa gloire.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا

english.text: Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ces gens sont obnubilés par ce bas monde au point d’en oublier un jour d’une extrême gravité.

renderings.arabic: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا

english.text: It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est Nous qui les avons créés et solidement constitués, et Nous pourrions, si Nous le voulions, les remplacer par d’autres hommes comme eux.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا

english.text: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who wills may take a way to his Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ceci, en vérité, est une simple exhortation. Que celui qui le veut suive donc la voie de son Seigneur !

renderings.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا

english.text: But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais vous ne le voudrez que si Allah Lui-même, Omniscient et infiniment Sage, le veut.

renderings.arabic: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا

english.text: He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il admet qui Il veut dans Sa grâce. Quant aux impies, Il leur a préparé un châtiment douloureux.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡمُرۡسَلَٰتِ عُرۡفٗا

english.text: By those [winds] sent forth in succession,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center

english.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Malheur, ce Jour-là, à ceux qui auront rejeté la vérité !

renderings.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

english.text: In which message after this [Qur’an] will they believe?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: En quel livre croiront-ils, s’ils ne croient pas en celui-ci ?

renderings.arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english.text: About what are they asking one another?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A quel propos s’interrogent-ils ?

renderings.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

english.text: About the momentous news[1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Resurrection.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A propos d’une nouvelle d’une extrême gravité[1],
french.footnotes: [1] La Résurrection ou le Coran.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ

english.text: that which they differ about[2].
english.footnotes: [2] The pagans of Makkah denied the Qur’an, resurrection, and judgment. They differed as to whether the Qur’an was magic, fortune-telling, or poetry.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui ne cesse aujourd’hui de les opposer[2].
french.footnotes: [2] Certains y croyant, d’autres non.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: No indeed; they will come to know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais ils sauront bientôt !

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ

english.text: Again no; they will come to know.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Oui, ils sauront bientôt !

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدٗا

english.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’avons-Nous pas fait de la terre une vaste étendue

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادٗا

english.text: And the mountains as stakes[3],
english.footnotes: [3] Mountains go deep below the surface like pegs and icebergs, stabilizing the earth and slowing tectonic movement.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et des montagnes des pieux fichés en terre[3] ?
french.footnotes: [3] Dont ils assurent la stabilité.

renderings.arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا

english.text: and created you in pairs,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne vous avons-Nous pas créés par couples ?

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتٗا

english.text: and made your sleep for rest,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’avons-Nous pas établi le sommeil pour votre repos,

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا

english.text: and made the night a covering[4],
english.footnotes: [4] Covering you in its darkness as garments cover you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: la nuit, qui vous couvre comme un manteau[4],
french.footnotes: [4] De son obscurité.

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشٗا

english.text: and made the day for seeking a livelihood,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et le jour, dédié à vos différentes activités ?

renderings.arabic: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعٗا شِدَادٗا

english.text: and built above you seven mighty heavens,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’avons-Nous pas édifié au-dessus de vous sept cieux parfaitement structurés

renderings.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجٗا وَهَّاجٗا

english.text: and made therein a blazing lamp,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et fait du soleil un flambeau vous procurant à la fois chaleur et lumière brillante ?

renderings.arabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءٗ ثَجَّاجٗا

english.text: and sent down from the rainclouds abundant water,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne faisons-Nous pas descendre, de nuages gorgés d’eau, une pluie abondante

renderings.arabic: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبّٗا وَنَبَاتٗا

english.text: so that We may produce thereby grains and vegetation,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: par laquelle Nous faisons pousser des céréales et diverses variétés de plantes,

renderings.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا

english.text: and gardens with dense foliage?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ainsi que des jardins et des vergers à la végétation luxuriante.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتٗا

english.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is a time appointed,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Jour du jugement dernier est d’ores et déjà fixé,

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا

english.text: the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, you will come forth in crowds,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jour où il sera soufflé dans la Corne et où, par groupes, vous viendrez,

renderings.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا

english.text: and the sky will be opened up and will become gateways,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Jour où les portes du ciel seront grandes ouvertes[5]
french.footnotes: [5] Pour laisser descendre les anges.

renderings.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا

english.text: and the mountains will vanish, becoming like a mirage.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et où les montagnes, réduites en poussière, ne seront plus qu’un mirage.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادٗا

english.text: Indeed, Hell is lying in wait,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La Géhenne sera alors tout disposée à accueillir

renderings.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابٗا

english.text: a resort for the transgressors,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: les impies dont elle sera l’ultime demeure

renderings.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابٗا

english.text: wherein they will abide for endless ages.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et où ils resteront des temps infinis.

renderings.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا

english.text: They will neither taste therein any coolness nor any drink,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ils n’y trouveront ni fraîcheur, ni boisson désaltérante,

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا

english.text: except for scalding water and discharge of wounds,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais chaleur étouffante, et eau bouillante et purulente.

renderings.arabic: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا

english.text: a fitting recompense[5].
english.footnotes: [5] To their disbelief and evil deeds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Telle sera la juste rétribution de leurs agissements.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا

english.text: Indeed, they did not expect a reckoning,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est qu’ils ne redoutaient pas d’affronter le Jugement,

renderings.arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا

english.text: and utterly rejected Our verses.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: reniant Nos signes et Nos versets obstinément.

renderings.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا

english.text: But We have enumerated everything in a record[6].
english.footnotes: [6] i.e., a record of deeds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, Nous avons tout consigné très précisément[6].
french.footnotes: [6] Dans le Livre archétype ou le registre des œuvres.

renderings.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

english.text: So taste [the punishment], for We will not increase you except in torment[7].”
english.footnotes: [7] The addressees are the dwellers of Hell.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: « Goûtez le châtiment ! Nous ne ferons qu’accroître votre supplice ! »

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

english.text: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation[8],
english.footnotes: [8] i.e., safety from Hell and winning Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les pieux croyants, pour leur part, jouiront de tous les délices :

renderings.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا

english.text: gardens and vineyards,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: vergers luxuriants et vignes,

renderings.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا

english.text: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: jeunes filles d’égale jeunesse,

renderings.arabic: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا

english.text: and a full cup [of wine][9].
english.footnotes: [9] i.e., tasteful wine which neither intoxicates nor causes headache.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: coupes remplies de vin à volonté.

renderings.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا

english.text: They will not hear therein vain talk or lies –
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Là, ils n’entendront ni futilités, ni propos mensongers.

renderings.arabic: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا

english.text: a reward and a generous gift from your Lord[10],
english.footnotes: [10] Or "a gift adequately calculated"; as a result of their righteous deeds as well as the ample generosity of Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Récompense plus que suffisante accordée par ton Seigneur,

renderings.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا

english.text: [from] the Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the Most Compassionate; none will dare to speak to Him[11].
english.footnotes: [11] None can ask or plead on the Day of Judgment except by Allah's permission.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Seigneur des cieux, de la terre et de ce qui se trouve entre eux, le Tout Miséricordieux, auquel nul n’osera s’adresser.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا

english.text: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows; none will dare to speak, except those to whom the Most Compassionate granted permission, and they will only speak the truth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, l’Esprit[7] et les anges se tiendront en rangs et nul ne pourra prendre la parole[8] sauf celui qui en aura été autorisé par le Tout Miséricordieux et qui ne prononcera que des paroles de vérité.
french.footnotes:
[7] L’ange Gabriel, selon la majorité des commentateurs.
[8] Pour intercéder, expliquent nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

english.text: That Day is sure to come. So whoever wills may seek a path leading to his Lord[12].
english.footnotes: [12] i.e., the path of guidance and righteous deeds.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour arrivera inéluctablement ! Que celui qui le désire revienne donc à son Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا

english.text: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment on the Day when everyone will see what his hands have sent forth[13], and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish that I were dust!”
english.footnotes: [13] i.e., the deeds he did in this world.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous vous avons mis en garde contre un châtiment imminent, le Jour où l’homme verra ses œuvres et où le mécréant s’exclamera : « Si seulement je n’étais que poussière ! »

renderings.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا

english.text: By those who pull out [evil souls][1] harshly,
english.footnotes: [1] Of the disbelievers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ceux qui arrachent les âmes[1] violemment !
french.footnotes: [1] Des mécréants.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا

english.text: and by those who draw out [good souls][2] gently,
english.footnotes: [2] Of the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ceux qui recueillent les âmes[2] délicatement !
french.footnotes: [2] Des croyants.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا

english.text: and by those who glide swiftly[3],
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., angels glide swiftly through the heavens and earth with Allah’s command.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par ceux qui glissent vélocement !

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ

english.text: Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ton Seigneur observe les hommes attentivement.

renderings.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ

english.text: As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[5]!”

english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

renderings.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ

english.text: No indeed[6]! You are not kind to the orphan,
english.footnotes: [6] It is not as you think. Allah puts people to test through prosperity and hardship and rewards their gratitude and patience in the Hereafter.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Non ! C’est plutôt que vous ne traitez pas l’orphelin avec bonté

english.text: nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.text: No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.text: Join My [righteous] slaves,

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Joins-toi à Mes serviteurs vertueux,

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: entre dans Mon Paradis avec eux ! »

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: où tu pourras agir en toute liberté !

english.text: and by every parent[2] and his offspring,
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., Adam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le père[2] et sa postérité !
french.footnotes: [2] De l’humanité, Adam, précisent nombre d’exégètes ou par le « père des prophètes », Abraham, selon d’autres qui font remarquer qu’un lien étroit lie Abraham à la Mecque mentionnée peu avant. D’autres encore pensent que ce verset se rapporte à tout père de famille et sa descendance.

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons créé l’homme pour une vie d’adversité.

renderings.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ

english.text: Does he think that none can ever have power over him?

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pense-t-il que nul ne pourra le soumettre à son autorité[3] ?

renderings.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا

english.text: He says, “I have squandered enormous wealth!”
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il se vante d’avoir dépensé sans compter.

renderings.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

english.text: Does he think that no one sees him?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Pense-t-il vraiment que nul ne l’a remarqué ?

english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne l’avons-Nous pas doté de deux yeux,

english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: mais aussi d’une langue et de deux lèvres ?

english.text: and shown him the two ways [of right and wrong]?

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne lui avons-Nous pas indiqué les deux voies[4] ?

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Si seulement il s’engageait dans la voie, si difficile, de son salut !

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais qui pourrait t’indiquer en quoi consiste cette voie si ardue ?

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: un proche parent orphelin

english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ou un pauvre dans le besoin,
