renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ

english.text: and proclaim the favors of your Lord[3].
english.footnotes: [3] i.e., be grateful to Allah by proclaiming the favors He has given you.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et proclame les grâces de ton Seigneur hautement !

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ

english.text: Have We not reassured your heart for you [O Prophet][1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., enlighten and gladden your heart for receiving the revelation.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’avons-Nous pas épanoui ton cœur,

renderings.arabic: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ

english.text: and relieved you of your burden[2]
english.footnotes: [2] forgave your previous or future errors, or relieved you of the anxiety you experienced at the beginning of your mission.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: te soulageant ainsi de ce fardeau

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ

english.text: that weighed down your back,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui pesait si lourdement sur ton dos ?

renderings.arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ

english.text: and raised high your fame for you[3]?
english.footnotes: [3] Allah raised the Prophet's name in numerous ways, such as his name is mentioned twice in the call to prayer five times a day, as well the second call to prayer; at the end of each of the five daily prayers; believers invoke Allah’s blessings upon him and his family; and upon reverting to Islam, his name is mentioned, etc.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’avons-Nous pas rehaussé ton renom ?

renderings.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا

english.text: For indeed, with hardship comes ease[4],
english.footnotes: [4] In Arabic grammar, if a definite noun is repeated, it is referring to the same thing. However, if an indefinite noun is repeated, it is referring to two different things. So here in this and the coming verse they refer to one hardship (a definite noun) and two eases (an indefinite noun), which manifests Allah's favors upon His servants even in times of hardships.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Sache qu’il n’est d’épreuve qui ne soit suivie d’une délivrance.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا

english.text: indeed, with hardship comes ease.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Oui, il n’est pas d’épreuve qui ne soit suivie d’une délivrance.

renderings.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ

english.text: So whenever you are free[5], strive in worship,
english.footnotes: [5] Of your duties.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Une fois donc libéré de tes occupations, consacre-toi au culte avec ferveur,

renderings.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب

english.text: and turn to your Lord in devotion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: te tournant sincèrement vers ton Seigneur, convoitant humblement Ses faveurs.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ

english.text: By the fig and the olive[1],
english.footnotes: [1] Of Jerusalem.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le figuier et l’olivier !

renderings.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

english.text: and by Mount Sinai[2],
english.footnotes: [2] Of Egypt.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par le mont Sinaï !

renderings.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ

english.text: and by this secure city [of Makkah][3],
english.footnotes: [3] This passage refers to the land of the three great prophets of Allah: Jesus (ﷺ) lived in the land of figs and olives, Moses (ﷺ) communicated with Allah on Mount Sinai, and Muhammad's (ﷺ) birthplace was Makkah. There is a similar reference in Deuteronomy 33:1, [Moses said:] “The Lord came from Sinai. Rising from Seir upon us, and he shone forth from Mount Paran.” Seir is a mountain near Jerusalem, and Paran is a mountain near Makkah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par cette cité sûre[1] !
french.footnotes: [1] Le « figuier et l’olivier » désignent, selon Ibn Kathîr, Jérusalem, ville où Jésus a prêché l’Evangile. Rappelons qu’une colline bien connue porte dans cette ville le nom de « mont des Oliviers ». Le « mont Sinaï » est le lieu où le Seigneur s’est adressé à Moïse. Quant à la « cité sûre », il s’agit de la Mecque, ville natale de Mouhammad où une partie du Coran - dont justement cette sourate - a été révélée. Le Seigneur jure donc ici par trois lieux hautement symboliques pour les trois religions révélées, lieux où s’est glorieusement manifestée Sa révélation.

renderings.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ

english.text: Surely We have created man in the best form[4],
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., in upright and balanced form and nature.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous avons créé l’homme en le dotant de la nature la plus pure[2],
french.footnotes: [2] Une nature le disposant à adorer son Seigneur sans Lui associer d’autres divinités. Allah dit par ailleurs : « Tourne-toi donc, en monothéiste pur et sincère, vers la vraie religion, la religion naturelle à laquelle Allah a prédisposé les hommes » (sourate 30, verset 30).

renderings.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ

english.text: then We will reduce him to the lowest of the low[5],
english.footnotes: [5] i.e., to the depths of Hell due to deviation from uprightness; or to decrepit old age.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: avant de lui faire connaître la plus infâme déchéance[3].
french.footnotes: [3] En le laissant pervertir sa nature et renier son Créateur.

renderings.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ

english.text: except those who believe and do righteous deeds; they will have a never-ending reward.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: A l’exception de ceux qui croient et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres, auxquels est réservée une récompense dont ils ne seront jamais privés.

renderings.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ

english.text: Then, what makes you deny the Judgment Day?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’est-ce qui peut, après cela, vous faire encore douter du Jugement dernier ?

renderings.arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ

english.text: Is not Allah the Most Just of all judges?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah n’est-Il pas le plus équitable et le plus sage des juges ?

renderings.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ

english.text: Read in the name of your Lord Who created,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lis au nom de ton Seigneur qui a créé,

renderings.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ

english.text: created man from a clinging clot.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qui a créé l’homme d’un corps accroché[1].
french.footnotes: [1] A l’utérus de la femme.

renderings.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ

english.text: Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lis ! Ton Seigneur est toute bonté,

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ

english.text: Who taught by the pen,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lui qui, par le calame, a enseigné[2],
french.footnotes: [2] L’écriture.

renderings.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ

english.text: taught man what he did not know[1].
english.footnotes: [1] These five verses (1-5) are the first ever verses revealed of the Qur’an. The Prophet (ﷺ) was retreating at a cave in the outskirts of Makkah when the angel Gabriel appeared before him, and ordered him to read. Since the Prophet (ﷺ) was unlettered, he would respond, “I cannot read.” Gabriel would then squeeze him tightly and order him again to read. Ultimately, Gabriel said to him: “Read in the name of your Lord …”.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: apprenant à l’homme ce qu’il ignorait.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ

english.text: Indeed, man transgresses
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais en vérité l’homme se montre hautain

renderings.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ

english.text: when he deems himself to be self-sufficient.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dès qu’il se croit au-dessus du besoin,

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ

english.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: oubliant qu’il fera retour à ton Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ

english.text: Have you seen the one who prevents[2]
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., Abu Jahl was a pagan leader of the Makkah who was an arch-enemy of Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: N’as-tu pas vu cet impie qui prétend interdire

renderings.arabic: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

english.text: a slave [of Allah] from praying[3]?
english.footnotes: [3] Abu Jahl abused the Prophet (ﷺ) when he prayed in the Holy Mosque.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: à un serviteur d’Allah d’accomplir la prière,

renderings.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

english.text: What if this [slave] is rightly guided,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: alors qu’il se contente de suivre le droit chemin

renderings.arabic: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ

english.text: and enjoins righteousness?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et d’inciter les hommes à craindre Allah,

renderings.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

english.text: How about the one who denies and turns away[4]?
english.footnotes: [4] From what the Prophet (ﷺ) has brought and does he not fear Allah?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: tandis que cet impie renie la vérité et se détourne de la foi ?

renderings.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

english.text: Does he not know that Allah is watching all?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne sait-il donc pas qu’Allah le voit ?

renderings.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

english.text: No indeed; if he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock[5]
english.footnotes: [5] To the Hellfire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: S’il ne cesse pas, Nous le traînerons par le toupet[3],
french.footnotes: [3] En Enfer.

renderings.arabic: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ

english.text: a lying, sinful forelock[6].
english.footnotes: [6] It alludes to the frontal lobe of the brain, where reasoning is processed.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: le toupet d’un menteur et d’un pécheur invétéré.

renderings.arabic: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

english.text: So let him call his associates;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’il fasse alors appel à tous ses partisans.

renderings.arabic: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ

english.text: We will call the wardens of Hellfire[7].
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., the coarse, rigorous, and harsh angels assigned for the Hellfire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous ferons appel aux anges du châtiment.

renderings.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩

english.text: No indeed; do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne l’écoute pas ! Mais, par la prière, rapproche-toi[4] !
french.footnotes: [4] Du Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ

english.text: Indeed, We sent this [Qur’an] down on the Night of Decree[1].
english.footnotes: [1] The Qur’an was first revealed completely to the lowest heaven on this night. Also, its revelation on the Prophet (ﷺ) started on this night.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Nous l’avons révélé[1] au cours de la Nuit des décrets divins[2].
french.footnotes:
[1] Le Coran, dont la révélation a débuté au cours de cette nuit bénie.
[2] Connue comme étant la « Nuit du destin » et située au mois de Ramadan. Le terme arabe « Qadr » traduit ici par « décrets divins » revêt un second sens : il signifie que cette nuit est sublime et d’une très grande valeur.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ

english.text: How do you know what the Night of Decree is?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais qui pourrait t’indiquer ce qu’est la Nuit des décrets divins ?

renderings.arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ

english.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La Nuit des décrets divins est plus bénie que mille mois réunis[3].
french.footnotes: [3] Les œuvres accomplies lors de cette nuit sont plus méritoires que celles de mille mois.

renderings.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ

english.text: On that night the angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend by their Lord’s permission with all decrees[2].
english.footnotes: [2] Bringing down the exact provisions, life, death, and other things destined for the creatures for the coming year by Allah's permission.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Porteurs de tous les arrêts divins[4], les anges et l’Esprit[5] descendent sur ordre de leur Seigneur au cours de cette nuit.
french.footnotes:
[4] Relatifs à l’année à venir, expliquent les commentateurs. Voir sourate 44, versets 3-5.
[5] L’ange Gabriel, selon la majorité des exégètes.

renderings.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ

english.text: It is all peace[3] until the break of dawn.
english.footnotes: [3] Upon the believers.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: C’est une nuit remplie de paix et de bénédiction jusqu’à l’apparition de l’aube.

renderings.arabic: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ

english.text: Those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist [from disbelief][1] until there came to them clear proof,
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., and from deviant ways.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants, parmi les gens du Livre et les idolâtres, ne pouvaient[1] renoncer à leurs croyances avant d’avoir reçu une preuve d’une grande clarté :
french.footnotes: [1] Selon leurs prétentions, précisent certains commentateurs.

renderings.arabic: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ

english.text: a messenger from Allah, reciting pure pages[2]
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., that contains no falsehood.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: l’avènement d’un Messager envoyé par Allah leur récitant des feuillets d’une grande pureté,

renderings.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ

english.text: containing upright commandments.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: renfermant des enseignements d’une parfaite justice, d’une infinie sagesse et d’une indéniable authenticité[2].
french.footnotes: [2] Or, ils n’ont pas renoncé à leur impiété, malgré l’avènement de ce Messager annoncé par leurs Ecritures.

renderings.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ

english.text: Yet those who were given the Scripture did not disagree[3] except after the clear proof came to them,
english.footnotes: [3] Into different sects and denominations.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Or, ceux qui ont reçu les Ecritures ne se sont divisés qu’après avoir reçu une preuve d’une grande clarté,

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ

english.text: although they were commanded only to worship Allah with sincere devotion to Him, being inclined to the true faith, and to establish prayer and give zakah; that is the true religion.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: un livre leur ordonnant simplement d’adorer Allah en Lui vouant un culte exclusif et sincère, d’accomplir la prière et de faire la charité, professant ainsi la religion de vérité.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ

english.text: Those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding therein forever. It is they who are the worst of creatures.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Les mécréants, parmi les gens du Livre et les idolâtres, sont donc voués au feu de la Géhenne où ils demeureront pour l’éternité. Voilà les êtres les plus abjects de l’humanité.

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ

english.text: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds – it is they who are the best of creatures.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à ceux qui croient et accomplissent de bonnes œuvres, ce sont les êtres les plus nobles de l’humanité.

renderings.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ

english.text: Their reward with their Lord is Gardens of Eternity under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is for those who fear their Lord.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: En récompense de leur foi, ils seront admis auprès de leur Seigneur dans les jardins d’Eden traversés de rivières, entièrement satisfaits d’Allah qui sera Lui-même satisfait d’eux. Voilà comment ceux qui craignent leur Seigneur seront récompensés pour l’éternité.

renderings.arabic: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا

english.text: When the earth is shaken with a mighty quake,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Lorsque la terre subira une violente secousse,

renderings.arabic: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا

english.text: and the earth throws out its burdens[1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., its dead bodies and treasures.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: au point de rejeter ses fardeaux à sa surface[1],
french.footnotes: [1] Les morts enterrés en son sein, qui sortiront de terre le Jour de la résurrection.

renderings.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا

english.text: and man says[2], “What is the matter with it?”
english.footnotes: [2] In terror and astonishment.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que l’homme se demandera ce qui lui arrive,

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا

english.text: On that Day it will recount all its news,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ce Jour-là, elle livrera l’ensemble de ses secrets[2],
french.footnotes: [2] Les œuvres, bonnes ou mauvaises, accomplies à la surface de la terre par les hommes, selon nombre d’exégètes.

renderings.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا

english.text: because your Lord has inspired it [to do so].
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: se pliant ainsi à la volonté de ton Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

english.text: On that Day all people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds[3].
english.footnotes: [3] From the place of Judgment to see the consequences of their deeds, whether to Paradise or to Hell.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, les hommes quitteront séparément le lieu de leur rassemblement afin que chacun découvre la rétribution de ses œuvres.

renderings.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ

english.text: So whoever does an atom’s weight[4] of good will see it,
english.footnotes: [4] Or a small ant’s weight.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quiconque aura accompli une once de bien le verra.

renderings.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ

english.text: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et quiconque aura commis une once de mal le verra.

renderings.arabic: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحٗا

english.text: By the galloping, panting horses[1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., those horses that fight for the cause of Allah as they race to attack the enemy.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Par les chevaux au galop haletant

renderings.arabic: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحٗا

english.text: striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][2],
english.footnotes: [2] While galloping over rocky terrain.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: dont les fers font jaillir des étincelles

renderings.arabic: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحٗا

english.text: launching raids at dawn[3],
english.footnotes: [3] While the enemy is unaware of their raid.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: lorsqu’ils chargent au point du jour

renderings.arabic: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعٗا

english.text: stirring up thereby clouds of dust,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: en soulevant un nuage de poussière

renderings.arabic: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا

english.text: plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[4],
english.footnotes: [4] i.e., penetrating into the ranks of the enemy as a surprise attack.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: au moment de se jeter dans la mêlée !

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٞ

english.text: indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[5] –
english.footnotes: [5] disobeying Him by not spending in the cause of Allah from what He has given him and commanded him to spend accordingly.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: L’homme en vérité est ingrat envers son Seigneur,

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٞ

english.text: and he himself is a witness to that[6] –
english.footnotes: [6] By his words and actions.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: ingratitude qu’il reconnaît lui-même d’ailleurs,

renderings.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

english.text: and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il voue aux biens terrestres un amour des plus ardents.

renderings.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ

english.text: Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ne sait-il pas que les tombes seront vidées de leurs occupants

renderings.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ

english.text: and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[7]?
english.footnotes: [7] i.e., when all secrets of the hearts and faiths are made known.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que les secrets des cœurs seront étalés au grand jour ?

renderings.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ

english.text: Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[8].
english.footnotes: [8] Nothing of their affairs will be hidden from Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, leur Seigneur les jugera en connaissance de cause.

renderings.arabic: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

english.text: The Striking Calamity!
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Le Grand choc !

renderings.arabic: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

english.text: What is the Striking Calamity?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qu’est-ce que le Grand choc ?

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

english.text: How do you know what the Striking Calamity is?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Qui pourrait t’indiquer ce qu’est le Grand choc ?

renderings.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ

english.text: On that Day people will be like scattered moths[1],
english.footnotes: [1] After having been thrown out of their graves.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ce Jour-là, les hommes s’éparpilleront comme des papillons[1],
french.footnotes: [1] Ou : des sauterelles.

renderings.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ

english.text: and the mountains will be like carded wool[2].
english.footnotes: [2] As they disintegrate.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et les montagnes auront, des flocons de laine cardée, la légèreté.

renderings.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

english.text: Then the one whose scales of good deeds are heavy,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Celui dont la balance penchera du bon côté,

renderings.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ

english.text: will have a pleasant life[3].
english.footnotes: [3] In Paradise.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: jouira au Paradis d’une éternelle félicité.

renderings.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

english.text: But the one whose scales of good deeds are light,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Quant à celui dont la balance penchera du mauvais côté,

renderings.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٞ

english.text: his abode will be the abyss[4].
english.footnotes: [4] Hāwiyah: the pit of Hellfire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: il sera, dans l’Abîme, violemment précipité.

renderings.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ

english.text: And how do you know what it is?
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Mais qui pourrait te décrire sa réalité ?

renderings.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ

english.text: It is a Blazing Fire.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Un feu ardent à jamais attisé !

renderings.arabic: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

english.text: Competition for worldly gains distracts you [from Allah],
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: La course aux richesses ne cessera de vous accaparer,

renderings.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ

english.text: until you come to your graves.

french.text: Lorsque, t’apportant Son secours, Allah te fera triompher[1]
french.footnotes: [1] De tes ennemis, par la conquête de la Mecque.

renderings.arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا

english.text: and you see people entering Allah’s religion in multitudes,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: et que tu verras les hommes embrasser la religion d’Allah par groupes entiers,

renderings.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا

english.text: then glorify the praise of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: célèbre, par les louanges, la gloire de ton Seigneur et implore Son pardon. Il accepte toujours le repentir de Ses serviteurs dévoués.

renderings.arabic: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ

english.text: May the hands of Abu Lahab[1] perish, and may he perish!
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Prophet's uncle, who was one of the staunchest enemies of Islam.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Que soit perdu Abou Lahab ! Et il est bel et bien perdu.

renderings.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

english.text: Neither his wealth nor his worldly gains will avail him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Ses richesses et ses œuvres ne lui seront d’aucune utilité.

renderings.arabic: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ

english.text: He will burn in a Flaming Fire,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il brûlera dans un feu aux flammes à jamais attisées,

renderings.arabic: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ

english.text: and so will his wife[2], the carrier of firewood,
english.footnotes: [2] i.e., ’Um Jamīl, who used to throw thorny branches in the Prophet's way and she used to slander him (ﷺ). The word hatab (firewood) was used by the Arabs to allude to slander and backbiting.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: de même que sa femme qui, de ronces, chargée[1],
french.footnotes: [1] Ronces qu’elle jetait sur la route empruntée par le Messager.

renderings.arabic: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلٞ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ

english.text: around her neck will be a rope of palm fiber[3].
english.footnotes: [3] This surah was one of the earliest surahs revealed in Makkah, yet Abu Lahab persisted in disbelief. For him to disprove the Qur’an, all he had to do was to accept Islam, for the Qur’an condemned him to Hell.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: porte autour du cou une corde de fibres tressées.

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

english.text: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
english.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « Allah est la seule et unique divinité.

renderings.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

english.text: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[2].
english.footnotes: [2] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Allah est le Maître dont nul ne peut se passer[1].
french.footnotes: [1] Celui vers lequel se tournent toutes les créatures afin qu’Il réponde à leurs besoins.

renderings.arabic: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ

english.text: He neither begets nor is He begotten,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Il n’a pas engendré, ni été Lui-même engendré.

renderings.arabic: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ

english.text: and there is none comparable to Him.”[3]
english.footnotes: [3] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Et nul dans Sa création n’est à même de L’égaler. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ

english.text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « J’implore la protection du Seigneur de l’aube,

renderings.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

english.text: from the harm of all what He has created;
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: contre le mal qui se trouve dans ce qu’Il a créé,

renderings.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

english.text: from the harm of darkening [night] when it spreads around,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: contre le mal de la nuit qui étend son obscurité,

renderings.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ

english.text: from the harm of the sorceresses[1] who blow on knots,
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., magicians.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: contre le charme maléfique de tous les sorciers[1],
french.footnotes: [1] Littéralement : contre le mal des sorcières qui soufflent dans les nœuds.

renderings.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

english.text: and from the harm of the envier when he envies."
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: contre l’envieux qui donne libre cours à sa méchanceté. »

renderings.arabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

english.text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dis : « J’implore la protection du Seigneur des hommes,

renderings.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

english.text: the Sovereign of mankind[1],
english.footnotes: [1] i.e., the King of mankind.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Maître des hommes,

renderings.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

english.text: the God of mankind,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: Dieu des hommes,

renderings.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ

english.text: from the harm of the lurking whisperer[2],
english.footnotes: [2] Which disappears when one remembers Allah.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: contre le mal du démon qui se dérobe[1] ou s’insinue chez l’homme[2],
french.footnotes:
[1] Lorsque l’homme se souvient de son Seigneur et invoque Son nom.
[2] Lorsque l’homme se montre insouciant et oublie son Seigneur.

renderings.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

english.text: who whispers into the hearts of mankind,
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: soufflant d’insidieuses pensées dans le cœur des hommes,

renderings.arabic: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

english.text: from among jinn and mankind[3].”
english.footnotes: [3] Evil prompters and whisperers can be from jinn or from men.
english.source: QuranEnc — English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
english.publisher_description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

french.text: qu’il soit du nombre des djinns ou du nombre des hommes. »
